HP_0020085.label: infection following live vaccination
HP_0020085.definition: An infection resulting from live attenuated vaccines (LAV), that is, a vaccine prepared from living viruses or bacteria that have been weakened under laboratory conditions. LAV vaccines will replicate in a vaccinated individual and produce an immune response but usually cause mild or no disease. are derived from disease-causing pathogens.

HP_0020086.label: bcgitis
HP_0020086.definition: Local or regional infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination.

HP_0020087.label: bcgosis
HP_0020087.definition: Distant, or disseminated infection with Bacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination associated with failure to contain thebacillus Calmette-Guerin (BCG) following vaccination leading to spread of BCG to many sites in the body. The tuberculosis vaccine BCG contains live attenuated Mycobacterium bovis.
HP_0020087.synonyms: bcgiosis | disseminated bacillus calmette - guerin infection

HP_0020088.label: post - vaccination measles
HP_0020088.definition: Infection with the measles virus of the live-attenuated vaccine. This is an extremely rare event and may indicate immunocompromise in some cases.
HP_0020088.UMLS synonyms: Post measles vaccination encephalitis | Measles post vaccine | Primary immunodeficiency with post-measles-mumps-rubella vaccine viral infection

HP_0020089.label: post - vaccination rubella
HP_0020089.definition: Infection with the rubella virus of the live-attenuated vaccine.
HP_0020089.UMLS synonyms: Post rubella vaccination encephalitis | Primary immunodeficiency with post-measles-mumps-rubella vaccine viral infection

HP_0020090.label: post - vaccination polio
HP_0020090.definition: Infection with live attenuated polio vaccine following vaccination. This is an extremely rare event that may indicate immunocompromise.
HP_0020090.UMLS synonyms: Post polio vaccination encephalitis | Post-school administration of poliomyelitis and tetanus vaccine

HP_0020091.label: post - vaccination rotavirus infection
HP_0020091.definition: Infection with live attenuated rotavirus vaccine following vaccination.

HP_0020093.label: recurrent deep organ abscess formation
HP_0020093.definition: Repeated episodes of the formation of abscesses in organs. An abscess is a circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the parenchyma or an organ.

HP_0020095.label: prolonged need of intravenous antibiotic therapy
HP_0020095.definition: Clinical assessment of a requirement to treat with intravenous antibiotics over an unusually prolonged period of time.

HP_0020096.label: recurrent streptococcal infections
HP_0020096.definition: Increased susceptibility to streptococcal infections, as manifested by recurrent episodes of streptococcal infections.
HP_0020096.UMLS synonyms: recurrent group A beta-hemolytic streptococcal infections

HP_0020097.label: infection due to encapsulated bacteria
HP_0020097.definition: An infection by an encapsulated bacterial agent. Isolates which cause invasive disease are usually surrounded by a polysaccharide capsule, which is a major virulence factor and the key antigen in protective protein-polysaccharide conjugate vaccines.

HP_0020099.label: severe norovirus infection
HP_0020099.definition: An unusually severe course of infection with Human norovirus, previously known as Norwalk virus. Norovirus, an RNA virus of the family Caliciviridae, is a human enteric pathogen. Norovirus infection-associated illness may also be more prolonged and severe in immunocompromised individuals and may be associated with remarkably persistent viral excretion in some of these individuals.

HP_0020100.label: unusual fungal infection
HP_0020100.definition: An unusual fungal infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a fungal agent.

HP_0020101.label: invasive fungal infection
HP_0020101.definition: Fungal infection characterized by invasion of host tissues.

HP_0020102.label: pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia
HP_0020102.definition: An opportunistic disease caused by invasion of unicellular fungus Pneumocystis jirovecii. Transmission of P. jirovecii cysts takes place through the airborne route, and usually, its presence in lungs is asymptomatic. However, people with impaired immunity, especially those with CD4+ T cell count below 200/microliter, are still at risk of the development of Pneumocystis pneumonia due to P. jirovecii invasion. Symptoms induced by this disease are not specific: progressive dyspnoea, non-productive cough, low-grade fever, arterial partial pressure of oxygen below 65 mmHg, and chest radiographs demonstrating bilateral, interstitial shadowing.
HP_0020102.UMLS synonyms: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis | Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia | History of Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia | Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis prescribed | aerosol inhalation of pentamidine for Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia | AIDS-Related Pneumocystis Pneumonia | Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia prophylaxis prescribed within three months of low CD4+ count/percentage

HP_0020103.label: invasive pulmonary aspergillosis
HP_0020103.definition: Infection of the lungs with aspergillus. In the respiratory mucosa, the spores may germinate into hyphae, which in turn can invade the mucosa leading to invasive pulmonary aspergillosis.
HP_0020103.UMLS synonyms: Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis | Refractory Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis | pulmonary; aspergillosis, invasive (manifestation) | Chronic Necrotizing Pulmonary Aspergillosis

HP_0020104.label: unusual protozoan infection
HP_0020104.definition: An unusual protozoan infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a protozoal agent.

HP_0020105.label: severe toxoplasmosis
HP_0020105.definition: Toxoplasmosis is a widespread parasitic infection that is frequently asymptomatic in immunocompetent patients. However, this obligate intracellular protozoan parasite can evade the immune system and persist for the life of its host in cyst form, predominantly in the brain, retina, and muscles. Reactivation of latent cysts may occur when the immune system fails to maintain cytokine pressure, which mainly relies on gamma interferon (IFN-gamma). Toxoplasmosis is a life-threatening infection in immunocompromised patients (ICPs).

HP_0020106.label: severe giardiasis
HP_0020106.definition: An unusually severe infection due to Giardia lamblia, also called Giardia duodenalis or Giardia intestinalis, which is a protozoan parasite of the small intestine that causes extensive morbidity worldwide.

HP_0020107.label: unusual helminthic infection
HP_0020107.definition: An unusual helminthic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a worm (helminth).

HP_0020108.label: unusual parasitic infection
HP_0020108.definition: An unusual parasitic infection that is regarded as a sign of a pathological susceptibility to infection by a parasite.

HP_0020110.label: bone fracture
HP_0020110.definition: A partial or complete breakage of the continuity of a bone.
HP_0020110.UMLS synonyms: Fracture | Metatarsal bone fracture | Fracture of carpal bone | Fracture of bone of face | Long-bone fracture | Fracture of frontal bone | Fracture of parietal bone (disorder) | Fracture of metacarpal bone | Fracture of temporal bone | Fracture of sphenoid bone | Petrous bone fracture | fracture of hyoid bone | Fracture of scaphoid bone of wrist | Fracture of ethmoid bone | Bone spur fracture | Pathological bone fracture | fracture of innominate bone | Fracture of lunate bone of wrist | Fracture of tarsal bone | Fracture of occipital bone | Fracture of first metacarpal bone | Epiphyseal fracture of bone | Fracture of pisiform bone of wrist | Fracture of sesamoid bone | Fracture of lacrimal bone

HP_0020111.label: abnormal cd4+cd25+ regulatory t cell proportion
HP_0020111.definition: A deviation from the normal proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.

HP_0020112.label: increased proportion of cd4+cd25+ regulatory t cells
HP_0020112.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.
HP_0020112.synonyms: elevated proportion of cd4+cd25+ regulatory t cells | increased proportion of cd4+cd25+ treg cells

HP_0020113.label: decreased proportion of cd4+cd25+ regulatory t cells
HP_0020113.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of CD4-positive, CD25-positive, alpha-beta regulatory T cells in circulation, relative to another population of cells.
HP_0020113.synonyms: decreased proportion of cd4+cd25+ treg cells | reduced proportion of cd4+cd25+ regulatory t cells

HP_0020114.label: persistent human papillomavirus infection
HP_0020114.definition: Human papillomaviruses (HPVs) are small oncogenic viruses. HPV has been shown to cause a variety of lesions and malignancies, which predominantly affect the anogenital region. Low-risk, non-oncogenic HPV types are associated with anogenital warts and recurrent respiratory papillomatosis while high-risk, oncogenic types are associated with cervical, penile, anal, vaginal, vulvar, and oropharyngeal cancers. Infection with anogenital HPV is usually asymptomatic and resolves spontaneously without consequences in the immunocompetent host. When disease does occur, the most common manifestation is genital warts, which may be small papules, or flat, smooth or pedunculated lesions. This resolution of HPV lesions is not generally seen in the immunosuppressed, resulting in severe, persistent and extensive manifestations of HPV disease.
HP_0020114.synonyms: chronic hpv infection | persistent hpv infection

HP_0020117.label: hypoplastic dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
HP_0020117.definition: Underdeveloped hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin.

HP_0020118.label: radial artery aplasia
HP_0020118.definition: Congenital absence of the radial artery.

HP_0020119.label: abnormal retinal nerve fiber layer morphology
HP_0020119.definition: A structural abnormality of the retinal nerve fiber layer
HP_0020119.synonyms: abnormal retinal nerve fibre layer morphology

HP_0020120.label: retinal nerve fiber edema
HP_0020120.definition: Swelling (edema) of the retinal nerve fibers.

HP_0020121.label: conception by assisted reproductive technology
HP_0020121.definition: A history of conception by an assisted reproductive technology such as in vitro fertilization (IVF), intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), and cryopreservation.

HP_0020122.label: bite cells
HP_0020122.definition: Red blood cells that appear to have parts of them bitten away.
HP_0020122.UMLS synonyms: Bite cells (finding) | Bite cell (cell) | RBC morphology - bite cells | Bite cells | Blood | Hematology and Cell counts | Bite cells:PrThr:Pt:Bld:Ord:Microscopy.light | Bite Cell Count (procedure) | Bite Cell to Erythrocyte Ratio Measurement

HP_0020123.label: tympanosclerosis
HP_0020123.definition: A stiffening of the tympanic membrane due to calcification, typically presents as white plaque-like lesions, involving discrete regions of the tympanic membrane and/or middle ear.
HP_0020123.UMLS synonyms: Tympanosclerosis | Bilateral tympanosclerosis | Intratympanic Tympanosclerosis | tympanosclerosis of left ear | tympanosclerosis of right ear | Tympanosclerosis involving tympanic membrane only | tympanosclerosis of both ears | Tympanosclerosis of left middle ear | Tympanosclerosis of right middle ear | Tympanosclerosis involving tympanic membrane AND ear ossicles | Tympanosclerosis involving other combination of structures | Tympanosclerosis involving tympanic membrane, ear ossicles AND middle ear

HP_0020125.label: spontaneous conjunctival filtering bleb
HP_0020125.definition: Avascular cystic elevations of the superior conjunctiva not related to ocular surgery or trauma.
HP_0020125.synonyms: conjunctival avascular cysts ( filtering blebs ) | spontaneous filtering bleb

HP_0020126.label: prostate mass
HP_0020126.definition: A lump detected in the prostate. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction.

HP_0020127.label: periarticular soft - tissue mass
HP_0020127.definition: A lump detected in the region that surrounds a joint. In this context, mass is a general term for a lump or growth that may be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes, or an immune reaction.

HP_0020128.label: aplasia of the olfactory tract
HP_0020128.definition: Aplasia (congenital absence) of the olfactory tract, which causes anosmia, a complete loss of the sense of smell.

HP_0020129.label: abnormal urine protein level
HP_0020129.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of one or more proteins in the urine.

HP_0020130.label: increased urinary neutrophil gelatinase - associated lipocalin
HP_0020130.definition: An increased concentration of neutrophil gelatinase-associated lipocalin in the urine (there is no generally accepted threshold, but some studies choose a threshold of above 150 nanogram per milliliter).

HP_0020131.label: abnormal tubular basement membrane morphology
HP_0020131.definition: Abnormal structure of the basement membrane of the renal tubulus.

HP_0020132.label: thickening of the tubular basement membrane
HP_0020132.definition: Increase in thickness of the basement membrane of the tubulus of the kidney.

HP_0020133.label: podocyte hypertrophy
HP_0020133.definition: Increased visceral epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets.
HP_0020133.synonyms: glomerular visceral epithelial cell hypertrophy | hypertrophy of visceral epithelial cells

HP_0020134.label: increased urine neutrophil count
HP_0020134.definition: Abnormally increased count of neutrophils in urine.

HP_0020135.label: myofibromatosis
HP_0020135.definition: A mesenchymal neoplasm characterized by solitary or multiple nodules involving the skin, striated muscles, bones and, sometimes, viscera. It usually appears as a subcutaneous nodule, but can also appear as an ulcer, pedunculated lesion, or similar to a hemangioma. Histology shows well-circumscribed tapered cell lobes, resembling smooth muscle cells. At its center, perivascular round cells (hemangiopericitoides) are usually observed, giving a biphasic appearance.

HP_0020136.label: anticardiolipin igg antibody positivity
HP_0020136.definition: The presence of circulating IgG autoantibodies to cardiolipin.

HP_0020137.label: anticardiolipin igm antibody positivity
HP_0020137.definition: The presence of circulating IgM autoantibodies to cardiolipin.

HP_0020138.label: history of recent animal bite
HP_0020138.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an animal.

HP_0020139.label: history of recent insect bite
HP_0020139.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to an insect.

HP_0020140.label: history of recent tick bite
HP_0020140.definition: Medical history of a recent bite injury due to a tick.

HP_0020141.label: blood pressure substantially higher in legs than arms
HP_0020141.definition: An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the legs being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the arms. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm.
HP_0020141.synonyms: blood pressure substantially higher in lower than upper extremities | blood pressure substantially lower in arms than legs | blood pressure substantially lower in upper than lower extremities

HP_0020142.label: blood pressure substantially higher in arms than legs
HP_0020142.definition: An abnormal blood pressure discrepancy between the upper and lower extremities with the blood pressure measured in the arms being much higher than the blood pressure measure in the legs. In healthy individuals, ankle systolic blood pressures are only slightly higher than the systolic blood pressure measured in the arm.
HP_0020142.synonyms: blood pressure substantially higher in upper than lower extremities | increased arm - leg blood pressure gradient

HP_0020143.label: tracheal duplication cyst
HP_0020143.definition: A cyst in the trachea, whose wall is made up by tissue similar to the bronchial tree, including cartilage and smooth muscle, and is lined by secretory respiratory epithelium composed of cuboid or columnar ciliated epithelium.

HP_0020144.label: calcium phosphate crystalluria
HP_0020144.definition: The presence of calcium phosphate crystals in the urine.

HP_0020145.label: calcium oxalate crystalluria
HP_0020145.definition: The presence of calcium oxalate crystals in the urine.

HP_0020146.label: calcium carbonate crystalluria
HP_0020146.definition: The presence of calcium carbonate crystals in the urine.

HP_0020147.label: 2 - methylbutyryl glycinuria
HP_0020147.definition: Increased concentration of 2-methylbutyryl glycine in the urine.

HP_0020148.label: increased circulating mead acid level
HP_0020148.definition: An abnormally elevated concentration od mead acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0020149.label: elevated circulating succinate
HP_0020149.definition: An increase concentration of succinate in the blood circulation.

HP_0020150.label: elevated urinary uromodulin level
HP_0020150.definition: The concentration of uromodulin (also known as Tamm Horsfall protein) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0020150.synonyms: elevated urinary tamm - horsfall protein concentration

HP_0020151.label: anti - dsdna antibody positivity
HP_0020151.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against double-stranded DNA.

HP_0020152.label: distal joint hypermobility
HP_0020152.definition: Lack of stability of a distal joint (e.g., finger).
HP_0020152.UMLS synonyms: Distal joint hypermobility Proximal joint contractures

HP_0020153.label: positive blood 1,3 beta glucan test
HP_0020153.definition: Beta-1,3-glucan is a major constituent of all of the characterized fungal cell walls, making up between 30-80 percent of the mass of the wall. It is a biomarker of fungal infections such as invasive pulmonary aspergillosis.

HP_0020154.label: nevus comedonicus
HP_0020154.definition: A type of epidermal nevus characterized by closely arranged, dilated follicular openings with keratinous plugs resembling classical comedones.

HP_0020155.label: abnormal oocyte morphology
HP_0020155.definition: An abnormal structure of the female germ cell (egg cell).

HP_0020156.label: abnormal zona pellucida morphology
HP_0020156.definition: Abnormal structure of the oocyte extracellular matrix region known as teh zona pellucida.

HP_0020157.label: thin zona pellucida
HP_0020157.definition: Reduced thickness of the zona pellucida.
HP_0020157.UMLS synonyms: Oocytes have thin or absent zona pellucida

HP_0020158.label: increased circulating adrenic acid concentration
HP_0020158.definition: An increased concentration of adrenic acid (also known as cis-7,10,13,16-Docosatetraenoic acid) in the blood circulation.

HP_0020159.label: reduced response to gonadotropin - releasing hormone stimulation test
HP_0020159.definition: Failure of the gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) stimulation test to induce an appropriate increased in luteinizing hormone (LH), follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) levels.
HP_0020159.synonyms: reduce response to gnrh stimulation test

HP_0020161.label: branch retinal artery occlusion
HP_0020161.definition: Blockage of a branch of the retinal artery. This can cause loss of a section of visual field.
HP_0020161.UMLS synonyms: Branch Retinal Artery Occlusion | Occlusion of left branch retinal artery | Occlusion of right branch retinal artery | Retinal Artery Branch Occlusion, Left Eye | Retinal Artery Branch Occlusion, Right Eye | Retinal artery branch occlusion, unspecified eye | History of occlusion of branch retinal artery | Bilateral occlusion of branch retinal arteries | retinal vessels arterial occlusion branch inferior temporal | retinal vessels arterial occlusion branch superior nasal | retinal vessels arterial occlusion branch superior temporal | retinal vessels arterial occlusion branch inferior nasal

HP_0020163.label: cilioretinal artery occlusion
HP_0020163.definition: Blockage of the cilioretinal artery. The central retinal artery supplies the inner retina and the surface of the optic nerve. In some individuals, the cilioretinal artery, a branch of the ciliary circulation, may supply a portion of the retina including the macula. In cilioretinal artery occlusion, vision loss results from cell death in the inner retinal layers (mainly ganglion cells) despite relative sparing of the outer layers.

HP_0020164.label: ophthalmic artery occlusion
HP_0020164.definition: A partial or complete obstruction of the ophthalmic artery (branch of the internal carotid artery) that may lead to severe ischemia of the affected globe and associated ocular tissues. It can present with a similar picture to central retinal artery occlusion; however, profound choroidal ischaemia also occurs.

HP_0020165.label: branch retinal vein occlusion
HP_0020165.definition: Blockage of a branch of the retinal vein. It may present with sudden-onset of painless vision loss or visual field defect correlating to the area of perfusion of the obstructed vessels.

HP_0020166.label: central retinal vein occlusion
HP_0020166.definition: Central retinal vein occlusion is an occlusion of the main retinal vein posterior to the lamina cribrosa of the optic nerve and is typically caused by thrombosis.

HP_0020167.definition: A variant of central retinal vein occlusions that involves the superior or inferior half of the retina.

HP_0020169.label: abnormal drug response
HP_0020169.definition: An anomalous response to a medication related to individual variation in metabolic or immune response to drugs varying from potentially from potentially life-threatening adverse drug reactions to alteration of therapeutic efficacy.

HP_0020170.label: increased blood drug concentration
HP_0020170.definition: High plasma concentration of a drug as compared to previously measured thresholds given the expected concentration for the applied dosage regime.
