HP_0031203.label: fatty casts
HP_0031203.definition: A type of acellular urinary casts that contain lipid droplets, oval fat bodies or cholesterol crystals, and are often associated with the free forms of these elements. Their identification may require the use of polarised light microscopy, under which fatty particles embedded into the cast matrix appear as Maltese crosses.

HP_0031204.label: bacterial cell casts
HP_0031204.definition: A type of urinary cast that contain bacteria. Bacterial casts can be difficult to identify and can be distinguished from other types of casts using phase contrast microscopy. Bacterial casts are diagnostic of acute pyelonephritis or intrinsic renal infection.

HP_0031205.label: reduced lysosomal acid lipase activity
HP_0031205.definition: Reduction in the activity of lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) in the blood. Lysosomal lipase activity is measured. LAL hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters derived from cell internalization of plasma lipoproteins.

HP_0031206.label: striatal t2 hyperintensity
HP_0031206.definition: Abnormally bright T2 signal from the striatum on brain magnetic resonance imaging.
HP_0031206.UMLS synonyms: Striatal T2-weighted hyperintensities seen on MRI

HP_0031207.label: hepatic hemangioma
HP_0031207.definition: A congenital vascular malformation in the liver composed of masses of blood vessels that are atypical or irregular in arrangement and size.
HP_0031207.synonyms: hemangioma of the liver | liver hemangioma
HP_0031207.UMLS synonyms: Hemangioma of liver | Infantile hemangioma of liver | Liver Congenital Hemangioma | Hepatic haemangioma rupture | Arteriovenous malformation of liver

HP_0031208.label: increased pituitary glycoprotein hormone alpha subunit level
HP_0031208.definition: An increased concentration of circulating alpha polypeptide of glycoprotein hormones (NCBI Gene 1081). This alpha subunit is common to luteinizing hormone (LH) , follicle stimulating hormone (FSH) , thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) and human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), which are glycoprotein hormones composed of an identical alpha subunit together with a beta subunit that confers biological specificity. The alpha subunit is used as a marker for tumors that produce these hormones.
HP_0031208.synonyms: increased pituitary glycoprotein alpha subunit level | increased pituitary glycoprotein polypeptide alpha subunit level

HP_0031209.label: decreased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP_0031209.definition: Reduction in the level of lipoprotein lipase in the blood.

HP_0031210.label: abnormal circulating hyaluronic acid concentration
HP_0031210.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of hyaluronic acid in the blood.

HP_0031211.label: elevated cholesterol ester level
HP_0031211.definition: An elevated concentration of circulating cholesterol esters, which are fatty acid esters of cholesterol and make up about two-thirds of total plasma cholesterol.
HP_0031211.synonyms: elevated cholesteryl ester level | increased cholesterol esters | increased cholesteryl esters

HP_0031213.label: elevated circulating 17 - hydroxyprogesterone concentration
HP_0031213.definition: An increased level of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood. 17-hydroxyprogesterone is an intermediate steroid in the adrenal biosynthetic pathway from cholesterol to cortisol and is the substrate for steroid 21-hydroxylase.
HP_0031213.synonyms: elevated circulating 17 - hydroxyprogesterone | elevated circulating 17 - ohp

HP_0031215.label: decreased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone - sulfate concentration
HP_0031215.definition: A reduced concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood.

HP_0031216.label: increased circulating progesterone
HP_0031216.definition: An elevated concentration of progesterone in the blood.

HP_0031217.label: hot flashes
HP_0031217.definition: Sudden feelings of warmth that are generally most pronounced over the face, neck and chest.
HP_0031217.UMLS synonyms: Hot flushes | Hot Flashes, CTCAE | Hot Flashes Attenuation | Have Hot Flashes | Bothered by Hot Flashes | EPIC-26 - Hot Flashes | Hot flashes or chills | Hot and cold flashes | Hot Flashes or Flushes, CTCAE | Fever, Sweat, and Hot Flashes | sudden onset of hot flashes | gradual onset of hot flashes | hot flashes after recent orchiectomy | How Often Experienced Hot Flashes | Grade 1 Hot Flashes, CTCAE | Grade 3 Hot Flashes, CTCAE | Grade 2 Hot Flashes, CTCAE | anxiety with hot and cold flashes | hot flashes after recent gynecological surgery | PRO-CTCAE V1.0 - Hot Flashes Frequency | PRO-CTCAE V1.0 - Hot Flashes Severity | Grade 3 Hot Flashes or Flushes, CTCAE | Grade 1 Hot Flashes or Flushes, CTCAE | Grade 2 Hot Flashes or Flushes, CTCAE | How Big a Problem Are Hot Flashes

HP_0031218.label: inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
HP_0031218.definition: A state of increased circulating antidiuretic hormone despite hyponatremia and hypo-osmolality with normal or increased plasma volume.
HP_0031218.synonyms: inappropriate adh secretion | syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion
HP_0031218.UMLS synonyms: Paraneoplastic inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion | Inappropriate ADH Syndrome | Ectopic syndrome of inappropriate secretion of antidiuretic hormone

HP_0031219.label: reduced radioactive iodine uptake
HP_0031219.definition: A decreased amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.

HP_0031220.label: increased radioactive iodine uptake
HP_0031220.definition: An elevated amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.
HP_0031220.UMLS synonyms: Iodine radioactive uptake increased | Increased RAI (radioactive iodine) uptake

HP_0031221.label: abnormal radioactive iodine uptake test result
HP_0031221.definition: Any deviation from normal in the amount of uptake on the radioactive iodine uptake (RAIU) test, which utilizes a radioisotope of iodine to measure how much iodine the thyroid gland absorbs from the blood. The radioactive marker is measured 4-6 hours and in some cases also 24 hours after administration of the radioactive marker.

HP_0031222.label: increased circulating thyroxine - binding globulin level
HP_0031222.definition: An elevated concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood.
HP_0031222.synonyms: thyroxine - binding globulin high in blood

HP_0031223.label: focal pancreatic islet hyperplasia
HP_0031223.definition: Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans that affects only certain regions of the pancreas and not others.

HP_0031224.label: diffuse pancreatic islet hyperplasia
HP_0031224.definition: Hyperplasia of the islets of Langerhans with a generalized distribution.

HP_0031225.label: intrapulmonary shunt
HP_0031225.definition: Blood flow through a region of the lung in which little or no ventilation takes place, resulting in reduced oxygenation of the blood leaving the lungs.
HP_0031225.UMLS synonyms: Shunt intrapulmonary | Pulmonary vasculature | Specific hemodynamics | Shunt intrapulmonary:VRat:Pt:Pulmonary vasculature:Qn | Ventilation-perfusion inequality with intrapulmonary shunting and widened alveolar-arteriolar diffusion gradient | TEMPI syndrome

HP_0031226.label: perinephric fluid collection
HP_0031226.definition: An accumulation of fluid in one or more of the perinephric spaces, which consist of the subcapsular, perirenal, anterior and posterior pararenal spaces. This abnormality can be demonstrated by cross-sectional imaging, particularly computed tomography.
HP_0031226.UMLS synonyms: ultrasound fluid collection kidney: perinephric | ct fluid collection kidney: perinephric | mri fluid collection kidney: perinephric | ct fluid collection left kidney: perinephric | ultrasound fluid collection left kidney: perinephric | mri fluid collection left kidney: perinephric | mri fluid collection right kidney: perinephric | ultrasound fluid collection right kidney: perinephric | ct fluid collection right kidney: perinephric | ultrasound fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - stable | ultrasound fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - expanding | ct fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - expanding | mri fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - expanding | ct fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - stable | ultrasound fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - shrinking | mri fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - stable | ct fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - shrinking | mri fluid collection left kidney: perinephric - shrinking | ultrasound fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - expanding | ultrasound fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - shrinking | ct fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - shrinking | ct fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - expanding | ct fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - stable | mri fluid collection right kidney: perinephric - stable

HP_0031227.label: nasopharyngeal teratoma
HP_0031227.definition: A teratoma arising in the nasopharyngeal region.
HP_0031227.UMLS synonyms: Congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma | Nasopharyngeal teratoma with Dandy Walker diaphragmatic hernia

HP_0031228.label: abnormal incisura morphology
HP_0031228.definition: An abnormal shape of the incisura, defined as the narrowed downward continuation of the conchal space bounded anteriorly by the borders of the tragus, posteriorly by the antitragus, and along its lower lateral margins and inferior boundary by the connection between the first two. The upper boundary is a somewhat arbitrary line crossing from the apices of the antitragus and the tragus.

HP_0031229.label: increased incisura length
HP_0031229.definition: The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is greater than that observed in the average population.

HP_0031230.label: decreased incisura length
HP_0031230.definition: The length of the incisura from the upper to lower border is less than that observed in the average population.

HP_0031231.label: narrow incisura width
HP_0031231.definition: Width of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border less than that observed in the average population.

HP_0031232.label: increased incisura width
HP_0031232.definition: Breadth of the incisura from the anterior to posterior border greater than that observed in the average population.

HP_0031233.label: horizontal inferior border of scapula
HP_0031233.definition: A morphological abnormality of the scapula in which there is a flat (horizontal) inferior edge of the scapula. The entire scapula is said to resemble a square, leading to the designation sqaring of the scapula (in Figure 1 of PMID:24706940 the scapulae have a roughly rectangular shape).
HP_0031233.synonyms: squaring of the inferior scapulae | squaring of the scapula

HP_0031234.label: neutrophilic infiltration of the skin
HP_0031234.definition: A predominantly neutrophilic infiltrate of the dermis and or epidermis (i.e., a large number of neutrophils inferred to have migrated into the skin).

HP_0031235.label: predominantly epidermal neutrophilic infiltrate
HP_0031235.definition: Collection of neutrophils in the epidermis.

HP_0031236.label: predominantly dermal neutrophilic infiltrate
HP_0031236.definition: Collection of neutrophils in the dermis.

HP_0031237.label: internally nucleated skeletal muscle fibers
HP_0031237.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of nuclei of sarcomeres with an internal localization. Individual muscle fibers are syncytia, formed by embryonic fusion of many myoblasts or later, myosatellite cells. Each muscle fiber contains many nuclei, peripherally positioned immediately adjacent to the sarcolemmal membrane. In healthy muscle only 3-5% of fibers contain nuclei that are located internally, within the cell, but many disease processes lead to internal nuclei.

HP_0031238.label: necklace skeletal muscle fibers
HP_0031238.definition: A histological alteration of muscle fibers that resembles a necklace (necklace fibers). A substantial proportion of fibers (4-20% in PMID:19084976) show internalized nuclei aligned in a basophilic ring (necklace) at 3 micrometers beneath the sarcolemma. Ultrastructurally, such necklaces consist of myofibrils of smaller diameter, in oblique orientation, surrounded by mitochondria, sarcoplasmic reticulum and glycogen granules.

HP_0031239.label: extrafoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP_0031239.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 200 to 1500 micrometers from the center of the fovea.

HP_0031240.label: juxtafoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP_0031240.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the nearest edge of the area of neovascularization is located 1 to 199 micrometers from the center of the fovea.

HP_0031241.label: subfoveal choroidal neovascularization
HP_0031241.definition: A type of choroidal neovascularization in which the area of neovascularization overlaps with the center of the fovea.

HP_0031265.synonyms: abnormal podocyte morphology | abnormal visceral epithelial cell morphology

HP_0031266.label: podocyte foot process effacement
HP_0031266.definition: An anomaly of podocyte morphology characterized by the loss of the interdigitating foot process pattern (generally called foot process effacement; FPE). The term FPE designates the loss of the usual interdigitating pattern of foot processes of neighboring podocytes, leading to relatively broad expanses of podocyte processes covering the glomerular basement membrane (GBM). It is widely viewed as a pathological derangement that is associated with leakage of macromolecules such as albumin through the glomerular filtration barrier.

HP_0031297.label: unroofed coronary sinus
HP_0031297.definition: Unroofed coronary sinus (CS) is a rare congenital cardiac anomaly in which there is partial (either focal or fenestrated) or complete absence of the roof of the CS, which results in a communication between the CS and the LA. It is often associated with persistent left superior vena cava (LSVC) and other forms of complex congenital heart disease, usually heterotaxia syndromes. HP_0031304.UMLS synonyms: Iliac, femoral, tibial, and popliteal artery calcification

HP_0031305.label: tibial arterial calcification
HP_0031305.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall of the tibial artery.
HP_0031305.UMLS synonyms: angiography of anterior tibial artery: calcification | angiography of posterior tibial artery: calcification | Iliac, femoral, tibial, and popliteal artery calcification | angiography of left posterior tibial artery: calcification | angiography of left anterior tibial artery: calcification | angiography of right anterior tibial artery: calcification | angiography of right posterior tibial artery: calcification | angiography of bilateral posterior tibial arteries: calcification | angiography of bilateral anterior tibial arteries: calcification

HP_0031306.label: intracranial arterial calcification
HP_0031306.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in an artery that is located within the skull (intracranial).

HP_0031307.label: internal carotid artery calcification
HP_0031307.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the internal carotid artery.

HP_0031308.label: vertebral artery calcification
HP_0031308.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the vertebral artery.

HP_0031309.label: cerebral artery calcification
HP_0031309.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a cerebral artery.

HP_0031310.label: basilar artery calcification
HP_0031310.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the basilar artery.

HP_0031311.label: middle cerebral artery calcification
HP_0031311.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the middle cerebral artery.

HP_0031313.label: abdominal aortic calcification
HP_0031313.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in abdominal aorta.

HP_0031314.label: carotid artery calcification
HP_0031314.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in a carotid artery.

HP_0031315.label: external carotid artery calcification
HP_0031315.definition: An accumulation of calcium and phosphate in arteries with mineral deposits in the intimal or medial layer of the vessel wall in the external carotid artery.

HP_0031316.label: abnormal ventricular myocardium morphology
HP_0031316.definition: A structural anomaly of the muscle layer of the heart wall of a cardiac ventricle.

HP_0031317.label: fatty replacement of ventricular myocardial tissue
HP_0031317.definition: Presence of an increased amount of fat tissue within a cardiac ventricle with corresponding reduction of muscle tissue.
HP_0031317.synonyms: fatty infiltration of cardiac ventricle | intramyocardial fat infiltration

HP_0031318.label: myofiber disarray
HP_0031318.definition: A nonparallel arrangement of cardiac myocytes.
HP_0031318.synonyms: myocardial fiber disarray | myocardial fibre disarray
HP_0031318.UMLS synonyms: Myofiber disarray | Enlarged myocytes without myofiber disarray

HP_0031319.label: cardiomyocyte hypertrophy
HP_0031319.definition: An increase in cell size, enhanced protein synthesis, and heightened organization of the sarcomere within cardiac myocytes.

HP_0031320.label: cardiomyocyte mitochondrial proliferation
HP_0031320.definition: An abnormal increase in the number of mitochondria per cardiac myocyte.
HP_0031320.UMLS synonyms: Cardiomyocytes show an accumulation of lipid droplets and mitochondrial proliferation

HP_0031321.label: myocardial immune cell infiltration
HP_0031321.definition: An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue (which can be assumed to have migrated into the myocardium).

HP_0031322.label: myocardial lymphocytic infiltration
HP_0031322.definition: An increase in the number of lymphocytes in myocardial tissue.

HP_0031323.label: myocardial eosinophilic infiltration
HP_0031323.definition: An increase in the number of eosinophils in myocardial tissue.

HP_0031324.label: myocardial multinucleated giant cells
HP_0031324.definition: The presence of extremely large cells with multiple nuclei. The so-called giant cells are thought to be of macrophage origin.

HP_0031325.label: myocardial granulomatous infiltrates
HP_0031325.definition: The presence of multiple granulomata (small nodular inflammatory lesions containing grouped mononuclear phagocytes) in the myocardium.

HP_0031326.label: monoclonal light chain cardiac amyloidosis
HP_0031326.definition: A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of an immunoglobulin light chain. The current gold standard of amyloid typing is to determine the precursor protein using laser microdissection mass spectrometry.

HP_0031327.label: transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis
HP_0031327.definition: A type of cardiac amyloidosis related to deposition of transthyretin (TTR), which is identified by immunohistochemical staining.
HP_0031327.UMLS synonyms: AMYLOIDOSIS, HEREDITARY, TRANSTHYRETIN-RELATED | Senile cardiac amyloidosis

HP_0031328.label: perivascular cardiac fibrosis
HP_0031328.definition: A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in perivascular spaces.

HP_0031329.label: interstitial cardiac fibrosis
HP_0031329.definition: A type of myocardial fibrosis characterized by excessive diffuse collagen accumulation concentrated in interstitial spaces.

HP_0031330.label: perivascular myocardial immune cell infiltration
HP_0031330.definition: An increase in the number of immune cells in myocardial tissue concentrated in the spaces surrounding blood vessels.

HP_0031331.label: abnormal cardiomyocyte morphology
HP_0031331.definition: Any structural anomaly of cardiomyocytes, which are terminally differentiated muscle cells in the heart that are interconnected end to end by gap junctions, which allows coordinated contraction of heart tissue.

HP_0031332.label: cardiomyocyte degeneration
HP_0031332.definition: Deterioration of cardiomyocyte characterized by abnormal features such as loss of myofilaments, occurrence of cellular sequestration, decreased mitochondrial sizes and cellular debris.

HP_0031333.label: myocardial sarcomeric disarray
HP_0031333.definition: A disruption of the structure of the sarcomeres of cardiomyocytes. The sarcomere is the repeating unit between two Z lines comprised largely of myosin and actin that mediates contractility, and normally sarcomeres are aligned with the long axis of cells, with the Z bands being in register throughout the length of the cardiac myocytes.
HP_0031333.synonyms: cardiac biopsy : myocyte disarray | cardiomyocyte disarray | myocardial sarcomere disarray

HP_0031334.label: cardiomyocyte inclusion bodies
HP_0031334.definition: Nuclear or cytoplasmic aggregates of stainable substances within cardiomyocytes.

HP_0031335.label: abnormal cardiomyocyte mitochondrial morphology
HP_0031335.definition: An anomaly of the structure of mitochondria within cardiomyocytes.

HP_0031336.label: intranuclear cardiomyocyte mitochondria
HP_0031336.definition: Abnormal localization of mitochondria within the nuclei of cardiomyocytes.

HP_0031337.label: abnormal cardiomyocyte connexin43 staining
HP_0031337.definition: Anomalous staining of Connexin43 in cardiomyocytes. Connexin43 (Cx43) is the primary gap junction protein in the working myocardium. Cx43 exhibits increased localization at the lateral membranes of cardiomyocytes in a variety of heart diseases.

HP_0031338.label: abnormal cardiomyocyte plakoglobin staining
HP_0031338.definition: Anomalous staining of plakoglobin in cardiomyocytes. Plakoglobin is a component of desmosomes in cardiomyocytes.

HP_0031339.label: abnormal cardiomyocyte dystrophin staining
HP_0031339.definition: Anomalous staining of dystrophin in cardiomyocytes.

HP_0031340.label: abnormal lysosomal morphology
HP_0031340.definition: A structural anomaly of lysosomes, membrane-enclosed organelles that contain an array of enzymes capable of catabolizing proteins, nucleic acids, carbohydrates, and lipids.

HP_0031341.label: gastric arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031341.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the stomach.
HP_0031341.UMLS synonyms: Arteriovenous malformation of stomach | arteriovenous malformation of stomach with hemorrhage

HP_0031342.label: duodenal arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031342.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the duodenum.
HP_0031342.UMLS synonyms: Arteriovenous malformation of duodenum | arteriovenous malformation of duodenum with hemorrhage

HP_0031343.label: jejunal arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031343.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the jejunum.

HP_0031344.label: pelvic arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031344.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the pelvis.

HP_0031345.label: colonic arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031345.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the colon.
HP_0031345.UMLS synonyms: arteriovenous malformation of colon with hemorrhage

HP_0031346.label: rectal arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031346.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the rectum.

HP_0031347.label: uterine arteriovenous malformation
HP_0031347.definition: An anomalous configuration of blood vessels that shunts arterial blood directly into veins without passing through the capillaries and that is located in the uterus.

HP_0031348.label: dextrotransposition of the great arteries
HP_0031348.definition: A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the right of the pulmonary artery. This is the most common kind of TGA.
HP_0031348.synonyms: d - loop transposition of the great arteries

HP_0031349.label: levotransposition of the great arteries
HP_0031349.definition: A type of transposition of the great arteries (TGA) in which aorta is in front of and primarily to the left of the pulmonary artery.
HP_0031349.UMLS synonyms: L - transposition of the great vessels

HP_0031350.label: cardiac sarcoma
HP_0031350.definition: A malignant soft tissue neoplasm that arises from the heart.
HP_0031350.UMLS synonyms: Cardiac Sarcoma | Mouse Cardiac Sarcoma | Cardiac Kaposi's Sarcoma | Cardiac Synovial Sarcoma | Cardiac Myeloid Sarcoma | CARDIAC SARCOMA PRIMARY | Mouse Cardiac Kaposi's Sarcoma | Cardiac Monophasic Synovial Sarcoma | Cardiac Biphasic Synovial Sarcoma | Cardiac Extraskeletal Osteosarcoma | Cardiac Malignant Fibrous Histiocytoma

HP_0031351.label: calcified amorphous tumor of the heart
HP_0031351.definition: A non-neoplastic cardiac tumor characterized by calcification and eosinophilic amorphous material in the background of dense collagenous fibrous tissue.
HP_0031351.synonyms: calcified amorphous tumour of the heart

HP_0031352.label: chest tightness
HP_0031352.definition: An unpleasant sensation of tightness or pressure in the chest.
HP_0031352.synonyms: chest distress | tightness in chest | tightness of chest

HP_0031354.definition: Difficulty initiating sleep, that is, increased sleep onset latency, refers to the condition where it takes 30 minutes or more to fall asleep.

HP_0031355.label: maintenance insomnia

HP_0031355.synonyms: insomnia middle | middle insomnia | waking up several times during the night

HP_0031356.label: terminal insomnia
HP_0031356.definition: A type of insomnia characterized by waking up too early in the morning is known as early morning awakening. The termination of sleep must occur at least 30 minutes before the desired time.

HP_0031357.label: glomeruloid hemangioma
HP_0031357.definition: A histologically distinctive, cutaneous, benign vascular tumor that is characterized by a solitary or multiple blue-red papules and histologically resembles renal glomeruli.

HP_0031358.label: vegetative state
HP_0031358.definition: The absence of wakefulness and consciousness, but in contrast to a coma, there is involuntary opening of the eyes and movements such as teeth grinding, yawning, or thrashing of the extremities.

HP_0031359.label: cutaneous sclerotic plaque
HP_0031359.definition: A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter that is characterized by hardening (sclerosis) of the affected skin area (related to collagen thickening).

HP_0031360.label: yellow skin plaque
HP_0031360.definition: A solid, raised, plateau-like (flat-topped) lesion greater than 1 cm in diameter and that has a yellow color.

HP_0031361.label: zebra bodies
HP_0031361.definition: Intralysosomal, osmiophilic, lamellated and sometimes concentric cytoplasmic inclusions comprised of broad transversely-stacked myelinoid membranes and said to resemble a zebra in electron microscopic images.

HP_0031373.label: stiff tongue
HP_0031373.definition: Increased rigidity and reduced mobility of the tongue.

HP_0031377.label: abnormal cell proliferation
HP_0031377.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of cells, which may result in the expansion of a cell population.

HP_0031378.label: abnormal lymphocyte proliferation
HP_0031378.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of lymphocytes, which results in the expansion of a cell population.

HP_0031379.label: abnormal t cell proliferation
HP_0031379.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of T cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population.

HP_0031380.label: abnormal b cell proliferation
HP_0031380.definition: Any abnormality in the multiplication or reproduction of B cells, which results in the expansion of a cell population.

HP_0031381.label: decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to mitogen
HP_0031381.definition: A decreased proliferative response of lymphocytes in vitro or in vivo, when stimulated with mitogens, such as phytohemagglutinin (PHA).

HP_0031382.label: decreased lymphocyte proliferation in response to anti - cd3
HP_0031382.definition: A decreased proliferative response of lymphocytes in vitro or in vivo, when stimulated with an anti-CD3 antibody against the T-cell co-receptor, CD3.
HP_0031382.synonyms: defective lymphocyte proliferation to anti - cd3 | defective proliferation of lymphocytes following anti - cd3 stimulation

HP_0031383.label: abnormal lymphocyte surface marker expression
HP_0031383.definition: Abnormal amount of a protein that is normally present on the cell surface of lymphocytes.

HP_0031384.label: reduced t cell cd40 expression
HP_0031384.definition: A deficiency in the expression of the CD40 ligand on the surface of activated T-lymphocytes.

HP_0031385.label: megakaryocyte nucleus hypolobulation
HP_0031385.definition: The presence of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow whose nuclei are less lobulated than expected for the size of the nucleus.

HP_0031386.label: increased micromegakaryocyte count
HP_0031386.definition: The presence of abnormally high numbers of micromegakaryocytes in the bone marrow. Micromegakaryocytes are mononuclear diploid cells, with a nucleus similar in size to that of a myeloblast or promyelocyte with the cell being less than 30 micrometers in diameter.

HP_0031387.label: increased multinucleated megakaryocyte count
HP_0031387.definition: The presence of abnormally high numbers of multinucleated megakaryocytes in the bone marrow.

HP_0031388.label: megakaryocyte nucleus hyperlobulation
HP_0031388.definition: The presence of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow whose nuclei are more lobulated than expected for the size of the nucleus.

HP_0031389.label: abnormal mhc ii surface expression
HP_0031389.definition: A deviation from the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.

HP_0031390.label: reduced mhc ii surface expression
HP_0031390.definition: A reduction from the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.

HP_0031391.label: elevated mhc ii surface expression
HP_0031391.definition: An increase above the normal level of major histocompatibility complex class II molecules expressed at the cell surface.

HP_0031392.label: abnormal proportion of cd4 - positive t cells
HP_0031392.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of CD4-positive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.

HP_0031393.label: abnormal proportion of cd8 - positive t cells
HP_0031393.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of CD8 T cells relative to the total number of T cells.

HP_0031394.label: abnormal cd4 : cd8 ratio
HP_0031394.definition: Any abnormality in the relative amount of CD4+ and CD8+ T lymphocytes.

HP_0031396.label: abnormal proportion of naive t cells
HP_0031396.definition: Any abnormality in the proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP_0031396.synonyms: abnormal naive t cell proportion | abnormal proportion of naive thymus - derived , alpha - beta t cells

HP_0031397.label: decreased proportion of naive t cells
HP_0031397.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP_0031397.synonyms: decreased proportion of naive thymus - derived , alpha - beta t cells | reduced proportion of naive t cells

HP_0031398.label: increased proportion of naive t cells
HP_0031398.definition: An abnormally increased proportion of naive T cells relative to the total number of T cells.
HP_0031398.synonyms: elevated proportion of naive t cells | increased proportion of naive thymus - derived , alpha - beta t cells

HP_0031399.label: abnormal proportion of double - negative alpha - beta regulatory t cell
HP_0031399.definition: An abnormal proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative (double negative or DN) alpha-beta regulatory T cells (Tregs) as compared to total number of T cells.
HP_0031399.synonyms: abnormal cd4 - negative , cd8 - negative , alpha - beta regulatory t cell distribution | abnormal dn treg distribution | abnormal double negative treg distribution | abnormal double - negative alpha - beta regulatory t cell distribution

HP_0031401.label: reduced proportion of cd4 - negative , cd8 - negative , alpha - beta regulatory t cells
HP_0031401.definition: An abnormally decreased proportion of CD4-negative, CD8-negative (double negative or DN) alpha-beta regulatory T cells (Tregs) as compared to total number of T cells.

HP_0031402.label: reduced antigen - specific t cell proliferation
HP_0031402.definition: Impaired proliferation and expansion of a T cell population following activation by an antigenic stimulus.
HP_0031402.synonyms: antigen - specific t cell proliferation defect | impaired activated t cell proliferation | impaired ag - specific t cell proliferation | impaired cellular adaptive immune response

HP_0031403.label: impaired pathogen - specific cd8 cytoxicity
HP_0031403.definition: Impaired response of CD8 T cells to pathogens. CD8 T cells direct the killing of a target cell through the release of granules containing cytotoxic mediators or through the engagement of death receptors.

HP_0031404.label: impaired antigen - specific response
HP_0031404.definition: An impaired immune response mediated by cells expressing specific receptors for antigen produced through a somatic diversification process, and allowing for an enhanced secondary response to subsequent exposures to the same antigen (immunological memory).

HP_0031405.label: poroma
HP_0031405.definition: A benign, well circumscribed sweat gland neoplasm with eccrine or apocrine differentiation. It usually presents as a solitary, dome-shaped papule, nodule, or plaque on acral sites. It is characterized by a proliferation of uniform basaloid cells in the dermis and it is associated with the presence of focal ductal and cystic structures [NCIT:C27273].

HP_0031406.label: abnormal cytokine signaling
HP_0031406.definition: Any abnormality in the series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a cytokine to a receptor on the surface of a cell, and ending with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

HP_0031407.label: impaired cytokine signaling
HP_0031407.definition: A defect or impairment in the series of molecular signals initiated by the binding of a cytokine to a receptor on the surface of a cell, and ending with regulation of a downstream cellular process, e.g. transcription.

HP_0031408.label: increased proportion of cd25+ mast cells
HP_0031408.definition: An increased proportion of mast cells are positive for the cell surface marker CD25 (also called interleukin-2 receptor alpha chain).

HP_0031410.label: abnormal distribution of cd56 bright / dim natural killer cells
HP_0031410.definition: An abnormal distribution in the number of CD56 bright NK cells, as measured by flow cytometry. CD56, an adhesion molecule mediating homotypic adhesion, is used as a functional marker for NK cells.
HP_0031410.synonyms: abnormal distribution of cd56 bright / dim nk cells

HP_0031411.definition: Any structural anomaly of a chromosome, which is a thread like molecule consisting of DNA and proteins (chromatin) that contains DNA sequences for genes and other genetic elements in linear order.

HP_0031413.label: short telomere length
HP_0031413.definition: An abnormal reduction in telomere length. Telomeres are non-coding, repetitive sequences of DNA at the ends of the chromosomes of eukaryotic cells which become shorter as cells divide, and when telomere attrition reaches its limit, cell proliferation arrest, senescence, and apoptosis can occur.

HP_0031414.label: high serum calcifediol
HP_0031414.definition: An increased concentration of calcifediol in the blood. Calcifediol is also known as 25-hydroxycholecalciferol or 25-Hydroxyvitamin D3.

HP_0031415.label: high serum calcitriol
HP_0031415.definition: An increased concentration of calcitriol in the blood. Calcitriol is also known as 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol or 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3.
HP_0031415.synonyms: high serum 1,25 - dihydroxycholecalciferol | high serum 1,25 - dihydroxyvitamin d3 | increased serum 1,25 - dihydroxyvitamin d3 | increased serum calcitriol

HP_0031416.label: abnormal nasal mucus secretion
HP_0031416.definition: Any deviation from the normal quantity of secretion of nasal mucus, a thick viscous liquid produced by the mucous membranes of the nose.

HP_0031417.label: rhinorrhea
HP_0031417.definition: Increased discharge of mucus from the nose.

HP_0031418.label: increased body mass index
HP_0031418.definition: Abnormally increased weight-to-height squared ratio, calculated by dividing the individual's weight in kilograms by the square of the individual's height in meters and used as an indicator of overweight compared to averages.

HP_0031419.label: reduced sex - hormone binding protein level
HP_0031419.definition: A decreased concentration of sex-hormone binding protein in the circulation.

HP_0031420.label: small yellow foveal lesion with surrounding gray zone
HP_0031420.definition: A lesion that is observed following light damage to the macula. Damage to the retinal by exposure to intense visible light, usually the sun. Intense light exposure such as staring at the sun causes fine structural anomalies in the outer segments of the photoreceptors and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells of the macula. Symptoms usually develop within 1 to 4 h after exposure and include decreased vision, metamorphopsia, micropsia, and central or paracentral scotomas. Fundus examination typically shows a small yellow spot with a surrounding gray zone in the foveolar or parafoveolar area. Spontaneous evolution leads to the improvement of visual acuity.

HP_0031421.label: small superior frontal cortex
HP_0031421.definition: Reduced size of the superior frontal portion of the cerebral cortex.

HP_0031422.label: abnormal cerebellar cortex morphology
HP_0031422.definition: Any structural anomaly of the cortex of the cerebellum.
HP_0031422.synonyms: abnormal morphology of the cerebellar cortex

HP_0031423.label: small cerebellar cortex
HP_0031423.definition: Reduced size of the cerebellar cortex.

HP_0031424.label: abnormal circulating beta - c - terminal telopeptide concentration
HP_0031424.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation, a marker of the rate of bone turnover.

HP_0031425.definition: A abnormal elevation above the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation.

HP_0031426.label: decreased circulating beta - c - terminal telopeptide concentration
HP_0031426.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of beta-C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen in the blood circulation.

HP_0031427.label: abnormal circulating osteocalcin level
HP_0031427.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of osteocalcin in the blood circulation.

HP_0031428.label: increased circulating osteocalcin level
HP_0031428.definition: An elevated level of osteocalcin in the blood.

HP_0031429.label: decreased circulating osteocalcin level
HP_0031429.definition: A reduced level of osteocalcin in the blood.

HP_0031430.label: oligoclonal t cell expansion
HP_0031430.definition: The presence of a population of T cells with a restricted T cell receptor (TCR) repertoire derived from a limited number of TCR clones.

HP_0031431.label: persistent repetition of sounds
HP_0031431.definition: Repetition of sounds with no meaning.

HP_0031432.label: restricted or repetitive behaviors or interests
HP_0031432.definition: A broad range of compulsive behaviors are repeated, including simple motor stereotypies and tics, as well as more complex repetitive movements or compulsions.

HP_0031433.label: alexithymia
HP_0031433.definition: A deficit in emotional awareness is characterized by difficulties in recognizing and expressing feelings and emotions. This deficit manifests as a limited ability to respond to facial cues or other signs of emotions in others, often accompanied by detached connections to others.

HP_0031434.label: abnormal prosody
HP_0031434.definition: Abnormalities in the patterns of rhythm, stress, or intonation of speech or vocalization.

HP_0031435.label: monotonic speech
HP_0031435.definition: A speech pattern characterized by an abnormal lack of tone in the voice.

HP_0031439.label: abnormal angiostatin level
HP_0031439.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in the circulation of angiostatin, an endogenous angiogenesis inhibitor, which blocks the growth of new blood vessels.

HP_0031441.definition: Any structural anomaly of the annulus of the tricuspid valve. The annulus is a ring composed of fibrous and myocardial tissue and is the structure onto which the cusps of the valve attach.

HP_0031442.definition: Any structural anomaly of the chordae tendinae of the tricuspid valve. The chordae tendineae connect the papillary muscles to the tricuspid valve.

HP_0031443.label: abnormal tricuspid valve leaflet morphology
HP_0031443.definition: Any structural anomaly of the leaflets (also known as cusps) of the tricuspid valve.

HP_0031444.label: dilatation of the tricuspid annulus
HP_0031444.definition: An increase in the diameter of the ring (annulus) of the tricuspid valve.

HP_0031445.label: oral mucosa nodule
HP_0031445.definition: A palpable, solid lesion greater than 5mm in diameter. that is located in the mucosa of the mouth.

HP_0031446.definition: Loss of the superficial layer of the oral mucosa usually resulting in a shallow or crusted lesion.
HP_0031446.UMLS synonyms: Erosion of oral mucosa | Blisters and erosion of oral mucosa

HP_0031447.label: penile freckling
HP_0031447.definition: Multiple pigmented macules located on the skin of the penis.

HP_0031448.label: herpetiform vesicles
HP_0031448.definition: Multiple vesicles distributed in multiple distinct groups consisting of multiple adjacent vesicles.

HP_0031449.label: perineal hemangioma
HP_0031449.definition: Hemangioma, a benign tumor of the vascular endothelial cells, located in the perineal region, i.e., the region between the anus and the genitals.

HP_0031453.label: oral lichenoid lesion
HP_0031453.definition: Mutliple lesions of the oral mucosa resembling those characteristic of the disease lichen planus. These are symmetric reticular lesions that resemble a white, lacelike network, as well as by papules, plaques, erythematous lesions, and erosions.

HP_0031461.label: intramuscular myxoma
HP_0031461.definition: A benign tumor that is usually solitary, painless, palpable mass that is firm in consistency and slightly movable and often fluctuant. It can occur in any location, but tends to involve the muscles of the thighs, buttocks, and shoulders. On microscopic examination, there is abundant mucoid material and relative hypo cellularity and loose reticulin fibers. Vascular structures are sparse. The cells have a stellate shape with small hyper chromatic pyknotic nuclei and scanty cytoplasm. Some myxomas may show focal areas of hyper cellularity. HP_0031484.definition: A form of hemolytic anemia that can be triggered by cold temperatures.

HP_0031485.label: subperiosteal bone formation
HP_0031485.definition: The formation of new bone along the cortex and underneath the periosteum of a bone.

HP_0031486.label: vascular malformation of the lip
HP_0031486.definition: An anomaly of blood vessels located in the lip.

HP_0031487.label: capillary malformation of the lip
HP_0031487.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is characterized by ectatic papillary dermal capillaries and postcapillary venules in the upper reticular dermis.
HP_0031487.UMLS synonyms: Capillary malformation of the lower lip | CAPILLARY MALFORMATION OF THE LOWER LIP, LYMPHATIC MALFORMATION OF FACE AND NECK, ASYMMETRY OF FACE AND LIMBS, AND PARTIAL/GENERALIZED OVERGROWTH, SOMATIC | CLAPO Syndrome

HP_0031488.label: arteriovenous malformation of the lip
HP_0031488.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is characterized by direct blood shunting from an artery to a vein due to the absence of a capillary bed. The artery and vein can be directly connected by a fistula or indirectly connected by an abnormal vessel channel termed a nidus.
HP_0031488.synonyms: atypical connection between arteries and veins

HP_0031489.label: venous malformation of the lip
HP_0031489.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is related to abnormal vascular morphogenesis.

HP_0031490.label: hemangioma of the lip
HP_0031490.definition: A vascular malformation located in the lip that is related to vascular endothelial cell hyperplasia.

HP_0031491.label: continuous spike and waves during slow sleep
HP_0031491.definition: Diffuse, bilateral and recently also unilateral or focal localization spike-wave occurring in slow sleep or non-rapid eye movement sleep.
HP_0031491.synonyms: electrical status epilepticus during slow - wave sleep
HP_0031491.UMLS synonyms: Continuous spike and waves during slow sleep | Continuous spike and wave during slow wave sleep syndrome | Continuous slow spike and wave activity during sleep | Continuous spike and slow-wave activity during sleep

HP_0031492.definition: A benign or malignant neoplasm that arises from and is composed of epithelial cells. This category include adenomas, papillomas, and carcinomas [NCIT:C3709].

HP_0031493.label: glandular cell neoplasm
HP_0031493.definition: A tumor that arises from a gland cell.

HP_0031494.definition: Ovarian mucinous neoplasms consist of borderline tumors (tumors of low malignant potential, or LMP tumors), intraepithelial (non-invasive) carcinoma, and invasive carcinoma.

HP_0031496.label: mucinous cystic neoplasm of the pancreas
HP_0031496.definition: Mucin-producing and septated cyst-forming epithelial neoplasia of the pancreas with a distinctive ovarian-type stroma.

HP_0031497.label: mucinous colorectal carcinoma
HP_0031497.definition: A subtype of colorectal carcinoma with mucin lakes.

HP_0031498.label: mucinous gastric carcinoma
HP_0031498.definition: A poorly differentiated type of gastric carcinoma with a substantial amount of extracellular mucus (over 50% of tumor volume) within the tumor.

HP_0031499.label: appendiceal mucinous neoplasm
HP_0031499.definition: An epithelial neoplasm originating in the appendix and often associated with cystic dilation of the appendix due to accumulation of gelatinous material, morphologically referred to as mucoceles.
HP_0031499.UMLS synonyms: Appendiceal mucinous neoplasm | Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm | High grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm | Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm of appendix | Low-Grade Appendiceal Mucinous Neoplasm (LAMN) pTis TNM Finding v8 | Surgical margin involved by low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm of appendix in appendectomy specimen | Surgical margin involved by high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm of appendix in appendectomy specimen | Presence of high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm of appendix at surgical margin in appendectomy specimen | Presence of low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm of appendix at surgical margin in appendectomy specimen

HP_0031500.label: abdominal mass
HP_0031500.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the abdomen.

HP_0031501.label: pelvic mass
HP_0031501.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling in the pelvic region.

HP_0031502.label: trophoblastic tumor
HP_0031502.definition: A gestational or non-gestational neoplasm composed of neoplastic trophoblastic cells [NCIT:C3422].
HP_0031502.UMLS synonyms: Trophoblastic Neoplasms | Trophoblastic Tumor, Placental Site | Trophoblastic tumor, epithelioid | Cystic Trophoblastic Tumor | Mixed Trophoblastic Tumor | Testicular Trophoblastic Tumor | Recurrent Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor | Testicular Cystic Trophoblastic Tumor | stage, gestational trophoblastic tumor | Non-Metastatic Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor | malignant trophoblastic tumor of placenta | APE/Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor Regimen | cellular diagnosis, gestational trophoblastic tumor | placental; tumor placental site trophoblastic | Poor Prognosis Metastatic Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor | Good Prognosis Metastatic Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor | Stage III Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage I Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IV Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage II Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IIIA Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IB Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IVA Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IIB Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7 | Stage IIIB Gestational Trophoblastic Tumor AJCC v7

HP_0031503.label: night gasping
HP_0031503.definition: Waking up at night gasping for breath.

HP_0031504.label: foamy urine
HP_0031504.definition: Urine has an increased amount of frothy fine bubbles.

HP_0031505.label: abnormal circulating t4 concentration
HP_0031505.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP_0031505.synonyms: abnormal circulating t4 level | abnormal circulating thyroxine level

HP_0031506.label: increased circulating t4 concentration
HP_0031506.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP_0031506.synonyms: increased circulating t4 level | increased circulating thyroxine level

HP_0031507.label: decreased circulating t4 concentration
HP_0031507.definition: A reduction below the normal concentration of thyroxine in the blood. Thyroxine (also known as T4) is the main hormone secreted by the thyroid gland into the blood. It can be converted into the active form triiodothyronine (also known as T3).
HP_0031507.synonyms: decreased circulating t4 level | decreased circulating thyroxine level | reduced t4 plasma level

HP_0031508.label: abnormal circulating thyroid hormone concentration
HP_0031508.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the hormones produced by the thyroid gland.

HP_0031509.label: dry nipple
HP_0031509.definition: Abnormally dry skin in the area of the nipple of the breast.

HP_0031510.label: linear earlobe crease
HP_0031510.definition: A transverse linear fissure (crease) in the lobule of the ear.

HP_0031511.label: diagonal earlobe crease
HP_0031511.definition: Diagonal earlobe creases run from the lower pole of the external meatus, diagonally backwards to the edge of the lobe at approximately 45 degrees.

HP_0031513.label: luse bodies
HP_0031513.definition: Fusiform collagen fibers with abnormally long spacing (exceeding 100 nm) between electron-dense bands.

HP_0031514.label: increased proportion of exhausted t cells
HP_0031514.definition: An abnormally elevated proportion of exhausted T cells (Tex) among circulating T cells. T cell exhaustion is a distinct differentiation state that can be distinguished from naive, effector, and memory T cells. Compared to effector (TE) and memory (TMEM) T cells, exhausted T cells (TEX) display impaired effector functions (e.g., rapid production of effector cytokines, cytotoxicity). TEX have limited proliferative potential, especially compared to some subsets of TMEM and naive T cells.

HP_0031515.label: abnormal meiosis
HP_0031515.definition: Any anomaly of meiosis, a type of cell division that reduces the number of chromosomes in the parent cell by half and produces four gamete cells.

HP_0031516.label: oocyte arrest at metaphase i
HP_0031516.definition: Failure of oocytes to proceed through the stages of meiosis with stoppage at the first metaphase stage.
HP_0031516.synonyms: metaphase i oocyte meiotic arrest | oocyte meiotic arrest at metaphase i

HP_0031517.label: verruciform xanthoma
HP_0031517.definition: A papillary or cauliflower-like growth characterized by the presence of foamy histiocytes within the elongated dermal papillae forms.
HP_0031517.UMLS synonyms: Verruciform xanthoma of skin | Verruciform xanthoma of oral mucous membrane | biopsy of oropharynx showed verruciform xanthoma | biopsy tongue benign neoplasm verruciform xanthoma

HP_0031518.label: absent posterior alpha rhythm
HP_0031518.definition: Lack of normal alpha rhythm in the EEG. Alpha rhythm has been defined as a rhythm at 8-13 Hz occurring during wakefulness over the posterior regions of the head, generally with higher voltage over the occipital areas. Amplitude is variable but is mostly below 50 microvolt in adults. It is best seen with eyes closed and under conditions of physical relaxation and relative mental inactivity. It is blocked or attenuated by attention, especially visual and mental effort. One should here note the difference between the terms alpha rhythm and alpha activity: Alpha activity refers to activity in the range of 8-13 Hz and alpha rhythm is the activity of 8-13 Hz with specific characteristics as defined above.

HP_0031519.label: cauliflower deformity of dermal collagen fibrils
HP_0031519.definition: An anomaly of collagen fibers of the skin that is said to resemble a cauliflower and can be appreciated by electron microscopy.

HP_0031520.label: groin pain
HP_0031520.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the groin region.
HP_0031520.UMLS synonyms: Inguinal pain | progressive groin pain | radiating groin pain | pain in left groin | pain in right groin | FLANK PAIN RADIATING GROIN | sharp or stabbing groin pain | groin pain radiating to testicle | groin pain worsens then abates | dull or aching groin pain | lower back pain radiating to groin | lower back pain radiating to left groin | lower back pain radiating to right groin | Pain in groin with internal/external rotation | bilateral inguinal pain | groin pain progressive with decreased level of activity | groin pain progressive with same level of activity | abdominal pain radiating to inguinal region | painful lump under skin of groin | lower back pain radiating to both groins

HP_0031521.label: vaginal clear cell adenocarcinoma
HP_0031521.definition: A type of adenocarcinoma originating in the vagina and characterized by large cells with moderate to abundant clear cytoplasm.
HP_0031521.synonyms: clear cell adenocarcinoma of the vagina

HP_0031522.label: cervical clear cell adenocarcinoma
HP_0031522.definition: A type of adenocarcinoma originating in the cervix and characterized by large cells with moderate to abundant clear cytoplasm.

HP_0031523.label: salivary gland oncocytoma
HP_0031523.definition: A benign epithelial neoplasm composed of layers of oncocytes (small round nucleus, micro-granular, eosinophilic cytoplasm with numerous tightly-packed mitochondria)
HP_0031523.UMLS synonyms: Benign oncocytoma of salivary gland | biopsy of salivary gland: oncocytoma

HP_0031524.label: ampulla of vater carcinoma
HP_0031524.definition: A carcinoma originating in the ampulla of Vater (also known as the hepatopancreatic duct), which is formed by the union of the pancreatic duct and the common bile duct.
HP_0031524.UMLS synonyms: Carcinoma of ampulla of Vater | Ampulla of Vater Undifferentiated Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Neuroendocrine Carcinoma | Advanced Ampulla of Vater Carcinoma | Refractory Ampulla of Vater Carcinoma | Metastatic Ampulla of Vater Carcinoma | Unresectable Ampulla of Vater Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Adenosquamous Carcinoma | Primary carcinoma of ampulla of Vater | Metastatic carcinoma to ampulla of Vater | Carcinoma in situ of ampulla of Vater | Ampulla of Vater Mixed Adenoneuroendocrine Carcinoma | Locally Advanced Ampulla of Vater Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Squamous Cell Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Small Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Large Cell Neuroendocrine Carcinoma | Ampulla of Vater Signet Ring Cell Carcinoma | biopsy of pancreas showed carcinoma of ampulla of Vater | Ampulla of Vater Undifferentiated Carcinoma with Osteoclast-Like Giant Cells | Stage I Ampulla of Vater Cancer AJCC v7 | Stage III Ampulla of Vater Cancer AJCC v7 | Stage II Ampulla of Vater Cancer AJCC v7 | Stage IV Ampulla of Vater Cancer AJCC v7 | Ampulla of Vater Cancer TNM Finding v8 | Stage II Ampulla of Vater Cancer AJCC v8

HP_0031525.label: keratoacanthoma
HP_0031525.definition: Keratoacanthoma (KA) is a common benign epithelial tumor that originates from the pilosebaceous glands. In most cases, it is characterized by rapid evolution, followed by spontaneous resolution over 4 to 6 months. KA usually presents as a solitary flesh-coloured nodule with a central keratin plug on the sun-exposed skin of elderly individuals.

HP_0031526.label: subretinal fluid
HP_0031526.definition: Edema/fluid accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane.

HP_0031527.label: intraretinal fluid
HP_0031527.definition: Edema/fluid accumulating within the retinal layers.

HP_0031528.label: subretinal deposits
HP_0031528.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium.
HP_0031528.UMLS synonyms: Subretinal hyperreflective deposits in central fovea seen on OCT | Subretinal lipid deposit | Drusen

HP_0031529.label: focal subretinal deposits
HP_0031529.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium and that have a focal distribution.

HP_0031530.label: multifocal subretinal deposits
HP_0031530.definition: Deposits accumulating between the outer retina and the retinal pigment epithelium and that are distributed with multiple foci.

HP_0031531.label: sub - rpe deposits
HP_0031531.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane.
HP_0031531.UMLS synonyms: Retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) thinning and photoreceptor loss correlate with thickness of sub-RPE deposits of lipid, esterified- and non-esterified cholesterol | Sub-RPE deposition

HP_0031532.label: focal sub - rpe deposits
HP_0031532.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane and that are distributed in a single focus.

HP_0031533.label: multifocal sub - rpe deposits
HP_0031533.definition: Deposits accumulating between the retinal pigment epithelium and Bruch's membrane and that are distributed in multiple foci.

HP_0031534.label: passive dorsiflexion of the 5th finger more than 90 degrees
HP_0031534.definition: An abnormally increased ability to bend (dorsiflex) one's fifth finger. To assess this feature, the examiner requests to proband to extend the elbows,to bend the wrist back so that it forms a ninety degree angle to the forearm, and to extend the fingers. Then, the proband is requested to bend the fifth finger back as far as is possible without discomfort. If the angle of the fifth finger exceeds 90 degrees, this is considered to be abnormal.

HP_0031535.label: increased theta frequency activity in eeg
HP_0031535.definition: Increased frequency of theta wave activity in the electroencephalogram. Theta waves have a frequency of 3.5-7.5 Hertz, and are present in very small amounts in healthy waking adult EEGs. Theta activity is normal in small very amounts in the healthy waking adult EEG in a symmetrical distribution.

HP_0031536.label: separate origin of the left anterior descending and left circumflex artery
HP_0031536.definition: Anomalous coronary origin whereby the left anterior descending (LAD) and the left circumflex artery (LCX) arise separately. Normally, these arteries arise from a common stem, the left main coronary artery (LMCA).

HP_0031537.label: anomalous origin of the left circumflex artery from the right coronary artery
HP_0031537.definition: An abnormal origin of the left circumflex artery (LCX) from the right coronary artery. Normally, the left anterior descending (LAD) and the LCX arise from a common stem, the left main coronary artery (LMCA).
HP_0031537.UMLS synonyms: Anomalous origin of left circumflex artery from right coronary artery

HP_0031538.label: abnormal dermoepidermal junction morphology
HP_0031538.definition: Any anomaly of the structure of the acellular zone that is between the dermis and the epidermis and which functions to bind the epidermis to the dermis and to serve as a selective barrier allowing the control of molecular and cellular exchanges between the two compartments.

HP_0031539.label: linear iga deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP_0031539.definition: Presence of IgA antibodies in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.

HP_0031540.label: linear igg deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP_0031540.definition: Presence of IgG antibodies in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.

HP_0031541.label: linear c3 deposits along the epidermal basement membrane zone
HP_0031541.definition: Presence of complement C3 in the dermoepidermal junction that are distributed in a linear pattern. This feature can be appreciated by immunofluorescence microscopy.

HP_0031542.label: myelin - like whorls in vacuolated fibers
HP_0031542.definition: Muscle fibers contain one or more vacuoles (membrane-bound cavity) associated with collections of membranes arranged in a whorl-like (spiral or circular) manner.
HP_0031542.synonyms: myelin - like whorls in vacuolated fibres

HP_0031544.label: elevated circulating palmitoleylcarnitine concentration
HP_0031544.definition: An elevated level of propionylcarnitine in the circulation. Propionylcarnitine is present in high abundance in the urine of patients with Methylmalonyl-CoA mutase (MUT) deficiency.
HP_0031544.synonyms: elevated circulating o - propionylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma palmitoleylcarnitine , c16:1 | elevated plasma propionylcarnitine , c3:0 | elevated propionylcarnitine level

HP_0031545.label: abnormally low t cell receptor excision circle level
HP_0031545.definition: Reduced level of T cell receptor excision circle (TRECs) as measured by the TREC assay. Late in maturation, 70% of thymocytes that will ultimately express alpha/beta-T cell receptors form a circular DNA TREC from the excised TCRdelta gene that lies within the TCRalpha genetic locus. The circles are stable but do not increase following cell division and, therefore, become diluted as T cells proliferate. A quantitative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) reaction across the joint of the circular DNA provides the TREC copy number, a marker of newly-formed, antigenically-naïve thymic emigrant T cells.

HP_0031546.label: cardiac conduction abnormality
HP_0031546.definition: Any anomaly of the progression of electrical impulses through the heart.
HP_0031546.synonyms: abnormality of cardiac conduction | abnormality of cardiac conduction system | cardiac conduction abnormalities | cardiac conduction defects | heart conduction disorder
HP_0031546.UMLS synonyms: Cardiac conduction abnormality | Abnormal cardiac conduction | CEREBELLAR ATAXIA, BRAIN ABNORMALITIES, AND CARDIAC CONDUCTION DEFECTS | ECG: F wave absent | Neurodevelopmental delay, hypotonia, cerebellar ataxia, cardiac conduction defects syndrome

HP_0031547.label: abnormal qt interval
HP_0031547.definition: Any anomaly of the time interval between the start of the Q wave and the end of the T wave as measured by the electrocardiogram (EKG).

HP_0031548.label: follicular infundibulum tumor
HP_0031548.definition: A cutaneous adnexal neoplasm with variable clinical presentation. It tends to be located in the head and neck and the presentation is papulonodular, scaly, asymptomatic, measuring up to 1-2cm, simulating a basal cell carcinoma.
HP_0031548.synonyms: basal cell hamartoma with follicular differentiation | follicular infundibulum tumour

HP_0031549.label: lymphocytoma cutis
HP_0031549.definition: Lymphocytoma cutis, or Spiegler-Fendt sarcoid, is classed as one of the pseudolymphomas, referring to inflammatory disorders in which the accumulation of lymphocytes on the skin resemble, clinically and histopathologically, cutaneous lymphomas. Careful clinical evaluation, histopathological and immunohistochemical exams may be needed to make the correct diagnosis.

HP_0031550.label: abnormal flow cytometry test result
HP_0031550.definition: Any abnormal result of flow cytometry, a method that suspends cells in a stream of fluid and passes them through an electronic detection apparatus in order to assess cell count or measure biomarkers or surface molecules.

HP_0031551.label: reduced cell surface marker level
HP_0031551.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the cell surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031552.label: reduced fibroblast surface marker level
HP_0031552.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031553.label: reduced granulocyte surface marker level
HP_0031553.definition: Reduced level of a protein that is normally present on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031554.label: reduced granulocyte cd55 level
HP_0031554.definition: Reduced level of CD55 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031555.label: reduced granulocyte cd59 level
HP_0031555.definition: Reduced level of CD59 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031556.label: reduced granulocyte cd16 level
HP_0031556.definition: Reduced level of CD16 on the granulocyte surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031557.label: reduced fibroblast cd55 level
HP_0031557.definition: Reduced level of CD55 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031558.label: reduced fibroblast cd59 level
HP_0031558.definition: Reduced level of CD59 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031559.label: reduced fibroblast cd16 level
HP_0031559.definition: Reduced level of CD16 on the fibroblast surface as assessed by flow cytometry.

HP_0031560.label: coronary cameral fistula
HP_0031560.definition: An abnormal communication between coronary artery and a cardiac chamber.

HP_0031561.label: coronary cameral fistula to right ventricle
HP_0031561.definition: An abnormal communication between the terminus of a coronary artery, bypassing the myocardial capillary bed and entering the right ventricle.

HP_0031562.label: balanced double aortic arch
HP_0031562.definition: A type of double aortic arch in which the two branches are of equal size. In most cases of double aortic arch, the right aortic arch is larger and located higher than the left aortic arch.
HP_0031562.UMLS synonyms: Double aortic arch with balanced arches

HP_0031563.label: coronary arteriovenous fistula
HP_0031563.definition: An abnormal communication between the terminus of a coronary artery, bypassing the myocardial capillary bed and entering any segment of the systemic or pulmonary circulation.
