HP_0032555.label: bounding pulse
HP_0032555.UMLS synonyms: Bounding pulse | peripheral pulses - bounding pulse | Collapsing pulse

HP_0032556.label: circumoral cyanosis
HP_0032556.definition: Persistent blue color of the skin that surrounds the mouth.

HP_0032557.label: history of bone marrow transplant
HP_0032557.definition: A past medical history of hematopoietic stem cell transplantation involving myeloablative chemoradiotherapy followed by stem cell rescue with autologous or human leukocyte antigen (HLA)-matched stem cells derived from a donor.
HP_0032557.synonyms: status post haematopoietic stem cell transplantation | status post hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
HP_0032557.UMLS synonyms: History of bone marrow transplant | History of autologous bone marrow transplant | Family history of transplantation of bone marrow | History of allotransplantation of bone marrow

HP_0032558.label: absent sperm flagella
HP_0032558.UMLS synonyms: Short or absent sperm flagella | Absent inner and outer dynein arms of sperm flagella seen on transmission electron microscopy

HP_0032559.label: short sperm flagella
HP_0032559.definition: Sperm cells with abnormally short flagella.
HP_0032559.UMLS synonyms: Thickened short sperm flagella | Short or absent sperm flagella

HP_0032560.label: coiled sperm flagella
HP_0032560.definition: Sperm cells whose flagella are twisted (coiled).

HP_0032561.label: microcephalic sperm head
HP_0032561.definition: Decreased size of the head of sperm.

HP_0032562.label: tapered sperm head
HP_0032562.definition: Sperm with cigar-shaped heads that gradually dimish in diameter (taper).

HP_0032563.label: dacryocytosis
HP_0032563.definition: Presence of teardrop-shaped red blood cells.

HP_0032564.label: ileitis
HP_0032564.UMLS synonyms: Ileitis | Terminal Ileitis | Noninfectious ileitis | Tuberculous ileitis | Allergic ileitis | Dietetic ileitis | Ileitis aggravated | Backwash ileitis | segmental ileitis | Radiation ileitis | Granulomatous ileitis | ILEITIS GENERALIZED | non-Crohn's regional ileitis | Crohn Disease | Regional ileitis aggravated | Follicular ileitis terminal | ileitis; presumed infectious | ILEITIS REGIONAL CHRONIC | Crohn's disease of ileum | Terminal ileitis in remission | Pouchitis | Ileitis, NOS dietetic or noninfectious | Jejunoileitis | Porcine intestinal adenomatosis

HP_0032567.label: lipiduria
HP_0032567.definition: An increased lipid content in the urine.

HP_0032568.label: urinary mulberry cells
HP_0032568.definition: Distal tubular epithelial cells in which globotriaosylceramide (Gb3) has accumulated. they are the characteristic feature of Fabry disease. Urinary mulberry bodies are a component of mulberry cells that can be distinguished easily from fat particles by their inner lamellar appearance.

HP_0032569.label: temporal bossing
HP_0032569.definition: Prominence (bulging) in the temple region, which is the part of the skull where the frontal, parietal, temporal, and sphenoid bones join on the side of the head.

HP_0032570.label: pontine ischemic lacunes
HP_0032570.definition: Lacunes are infarcts less than 15 mm in diameter in the cortical white matter or in the corona radiata, internal capsule, centrum semiovale, thalamus, basal ganglia, or pons.

HP_0032571.label: increased oocyte death
HP_0032571.definition: An increase in death of oocytes, the female germ cell (egg cell), which can be observed clinically in the setting of in vitro fertilization.

HP_0032572.label: abnormal urinary nucleobase concentration
HP_0032572.definition: A deviation from the normal level of a nucleobase in the urine. Nucleobases are nitrogen-containing biological compounds that form nucleosides: adenine (A), cytosine (C), guanine (G), thymine (T), and uracil (U).

HP_0032573.label: elevated urinary cytidine
HP_0032573.definition: Increased levels of urinary cytidine, a pyrimidine nucleoside in which cytosine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.

HP_0032574.label: elevated urinary uridine level
HP_0032574.definition: Increased levels of urinary uridine, a ribonucleoside composed of a molecule of uracil attached to a ribofuranose moiety via a beta-N1 glycosidic bond.

HP_0032575.label: decreased circulating 12 - hete
HP_0032575.definition: A reduction in the concentration of 12-HETE in the blood circulation, a metabolite of arachidonic acid.

HP_0032576.label: intracellular accumulation of dol - pp - glcnac2man5
HP_0032576.definition: Intracellular accumulation of the lipid-linked oligosaccharide intermediate Man5GlcNAc2-PP-dolichol.

HP_0032577.label: clonal t cell receptor rearrangement
HP_0032577.definition: Presence of a predominant T cell clone. In PCR-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of one or two prominent bands within a valid size range. In NGS-based assays, this finding is inferred on the basis of a high number of reads that map to a single T cell receptor clone.
HP_0032577.UMLS synonyms: Clonal T-Cell Receptor Gene Rearrangement | Clonal T-Cell Receptor Beta Chain Gene Rearrangement | Clonal T-Cell Receptor Gamma Chain Gene Rearrangement | TRG@ (T cell antigen receptor, gamma) (eg, leukemia and lymphoma), gene rearrangement analysis, evaluation to detect abnormal clonal population(s) | TRB@ (T cell antigen receptor, beta) (eg, leukemia and lymphoma), gene rearrangement analysis to detect abnormal clonal population(s); using direct probe methodology (eg, Southern blot) | T cell antigen receptor, beta (TRB@) gene rearrangement analysis for detection of abnormal clonal population, using amplification method | TRB@ (T cell antigen receptor, beta) (eg, leukemia and lymphoma), gene rearrangement analysis to detect abnormal clonal population(s) | T cell antigen receptor, beta (TRB@) gene rearrangement analysis for detection of abnormal clonal population, using direct probe method | T cell antigen receptor, beta (TRB@) gene rearrangement analysis for detection of abnormal clonal population, using Southern blot method | Molecular pathology procedure, Level 3 - T cell antigen receptor, delta (TCD@) gene rearrangement analysis for detection of abnormal clonal population | T cell antigen receptor, beta (TRB@) gene rearrangement analysis for detection of abnormal clonal population, using polymerase chain reaction method | TRB@ (T cell antigen receptor, beta) (eg, leukemia and lymphoma), gene rearrangement analysis to detect abnormal clonal population(s); using amplification methodology (eg, polymerase chain reaction)

HP_0032578.label: third ventricle colloid cyst
HP_0032578.definition: An epithelial lined cyst filled with gelatinous material. The gelatinous material commonly contains mucin, old blood, cholesterol, and ions. Most colloid cysts identified are currently asymptomatic and identified incidentally on imaging. When a colloid cyst does cause issues, it most commonly causes obstructive hydrocephalus.
HP_0032578.UMLS synonyms: Colloid cysts of third ventricle | Adult Third Ventricle Colloid Cyst | Childhood Third Ventricle Colloid Cyst | cyst; brain, third ventricle (colloid), congenital

HP_0032579.label: vascular hamartoma
HP_0032579.definition: A benign focal growth composed of vascular tissue.
HP_0032579.UMLS synonyms: Nevus sanguineous | Vascular hamartoma of skin | Strawberry nevus of skin

HP_0032580.label: abnormal bulbus cordis morphology
HP_0032580.definition: Abnormal structure of the bulbus cordis, which is the single outflow tract of the heart during early embryogenesis.

HP_0032581.label: abnormal renal insterstitial morphology
HP_0032581.definition: Any structural anomaly of the interstitium of the kidney. The renal interstitium is defined as the intertubular, extraglomerular, extravascular space of the kidney. It is bounded on all sides by tubular and vascular basement membranes and is filled with cells, extracellular matrix, and interstitial fluid.

HP_0032582.label: renal interstitial foam cells
HP_0032582.definition: Accumulation of foam cells (FC) in the interstitium of the kidney. Renal FCs display phenotypic characteristics of macrophages and belong to the monocyte/macrophage lineage. Histologically, renal FCs are characterized by round cells with small nuclei and an abundant PAS-positive cytoplasm with lipid-containing vacuoles.

HP_0032584.label: renal interstitial neutrophil infiltration
HP_0032584.definition: Increased numbers of neutrophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

HP_0032585.label: renal interstitial eosinophil infiltration
HP_0032585.definition: Increased numbers of eosinophils in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

HP_0032586.label: renal interstitial plasma cell infiltration
HP_0032586.definition: Increased numbers of plasma cells in the interstitial tissues of the kidney.

HP_0032587.label: renal interstitial calcium oxalate
HP_0032587.definition: The presence of birefringent calcium- and oxalate deposits in interstitial cells of the kidney.

HP_0032588.label: hand apraxia
HP_0032588.definition: Inability to perform purposeful (learned) movements with the hand upon command, even though the command is understood and there is a willingness to perform the movement. Hand apraxia includes the inability to grasp, pick up, and hold large and small objects.

HP_0032589.label: renal lymphocytic tubulitis
HP_0032589.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by lymphocytes.

HP_0032590.label: renal neutrophilic tubulitis
HP_0032590.definition: Infiltration of the renal tubular epithelium by neutrophils.

HP_0032591.label: renal interstitial hemosiderin
HP_0032591.definition: Deposition of hemosiderin (a golden-brown, granular pigment derived from ferritin) in interstitial cells of the kidney.

HP_0032592.label: aplasia of the right hemidiaphragm
HP_0032592.definition: Congenital absence of the right-sided diaphragm.

HP_0032593.label: myoglobin casts
HP_0032593.definition: A type of acelluar casts with positive myoglobin staining A that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented.
HP_0032593.UMLS synonyms: Myoglobin casts | Urine sediment | Urinalysis | Myoglobin casts:PrThr:Pt:Urine sed:Ord:Microscopy.light

HP_0032594.label: renal tubular basement membrane denudation
HP_0032594.definition: Naked basement membranes without tubular epithelium.

HP_0032595.label: renal tubular epithelial cell detachment
HP_0032595.definition: Tubular cross section with a space between the basolateral aspect of tubular epithelium and its basement membrane; classified as global when at least 2/3 circumference of the tubular cross section are involved and segmental when less than 2/3 are involved.

HP_0032596.label: renal tubular epithelial cell cytoplasmic vacuolization
HP_0032596.definition: Tubular cross section with intracytoplasmic vacuoles in at least one tubular epithelial cell. This feature is classified as isometric when vacuoles are round and similar in size and coarse when vacuoles were not round in shape or varied in size.

HP_0032597.label: renal tubular epithelial cell sloughing
HP_0032597.definition: At least one free floating cell in the tubular lumen without attachment to adjacent cells or basement membrane in a tubular cross section without detachment. These cells must not aggregate into a tubular shape and completely fill the lumen, if so, it should be classified as a cast.

HP_0032598.label: blebbing of apical cytoplasm of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP_0032598.definition: Tubular cross section with round/irregular cytoplasmic protrusion, shaped like the Greek capital letter Omega (or it may be more vertically elongated Omega), pinched off from apical membrane without apparent closure of the lumen, involving over 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section. The feature can be further classified into proximal or distal tubule.

HP_0032599.label: abnormal renal tubular epithelial morphology
HP_0032599.definition: Any structural anomaly of the renal tubular epithelial cells (RTEC), a layer of cells in the outer layer of the renal tubule. These cells play a role in the absorption of substances such as glucose and amino from the primary urine.

HP_0032600.label: renal tubular epithelial cell hyaline droplets
HP_0032600.definition: Tubular epithelium with round strongly PAS-positive cytoplasmic droplet material in at least one tubular epithelial cell.

HP_0032601.label: multinucleation of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP_0032601.definition: Tubular epithelial cells with greater than 3 nuclei in a single epithelial cell, often overlapping with each other in a single plane of view.

HP_0032602.label: prominent nucleoli of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP_0032602.definition: Tubular epithelium with nucleoli clearly visible at 100-fold magnification.

HP_0032603.label: renal tubular epithelial cell simplification
HP_0032603.definition: Tubular cross section with flattened tubular cell cytoplasm (height unequivocally less than width), with complete loss of brush border involving greater than 50 percent of the tubular cells in cross section, resulting in an apparent increase in the size of the lumen, without the presence of casts.

HP_0032604.label: renal tubular epithelial cell mitosis
HP_0032604.definition: Tubular epithelial cells in any mitotic phase, identified by distinctively visible chromosome in either prophase, metaphase, anaphase or telophase configuration.

HP_0032605.label: high renal tubular epithelial cell n / c ratio
HP_0032605.definition: At least one tubular epithelial cell with average sized cytoplasmic area and a nuclear area 3 times greater than average sized nuclei.
HP_0032605.synonyms: high n / c ratio of renal tubular epithelial cells

HP_0032606.label: renal tubular epithelial lipofuscin
HP_0032606.definition: Presence of increased amount of lipofuscin, a yellow, granular cytoplasmic pigment in the renal tubules.

HP_0032607.label: renal tubular epithelial cell swelling
HP_0032607.definition: Tubular cross section lined entirely by tubular epithelium with convex apical cell membrane (i.e., cells are shaped like an upside down U, and lack a distinct smaller protrusion seen in blebbing as defined above) resulting in apparent complete closure of the lumen.

HP_0032608.label: thyroidization - type tubular atrophy
HP_0032608.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by a thyroid-like appearance, with small round tubules with markedly flattened, simplified epithelium and uniform intratubular casts.

HP_0032609.label: endocrine - type tubular atrophy
HP_0032609.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy characterized by endocrine-like appearance of tubules, which are small and have narrow lumina, clear cells, and relatively thin basement membranes.
HP_0032609.synonyms: endocrinization pattern of tubular atrophy | renal tubular atrophy , endocrine - type

HP_0032610.label: tubulointerstitial mycobacterial infiltration
HP_0032610.definition: Renal tubulointerstitial infiltration of mycobacteria identified on acid-fast or Fite stains. Can be associated with granulomatous inflammation.

HP_0032611.label: renal tubular epithelial cell hemosiderin
HP_0032611.definition: Tubular epithelial cells containing cytoplasmic hemosiderin, brown-golden granular pigment.

HP_0032612.label: triphalangeal hallux
HP_0032612.definition: A hallux (big toe) with three phalanges in a single, proximo-distal axis.

HP_0032613.label: renal interstitial amyloid deposits
HP_0032613.definition: Deposition of amyloid in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Amyloid is is made up of 10 nm (on average) fibrils that are most commonly composed of monoclonal light chains (AL), transthyretin (TTR), amd LECT2, or occur in the setting of long standing systemic inflammation.
HP_0032613.synonyms: renal interstitial amyloid | renal interstitial amyloid deposition | renal interstitial amyloidosis

HP_0032614.label: renal glomerular amyloid deposition
HP_0032614.definition: Amyloid deposits located in the glomeruli in a focal segmental, diffuse segmental or diffuse global fashion. This abnormality can be accompanied by mesangial involvement and in later stages also involvement of the peripheral capillaries.

HP_0032615.label: abnormal diffusion weighted cerebral mri morphology
HP_0032615.definition: A diffusion abnormality observed in diffusion-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) of the brain. Molecular diffusion refers to the notion that any type of molecule in a fluid (eg, water) is randomly displaced as the molecule is agitated by thermal energy. Restricted diffusion of water appears bright on diffusion-weighted images.
HP_0032615.synonyms: diffusion weighted imaging ( dwi ) abnormality | diffusion weighted magnetic resonance imaging ( dwi ) abnormality | mri diffusion abnormality of the cerebrum

HP_0032616.label: renal interstitial immunoglobulin deposits
HP_0032616.definition: Accumulation of an immunoglobulin in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. The immunoglobulin may be a monoclonal Ig or the corresponding heavy-chain (HC) or light-chain (LC) subunit. By convention this definition excludes Ig-derived amyloidosis (amyloidosis can be distinguished by its affinity for Congo red staining).

HP_0032617.label: renal interstitial hemorrhage
HP_0032617.definition: A focal collection of 20 or more red blood cells within the interstitium, that is irregular in shape (i.e., collections do not conform to the shape of tubules or capillary networks), without surrounding endothelium or tubular epithelium, and is in an area of intact core.

HP_0032618.label: renal necrosis
HP_0032618.definition: Cell death (necrosis) affecting one or more parts of the kidney.
HP_0032618.UMLS synonyms: Necrosis of kidney | Renal tubular necrosis | Acute renal cortical necrosis | Acute renal papillary necrosis with renal failure | Diphtheritic renal tubular necrosis | Idiopathic Renal Papillary Necrosis | Acute Kidney Tubular Necrosis | Miscarriage with renal tubular necrosis | Kidney Papillary Necrosis | Renal necrosis and vascular insufficiency | lesion of renal cortical necrosis | lesion of renal medullary necrosis | Renal failure with tubular necrosis | Kidney Cortex Necrosis | Acute pyelitis without renal medullary necrosis | Acute pyonephrosis without renal medullary necrosis | Legal abortion with renal tubular necrosis | Illegal abortion with renal tubular necrosis | Renal tubular necrosis following ectopic pregnancy | Renal tubular necrosis following molar pregnancy | Acute pyonephrosis with renal medullary necrosis | Acute pyelitis with renal medullary necrosis | Acute renal failure due to tubular necrosis

HP_0032619.label: perinephric abscess
HP_0032619.definition: A perinephric abscess is a collection of suppurative material in the perinephric space (i.e., the connective and adipose tissues surrounding the kidney).
HP_0032619.UMLS synonyms: Perirenal abscess | tuberculous perinephric abscess | PERINEPHRIC ABSCESS SURGERY | renal abscess with perinephric abscess | Renal and perinephric abscess | tuberculous perinephric abscess TB (+) microscopy | tuberculous perinephric abscess TB (+) histology (-) bacteriology | tuberculous perinephric abscess TB (+) culture (-) microscopy | Drainage of perirenal abscess | tuberculous perinephric abscess bacteriology and histology unknown | tuberculous perinephric abscess TB (+) other way (-) bacteriology (-) histology | tuberculous perinephric abscess bacteriology and histology not done

HP_0032620.label: intrarenal abscess
HP_0032620.definition: An encapsulated collection of pus and necrotic material within the renal parenchyma. The destruction of renal parenchyma is associated with suppurative/neutrophil-rich inflammation and necrosis.

HP_0032621.label: hyperchromasia of renal tubular epithelial cells
HP_0032621.definition: At least one tubular cross section with all tubular epithelial nuclei having a chromatin pattern resembling normal mature lymphocytes.
HP_0032621.synonyms: condensed chromatin of renal tubular epithelial cells

HP_0032622.label: tubular luminal dilatation
HP_0032622.definition: Dilatation (expansion beyond the normal dimension) of the cavity (lumen) of tubules of the kidney. The tubular cross section displays an attenuated brush border (apical PAS positivity greater than 10 percent of the normal expected height, but unequivocally less than normal expected height), resulting in an apparent increase in the size of lumen.

HP_0032623.label: renal intratubular casts
HP_0032623.definition: Urinary casts are formed in the distal convoluted tubule or the collecting duct by solidification of protein in the lumen of the kidney tubules. This term refers to casts located within the tubuli of the kidney. More precisely, casts are defined as a material that completely fills and expands the tubular lumen with simplification of surrounding tubular epithelium. Casts are classified as either nuclear debris/granular brown material, red blood cell, white blood cell, myeloma, or myoglobin cast.

HP_0032624.label: intratubular bilirubin casts
HP_0032624.definition: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. On H&E (red brown), PAS (amaranth purple), trichrome (red with ragged contours), Hall (olive-emerald green).

HP_0032625.label: intratubular erythrocyte cast
HP_0032625.definition: Casts that contain red blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

HP_0032626.label: intratubular vancomycin casts
HP_0032626.definition: Intratubular casts composed of vancomycin aggregates and uromodulin.

HP_0032627.label: intratubular leukocyte casts
HP_0032627.definition: Casts that contain white blood cells and are located within the tubuli of the kidney.

HP_0032629.label: intratubular dihydroxyadenuria crystals
HP_0032629.definition: Intratubular crystals composed of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine are small needle-shaped brownish crystals that are highly birefringent under polarized light and black by Jones methenamine silver.

HP_0032630.label: intratubular light - chain casts
HP_0032630.definition: The presence of casts containing immunoglobulin light chains within the lumina of the renal tubules.

HP_0032631.label: intratubular hemoglobin casts
HP_0032631.definition: A type of acelluar intratubular casts that have a surface composed of granules, which can vary in size. The granules can be rather heterogeneous, ranging from fine (finely granular cast) up to coarse (coarsely granular cast), dark, clear, and pigmented. On H&E (red granular), PAS (purple), trichrome (red granular), Hall (yellow brown). Stain positively for Hemoglobin A.

HP_0032632.label: renal papillary necrosis
HP_0032632.definition: Premature death of cells in the renal papilla (the apex of a renal pyramid which projects into the cavity of a calyx of the kidney and through which collecting ducts discharge urine). Histologically, one observes pale tissue with typical appearance of coagulative necrosis, affecting the renal papillae. Necrosis can be identified by pyknotic nuclei and simplified, flattened epithelium of proximal tubules. The tubular and glomerular basement membranes are still visible without viable nuclei.
HP_0032632.UMLS synonyms: Kidney Papillary Necrosis | Idiopathic Renal Papillary Necrosis | Acute renal papillary necrosis with renal failure | Nephropathy NOS with renal papillary necrosis | Nephritis NOS with renal papillary necrosis | Renal papillary necrosis due to diabetes mellitus | Renal papillary necrosis caused by analgesic drug | ultrasound of kidney: papillary necrosis of kidney | Medullary [papillary] necrosis NOS | Renal papillary necrosis due to sickle cell disease | ultrasound of kidney: papillary necrosis of both kidneys | Acute kidney failure with lesion of renal medullary [papillary] necrosis | ultrasound of kidney: papillary necrosis of left kidney only | ultrasound of kidney: papillary necrosis of right kidney only

HP_0032633.label: intratubular hyaline casts
HP_0032633.definition: A type of acellular urinary cast located within the distal tubules of the kidney and that is composed only of Tamm-Horsfall glycoprotein. Correspondingly, these casts have a low refractive index. Hyaline casts may display a spectrum of morphologies, which includes fluffy, compact, convoluted or wrinkled casts. Hyaline casts have a smooth texture and usually have parallel sides with clear margins and blunted ends.

HP_0032634.label: intratubular myoglobin cast
HP_0032634.definition: Casts located within the tubuli of the kidney and that contain myoglobin. Myoglobin casts are composed of round granules that may line up in chains or aggregate in clusters. Their color ranges from pink to red-brown with hematoxylin and eosin stain, light brown to black with Jones methenamine silver stain, pink to bright magenta with periodic acid-Schiff stain, and bright red with trichrome stain. Immunoperoxidase staining with antibody to myoglobin is stronglypositive in the casts.Electron microscopy shows globular casts with an electron-dense core and a somewhat less-intense periphery. Substructure is absent. This feature may be accompanied by acute tubular injury with variable flattening of tubular epithelial cells, loss of brush borders, and intratubular sloughed epithelial cells.

HP_0032635.label: tubulointerstitial microganismal infiltration
HP_0032635.definition: Infiltration of microorganisms into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as observed by appropriate staining procedures, e.g., bacteria on a bacterial stain (Brown and Hopps) or fungi on PAS or silver stain.

HP_0032636.label: tubulointerstitial viral infiltration
HP_0032636.definition: Infiltration of viruses into renal tubulointerstitial tissues as demonstrated on renal biopsy by viral inclusions which can be seen on routine stains or with immunohistochemistry.

HP_0032637.label: renal interstitial edema
HP_0032637.definition: Edema is characterized but the acute swelling of the stroma, with expansion of the interstitial space without the a concurrent increase in interstitial cells or extracellular matrix. Histologically this change is appreciated as interstitial areas of lower optical density.

HP_0032638.label: elevated urine mevalonic acid level
HP_0032638.definition: An abnormally increased amount of mevanolate in the urine. Mevanolate is that hydroxy monocarboxylic acid anion that is the conjugate base of mevalonic acid.
HP_0032638.synonyms: elevated urine mevalonate | elevated urine mevalonate levels | elevated urine mevalonic acid | mevalonate aciduria

HP_0032639.label: elevated leukocyte cystine
HP_0032639.definition: An increased concentration of cystine within white blood cells.

HP_0032640.label: elevated circulating ccl18 level
HP_0032640.definition: An increased concentration of C-C motif chemokine ligand 18 in the blood circulation.
HP_0032640.synonyms: increased c - c motif chemokine ligand 18 concentration

HP_0032641.label: renal interstitial granulomas
HP_0032641.definition: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present.

HP_0032642.label: renal interstitial necrotizing granulomas
HP_0032642.definition: An organized collection of histiocytes (specifically macrophages) localized in the interstitial tissue of the kidney. Through light microscopy, the activated histiocytes appear as epithelioid cells with round to oval nuclei, often with irregular contours and abundant granular eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders. They may also coalesce to form multinucleated giant cells. Granulomas may be associated with a peripheral cuff of lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined. Granulomas can present as necrotizing or non-necrotizing. Microscopically, necrotizing granulomas distinctly have central necrosis with a palisaded lymphohistiocytic reaction and a cuff of chronic inflammation.

HP_0032643.label: renal interstitial non - necrotizing granulomas
HP_0032643.definition: Interstital aggregates of histiciocytes, occasionally multinucleated with associated lymphoplasmacytic and occasionally eosinophilic inflammation. Organization can range from poorly-to-well defined and multinucleated giant cells may be present with no necrosis.

HP_0032644.label: renal interstitial deposits
HP_0032644.definition: Abnormal accumulation of a metabolite, protein, or protein-derived substance in the interstitial region of the kidney.

HP_0032645.label: renal interstitial mononuclear cell infiltration
HP_0032645.definition: Presence of interstitial mononuclear leukocytes, i.e., white blood ceclls with a single round nucleus, including lymphocytes and monocytes but not including granulocytes (which have multilobed nuclei).

HP_0032646.label: renal interstitial xanthogranulomatous inflammation
HP_0032646.definition: Inflammation of interstitial tissues of the kidney consisting of foamy macrophages admixed with plasma cells, lymphocytes and neutrophils and occasional giant cells.

HP_0032647.label: renal tubular epithelial cell apoptosis
HP_0032647.definition: Increased apoptosis (programmed cell death) of tubular epithelial cells. The cells arre rounded with increased eosinophilia and contain fragmented, densely basophilic nuclear debris.

HP_0032648.label: tubularization of bowman capsule
HP_0032648.definition: The presence of cuboidal to columnar epithelium (height greater than width) lining the Bowman capsule, in an absence of adjacent segmental sclerosis, crescents, or collapsing variant of focal segmental glomerulosclerosis; scored as present or absent in at least one glomerulus.

HP_0032649.label: skewfoot
HP_0032649.definition: A type of flat-foot characterized by hindfoot abductovalgus, metatarsus adductus, and Achilles tendon shortening. The predominant radiographic findings include forefoot adduction with lateral subluxation of the navicular on the talus and heel valgus. Very abnormal shoe wear is noted on the medial side. Calluses occur under the metatarsal heads and the head of the plantar-flexed talus.

HP_0032650.label: elevated csf glial fibrillary acidic protein concentration
HP_0032650.definition: Increased concentration of glial fibrillary acidic protein in cerebrospinal fluid.
HP_0032650.synonyms: elevated csf glial fibrillary acidic protein level

HP_0032651.label: elevated csf chitinase - 3 - like protein 1 concentration
HP_0032651.definition: Increased concentration of chitinase-3-like protein 1 in cerebrospinal fluid.
HP_0032651.synonyms: elevated csf chitinase - 3 - like protein 1 level

HP_0032652.label: elevated csf chitotriosidase 1 concentration
HP_0032652.definition: Increased concentration of chitotriosidase 1 in cerebrospinal fluid.

HP_0032653.label: elevated lactate : pyruvate ratio
HP_0032653.definition: An abnormal increase in the molar ratio of lactate to pyruvate in the blood circulation.

HP_0032654.label: impaired flow - mediated arterial dilatation
HP_0032654.definition: Flow-mediated dilatation is a noninvasive tests of endothelial function that leverages ultrasound to measure arterial diameter and its response to an increase in shear stress, which normally causes endothelium-dependent dilatation. This term pertains to an abnormal reduction in the magnitude of dilatation. Flow-mediated dilatation is usually measured at the brachial artery.

HP_0032655.label: decreased adipose tissue tocopherol level
HP_0032655.definition: A reduced concentration of tocopherol in fat tissue.

HP_0032656.label: febrile status epilepticus
HP_0032656.definition: A seizure lasting 30 minutes without fully regaining consciousness, provoked by fever (temperature greater than 38.0 degrees Celcius) at the time of seizure-onset, without a prior history of afebrile seizure and with no evidence of an acute central nervous system infection or insult.
HP_0032656.UMLS synonyms: Status epilepticus (at age 4 following febrile illness)

HP_0032657.label: elevated circulating lyso - globotriaosylsphingosine concentration
HP_0032657.definition: An abnormal increase in the level of globotriaosylsphingosine (Lyso-Gb3) in the blood circulation.

HP_0032658.label: status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms
HP_0032658.definition: Status epilepticus with prominent motor signs during the prolonged seizure.
HP_0032658.UMLS synonyms: Status epilepticus with prominent motor symptoms

HP_0032659.label: non - convulsive status epilepticus with coma
HP_0032659.definition: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms and in the presence of coma.

HP_0032660.label: convulsive status epilepticus
HP_0032660.definition: A type of status epilepticus characterized by a prolonged bilateral tonic-clonic seizure, or repeated bilateral tonic-clonic seizures without recovery between.
HP_0032660.UMLS synonyms: Non-Convulsive Status Epilepticus | Generalized convulsive status epilepticus | Grand Mal Status Epilepticus | Tonic-clonic status epilepticus | Non-convulsive simple partial status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, intractable with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, intractable without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, not intractable with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, not intractable without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure without status epilepticus | Petit mal status | Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic status epilepticus | Typical absence status epilepticus | Atypical absence status epilepticus | grand mal seizure with intractable seizure, with status epilepticus | grand mal seizure without intractable seizure, with status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, without intractable seizure, with status epilepticus

HP_0032661.label: generalized convulsive status epilepticus
HP_0032661.definition: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of generalized onset that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.
HP_0032661.UMLS synonyms: Generalized convulsive status epilepticus | Grand Mal Status Epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, intractable without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, intractable with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, not intractable with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive epilepsy, not intractable without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure with status epilepticus | Petit mal status | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, without intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, without intractable seizure, with status epilepticus

HP_0032662.label: focal - onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus
HP_0032662.definition: A type of bilateral convulsive seizure of focal onset (which could be with awareness or impaired awareness, either motor or non- motor) that is sufficiently prolonged (or repeated without recovery) to reach the threshold for status epilepticus.
HP_0032662.synonyms: focal onset seizure evolving into bilateral convulsive status epilepticus | focal - onset seizure evolving into generalised convulsive status epilepticus | focal - onset seizure evolving into generalized convulsive status epilepticus | partial onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus | partial - onset seizure evolving into convulsive status epilepticus | secondarily generalised convulsive status epilepticus | secondarily generalised tonic - clonic status epilepticus | secondarily generalized convulsive status epilepticus | secondarily generalized tonic - clonic status epilepticus

HP_0032663.label: focal motor status epilepticus
HP_0032663.definition: Status epilepticus with focal motor signs originating within networks limited to one hemisphere. Involves musculature in any form. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.

HP_0032664.label: adversive status epilepticus
HP_0032664.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by continuous neck or body rotation and conjugate gaze deviation in a direction contralateral to the responsible epileptic focus. This includes some forms of tonic status epilepticus.

HP_0032665.label: repeated focal motor seizures
HP_0032665.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repeated motor, typically clonic events repeatedly affecting the same segments of the body with spread of clonic movements through contiguous body parts unilaterally, and repeating over a sufficiently prolonged period to reach a diagnosis of status epilepticus.

HP_0032666.label: hyperkinetic status epilepticus
HP_0032666.definition: Status epilepticus characterized by continuous hyperkinetic proximal limb or axial muscles producing irregular sequential ballistic movements such as pedaling pelvic thrusting, thrashing, or rocking movements.

HP_0032667.label: myoclonic status epilepticus
HP_0032667.definition: A type of motor status epilepticus with repeating bilateral sudden brief (less than 100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography.
HP_0032667.UMLS synonyms: Myoclonic status epilepticus | Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy, Intractable, with Status Epilepticus | Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy, Intractable, without Status Epilepticus | myoclonic seizure, not intractable with status epilepticus | myoclonic seizure, not intractable without status epilepticus | Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy, not Intractable, with Status Epilepticus | Juvenile Myoclonic Epilepsy, not Intractable, without Status Epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, with status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, without intractable seizure, with status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, without intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure without status epilepticus

HP_0032668.label: myoclonic status epilepticus without coma
HP_0032668.definition: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the absence of coma.

HP_0032669.label: myoclonic status epilepticus with coma
HP_0032669.definition: A type of myoclonic status epilepticus in the presence of coma.

HP_0032670.label: tonic status epilepticus
HP_0032670.definition: Tonic status epilepticus is a type of status epilepticus characterized by focal or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, which may be electrographically generalized or focal.
HP_0032670.UMLS synonyms: Tonic-clonic status epilepticus | Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic status epilepticus | Generalized convulsive status epilepticus

HP_0032671.label: non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP_0032671.definition: A type of status epilepticus without prominent motor symptoms in the absence of coma.

HP_0032672.label: autonomic status epilepticus
HP_0032672.definition: Autonomic status epilepticus is a type of non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma with prominent autonomic features regardless of whether it is electrographically generalized or focal.

HP_0032673.label: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP_0032673.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically focal. It is a prolonged focal non-motor seizure.

HP_0032674.label: cutaneous wound
HP_0032674.definition: A cutaneous wound is a defined as a disruption of normal anatomic structure and function of the skin that occurs owing to an injury of the skin. Wound healing is a dynamic, interactive process involving soluble mediators, blood cells, extracellularmatrix, and parenchymal cells. Wound healing has three phases: inflammation, tissue formation, and tissue remodeling, that overlap in time.

HP_0032675.label: acute cutaneous wound
HP_0032675.definition: A cutaneous wound that is proceeding through an orderly and timely reparative process that results in sustained restoration of the anatomic and functional integrity of the skin.

HP_0032676.label: chronic cutaneous wound
HP_0032676.definition: A cutaneous wound that has failed to proceed through the orderly and timely process to produce an atomic and functional integrity, or proceeded through the repair process without establishing a sustained anatomic and functional result.

HP_0032677.label: generalized - onset motor seizure
HP_0032677.definition: A generalized motor seizure is a type of generalized-onset seizure with predominantly motor (involving musculature) signs. The motor event could consist of an increase (positive) or decrease (negative) in muscle contraction to produce a movement.
HP_0032677.synonyms: generalised onset motor seizure | generalised - onset motor seizure | generalized onset motor seizure
HP_0032677.UMLS synonyms: Generalized onset motor epileptic seizure | Absence Epilepsy | Seizures, partial with secondary generalization, focal at onset, usually motor

HP_0032678.label: eyelid myoclonia seizure
HP_0032678.definition: An eyelid myoclonia seizure is a type of generalized myoclonic seizure which may or may not be associated with loss of awareness.

HP_0032679.label: focal non - motor seizure
HP_0032679.definition: A type of focal-onset seizure characterized by non-motor signs or symptoms (or behaviour arrest) as its initial semiological manifestation.
HP_0032679.synonyms: focal seizure without motor onset | partial seizure without motor onset
HP_0032679.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Focal onset nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0032680.label: focal cognitive seizure
HP_0032680.definition: A focal cognitive seizure involves an alteration in a cognitive function (which can be a deficit or a positive phenomenon such as forced thought), which occurs at seizure onset. To be classified as a focal cognitive seizure, the change in cognitive function should be specific and out of proportion to other relatively unimpaired aspects of cognition, because all cognition is impaired in a focal impaired awareness seizure.
HP_0032680.synonyms: cognitive aura | cognitive seizure | partial cognitive seizure
HP_0032680.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware cognitive epileptic seizure | Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure with illusions | Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure with hallucinations | Focal onset impaired awareness cognitive epileptic seizure | Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure with dysphasia | Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure with memory impairment

HP_0032681.label: focal aware cognitive seizure
HP_0032681.definition: A focal aware cognitive seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP_0032681.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware cognitive epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness cognitive epileptic seizure

HP_0032682.label: focal aware non - motor seizure
HP_0032682.definition: A focal non-motor seizure in which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP_0032682.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0032683.label: obsolete focal aware cognitive seizure with impaired attention

HP_0032684.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
HP_0032684.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032685.label: focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
HP_0032685.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by auditory agnosia as the initial semiological manifestation. For example a person may hear a ringing sound, but may not connect this with the concept that the sound is from a telephone ringing.

HP_0032686.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with memory impairment
HP_0032686.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032687.label: focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment
HP_0032687.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by transient memory impairment as the initial semiological manifestation whilst other cognitive functions and awareness are preserved at seizure onset. The memory impairment may be an inability to recall events occurring prior to the seizure (retrograde amnesia), or failure to encode new memories for events occurring during the seizure (anterograde amnesia).
HP_0032687.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset cognitive epileptic seizure with memory impairment

HP_0032688.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with dissociation
HP_0032688.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dissociation characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032689.label: focal cognitive seizure with dissociation
HP_0032689.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by an experience of being disconnected from, though aware of, self or environment as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032690.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia
HP_0032690.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia and or acalculia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032691.label: focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia
HP_0032691.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyscalculia / acalculia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032692.label: focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking
HP_0032692.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by forced thinking as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032693.label: focal cognitive seizure with neglect
HP_0032693.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by neglect as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032694.label: focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia
HP_0032694.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dyslexia / alexia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032696.label: focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032696.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by receptive dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032697.label: obsolete focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP_0032697.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by memory phenomena such as feelings of familiarity (deja vu) and unfamiliarity (jamais vu) as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032698.label: focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032698.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by conduction dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032699.label: focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia
HP_0032699.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by dysgraphia / agraphia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032700.label: focal cognitive seizure with left - right confusion
HP_0032700.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by left-right confusion as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032701.label: focal cognitive seizure with anomia
HP_0032701.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by anomia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032702.label: focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032702.definition: A focal cognitive seizure characterized by expressive dysphasia / aphasia as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032704.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with illusion
HP_0032704.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032705.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with forced thinking
HP_0032705.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032706.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with left - right confusion
HP_0032706.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032707.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia
HP_0032707.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032708.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with anomia
HP_0032708.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with anomia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032709.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia
HP_0032709.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032710.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032710.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032711.label: focal aware clonic seizure
HP_0032711.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP_0032711.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware clonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness clonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032712.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure
HP_0032712.definition: A type of focal motor seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032712.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness motor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0032713.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with version
HP_0032713.definition: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032713.synonyms: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with version

HP_0032714.label: focal impaired awareness bilateral motor seizure
HP_0032714.definition: A focal bilateral motor seizure characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032715.label: focal bilateral motor seizure
HP_0032715.definition: A type of focal motor seizure (it commences in one hemisphere) involving bilateral muscle groups rapidly at seizure onset.

HP_0032716.label: focal impaired awareness non - motor seizure
HP_0032716.definition: A focal non-motor seizure characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032716.synonyms: focal non - motor impaired awareness seizure
HP_0032716.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0032717.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with dystonia
HP_0032717.definition: A focal motor seizure with dystonia characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032717.synonyms: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with dystonia

HP_0032718.label: focal motor seizure with dystonia
HP_0032718.definition: A focal motor seizure in which the initial semiological manifestation is the sustained contraction of both agonist and antagonist muscles producing athetoid or twisting movements, which produces abnormal postures.

HP_0032719.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria
HP_0032719.definition: A focal motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032719.synonyms: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with dysarthria / anarthria

HP_0032720.label: focal motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria
HP_0032720.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by difficulty with articulation of speech, due to impaired coordination of muscles involved in speech sound production as the initial semiological manifestation. Receptive and expressive language functions are intact, however speech is poorly articulated and is less intelligible.

HP_0032721.label: focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis
HP_0032721.definition: A focal motor seizure characterized by weakness or complete paralysis of a muscle or group of muscles as the initial semiological manifestation.

HP_0032722.label: focal aware tonic seizure
HP_0032722.definition: A type of focal tonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP_0032722.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware tonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness tonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032723.label: focal aware motor seizure with dystonia
HP_0032723.definition: A focal motor seizure with dystonia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032723.synonyms: focal motor aware seizure with dystonia

HP_0032724.label: focal impaired awareness tonic seizure
HP_0032724.definition: A focal tonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032724.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness tonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032725.label: focal impaired awareness clonic seizure
HP_0032725.definition: A type of focal clonic seizure during which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point in the seizure.
HP_0032725.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness clonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032726.label: focal impaired awareness hyperkinetic seizure
HP_0032726.definition: A focal hyperkinetic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032726.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness hyperkinetic epileptic seizure

HP_0032727.label: focal emotional seizure with agitation
HP_0032727.definition: Focal emotional seizure with agitation is characterized by the presence of psychomotor agitation as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. Because of the unpleasant nature of these seizures, patients may also have anticipatory anxiety about having seizures.

HP_0032728.label: focal impaired awareness atonic seizure
HP_0032728.definition: A focal atonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032728.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness atonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032729.label: focal emotional seizure with pleasure
HP_0032729.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure is characterized by the presence of a positive emotional experience with pleasure, bliss, joy, enhanced personal well-being, heightened self-awareness or ecstasy.

HP_0032730.label: focal impaired awareness myoclonic seizure
HP_0032730.definition: A focal myoclonic seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032730.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness myoclonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032731.label: focal aware hyperkinetic seizure
HP_0032731.definition: A type of focal hypermotor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP_0032731.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware hyperkinetic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness hyperkinetic epileptic seizure

HP_0032732.label: focal aware motor seizure with paresis / paralysis
HP_0032732.definition: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032732.synonyms: focal motor aware seizure with paresis / paralysis

HP_0032733.label: focal aware motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria
HP_0032733.definition: A focal motor seizure with dysarthria / anarthria characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032733.synonyms: focal motor aware seizure with dysarthria / anarthria

HP_0032734.label: focal aware emotional seizure
HP_0032734.definition: A focal emotional seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP_0032734.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware emotional epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness emotional epileptic seizure

HP_0032735.label: focal aware emotional seizure with anger
HP_0032735.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032736.label: focal emotional seizure with anger
HP_0032736.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger is characterized by the presence of anger, as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. It may be accompanied by aggressive behaviour.

HP_0032737.label: focal emotional seizure with paranoia
HP_0032737.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia is characterized by the presence of paranoia as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure.

HP_0032738.label: focal aware emotional seizure with fear / anxiety / panic
HP_0032738.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure, in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032739.label: focal emotional seizure with fear / anxiety / panic
HP_0032739.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety is characterized by the presence of anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion, at the outset of the seizure. Because of the unpleasant nature of these seizures, patients may also have anticipatory anxiety about having seizures.

HP_0032740.label: focal aware autonomic seizure
HP_0032740.definition: A focal aware autonomic seizure has an initial manifestation pertaining to autonomic nervous system function, which may be objective (for example, pupillary dilation) or subjective (for example, nausea). As a type of focal aware seizure, awareness is retained throughout.
HP_0032740.synonyms: focal autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness | localised autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness | localized autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness | partial autonomic seizures without altered responsiveness
HP_0032740.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware autonomic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness autonomic epileptic seizure

HP_0032741.label: focal aware emotional seizure with paranoia
HP_0032741.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032742.label: focal aware emotional seizure with pleasure
HP_0032742.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032743.label: focal aware emotional seizure with crying
HP_0032743.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying (dacrystic)in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032744.label: focal aware emotional seizure with agitation
HP_0032744.definition: Focal emotional seizure with agitation in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032745.label: focal aware emotional seizure with laughing
HP_0032745.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032746.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure
HP_0032746.definition: A focal emotional seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032746.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness emotional epileptic seizure

HP_0032747.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with pleasure
HP_0032747.definition: Focal emotional seizure with pleasure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032748.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with anger
HP_0032748.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anger in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032749.definition: Focal emotional seizure with paranoia in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032750.definition: Focal emotional seizure with laughing in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032751.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with crying
HP_0032751.definition: Focal emotional seizure with crying in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032752.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with fear / anxiety / panic
HP_0032752.definition: Focal emotional seizure with anxiety, fear or panic as an expressed or observed emotion at the outset of the seizure, in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032753.label: focal impaired awareness emotional seizure with agitation
HP_0032753.definition: A focal emotional seizure with agitation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032754.label: focal aware sensory seizure
HP_0032754.definition: A focal sensory seizure during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.
HP_0032754.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware sensory epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness sensory epileptic seizure

HP_0032755.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure
HP_0032755.definition: A focal autonomic seizure characterised by impaired awareness at some point within the seizure.
HP_0032755.synonyms: focal autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness | localised autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness | localized autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness | partial autonomic seizure with altered responsiveness
HP_0032755.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness autonomic epileptic seizure

HP_0032756.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure
HP_0032756.definition: A focal cognitive seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032756.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness cognitive epileptic seizure

HP_0032757.label: focal aware hemiclonic seizure
HP_0032757.definition: A focal hemiclonic seizure in which awareness is retained throughout.

HP_0032758.label: focal aware myoclonic seizure
HP_0032758.definition: A type of focal myoclonic seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP_0032758.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware myoclonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness myoclonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032759.label: focal sensory seizure with vestibular features
HP_0032759.definition: A seizure characterized by symptoms of dizziness, spinning, vertigo or sense of rotation as its first clinical manifestation.
HP_0032759.synonyms: focal vestibular seizure | partial vestibular seizure | vestibular aura

HP_0032760.label: focal sensory seizure with hot - cold sensations
HP_0032760.definition: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot or cold as its first clinical manifestation.

HP_0032761.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing
HP_0032761.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032762.label: focal autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing
HP_0032762.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes of the skin as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032763.label: focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction
HP_0032763.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by pupillary dilatation or contraction as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032764.label: focal autonomic seizure with erection
HP_0032764.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterised by penile erection as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032765.label: focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate
HP_0032765.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by an urge to unripe or defecate as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032766.label: focal autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration
HP_0032766.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes in respiratory rate as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032767.label: focal autonomic seizure with piloerection
HP_0032767.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032768.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction
HP_0032768.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032769.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration
HP_0032769.definition: An autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032770.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with erection
HP_0032770.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with erection characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032771.label: focal autonomic seizure with lacrimation
HP_0032771.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by lacrimation as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032772.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with piloerection
HP_0032772.definition: A Focal autonomic seizure with piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032773.label: focal autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
HP_0032773.definition: A type of focal autonomic seizure characterized by changes in heart rate as the initial semiological feature.

HP_0032774.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate
HP_0032774.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032775.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration
HP_0032775.definition: An autonomic seizure with hypoventilation / hyperventilation / altered respiration characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032776.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with lacrimation

HP_0032777.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing
HP_0032777.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pallor / flushing characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032778.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena
HP_0032778.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032779.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction
HP_0032779.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with pupillary dilation / constriction characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032780.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with erection
HP_0032780.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with erection characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032781.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate
HP_0032781.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with urge to urinate / defecate characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032782.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with lacrimation
HP_0032782.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with lacrimation characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032783.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with piloerection
HP_0032783.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with piloerection (bristling of hairs due to the involuntary contraction of small muscles at the base of hair follicles) characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032784.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
HP_0032784.definition: An autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032785.label: focal aware autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena
HP_0032785.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with epigastric sensation / nausea / vomiting / other gastrointestinal phenomena characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032786.label: migrating focal seizure
HP_0032786.definition: A migrating focal seizure is a seizure that involves different body parts, usually without overlap, in a consecutive manner so that the offset of a seizure in one part coincides with its onset in another, even shifting multiple times between the sides of the body. They can be associated with autonomic manifestations.
HP_0032786.UMLS synonyms: Migrating focal or multifocal origin seizures | Epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures | Epilepsy of infancy with migrating focal seizures (EIMFS) | Malignant migrating partial seizures of infancy (disorder)

HP_0032787.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure
HP_0032787.definition: A focal sensory seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032787.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness sensory epileptic seizure

HP_0032788.label: focal impaired awareness autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole
HP_0032788.definition: A focal autonomic seizure with palpitations / tachycardia / bradycardia / asystole characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032789.label: focal aware behavior arrest seizure
HP_0032789.definition: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterised by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032789.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware behavior arrest epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness behavior arrest epileptic seizure

HP_0032790.label: focal impaired awareness behavior arrest seizure
HP_0032790.definition: A focal behavior arrest seizure characterised by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032790.synonyms: focal impaired awareness behaviour arrest seizure
HP_0032790.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness behavior arrest epileptic seizure

HP_0032791.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with anomia
HP_0032791.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with anomia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032792.label: tonic seizure
HP_0032792.definition: A tonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterised by unilateral or bilateral limb stiffening or elevation, often with neck stiffening.
HP_0032792.UMLS synonyms: Tonic Seizures | Epilepsy, Tonic | tonic seizure with intractable seizure | Generalized onset tonic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal tonic epileptic seizure | Tonic-clonic seizure, refractory | Tonic seizure, grand mal | Tonic-Clonic Seizures | Generalized onset tonic-clonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware tonic epileptic seizure | Absence seizure with tonic components | Focal Tonic Seizures | Tonic-clonic seizure, non-refractory | SEIZURE DISORDER GENERALIZED TONIC CLONIC | Focal to bilateral tonic-clonic epileptic seizure | Generalized onset myoclonic-tonic-clonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness tonic epileptic seizure

HP_0032793.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032793.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with receptive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032794.label: myoclonic seizure
HP_0032794.definition: A myoclonic seizure is a type of motor seizure characterised by sudden, brief (<100 ms) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal). Myoclonus is less regularly repetitive and less sustained than is clonus.
HP_0032794.UMLS synonyms: Myoclonic Seizures | Generalized myoclonic seizure | Myoclonic absence seizure | Myoclonic Epilepsy | Focal onset myoclonic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal myoclonic epileptic seizure | Generalized onset myoclonic-atonic epileptic seizure (finding) | myoclonic seizure, not intractable | Focal onset aware myoclonic epileptic seizure | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy without intractable seizure | Generalized onset myoclonic-tonic-clonic epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness myoclonic epileptic seizure | Myoclonic Astatic Epilepsy | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, with status epilepticus | Juvenile myoclonic epilepsy, with intractable seizure, without status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure with status epilepticus | generalized convulsive myoclonic seizure with intractable seizure without status epilepticus | myoclonic seizure, not intractable with status epilepticus

HP_0032795.label: generalized myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
HP_0032795.definition: A generalized myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterised by a single or multiple jerks of limbs bilaterally, followed by tonic and clonic phases. The initial jerks can be considered to be either a brief period of clonus or myoclonus.
HP_0032795.synonyms: generalised myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure | generalised onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure | generalised - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure | generalized onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure | generalized - onset myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
HP_0032795.UMLS synonyms: Generalized onset myoclonic-tonic-clonic epileptic seizure | Seizures (tonic-clonic, generalized myoclonic, absence, focal-onset) | Seizures, generalized tonic/clonic, myoclonic, atonic, or atypical absence, aggravated by fatigue and fasting with frequency ranges from daily to monthly

HP_0032796.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with left - right confusion
HP_0032796.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with left-right confusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032797.label: focal aware sensory seizure with olfactory features
HP_0032797.definition: Seizures characterized by olfactory phenomena at onset - usually an odor, which is often unpleasant.

HP_0032798.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with neglect
HP_0032798.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032799.label: focal impaired awareness hemiclonic seizure
HP_0032799.definition: A focal hemiclonic seizure in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032800.label: focal aware sensory seizure with vestibular features
HP_0032800.definition: A seizure characterized by symptoms of dizziness, spinning, vertigo or sense of rotation.

HP_0032801.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with memory impairment
HP_0032801.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with memory impairment characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032802.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia
HP_0032802.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyscalculia / acalculia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032803.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia
HP_0032803.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dysgraphia / agraphia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032804.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with olfactory features
HP_0032804.definition: A focal sensory seizure with olfaction in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032805.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with vestibular features
HP_0032805.definition: A focal sensory seizure with vestibular features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032806.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with visual features
HP_0032806.definition: A focal sensory seizure with visual features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032807.label: neonatal seizure
HP_0032807.definition: A seizure occurring within the neonatal period (28 days beyond the full term date).
HP_0032807.UMLS synonyms: Convulsions in the newborn | Neonatal epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal autonomic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal tonic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal clonic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal automatism epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal myoclonic epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal sequential electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal Epileptic Seizure, Adverse Event | Neonatal focal electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal electrographic-only epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal behavioral arrest epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032808.label: neonatal seizure with electrographic correlate
HP_0032808.definition: Neonatal seizure is a seizure type that occurs in neonatal period and is characterized by an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end. This event can be associated or not with a clinical manifestation.

HP_0032809.label: neonatal electro - clinical seizure
HP_0032809.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical seizure is an electrographic event occurring in neonatal period and coupled with a clinical manifestation.
HP_0032809.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal sequential electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032810.label: focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP_0032810.definition: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache as its first clinical manifestation.
HP_0032810.synonyms: cephalic aura | focal seizure with cephalic sensation | partial seizure with cephalic sensation

HP_0032811.label: neonatal electrographic only seizure
HP_0032811.definition: Neonatal electrographic only seizure is an electrographic event with sudden, repetitive, evolving stereotyped waveforms with a beginning and an end, which is not associated with a clinical manifestation.

HP_0032812.label: neonatal electro - clinical non - motor seizure
HP_0032812.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032813.label: neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure
