HP_0032813.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant motor features.
HP_0032813.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032814.label: neonatal electro - clinical clonic seizure
HP_0032814.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups; it can be symmetric or asymmetric.

HP_0032815.label: neonatal electro - clinical myoclonic seizure
HP_0032815.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal).

HP_0032816.label: neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure
HP_0032816.definition: Neonatal multifocal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at multiple sites.

HP_0032817.label: neonatal focal myoclonic seizure
HP_0032817.definition: Neonatal focal myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) which occurs focally.

HP_0032818.label: neonatal focal clonic seizure
HP_0032818.definition: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is unilateral regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups.

HP_0032819.label: neonatal bilateral clonic seizure
HP_0032819.definition: Neonatal bilateral clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the clonic jerking is bilateral.

HP_0032820.label: neonatal multifocal clonic seizure
HP_0032820.definition: Neonatal focal clonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical clonic seizure where the predominant motor feature is a regularly repeating jerking involving the same muscle groups, which occurs at multiple sites.

HP_0032821.label: neonatal electro - clinical tonic seizure
HP_0032821.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is a sustained increase in muscle tone, usually focal, that can be unilateral or bilateral, and lasting a few seconds to minutes.

HP_0032822.label: neonatal electro - clinical autonomic seizure
HP_0032822.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor autonomic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure with predominant features of autonomic alterations, involving cardiovascular, pupillary, gastrointestinal, sudomotor, vasomotor, and thermoregulatory functions. May present as apnea.

HP_0032823.label: neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behavior arrest
HP_0032823.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical non-motor seizure with behavior arrest is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure characterized by an arrest of activities, freezing, immobilization, with or without apnea and/or other autonomic manifestations.
HP_0032823.synonyms: neonatal electro - clinical seizure with behaviour arrest | neonatal electroclinical seizure with behavioural arrest

HP_0032824.label: neonatal focal tonic seizure
HP_0032824.definition: Neonatal focal tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure with a focal sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes.

HP_0032825.label: neonatal electro - clinical sequential seizure
HP_0032825.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.
HP_0032825.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal sequential electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032826.label: focal neonatal sequential seizure
HP_0032826.definition: Focal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic focal signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.
HP_0032826.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal focal sequential electro-clinical epileptic seizure

HP_0032827.label: multifocal neonatal sequential seizure
HP_0032827.definition: Multifocal neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting with a variety of clinical and electrographic multifocal signs.

HP_0032828.label: neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure
HP_0032828.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

HP_0032829.label: neonatal electro - clinical motor seizure with automatism
HP_0032829.definition: Neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure with automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, and in association with other features.
HP_0032829.synonyms: neonatal electroclinical motor seizure with automatism

HP_0032830.label: neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism
HP_0032830.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

HP_0032831.label: neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure
HP_0032831.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical tonic seizure where the sustained increase in muscle tone, lasting a few seconds to minutes, occurs at both sides of the body but asymmetrically.

HP_0032832.label: neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure
HP_0032832.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body asymmetrically.

HP_0032833.label: neonatal epileptic spasm
HP_0032833.definition: A sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that is usually more sustained than a myoclonic movement but not as sustained as a tonic seizure. Limited forms may occur: grimacing, head nodding, or subtle eye movements. May occur in clusters.

HP_0032834.label: neonatal seizure with unilateral automatism
HP_0032834.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatisms is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at one side of the body.

HP_0032835.label: neonatal seizure with bilateral symmetric automatism
HP_0032835.definition: Neonatal seizure with bilateral asymmetric automatism is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the electrographic event is correlated with a coordinated motor activity, typically oral, usually with impaired awareness, occurring at both sides of the body symmetrically.

HP_0032836.label: neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure
HP_0032836.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric myoclonic seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical motor seizure where the predominant motor feature is sudden, brief (<100 msec) involuntary single or multiple contraction of muscles or muscle groups of variable topography (axial, proximal limb, distal) that occurs at both sides of the body symmetrically.

HP_0032837.label: bilateral asymmetric neonatal sequential seizure
HP_0032837.definition: Asymmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting asymmetrically with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs, often changing lateralization within or between seizures.

HP_0032838.label: neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm
HP_0032838.definition: Neonatal unilateral epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs at one side of the body.

HP_0032839.label: bilateral symmetric neonatal sequential seizure
HP_0032839.definition: Symmetric neonatal electro-clinical sequential motor seizure is a type of neonatal electro-clinical seizure where the predominant feature cannot be detected because of seizures presenting symmetrically but with a variety of clinical and electrographic signs.

HP_0032840.label: neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm
HP_0032840.definition: Neonatal bilateral symmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs symmetrically at both sides of the body.

HP_0032841.label: neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm
HP_0032841.definition: Neonatal bilateral asymmetric epileptic spasm is a sudden flexion, extension, or mixed extension-flexion of predominantly proximal and truncal muscles that occurs asymmetrically at both sides of the body.

HP_0032842.label: generalized - onset epileptic spasm
HP_0032842.definition: A type of epileptic spasm of generalized onset.
HP_0032842.synonyms: generalised onset epileptic spasm | generalised - onset epileptic spasm | generalized onset epileptic spasm
HP_0032842.UMLS synonyms: Generalized onset epileptic spasms | Cryptogenic late-onset epileptic spasms

HP_0032843.label: focal - onset epileptic spasm
HP_0032843.definition: A type of epileptic spasm of focal onset.

HP_0032844.label: focal impaired awareness epileptic spasm
HP_0032844.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032845.label: focal aware epileptic spasm
HP_0032845.definition: A type of focal-onset epileptic spasm in which awareness is preserved throughout the seizure.

HP_0032846.label: focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP_0032846.definition: A type of focal motor seizure characterized by a sudden interruption in normal tonic muscle activity lasting 500 ms or less, without evidence of preceding myoclonus as the initial semiological manifestation. The interruption in muscle tone is briefer than seen in a focal atonic seizure.

HP_0032847.label: focal impaired awareness hemifacial clonic seizure
HP_0032847.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with impairment of awareness in which awareness is impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032848.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with neglect
HP_0032848.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with neglect characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032849.label: aphasic status epilepticus
HP_0032849.definition: Aphasic status epilepticus is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma characterized by a cognitive (rather than motor) language deficit.

HP_0032850.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032850.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032851.label: focal aware sensory seizure with visual features
HP_0032851.definition: A seizure characterized by elementary visual hallucinations such as flashing or flickering lights/colours, or other shapes, simple patterns, scotomata, or amaurosis.

HP_0032852.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032852.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032853.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with hot - cold sensations
HP_0032853.definition: A focal sensory seizure with hot-cold sensations in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032854.label: focal aware hemifacial clonic seizure
HP_0032854.definition: Focal seizure characterized at onset by clonic movements affecting half of the face with retained awareness throughout.

HP_0032855.label: photosensitive myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure
HP_0032855.definition: Generalised myoclonic-tonic-clonic seizure provoked by flashing or flickering light.
HP_0032855.synonyms: photically induced myoclonic - tonic - clonic seizure

HP_0032856.label: focal aware bilateral motor seizure
HP_0032856.definition: A type of focal bilateral motor seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032857.label: focal aware motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP_0032857.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032857.synonyms: focal motor aware seizure with negative myoclonus

HP_0032858.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with negative myoclonus
HP_0032858.definition: A focal motor seizure with negative myoclonus characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032858.synonyms: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with negative myoclonus

HP_0032859.label: focal impaired awareness motor seizure with paresis / paralysis
HP_0032859.definition: A focal motor seizure with paresis / paralysis characterized by impaired awareness at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032859.synonyms: focal motor impaired awareness seizure with paresis / paralysis

HP_0032860.label: generalized non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma
HP_0032860.definition: Generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma is a type of status epilepticus without prominent motor signs, which is electrographically generalized. It is a prolonged absence seizure.
HP_0032860.synonyms: absence status epilepticus | generalised non - convulsive status epilepticus without coma | petit mal status epilepticus

HP_0032861.label: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness
HP_0032861.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness is impaired.
HP_0032861.synonyms: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with impairment of awareness

HP_0032862.label: status epilepticus with ictal paresis
HP_0032862.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by prolonged ictal paresis or inhibitory motor seizures.

HP_0032863.label: typical absence status epilepticus
HP_0032863.definition: Typical absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged typical absence seizure.

HP_0032864.label: focal aware sensory seizure with auditory features
HP_0032864.definition: A type of focal sensory seizure with auditory features during which awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

HP_0032865.label: myoclonic absence status epilepticus
HP_0032865.definition: Myoclonic absence status epilepticus is a type of generalized non-convulsive status epilepticus without coma that is semiologically a prolonged myoclonic absence seizure. Myoclonic absence status epilepticus consists of proximal, predominantly upper extremity myoclonic jerks corresponding with 3 Hz spike-wave discharges in the EEG.

HP_0032866.label: oculoclonic status epilepticus
HP_0032866.definition: A type of focal motor status epilepticus characterized by repetitive and rapid saccades, in association with epileptic discharges.

HP_0032867.label: refractory status epilepticus
HP_0032867.definition: Refractory status epilepticus is defined as status epilepticus continuing despite two appropriately selected and dosed antiepileptic drugs, including a benzodiazepine.
HP_0032867.UMLS synonyms: New-onset refractory status epilepticus | Febrile infection related epilepsy syndrome

HP_0032868.label: super - refractory status epilepticus
HP_0032868.definition: Super-refractory status epilepticus is defined as refractory status epilepticus continuing for 24 h or more following initiation of anesthetic medications, including cases in which seizure control is attained after induction of anesthetic drugs but recurs on weaning the patient off the anesthetic agent.

HP_0032869.label: focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness
HP_0032869.definition: Focal non-convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of consciousness is a type of focal non-convulsive status epilepticus in which awareness remains intact.
HP_0032869.synonyms: aura continua | focal non - convulsive status epilepticus with retained awareness | focal non - convulsive status epilepticus without impairment of awareness

HP_0032870.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia
HP_0032870.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with dyslexia / alexia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032871.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP_0032871.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032872.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with illusion
HP_0032872.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with illusion characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032873.label: focal aware sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP_0032873.definition: A seizure characterized by a sensation in the head such as light-headedness or headache.

HP_0032874.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia
HP_0032874.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with auditory agnosia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032875.label: obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness

HP_0032876.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032876.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with conduction dysphasia / aphasia characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032877.label: focal aware sensory seizure with hot - cold sensations
HP_0032877.definition: A seizure characterized by sensations of feeling hot and then cold.

HP_0032878.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with cephalic sensation
HP_0032878.definition: A focal sensory seizure with cephalic sensation in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032879.label: focal impaired awareness seizure with dissociation at onset
HP_0032879.definition: A focal cognitive epileptic seizure with dissociation at the onset of the seizure and with impairment of awareness at at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032880.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with auditory features
HP_0032880.definition: A focal sensory seizure with auditory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032881.label: obsolete focal aware cognitive seizure with impaired responsiveness

HP_0032882.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP_0032882.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032883.label: focal aware cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu
HP_0032883.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with deja vu / jamais vu characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.

HP_0032884.label: focal aware sensory seizure with somatosensory features
HP_0032884.definition: A seizure characterized by sensory phenomena including tingling, numbness, electric-shock like sensation, pain, sense of movement, or desire to move. Awareness is retained throughout the seizure.

HP_0032885.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with hallucination
HP_0032885.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with hallucination characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032886.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia
HP_0032886.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with expressive dysphasia / aphasia characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032887.label: generalized atonic seizure
HP_0032887.definition: Generalized atonic seizure is a type of generalized motor seizure characterized by a sudden loss or diminution of muscle tone without apparent preceding myoclonic or tonic event lasting about 1-2 s, involving head, trunk, jaw, or limb musculature.
HP_0032887.UMLS synonyms: Generalized onset atonic epileptic seizure | Generalized onset myoclonic-atonic epileptic seizure (finding) | Myoclonic Astatic Epilepsy | Seizures, generalized tonic/clonic, myoclonic, atonic, or atypical absence, aggravated by fatigue and fasting with frequency ranges from daily to monthly

HP_0032888.label: focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with forced thinking
HP_0032888.definition: A focal cognitive seizure with forced thinking characterized by impairment of awareness at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032889.label: focal aware sensory seizure with gustatory features
HP_0032889.definition: A seizure characterized by taste phenomena including acidic, bitter, salty, sweet, or metallic tastes.

HP_0032890.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with somatosensory features
HP_0032890.definition: A focal sensory seizure with somatosensory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032891.label: focal aware motor seizure with version
HP_0032891.definition: A focal motor seizure with version characterized by retained awareness throughout the seizure.
HP_0032891.synonyms: focal motor aware seizure with version

HP_0032892.label: infection - related seizure
HP_0032892.definition: Seizure associated with a presumed or proven infection (excluding infection of the central nervous system) or inflammatory state without an alternative precipitant such as metabolic derangement, and regardless of the presence or absence of a fever.

HP_0032893.label: gastroenteritis - related afebrile seizure
HP_0032893.definition: Afebrile (less than 38.0 degrees Celcius), brief, and generalized seizures accompanying gastroenteritis without an alternative cause.

HP_0032894.label: seizure precipitated by febrile infection
HP_0032894.definition: Any form of seizure occurring at the time of a fever (temperature at or above 38.0 degrees Celcius) without infection of the central nervous system, and without an alternative cause such as severe metabolic derangement, occurring at any age.

HP_0032895.label: febrile seizure outside the age of 3 months to 6 years
HP_0032895.definition: Any type of seizure (most often a generalized tonic-clonic seizure) occurring with fever (at least 38.0 degrees Celsius) but in the absence of central nervous system infection, severe metabolic disturbance or other alternative precipitant in people beyond the typical arrange of 3 months-6 years with no prior history of afebrile seizure.

HP_0032896.label: music - induced seizure
HP_0032896.definition: Seizure precipitated by listening to music or other complex sounds.

HP_0032897.label: focal impaired awareness sensory seizure with gustatory features
HP_0032897.definition: A focal sensory seizure with gustatory features in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.

HP_0032898.label: focal automatism seizure
HP_0032898.definition: A focal seizure characterized at onset by coordinated motor activity. This often resembles a voluntary movement and may consist of an inappropriate continuation of preictal motor activity.
HP_0032898.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset automatism epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware automatism epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal automatism epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness automatism epileptic seizure

HP_0032899.label: focal orofacial automatism seizure
HP_0032899.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

HP_0032900.label: focal manual automatism seizure
HP_0032900.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

HP_0032901.label: focal pedal automatism seizure
HP_0032901.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

HP_0032902.label: focal perseverative automatism seizure
HP_0032902.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

HP_0032903.label: focal vocal automatism seizure
HP_0032903.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

HP_0032904.label: focal verbal automatism seizure
HP_0032904.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

HP_0032905.label: focal sexual automatism seizure
HP_0032905.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

HP_0032906.label: focal head nodding automatism seizure
HP_0032906.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

HP_0032907.label: focal undressing automatism seizure
HP_0032907.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

HP_0032908.label: focal aware undressing automatism seizure
HP_0032908.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032909.label: focal impaired awareness automatism seizure
HP_0032909.definition: A focal seizure with automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure.
HP_0032909.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset impaired awareness automatism epileptic seizure

HP_0032910.label: focal aware automatism seizure
HP_0032910.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure during which awareness is fully retained throughout.
HP_0032910.UMLS synonyms: Focal onset aware automatism epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness automatism epileptic seizure

HP_0032911.label: focal aware orofacial automatism seizure
HP_0032911.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032912.label: focal aware manual automatism seizure
HP_0032912.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by manual automatisms at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032913.label: focal aware pedal automatism seizure
HP_0032913.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

HP_0032914.label: focal aware perseverative automatism seizure
HP_0032914.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032915.label: focal aware vocal automatism seizure
HP_0032915.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032916.label: focal aware verbal automatism seizure
HP_0032916.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032917.label: focal aware sexual automatism seizure
HP_0032917.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032918.label: focal impaired awareness orofacial automatism seizure
HP_0032918.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by orofacial automatisms at onset.

HP_0032919.label: focal aware head nodding automatism seizure
HP_0032919.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset and during which awareness is fully retained throughout.

HP_0032920.label: focal impaired awareness manual automatism seizure
HP_0032920.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by manual automatisms at onset.

HP_0032921.label: focal impaired awareness pedal automatism seizure
HP_0032921.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by coordinated bilateral or unilateral movements of the feet or legs at onset. The movement is more reminiscent of normal movements in amplitude, and is less frenetic or rapid in comparison to the movements seen in focal hyperkinetic seizures involving the legs.

HP_0032922.label: focal impaired awareness perseverative automatism seizure
HP_0032922.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by inappropriate continuation of pre-seizure movement or behavior at onset.

HP_0032923.label: focal impaired awareness vocal automatism seizure
HP_0032923.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive meaningless vocal sounds such as shrieks or grunts at onset.

HP_0032924.label: focal impaired awareness verbal automatism seizure
HP_0032924.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by the production of single or repetitive words, phrases, or brief sentences at onset.

HP_0032925.label: focal impaired awareness sexual automatism seizure
HP_0032925.definition: A type of focal automatism seizure in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is characterized by involuntary sexual behavior at onset.

HP_0032926.label: focal impaired awareness head nodding automatism seizure
HP_0032926.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary head nodding at onset.

HP_0032927.label: focal impaired awareness undressing automatism seizure
HP_0032927.definition: A type of focal automatism in which awareness is partially or fully impaired at some point during the seizure and is seizure characterized by involuntary undressing at onset.

HP_0032928.label: elevated csf neurofilament light chain concentration
HP_0032928.definition: Neurofilament light chain (NfL) is a neuronal cytoplasmic protein highly expressed in large calibre myelinated axons. Its levels increase in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) and blood proportionally to the degree of axonal damage in a variety of neurological disorders, including inflammatory, neurodegenerative, traumatic and cerebrovascular diseases.

HP_0032929.label: abnormal chondrocyte morphology
HP_0032929.definition: Any abnormal structure of a chondrocyte, which is a polymorphic cell that forms cartilage.

HP_0032930.label: lacunar halos around chondrocytes
HP_0032930.UMLS synonyms: Lacunar halos around chondrocytes in skeletal cartilage

HP_0032931.label: obsolete focal impaired awareness cognitive seizure with impaired attention

HP_0032932.label: increased circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase level
HP_0032932.definition: An increased level of triacylglycerol lipase in the blood circulation (can be measured in serum or plasma).
HP_0032932.synonyms: elevated circulating pancreatic triacylglycerol lipase activity

HP_0032933.label: airway hyperresponsiveness
HP_0032933.definition: An increased sensitivity of the airways to an inhaled constrictor agonist, a steeper slope of the dose-response curve, and a greater maximal response to the agonist.

HP_0032934.label: spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak
HP_0032934.definition: A spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak (SCSFL) is a spontaneous and unexplained leak of the cerebrospinal fluid from the dura surrounding either the brain (cranial leak) or spine (spinal leak).
HP_0032934.UMLS synonyms: Cerebrospinal Fluid Leak, Spontaneous | spontaneous cranial cerebrospinal fluid leak | Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak syndrome | Intracranial Hypotension, Essential | Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak from spine | Spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid leak from skull base | otorrhea due to spontaneous cranial cerebrospinal fluid leak | rhinorrhea due to spontaneous cranial cerebrospinal fluid leak | spontaneous cranial cerebrospinal fluid leak from skull base | Rhinorrhea due to spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid CSF leak | Otorrhea due to spontaneous cerebrospinal fluid CSF leak

HP_0032935.label: posterior crocodile shagreen of the cornea
HP_0032935.definition: Grayish, polygonal pattern of opacities with intervening clear zones across the central cornea that resembles crocodile skin.

HP_0032936.label: intrusion symptom
HP_0032936.definition: Unintentional re-experiencing of a traumatic event involves symptoms that typically include sensory impressions and emotional responses stemming from the trauma. These symptoms seem to lack a sense of time perspective and context.

HP_0032937.label: recurrent , involuntary , and intrusive distressing memories
HP_0032937.definition: After experiencing psychological trauma, individuals may repeatedly encounter sensory-perceptual impressions of the event that intrude into their consciousness involuntarily. These intrusive memories often manifest as visual images (such as mental pictures), but can also involve sounds, smells, tastes, and physical sensations. They are accompanied by a variety of negative emotions linked to the most intense moments of the traumatic memory.

HP_0032938.label: recurrent trauma - related distressing dreams
HP_0032938.definition: Recurrent distressing dreams occur when the content and/or emotional impact of the dream is connected to a traumatic event or events.

HP_0032939.label: physiological reactivity to cues
HP_0032939.definition: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event(s).

HP_0032940.label: dissociation
HP_0032940.definition: Disruption or detachment of certain aspects of one's normal psychological functioning typically involves a disconnection or separation from thoughts, feelings, sensations, memories, or one's sense of identity or reality.
HP_0032940.UMLS synonyms: Dissociation | Dissociative disorder | Auriculo-Ventricular Dissociation | Electromechanical dissociation | Molecular dissociation | Dissociation corporeal | Prism dissociation | Antibody Dissociation | Scapulothoracic dissociation | Drug Dissociation | Dissociation (Psychology) | chemical dissociation | Tissue Dissociation Method | Strabismus | Isorhythmic Atrioventricular Dissociation | Increased molecular dissociation | Decreased molecular dissociation | Collision-Induced Dissociation | Electron-Transfer Dissociation | Electron-Capture Dissociation | Dissociation Hysterical Neurosis | sternal manubrial dissociation | electrocardiogram: atrioventricular dissociation | D-loop dissociation

HP_0032941.label: intense psychological distress to cues
HP_0032941.definition: Intense or prolonged psychological distress occurs when individuals are exposed to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event or events.

HP_0032942.label: avoidance of stimuli associated with traumatic event
HP_0032942.definition: Avoidance of or efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s). Avoidance of or efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event(s).

HP_0032943.label: abnormal urine ph
HP_0032943.definition: A deviation of urine pH from the normal range of 4.5 to 7.8.

HP_0032944.label: alkaline urine
HP_0032944.UMLS synonyms: Elevated Urine Alkaline Phosphatase | Alkaline phosphatase | Urine | Chemistry - non-challenge | Alkaline phosphatase:MCnc:Pt:Urine:Qn | Alkaline phosphatase:CCnc:Pt:Urine:Qn | Urine alkalinisation therapy

HP_0032945.label: renal interstitial inflammation
HP_0032945.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium potentially involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic areas, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

HP_0032946.label: renal cortical interstitial inflammation
HP_0032946.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the renal interstitium involving fibrotic as well as non-fibrotic renal cortex, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

HP_0032947.label: renal medullary interstitial inflammation
HP_0032947.definition: Histopathological findings of inflammation of the interstitium of the renal medulla, composed of lymphocytes, monocytes, plasma cells.

HP_0032948.label: renal interstitial fibrosis
HP_0032948.definition: The accumulation of collagen and related extracellular matrix (ECM) molecules in the interstitium of the kidney. The interstitium is expanded by the presence of collagen that stain blue on trichrome. Tubules are not back to back, but rather separated by fibrosis and can be atrophic.
HP_0032948.UMLS synonyms: Renal interstitial fibrosis | Renal biopsy showed interstitial fibrosis | renal biopsy results: interstitial fibrosis | Renal transplant interstitial fibrosis and tubular atrophy

HP_0032949.label: renal interstitial calcium phosphate deposits
HP_0032949.definition: The presence of interstitial aggregates of purple finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate deposits.

HP_0032950.label: abnormal renal tubular lumen morphology
HP_0032950.definition: Abnormal structure or form of the lumen (opening) of kidney tubules.

HP_0032951.label: renal tubular viral cytopathic changes
HP_0032951.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage. Tubular destruction may be associated with necrotizing interstitial granulomas. Severe granulomatous tubulointerstitial nephritis appears to be characteristic of adenoviral infection and is quite rare in other viral infections. Focal wedge-shaped necrosis may occur in renal parenchyma. Immunostaining for adenovirus shows strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining in infected cells.

HP_0032952.label: usual - type tubular atrophy
HP_0032952.definition: A type of renal tubular atrophy in which the tubules show thick tubular basement membranes lined by small cuboidal or flat cells. Generally accompanied by fibrosis.

HP_0032953.label: renal tubular cytomegalovirus inclusions
HP_0032953.definition: Characteristic intranuclear glassy-appearing basophilic inclusions with surrounding halo (owl's eye-type inclusion) and marked increase in the size of the cell (cytomegaly), particularly in tubular epithelial cells and in endothelial cells. Often accompanied by cytopathic changes including patchy interstitial pleomorphic infiltrate with lymphocytes, plasma cells, and macrophages.

HP_0032954.label: renal tubular adenovirus inclusions
HP_0032954.definition: Viral cytopathic changes consist of smudgy basophilic intranuclear inclusions with enlarged nuclei of infected cells. The inclusions stain positive for adenovirus (e.g., Figure 3 of PMID:29273157). Distal tubules are more commonly involved than proximal tubules. Occasionally glomerular visceral and parietal epithelial cells can be infected. There is associated acute tubular injury, often with frank tubular necrosis and destruction, with acute interstitial nephritis, often with a pleomorphic infiltrate composed of lymphocytes, histiocytes, plasma cells, and variable numbers of neutrophils, with interstitial edema and hemorrhage.

HP_0032955.label: renal tubular polyoma virus inclusions
HP_0032955.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions have a ground-glass appearance with irregular central clearing, or a coarse, vesicular appearance. Distal tubules are involved more often than proximal tubules. There may be only medullary involvement in early stages, and parietal epithelial cells may be involved in later stages of the infection. Infected epithelial cell nuclei stain with antibody to the large T antigen of the SV40 virus, which serves as a surrogate marker of human polyomavirus infection.

HP_0032956.label: renal tubular herpes simplex virus inclusions
HP_0032956.definition: Renal tubular nuclear inclusions that stain positive for herpes simplex virus (HSV). HSV is typically associated with multinucleated giant cells with nuclear inclusions and may cause hemorrhagic interstitial nephritis.

HP_0032957.label: dysmorphic hematuria
HP_0032957.definition: The presence of dysmorphic urinary erythrocytes. This feature can be observed by phase-contrastmicroscopy, differential interference microscopy, and bright-field microscopy. The acanthocyte or G1 cell, which is a doughnut-shaped cell with one or more blebs, is reported to constitute a special form of dysmorphic erythro-cyte (D cell) specific for glomerular hematuria.

HP_0032958.label: urinary oval fat bodies
HP_0032958.definition: The presence in the urine of desquamated tubular epithelial cells or macrophages filled with lipid droplets.

HP_0032959.label: intratubular calcium oxalate casts
HP_0032959.definition: Birefringent calcium- and oxalate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

HP_0032960.label: intratubular calcium phosphate casts
HP_0032960.definition: Purple and finely granular/laminated calcium- and phosphate-containing casts located within the tubuli of the kidney.

HP_0032961.label: magnesium ammonium phosphate crystalluria
HP_0032961.definition: Magnesium ammonium phosphate crystals in the urine.
HP_0032961.UMLS synonyms: Urinary crystal, magnesium ammonium phosphate hexahydrate

HP_0032962.label: tubular microcystic change
HP_0032962.definition: Dilated renal tubules (over twice the diameter of a normal proximal tubule) containing eosinophilic amorphous material. This feature is generally accompanied by scalloping of the cast profile. The epithelium lining the microcyst is generally flattened and does not reveal brush border.

HP_0032963.label: complex renal cyst
HP_0032963.definition: A renal cyst characterized by epithelium lined space (squamous/columnar) with septations.
HP_0032963.UMLS synonyms: Complex renal cyst | Acquired complex renal cyst | RENAL CYST COMPLEX BENIGN

HP_0032964.label: uric acid crystalluria
HP_0032964.definition: The presence of uric acid crystals in the urine.

HP_0032965.label: interstitial emphysema
HP_0032965.definition: Interstitial emphysema is characterized by air dissecting within the interstitium of the lung, typically in the peribronchovascular sheaths, interlobular septa, and visceral pleura. It is most commonly seen in neonates receiving mechanical ventilation. It is rarely recognized radiographically in adults and is infrequently seen on CT scans. It appears as perivascular lucent or low attenuating halos and small cysts.
HP_0032965.UMLS synonyms: Interstitial emphysema | Perinatal interstitial emphysema | interstitial; emphysema, congenital | Pulmonary interstitial emphysema syndrome | interstitial; emphysema, perinatal period | interstitial emphysema and related conditions originating in perinatal period | Interstitial emphysema and related conditions | Pulmonary fibrosis Chronic interstitial fibrosis Emphysema | Pulmonary collapse; interstitial and compensatory emphysema | Other conditions related to interstitial emphysema originating in the perinatal period

HP_0032966.label: centrilobular emphysema
HP_0032966.definition: A type of emphysema characterized by destroyed centrilobular alveolar walls and enlargement of respiratory bronchioles and associated alveoli. This is the commonest form of emphysema in cigarette smokers. CT findings are centrilobular areas of decreased attenuation, usually without visible walls, of nonuniform distribution and predominantly located in upper lung zones.

HP_0032967.label: panacinar emphysema
HP_0032967.definition: Panacinar emphysema involves all portions of the acinus and secondary pulmonary lobule more or less uniformly. It predominates in the lower lobes and is the form of emphysema associated with1-antitrypsin deficiency. CT scans show a generalized decrease of the lung parenchyma with a decrease in the caliber of blood vessels in the affected lung. Severe panacinar emphysema may coexist and merge with severe centrilobular emphysema. The appearance of feature less decreased attenuation may be indistinguishable from severe constrictive obliterative bronchiolitis.

HP_0032968.label: expiratory air trapping
HP_0032968.definition: Abnormal retention of gas within a lung or part of a lung, as a result of airway obstruction of abnormalities in lung compliance. In the classic presentation, the lung will appear normal at inspiration, but on exhalation, the diseased portions of the lung which have lost connective tissue recoil will remain lucent while the healthy portions of the lung will become more dense due to atelectasis. This helps distinguish it from mosaic attenuation due to patchy fibrosis, as occurs with nonspecific interstitial pneumonia, and in early usual interstitial pneumonitis (the hallmark imaging diagnosis of interstitial lung disease) in which there is no change with inspiration and expiration.

HP_0032969.label: traction bronchiectasis
HP_0032969.definition: Distortion of the bronchial airways due to mechanical traction on the bronchi resulting from fibrosis of the surrounding lung parenchyma. CT findings represent irregular bronchial dilatation caused by surrounding retractile pulmonary fibrosis. Dilated airways are usually identifiable as such but may be seen as cysts.

HP_0032971.label: computed tomographic halo sign
HP_0032971.definition: CT finding of ground-glass opacity surrounding a nodule or mass. It was first described as a sign of hemorrhage around foci of invasive aspergillosis. The halo sign is nonspecific and may also be caused by hemorrhage associated with other types of nodules or by local pulmonary infiltration by neoplasm.

HP_0032972.label: nodular - centrilobular without tree - in - bud pattern on pulmonary hrct
HP_0032972.definition: A nodular pattern on pulmonary high-resolution computed tomography which are anatomically located centrally within secondary pulmonary lobules. Centrilobular nodules may be dense (i.e., solid) and of homogeneous opacity or ground-glass opacity, and may range from a few millimeters to about 1 cm in size. Because of the similar size of secondary lobules, centrilobular nodules often appear to be evenly spaced. Centrilobular nodules are usually separated from the pleural surfaces, fissures, and interlobular septa by a distance of at least several millimeters. They may appear patchy or diffuse in different diseases.

HP_0032973.label: abnormal bronchoalveolar lavage fluid morphology
HP_0032973.definition: Abnormal type or counts of nucleated immune cells and acellular components in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid. BAL us performed with a fiberoptic bronchoscope in the wedged position within a selected bronchopulmonary segment. BAL is commonly used to inform the differential diagnosis of interstitial lung disease or to monitor therapeutic interventions.

HP_0032974.label: abnormal cellular composition of bronchoalveolar fluid
HP_0032974.definition: Deviation from the commonly in healthy people observe cellular distribution. Normal ranges are macrophages over 80%, lymphocytes less than 15%, neutrophils less than 3%, eosinophils less than 0.5%, mast cells less than 0.5%.
HP_0032974.synonyms: abnormal cell differential of broncho - alveolar fluid

HP_0032975.label: abnormal bronchoalveolar fluid protein level
HP_0032975.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of protein in the bronchoalveolar fluid.
HP_0032975.synonyms: abnormal biochemical composition of broncho - alveolar fluid | abnormal level of proteins in the broncho - alveolar fluid

HP_0032976.label: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid lymphocyte proportion
HP_0032976.definition: Usually, Lymphoycytes make up less than 15% of all cells found in the bronchoalveloar lavage fluid. This elevated cell proportion can be induced by virus or drugs, or is associated with specific diseases.

HP_0032977.label: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid neutrophil proportion
HP_0032977.definition: Usually, Neutrophils make up less than 3% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. In children, standard value of neutrophils is higher depending on their age (children under the age of 5 show a maximum value of 10%). This elevated cell proportion is a sign for acute and chronic infections (HP:0012387, HP:0006538) and can be associated to specific diseases.
HP_0032977.synonyms: elevated level of neutrophils in broncho - alveolar lavage fluid

HP_0032978.label: lipid - laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
HP_0032978.definition: Accumulation of lipids in alveolar macrophages with droplet-shaped fat inclusions.

HP_0032979.label: hemosiderin - laden macrophages in bronchoalveolar fluid
HP_0032979.definition: Hemosiderin-laden macrophages (HLM) in bronchoalveolar lavage (BAL) fluid were originally known as adiagnostic biomarker of alveolar hemorrhage, but have also been observed in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) with histopathological pattern of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP).
HP_0032979.synonyms: accumulation of hemosiderin laden alveolar macrophages | siderophages in bronchoalveolar fluid

HP_0032980.label: absent bronchoalveolar surfactant - protein c
HP_0032980.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein C in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid. Comment: Pulmonary surfactant is a highly surface-active mixture of proteins and lipids that is synthesized and secreted onto the alveoli by type II epithelial cells. The protein part of surfactant constitutes of four types of surfactant proteins (SP), SP-A, SP-B, SP-C and SP-D. SP-A and SP-D are hydrophilic proteins that regulate surfactant metabolism and have immunologic functions, whereas SP-B and SP-C are hydrophobic molecules, which play a direct role in the organization of the surfactant structure in the interphase and in the stabilization of the lipid layers during the respiratory cycle. Lack of SP-C may result of surfactant metabolism dysfunction and is also observed in patients with other diffuse parenchymal lung diseases, pathogenetically related to the alveolar surfactant region.

HP_0032981.label: absent bronchoalveolar dimeric surfactant - protein b
HP_0032981.definition: Significantly decreased level or failed detection of surfactant protein B in broncho-alveolar lavage fluid.

HP_0032983.label: atoll sign
HP_0032983.definition: CT finding of central ground-glass opacity surrounded by denser consolidation of crescentic shape (forming more than three-fourths of a circle) or complete ring of at least 2 mm in thickness. A rare sign, it was initially reported to be specific for cryptogenic organizing pneumonia, but was subsequently described in patients with paracoccidioidomycosis.

HP_0032984.label: abnormal alveolar macrophage morphology
HP_0032984.definition: Alveolar macrophages usually make up the majority of cells in the bronchoalveolar space (over 80%). The may contain intracellular material depending on underlying diseases or due to exposition to inhaled particles.

HP_0032985.label: dust particle inclusion in alveolar macrophages
HP_0032985.definition: Accumulation of inhaled, nondigestable particles in macrophages.

HP_0032986.label: smoker - inclusions in alveolar macrophages
HP_0032986.definition: In otherwise healthy smokers, characteristic so called smoker-inclusion can be found within the macrophages in the bronchoalveolar fluid. These blue/ black/ round/ oval cytoplasmic inclusions consist of pigmented lipid deposits.

HP_0032987.label: elevated bronchoalveolar lavage fluid eosinophil proportion
HP_0032987.definition: Usually, eosinophils make up less than 0.5% of all cells found in the broncho-alveloar lavage fluid. But in eosinophilic lung disease, the eosinophil cell proportion typically represents more than 25%. Comment: An elevated level of eosinophil cells are also a result of infections, or an allergic reaction or can be drug-induced.

HP_0032988.label: persistent head lag
HP_0032988.definition: The Premie-Neuro and the Dubowitz Neurological Examination score head lag in the same manner. Scoring for both is as follows: 0 = head drops and stays back, 1 = tries to lift head but drops it back, 2 = able to lift head slightly, 3 = lifts head in line with body, and 4 = head in front of body. This term applies if head lag persists beyond an expected age at a level of 0 or 1. Persistent head lag beyond age 4 mo has been linked to poor outcomes.

HP_0032989.label: delayed ability to roll over
HP_0032989.definition: Delayed achievement of the ability to roll front to back and back to front.

HP_0032990.label: localized pulmonary hemorrhage
HP_0032990.definition: Circumscribed pulmonary hemorrhage originating from a single bleeding site in the lungs. This can be due to infections, tumorigenesis, foreign bodies, or vascular abnormalities. Patient often feel the site of bleeding, contrast CT scan or angiography may localize the bleeder.

HP_0032991.label: abnormal pulmonary fissure morphology
HP_0032991.definition: An abnormal form or number of the pulmonary fissures.

HP_0032992.label: abnormal pulmonary fissure architecture
HP_0032992.definition: An abnormal form or location of a pulmonary fissure.

HP_0032993.label: abnormal pulmonary fissure count
HP_0032993.definition: A deviation from the normal number of pulmonary fissures.

HP_0032994.label: supernumerary pulmonary fissure
HP_0032994.definition: Presence of a lung fissure that does not exist normally. Supernumerary fissures include the superior accessory fissure, the medial basal fissure, the left horizontal fissure, and the azygos fissure form supernumerary lobes.

HP_0032995.label: decreased pulmonary fissure count
HP_0032995.definition: Lack of one or more of the normal pulmonary fissures.

HP_0032996.label: abnormal cystatin c level
HP_0032996.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cystatin C in serum or plasma.

HP_0032997.label: decreased cystatin c level
HP_0032997.definition: A decreased concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation.

HP_0032998.label: increased cystatin c level
HP_0032998.definition: A elevated concentration of cystatin C in the blood circulation.

HP_0032999.label: increased fecal porphyrin
HP_0032999.definition: Abnormally high concentration of fecal porphyrins in feces.

HP_0033000.label: subglottic laryngitis
HP_0033000.definition: Narrowing of the larynx, commonly occuring during viral respiratory tract infections, in particular in children, leads to symptoms such as hoarseness, a barking cough, stridor, and sometimes dyspnea and respiratory failure.
HP_0033000.synonyms: croup | laryngitis | pseudocroup | spasmodic croup | viral croup

HP_0033001.label: laryngeal papilloma
HP_0033001.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the larynx.
HP_0033001.UMLS synonyms: Laryngeal papillomatosis | Squamous Papilloma of the Larynx | Childhood Laryngeal Squamous Papilloma | Recurrent respiratory papillomatosis | Papilloma of the Rat Larynx | Squamous Cell Papilloma of the Rat Larynx

HP_0033002.label: bronchial papilloma
HP_0033002.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on a bronchus.
HP_0033002.UMLS synonyms: Glandular papilloma of lung | Papilloma of the Rat Bronchus | Lung Squamous Papilloma | Squamous Cell Papilloma of the Rat Bronchus | Lung Mixed Squamous Cell and Glandular Papilloma

HP_0033003.label: tracheal papilloma
HP_0033003.definition: A wart-like lesion (papilloma, i.e., benign epithelial tumors that are caused by infection with the human papilloma virus) located on the trachea.
HP_0033003.UMLS synonyms: Papilloma of the Rat Trachea | Squamous Cell Papilloma of the Rat Trachea

HP_0033004.label: palmar warts
HP_0033004.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the palm. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).
HP_0033004.UMLS synonyms: Palmar and plantar warts | Removal of palmar wart under general anesthesia | Removal of palmar wart under local anesthesia

HP_0033005.label: plantar warts
HP_0033005.definition: Multiple verrucous lesions on the skin of the sole of the foot. These lesions are raised, have a thickened and rough surface, and may display prominent black dots (thrombosed capillaries). Palmar warts are caused by caused by human papillomavirus (HPV).
HP_0033005.UMLS synonyms: Plantar wart | left plantar warts | right plantar warts | Palmar and plantar warts | Bilateral plantar wart | Myrmecia plantar wart | Mosaic plantar wart | excision or debridment of a plantar wart | Plantar wart of left foot | Plantar wart of right foot | Compound W Plantar Wart Remover | Dr Scholl's Clear Away Plantar Wart | Removal of plantar wart under local anesthesia | Removal of plantar wart under general anesthesia | salicylic acid 0.4 MG/MG Medicated Patch | Compound W Freeze Off Plantar Wart Removal Sy | Dr Scholls Clear Away One Step Plantar Wart Remover | salicylic acid 0.4 MG/MG Medicated Patch [Compound W brand of salicylic acid]

HP_0033006.label: diffuse alveolar damage
HP_0033006.definition: Diffuse alveolar damage (DAD) describes a common histologic injury pattern of the lung. The early stages are characterized by epithelial cell necrosis and sloughing, fibrous exsudate, edema, and hyaline membranes made of surfactant and proteins, filling the alveoli. This results in impaired gas exchange. In later stages, type II cells and myofibroblasts proliferate within the interstitium and airspaces. The corresponding clinical entity is acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). DAD may result from pulmonary drug toxicity, occurs in immunosuppressed, severe viral infections, acute interstial pneumonitis, and crack cocaine inhalation.

HP_0033007.label: architectural distortion of the lung
HP_0033007.definition: Architectural distortion is characterized by abnormal displacement of bronchi, vessels, fissures, or septa caused by diffuse or localized lung disease, particularly interstitial fibrosis. This is visible in lung biopsy and CT scans in a distorted appearance and is usually associated with pulmonary fibrosis and accompanied by volume loss.

HP_0033008.label: increased z - disc width
HP_0033008.definition: Abnormally increased width of the Z-disk of the sarcomere, resulting from splitting or opening of the Z-disc (c.f., Figure 2 of PMID:28732005).
HP_0033008.synonyms: increased z - disk width | widened z - discs

HP_0033009.label: increased fecal coproporphyrin 1
HP_0033009.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 1 in feces.
HP_0033009.synonyms: elevated faecal coproporphyrin 1 | elevated fecal coproporphyrin 1 | elevated stool coproporphyrin 1 | high faecal coproporphyrin 1 | high fecal coproporphyrin 1 | high stool coproporphyrin 1 | increased faecal coproporphyrin 1

HP_0033010.label: increased fecal coproporphyrin 3
HP_0033010.definition: Abnormally high concentration of coproporphyrin 3 in feces
HP_0033010.synonyms: elevated faecal coproporphyrin 3 | elevated fecal coproporphyrin 3 | elevated stool coproporphyrin 3 | high faecal coproporphyrin 3 | high fecal coproporphyrin 3 | high stool coproporphyrin 3 | increased faecal coproporphyrin 3

HP_0033011.label: platystencephaly
HP_0033011.definition: Extreme width of the skull in the occipital region, with anterior narrowing and prognathism.

HP_0033012.label: abnormal salivary metabolite concentration
HP_0033012.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a metabolite in saliva.

HP_0033013.label: abnormal salivary cortisol level
HP_0033013.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of cortisol in saliva.

HP_0033014.label: decreased salivary cortisol level
HP_0033014.definition: Abnormally reduced concentration of cortisol in saliva.

HP_0033015.label: increased salivary cortisol level
HP_0033015.definition: Abnormally elevated concentration of cortisol in saliva.

HP_0033016.label: chronic decreased circulating igd
HP_0033016.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood.

HP_0033017.label: transient decreased circulating igd
HP_0033017.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood circulation.

HP_0033018.label: chronic absent circulating igd
HP_0033018.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin D (IgD) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgD can be measured.
HP_0033018.synonyms: chronic ( near ) absent igm in blood

HP_0033019.label: male reproductive system neoplasm
HP_0033019.definition: A neoplasm that affects the male reproductive system.

HP_0033020.label: female reproductive system neoplasm
HP_0033020.definition: A neoplasm that affects the female reproductive system.

HP_0033021.label: transient decreased circulating ige
HP_0033021.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.

HP_0033022.label: chronic decreased circulating ige
HP_0033022.definition: A lasting reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood.

HP_0033023.label: chronic absent circulating ige
HP_0033023.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin E (IgE) in the blood circulation, whereby at most trace quantities of IgE can be measured.
HP_0033023.synonyms: chronic ( near ) absent ige in blood

HP_0033024.label: transient decreased circulating iga
HP_0033024.definition: A temporary reduction beneath the normal level of total immunoglobulin A (IgA) in the blood circulation.

HP_0033025.label: chronic absent circulating total igg
HP_0033025.definition: A lasting absence of immunoglobulin G (IgG) in the blood, whereby at most trace quantities of IgG can be measured.
HP_0033025.synonyms: chronic ( near ) absent total igg in blood

HP_0033026.label: white oral mucosal macule
HP_0033026.definition: A small circumscribed whitish change in the color of the oral mucosa that is neither elevated nor depressed.

HP_0033027.label: retinal peau d'orange
HP_0033027.definition: A pebbly orange appearance of the fundus that is said to resemble the skin of an orange.
HP_0033027.UMLS synonyms: Peau d'orange retinal changes | Peau d'orange retinal changes (yellow-mottled retinal hyperpigmentation)

HP_0033028.label: anti - u1 ribonucleoprotein antibody positivity
HP_0033028.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react to proteins (70 Kd, A, C) that are associated with U1 RNA and form U1snRNP.
HP_0033028.synonyms: anti - rnp - antibodies | anti - scl - 34 antibody positivity | anti - u1 - rnp antibody positivity | anti - u3 ribonucleoprotein antibody positivity

HP_0033030.label: anti - glomerular basement membrane - antibody positivity
HP_0033030.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to the glomerular basement membrane.

HP_0033031.label: hyperpyrexia
HP_0033031.definition: An extreme elevation of core body temperature above normal defined as a rectal temperature of 41.1 degrees Celsius (106 degrees Fahrenheit).
HP_0033031.UMLS synonyms: Hyperpyrexia | Malignant hyperpyrexia due to anesthesia | Parkinsonism hyperpyrexia syndrome | Heat Stroke | Malignant hyperthermia | Fever of Unknown Origin | Treatment of fever | Malignant fever | Hyperpyrexia, usually associated with anesthesia | Drug Fever | Anesthetic-induced malignant hyperpyrexia in children | Malignant Hyperpyrexia Gene Anomaly Detection Reagents | Fulminating Hyperpyrexia Gene Anomaly Detection Reagents | MALIGNANT HYPERTHERMIA, SUSCEPTIBILITY TO, 6 | MALIGNANT HYPERTHERMIA, SUSCEPTIBILITY TO, 5 | Malignant hyperthermia susceptibility type 2 | Malignant hyperthermia susceptibility type 3 | MALIGNANT HYPERTHERMIA, SUSCEPTIBILITY TO, 4 | Family history of malignant hyperthermia | Kousseff Nichols syndrome

HP_0033032.label: triggered by an abusive adult
HP_0033032.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is induced by an abusive adult (usually a parent).

HP_0033033.label: anti - mda5 antibody positivity
HP_0033033.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to Anti-MDA5 (Anti-melanoma differentiation-associated proteine 5).
HP_0033033.synonyms: increased level of anti - melanoma differentiation - associated protein 5 antibodies

HP_0033034.label: anti - citrullinated protein antibody positivity
HP_0033034.definition: The presence autoantibodies in the serum that react do different citrullinated antigens, including filaggrin, fibrinogen, vimentin and collagen.

HP_0033035.label: abnormal schwann cell morphology
HP_0033035.definition: Abnormality of schwann cells, glial cells that ensheath axons of neurons in the peripheral nervous system and are necessary for their maintenance and function.
HP_0033035.synonyms: abnormal neurilemmal cell morphology | abnormal neurilemmocyte morphology

HP_0033036.label: decreased nasal nitric oxide
HP_0033036.definition: Reduced level of nasal nitric oxide (nNO). Current American Thoracic Society/European Respiratory Society (ATS/ERS) guidelines for nNO measurements recommend air aspiration via a nasal probe while the subject exhales through the mouth against resistance in order to maintain velum closure.
HP_0033036.UMLS synonyms: Decreased nasal nitric oxide (nNO) | Nasal nitric oxide may be decreased | Decreased nasal nitric oxide (NO) levels

HP_0033038.label: anti - rna - polymerase - iii - autoantibody positivity
HP_0033038.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to RNA-polymerase III.

HP_0033039.label: increased circulating precipitin level
HP_0033039.definition: The presence of high titers of antigen-precipitating IgG in the serum.
HP_0033039.synonyms: increased level of antigen - precipitating igg antibodies

HP_0033040.label: anti - sm antibody positivity
HP_0033040.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react to seven proteins that consist of a core of small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (snRNP) particles.
HP_0033040.UMLS synonyms: Anti-Sm antibody positivity | Anti-Smith (Sm) antibody positive

HP_0033041.label: cytokine storm
HP_0033041.definition: Excessive or uncontrolled release of proinflammatory cytokines.

HP_0033042.label: abnormal chorion morphology
HP_0033042.definition: Any structural anomaly of the fetal part of the placenta, which is known as the chorion.

HP_0033043.label: edematous chorionic villi
HP_0033043.definition: Swelling of the chorionic villi owing to fluid accumulation.

HP_0033044.label: motor regression
HP_0033044.definition: Loss of previously achieved motor skills, as manifested by loss of developmental motor milestones.
HP_0033044.UMLS synonyms: Regression of motor development | Regression of early motor skills | Childhood-onset motor and cognitive regression syndrome with extrapyramidal movement disorder | NEURODEVELOPMENTAL DISORDER WITH MOTOR REGRESSION, PROGRESSIVE SPASTIC PARAPLEGIA, AND OROMOTOR DYSFUNCTION | Acquire ability to walk and jump in childhood, but motor regression occurs later

HP_0033045.label: bipedal edema
HP_0033045.definition: A palpable swelling in both feet and ankles caused by an increase in interstitial fluid volume (excess fluid).

HP_0033046.label: michaelis - gutmann bodies
HP_0033046.definition: Basophilic intracytoplasmic inclusions in macrophages. The inclusions have a small, round laminated appearance. Electron microscopy of Michaelis-Gutmann bodies exhibits partially digested bacteria.

HP_0033047.label: body ache
HP_0033047.definition: Body ache is a complaint that is often used to denote vague symptoms of mild fatigue, lethargy, or dull aches. We will define it here to mean a dull and poorly localizable pain that is described by the affected individual to affect multiple joints or body parts or even the entire body.
HP_0033047.UMLS synonyms: BODY ACHE | Generalized aches and pains | Muscle or body aches | Generalized acute body pains | Generalized chronic body pains | Feel Pain, Soreness, or Aches in Some Areas of Body | aspirin 845 MG / caffeine 65 MG Oral Powder | aspirin 845 MG / caffeine 65 MG Oral Powder [BC Original Formula] | Acetaminophen/Chlorpheniramine Maleate/Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide/Phenylpropanolamine Bitartrate 325 MG-2 MG-10 MG-20 MG Oral Tablet, Effervescent [ALKA-SELTZER PLUS FLU & BODY ACHES]

HP_0033048.label: substantia nigra hypointensity on susceptibility - weighted imaging
HP_0033048.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the substantia nigra inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).
HP_0033048.synonyms: low signal intensity in the substantia nigra on susceptibility - weighted imaging ( swi )

HP_0033049.label: globus pallidus hypointensity on susceptibility - weighted imaging
HP_0033049.definition: Hypointence (dark) appearance of the globus pallidus inmagnetic resonance imaging using susceptibility weighted imaging (SWI).

HP_0033050.label: pharyngalgia
HP_0033050.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) and perceived to originate in the throat.
HP_0033050.synonyms: pharyngodynia | sore throat | throat discomfort | throat pain

HP_0033051.label: impaired executive functioning
HP_0033051.definition: A disturbance of executive functioning, which is broadly defined as the set of abilities that allow for the planning, executing, monitoring, and self-correcting of goal-directed behavior while inhibiting task-irrelevant behavior. At least some degree of executive skill is needed to complete most cognitive tasks, and deficits in executive abilities are central to many clinical conditions, including fronto-temporal dementia.
HP_0033051.UMLS synonyms: Impaired executive functioning | Impaired attentional and executive function | Executive dysfunction

HP_0033052.label: non - epileptic seizure
HP_0033052.definition: Psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (PNES) are not abnormal perceptions or abnormal beliefs/judgments, nor are they epileptic attacks. They are behaviors that simulate epileptic attacks, not fully consciously.
HP_0033052.synonyms: functional seizure | psychogenic non - epileptic seizure | psychosomatic seizure
HP_0033052.UMLS synonyms: Non-motor epileptic seizure | Nonepileptic Seizures | Psychogenic seizure | Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | Focal onset nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0033053.label: pseudoseizure
HP_0033053.definition: Sudden, involuntary seizure-like attacks that, unlike epileptic seizures, are not related to electrographic ictal discharges.
HP_0033053.UMLS synonyms: Dissociative convulsions | SEIZURE LIKE ACTIVITY PSEUDOSEIZURE | SEIZURE LIKE EPISODE PSEUDOSEIZURE

HP_0033054.label: myoclonic tremor
HP_0033054.definition: A tremor-like cortical myoclonus. The tremulous movements are in fact small, high-frequency myoclonic jerks, induced by posture or action. They can be mild, but can also be more incapacitating. When present in the lower limbs, these may lead to gait disorders and even drop attacks. These tremor-like movements during action can be mistaken for essential tremor or epileptic seizures.
HP_0033054.UMLS synonyms: Involuntary rhythmic myoclonic movements ('tremor', upper extremities) | Benign adult familial myoclonic epilepsy | EPILEPSY, FAMILIAL ADULT MYOCLONIC, 1 | Involuntary rhythmic myoclonic movements ('tremor') of the distal extremities, usually fingers | EPILEPSY, MYOCLONIC, BENIGN ADULT FAMILIAL, TYPE 2 | EPILEPSY, FAMILIAL ADULT MYOCLONIC, 3 | EPILEPSY, FAMILIAL ADULT MYOCLONIC, 4 | EPILEPSY, FAMILIAL ADULT MYOCLONIC, 6 | EPILEPSY, FAMILIAL ADULT MYOCLONIC, 7 | EPILEPSY, EARLY-ONSET, 5, WITH OR WITHOUT DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY | Cortical myoclonic tremors characterized by 8 to 10-Hz discharges

HP_0033055.label: impaired ability to plan
HP_0033055.definition: Impaired ability to anticipate future events, implement instructions or goals, and develop appropriate steps ahead of time in order to carry out a task or activity.

HP_0033056.label: impaired ability to organize
HP_0033056.definition: Impaired ability to bring order to information, actions, or materials to achieve a goal or to follow an established organized routine.

HP_0033057.label: decreased circulating terminal complement component concentration
HP_0033057.definition: Concentration below the lower limit of normal of one or more components of the the terminal membrane attack complex (MAC) portion of complement, which represents the lytic, pore-forming part of the system. The MAC comprises seven components: C5b, C6, C7, C8 (a heterotrimer composed of C8alpha, C8beta and C8gamma) and multiple copies of C9.

HP_0033058.label: decreased circulating complement c7 concentration
HP_0033058.definition: Concentration of the complement component C7 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0033059.label: decreased circulating complement c6 concentration
HP_0033059.definition: Concentration of the complement component C6 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0033060.label: decreased circulating complement c5 concentration
HP_0033060.definition: Concentration of the complement component C5 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0033061.label: increased factor ix activity
HP_0033061.definition: Elevated activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

HP_0033062.label: abnormal factor ix activity
HP_0033062.definition: Abnormal activity of coagulation factor IX. Factor IX, which itself is activated by factor Xa or factor VIIa to form factor IXa, activates factor X into factor Xa.

HP_0033063.label: shortened sleep phase
HP_0033063.definition: A tendency to sleep fewer hours than usual while feeling well-rested.

HP_0033064.label: renal interstitial globotriaosylceramide inclusions
HP_0033064.definition: Accumulation of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) in kidney tissues, which can be quantified as the number of globotriaosylceramide (GL-3) inclusions/kidney interstitial capillary (KIC).

HP_0033065.label: mild albuminuria
HP_0033065.definition: The presence of mildly increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio (ACR) less than 30 mg/gm (less than 3.4 mg/mmol).
HP_0033065.UMLS synonyms: Hypertension in pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium, not specified as pre-existing, with either albuminuria or edema, or both; mild or unspecified

HP_0033066.label: severe albuminuria
HP_0033066.definition: The presence of severely increased concentrations of albumin in the urine, defined as an albumin-creatinine ratio greater than 300 mg/gm (greater than 34 mg/mmol).
HP_0033066.UMLS synonyms: albuminuria; pre-eclamptic, severe | pregnancy; hypertension, with albuminuria, severe | c.puerperium; hypertension, with albuminuria, severe pre-eclampsia | albuminuria; pre-eclamptic, severe, affecting fetus or newborn | c.pregnancy; hypertension, gestational hypertension, with albuminuria (severe pre-eclampsia) | Hypertension in pregnancy, childbirth, or the puerperium, not specified as pre-existing, with either albuminuria or edema, or both; specified as severe

HP_0033068.label: medication crystalluria
HP_0033068.definition: A variety of drugs may occasionally cause transient crystalluria, in isolation or in conjunction with other urinary abnormalities. Overdose, dehydration, or hypoalbuminaemia, which increases the unbound drug which is ultrafiltrated by the glomerulus, are the factors usally favoring the precipitation of crystals within the tubular lumina. In some cases, medication-induced crystalluria has a distinct phenotypic appearance. For instance, Sulphadiazine crystals appear as strongly birefringent 'shocks of wheat' or 'shells' with an amber colour. Acyclovir crystals are birefringent and needle-shaped, and when present in abundance give to urine a silky and opalescent macroscopic appearance.

HP_0033069.label: renal interstitial igg4+ plasma cell infiltration
HP_0033069.definition: An increased number of IgG4+ plasma cells in the interstitial space of the kidney.

HP_0033070.label: impaired self monitoring
