HP_0033070.definition: Impaired ability to track awareness of the effect that one's behavior has on others and how it compares with standards or expectations for behavior.

HP_0033071.label: impaired task monitoring
HP_0033071.definition: Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal.

HP_0033072.label: abnormal macroscopic urine appearance
HP_0033072.definition: Anomalous physical appearance (color, cloudiness, clarity) or odor of urine.

HP_0033073.label: urate tophus
HP_0033073.definition: Intradermal urate crystal deposits appeared as small, superficial, pustule-like, whitish lesions. The lesions may be the focus of inflammatory episodes with increasing pain, swelling, and erythema of the intradermal tophi.

HP_0033074.label: steroid - responsive anemia
HP_0033074.definition: Amelioration of anemia upon treatment with a steroid medication.
HP_0033074.synonyms: prednisone - responsive anaemia | prednisone - responsive anemia | steroid - responsive anaemia

HP_0033075.label: inappropriately normal thyroid - stimulating hormone level
HP_0033075.definition: A normal or elevated serum thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level in the face of an elevation in circulating FT4 and/or FT3.

HP_0033076.label: abnormal circulating free t4 concentration
HP_0033076.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of free thyroxine (T4) in the blood circulation. Circulating T4 is almost entirely bound to specific transport proteins such as thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) but it is the unbound (free) fraction that is able to enter tissues and exert effects.
HP_0033076.synonyms: abnormal circulating free t4 level | abnormal circulating free thyroxine level

HP_0033077.label: increased circulating free t4 concentration
HP_0033077.definition: An elevated concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.

HP_0033078.label: decreased circulating free t4 concentration
HP_0033078.definition: A reduced concentration of free thyroxine (fT4) in the blood circulation.

HP_0033079.label: aplasia / hypoplasia of the thyroid gland
HP_0033079.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the thyroid gland.

HP_0033080.label: abnormal tsh response to thyrotrophin - releasing hormone stimulation test
HP_0033080.definition: Thyrotrophin-releasing hormone (TRH) is a hypothalamic tripeptide synthesized by, stored within, and released from the hypothalamus. It stimulates the synthesis and release of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) from the anterior pituitary gland. Following administration of exogenous TRH, a transient increase in serum TSH is expected. This term refers to an abnormal response in the TRH stimulation test.
HP_0033080.synonyms: abnormal tsh response to trh stimulation test

HP_0033081.label: absent tsh response to thyrotrophin - releasing hormone stimulation test
HP_0033081.definition: Failure to increase serum TSH levels in response to a TRH stimulation test.

HP_0033082.label: reduced tsh response to thyrotrophin - releasing hormone stimulation test
HP_0033082.definition: A lower than normal TSH response to thyrotrophin-releasing hormone stimulation test.

HP_0033083.label: increased circulating farnesol concentration
HP_0033083.definition: An elevated level of farnesol in the blood circulation.

HP_0033084.label: abnormal antral follicle count
HP_0033084.definition: Any deviation from a count of antral follicles that is normal for age. Antral follicles appear as small fluid-filled sacs that contain an immature egg. Antral follicle count can be measured (usually on day 2-5 of the menstrual cycle) by transvaginal ultrasound. The number of antral follicles may reflect ovarian reserve.

HP_0033085.label: reduced antral follicle count
HP_0033085.definition: A count of antral follicles that is lower than normal for age.

HP_0033086.label: increased antral follicle count
HP_0033086.definition: A count of antral follicles that is higher than normal for age.

HP_0033087.label: quotidian fever
HP_0033087.definition: Fever that occurs at daily intervals.

HP_0033088.label: valinuria
HP_0033088.definition: Urine valine level above the normal range.

HP_0033089.label: branched - chain aminoaciduria
HP_0033089.definition: An increased level of a branched chain family amino acid in the urine.
HP_0033089.UMLS synonyms: Disorder of branched-chain amino acid metabolism

HP_0033090.label: increased aromatic amino acid level in urine
HP_0033090.definition: An elevated level of an aromatic amino acid in the urine.

HP_0033091.label: tyrosinuria
HP_0033091.definition: An abnormally increased level of tyrosine in the urine.

HP_0033092.label: increased urine succinate level
HP_0033092.definition: The concentration of succinate in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033093.label: increased glutamine family amino acid level in urine
HP_0033093.definition: An elevated level of an glutamine family amino acid in the urine.

HP_0033094.label: increased urine glutamate level
HP_0033094.definition: An increased concentration of glutamate in the urine.

HP_0033095.label: increased sulfur amino acid level in urine
HP_0033095.definition: An elevated level of a sulfur-containing amino acid in the urine.
HP_0033095.synonyms: increased sulfur - containing amino acid level in urine | increased sulphur amino acid level in urine

HP_0033096.label: increased aspartate family amino acid level in urine
HP_0033096.definition: An elevated level of an aspartate family amino acid in the urine.

HP_0033097.label: increased urine proteinogenic amino acid derivative level
HP_0033097.definition: An elevated urine level of a compound that is derived from an amino acid.

HP_0033098.label: increased urinary non - proteinogenic amino acid level
HP_0033098.definition: An increased level in the urine of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.
HP_0033098.synonyms: elevated urinary non - proteinogenic amino acid level

HP_0033099.label: increased serine family amino acid in urine
HP_0033099.definition: An increased level of a serine family amino acid in the urine.

HP_0033100.label: increased proteinogenic amino acid level in urine
HP_0033100.definition: An elevated level of a proteinogenic amino acid in the urine. These are the 23 alpha-amino acids that are precursors to proteins, and are incorporated into proteins during translation. The group includes the 20 amino acids encoded by the nuclear genes of eukaryotes together with selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, and N-formylmethionine.

HP_0033101.label: elevated urine aconitic acid level
HP_0033101.definition: An abnormally increased level of aconitic acid in the urine.

HP_0033102.label: monkey wrench femoral neck
HP_0033102.definition: The femoral neck region shows medial metaphyseal beaking and a significant enlargement of the lesser trochanter (with some enlargement also of the greater trochanter), producing a monkey wrench (Swedish key) configuration of the proximal femur. A monkey wrench refers to a type of adjustable wrench with one fixed and one adjustable jaw at right angles to a straight handle.
HP_0033102.synonyms: monkey wrench appearance of femoral neck | monkey wrench configuration of the proximal femur | swedish key appearance of femoral neck | swedish key configuration of the proximal femur
HP_0033102.UMLS synonyms: Neonatal monkey-wrench appearance of femoral neck

HP_0033103.label: elevated circulating chi3l1 level
HP_0033103.definition: Increased concentration of chitinase 3-like 1 (CHI3L1) in the blood circulation.
HP_0033103.synonyms: elevated circulating chitinase 3 - like 1 level | elevated circulating ykl40 level

HP_0033104.label: inappropriate absence of fever
HP_0033104.definition: Failure to develop fever in the presence of an infection that normally would be expected to elicit a febrile response.

HP_0033105.label: interhypothalamic adhesion
HP_0033105.definition: An abnormal parenchymal band connecting the medial margins of the left and right hypothalami across the third ventricle.

HP_0033106.label: elevated circulating d - dimer concentration
HP_0033106.definition: An increased concentration of D-dimers, a marker of fibrin degradation, in the blood circulation.
HP_0033106.synonyms: elevated d - dimers | elevated fibrin degradation fragment concentration

HP_0033107.label: abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid concentration
HP_0033107.definition: An elevated level of a proteinogenic amino acid in the blood circulation. These are the 23 alpha-amino acids that are precursors to proteins, and are incorporated into proteins during translation. The group includes the 20 amino acids encoded by the nuclear genes of eukaryotes together with selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, and N-formylmethionine.

HP_0033108.label: abnormal circulating proteinogenic amino acid derivative concentration
HP_0033108.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of a compound that is derived from an amino acid.

HP_0033109.label: abnormal circulating non - proteinogenic amino acid concentration
HP_0033109.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration in the blood circulation of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.

HP_0033110.label: elevated circulating alpha - aminobutyric acid concentration
HP_0033110.definition: An abnormally increased level of alpa-aminobutyric acid in the blood circulation. Alpha-aminobutyric acid alpha-amino acid that is butyric acid bearing a single amino substituent located at position 2.

HP_0033111.label: 3 - hydroxyisovaleric aciduria
HP_0033111.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxyisovaleric acid in the urine above the normal range.

HP_0033112.label: elevated circulating apolipoprotein c - iii concentration
HP_0033112.definition: An increased concentration in blood of apolipoprotein C-III, a protein component of triglyceride (TG)-rich lipoproteins (TRLs) including very low density lipoproteins (VLDL), high density lipoproteins (HDL) and chylomicrons.
HP_0033112.synonyms: elevated apoc3 level | elevated apolipoprotein c - iii level

HP_0033113.label: gallop rhythm
HP_0033113.definition: In the normal heart cycle, two heart sounds can be heard by auscultation per cycle: S1 and S2. A gallop rhythm refers to the presence of three or four heart sounds per cardiac cycle, which is said to resemble the gallop of a horse.
HP_0033113.UMLS synonyms: Gallop rhythm | No gallop rhythm | Gallop rhythm present

HP_0033114.label: quadruple gallop rhythm
HP_0033114.definition: A type of gallop rhythm in which both the third and the fourth sounds are present.

HP_0033115.label: elevated circulating tenascin - c level
HP_0033115.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of tenascin-C in the blood circulation.

HP_0033116.label: duodenal gastric metaplasia
HP_0033116.definition: Foci of gastric-type mucus-secreting cells interspersed between duodenal enterocytes. These foci of gastric epithelial cells contain Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive neutral mucin and lack a brush border.

HP_0033117.label: duodenitis
HP_0033117.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the upper small intestine (duodenum).
HP_0033117.UMLS synonyms: Duodenitis | Hemorrhagic duodenitis | Acute Enteritis of the Mouse Intestinal Tract | Chronic duodenitis | Erosive Duodenitis | Tuberculous duodenitis | Lymphocytic duodenitis | Infective duodenitis | Eosinophilic duodenitis | acute duodenitis | Granulomatous duodenitis | Sarcoid duodenitis | Strongyloides duodenitis | Bacterial duodenitis | Mycobacterial duodenitis | Parasitic duodenitis | Viral duodenitis | Fungal duodenitis | Allergic duodenitis | Necrotizing duodenitis | Cytomegalovirus duodenitis | Helicobacter duodenitis | Ulcerative duodenitis | duodenitis; tuberculous (manifestation) | tuberculosis; duodenitis (manifestation)

HP_0033118.label: abnormal right ventricular function
HP_0033118.definition: Anomalous physiology (function) of the right ventricle.

HP_0033119.label: elevated right ventricular systolic pressure
HP_0033119.definition: Elevation of right ventricular systolic pressure (RVSP) above normal limits. In adults, RVSP is normally 20-30 mmHg.

HP_0033120.label: nummular eczema
HP_0033120.definition: A type of eczema characterized by pruritic coin-shaped patches on the skin. Nummular eczema most commonly occurs on the extremities, particularly the legs, but may occur anywhere on the trunk, hands, or feet
HP_0033120.UMLS synonyms: Nummular eczema | Adult nummular atopic dermatitis | Childhood nummular atopic eczematous dermatitis

HP_0033121.label: barking cough
HP_0033121.definition: A cough with a characteristic sound that has been compared to a seal's bark.

HP_0033122.label: absent p wave
HP_0033122.definition: The P wave that normally precedes each QRS complex by a fixed PR interval of 120 to 200 milliseconds is not present.
HP_0033122.synonyms: absence of p wave on electrocardiography
HP_0033122.UMLS synonyms: electrocardiogram: absent P wave | Absent or difficult-to-count P waves on electrocardiogram (ECG)

HP_0033123.label: elevated circulating osteopontin level
HP_0033123.definition: Abnormally increased level of osteopontin in the blood circulation

HP_0033124.label: increased serum sorbitol concentration
HP_0033124.definition: An increased level of sorbitol in the blood circulation.

HP_0033125.label: follicular lymphoma
HP_0033125.definition: An indolent B cell lymphoproliferative disorder of transformed follicular center B cells. Follicular lymphoma is characterized by diffuse lymphadenopathy, bone marrow involvement, splenomegaly and less commonly other extranodal sites of involvement.
HP_0033125.UMLS synonyms: Lymphoma, Follicular | Pediatric follicular lymphoma | Classic Follicular Lymphoma | Follicular lymphoma refractory | Follicular lymphoma recurrent | FOLLICULAR LYMPHOMA, SOMATIC | Advanced Follicular Lymphoma | Prostate Follicular Lymphoma | Intestinal Follicular Lymphoma | Conjunctival Follicular Lymphoma | Testicular Follicular Lymphoma | Cutaneous Follicular Lymphoma | lymphoma; follicular, histiocytic | lymphoma; follicular, centroblastic | noncleaved; lymphoma, follicular | Non-follicular lymphoma | Lymphoma, Mixed-Cell, Follicular | Lymphoma, Large-Cell, Follicular | follicular lymphoma of spleen | follicular lymphoma of lung | follicular malignant lymphoma of breast | Malignant lymphoma, follicular center cell, cleaved | Lymphoma, Follicular, Grade 1 | Lymphoma, Small Cleaved-Cell, Follicular | grade 3A follicular lymphoma

HP_0033126.label: cutaneous necrosis
HP_0033126.definition: Skin and subcutaneous tissue necrosis (tissue death). Clinically, cutaneous necrosis may present as a painful and extremely tender black eschar (dead tissue found in a full-thickness wound) surrounded by dusky grey-red coloured skin.
HP_0033126.UMLS synonyms: Skin necrosis | Total necrosis of skin flap | Necrosis of skin due to and following injection of filler | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the thigh with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the calf with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the calf with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of ankle with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the foot with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of ankle with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the foot with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the thigh with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left calf with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left ankle with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left thigh with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left thigh with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left calf with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the left ankle with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right calf with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right thigh with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right ankle with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right thigh with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right calf with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of the right ankle with necrosis of bone | chronic non-pressure ulcer of lower leg with necrosis of muscle | chronic non-pressure ulcer of lower leg with necrosis of bone

HP_0033127.label: abnormality of the musculoskeletal system
HP_0033127.definition: An anomaly of the musculoskeletal system, which consists of the bones of the skeleton, muscles, cartilage, tendons, ligaments, joints, and other connective tissue. The musculoskeletal system supports the weight of the body, maintains body position and produces movements of the body or of parts of the body.
HP_0033127.UMLS synonyms: Functions and Abnormal Functions of the Musculoskeletal System | Function and Abnormal Function of the Nervous and Musculoskeletal Systems

HP_0033128.label: delayed ability to crawl
HP_0033128.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to crawl at an appropriate developmental stage. Normal infant motor development is marked by a series of postural milestones including learning to crawl on hands and knees between the ages of 6 and 10 months.

HP_0033129.label: abnormal shoulder physiology
HP_0033129.definition: Anopmalous function of the shoulder. The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint that is made up of humerus, scapula and clavicle, which are connected by the sternoclavicular joint (SC), the acromioclavicular joint (AC), the glenohumeral joint (GH), and the scapulothoracic joint (ST). The GH, AC and SC joints link the upper extremity to the axial skeleton at the thorax and enable movement at the shoulder joint: flexion, extension, and rotation of the arm.

HP_0033130.label: abnormal renal echogenicity
HP_0033130.definition: Anomalous echogenicity of the kidney on ultrasound examination.

HP_0033131.label: renal medullary hyperechogenicity
HP_0033131.definition: Increased echogenecity of the medullary region of the kidney.

HP_0033132.label: renal cortical hyperechogenicity
HP_0033132.definition: Increased echogenecity of the kidney cortex.

HP_0033134.label: abdominal adhesions
HP_0033134.definition: Fibrous bands (i.e., bands of scar-like tissue) that span two or more intra-abdominal organs and/or the inner abdominal wall (i.e. peritoneal membrane).
HP_0033134.UMLS synonyms: Division of abdominal adhesions | Laparoscopic division of abdominal adhesions | Adhesion of abdominal wall | Entrapment of intestine in abdominal adhesions | Abdominal hernia due to adhesions with obstruction | Peritoneal adhesion | Adhesion of intestine | Adhesion of omentum | Postprocedural pelvic peritoneal adhesions | Adhesion of mesentery | Colonic adhesions | Small bowel adhesions | uterus; adhesion, to abdominal wall

HP_0033135.label: hepatic infarction
HP_0033135.definition: Hepatic infarction is defined as areas of coagulative necrosis from hepatocyte cell death caused by local ischemia. Liver infarctions appear as hypoechoic nonvascular regions on conventional and Doppler sonography.
HP_0033135.UMLS synonyms: Hepatic Infarction | ultrasound of abdomen: infarction of liver

HP_0033136.label: lymph node abscess
HP_0033136.definition: An inflamed lymph node that is filled with pus.
HP_0033136.UMLS synonyms: Lymph node abscess | Cervical lymph node abscess | Acute abscess lymph node | lymph node; abscess, mesentery | abscess of inguinal lymph node | abscess of axillary lymph node | abscess of epitrochlear lymph node | abscess of suboccipital lymph node | abscess of postauricular lymph node | abscess of supraclavicular lymph node | abscess of femoral lymph node | abscess of submandibular lymph node | abscess of submental lymph node | abscess of popliteal lymph node | abscess of preauricular lymph node | drainage of lymph node abscess | abscess; axilla (region), lymph node | Simple drainage of lymph node abscess | Extensive drainage of lymph node abscess | External drainage of lymph node abscess | neck; abscess, lymph gland or node | Drainage of lymph node abscess or lymphadenitis | abscess of axillary lymph node on left | abscess of cervical lymph node on left | abscess of inguinal lymph node on left

HP_0033137.label: abnormal pulmonary alveolar system morphology
HP_0033137.definition: A structural abnormality of the pulmonary acinus, alveolar parenchyma, or alveoli.

HP_0033138.label: right atrial thrombus
HP_0033138.definition: A thrombus (i.e., a blood clot formed in situ within the vascular system) located in the right atrium of the heart.
HP_0033138.UMLS synonyms: Right atrial appendage thrombus | Thrombus of right atrium | Removal of right atrial thrombus | echocardiography: thrombus formation of right atrial appendage

HP_0033139.label: elevated circulating uracil concentration
HP_0033139.definition: Concentration of uracil in the blood circulation is above the normal range.

HP_0033140.label: blake 's pouch cyst
HP_0033140.definition: The presence of an upwardly displaced normal cerebellar vermis, normal appearance of the fastigium, tentorium and size of the cisterna magna.

HP_0033141.label: severe sars - cov - 2 infection
HP_0033141.definition: Unusually severe clinical course of SARS-CoV-2 infection, manifested clinically by features such as dyspnea and hypoxia with diffuse bilateral ground-glass opacities of the lungs on computed tomographic scan with progressive respiratory insufficiency necessitating oxygen supplementation or mechanical ventilation.
HP_0033141.UMLS synonyms: Infectious disease (viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific RNA, 3 targets (severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 [SARS-CoV-2], influenza A, influenza B), upper respiratory specimen, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected | Infectious disease (viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific RNA, 4 targets (severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 [SARS-CoV-2], influenza A, influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus [RSV]), upper respiratory specimen, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected | Infectious disease (bacterial or viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific nucleic acid (DNA or RNA), 22 targets including severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), qualitative RT-PCR, nasopharyngeal swab, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected (0223U) | Infectious disease (bacterial or viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific nucleic acid (DNA or RNA), 22 targets including severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), qualitative RT-PCR, nasopharyngeal swab, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected (0202U) | Infectious disease (bacterial or viral respiratory tract infection) pathogen-specific DNA and RNA, 21 targets, including severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2), amplified probe technique, including multiplex reverse transcription for RNA targets, each analyte reported as detected or not detected

HP_0033142.label: long nasal bridge
HP_0033142.definition: Increased superior-inferior length of the nasal bridge, which is the saddle-shaped area that includes the nasal root and the lateral aspects of the nose.

HP_0033143.label: jejunitis
HP_0033143.definition: Inflammation of the lining of the middle section of the small intestine.
HP_0033143.UMLS synonyms: jejunitis | Noninfectious jejunitis | Dietetic jejunitis | Allergic jejunitis | Ulcerative jejunitis | jejunitis; tuberculous (manifestation) | tuberculosis; jejunitis (manifestation) | jejunitis; presumed infectious | Duodenitis with proximal jejunitis | Crohn's disease of jejunum | Jejunitis, NOS dietetic or noninfectious

HP_0033144.label: abnormal circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
HP_0033144.definition: Any deviation of the concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood from the normal range.

HP_0033145.label: increased circulating ceruloplasmin concentration
HP_0033145.definition: Elevated concentration of ceruloplasmin in the blood circulation.

HP_0033146.label: elevated circulating methylsuccinic acid concentration
HP_0033146.definition: Increased concentration of methylsuccinic acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0033147.label: abnormal circulating short - chain fatty - acid concentration
HP_0033147.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of a short-chain fatty acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0033148.label: increased circulating isovaleric acid concentration
HP_0033148.definition: Increased concentration of isovaleric acid, a C5, branched-chain saturated fatty acid, in the blood concentration.

HP_0033149.label: intrahepatic bile duct dilatation
HP_0033149.definition: Increased diameter (caliber) of intrahepatic bile ducts (bile ducts that transport bile between the Canals of Hering and the interlobar bile ducts).
HP_0033149.UMLS synonyms: Congenital dilatation of lobar intrahepatic bile duct | Congenital dilatation of lobar intrahepatic bile duct with obstruction | Dilated intrahepatic bile ducts | ultrasound of intrahepatic bile duct: dilation | ultrasound of intrahepatic bile duct: focal dilation | ultrasound of intrahepatic bile duct: diffuse dilation | Dilatation and beading of the intrahepatic bile ducts | Caroli disease isolated

HP_0033150.label: anorectal abscess
HP_0033150.definition: An abscess located at the junction of the anal canal and the rectum.
HP_0033150.UMLS synonyms: Anorectal abscess | Submucous anorectal abscess | skin abscess anorectal | COLON ANORECTAL ABSCESS | Abscess of anorectal fissure | Drainage of anorectal abscess | Incision and drainage of anorectal abscess

HP_0033151.label: abnormal pharynx morphology
HP_0033151.definition: A structural anomaly of the pharynx.

HP_0033152.label: abnormal pharynx physiology
HP_0033152.definition: A functional anomaly of the pharynx.

HP_0033153.label: elevated circulating dodecenoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033153.definition: An abnormally increased circulation of dodecenoylcarnitine, C12:1, in the blood circulation.

HP_0033154.label: elevated circulating deoxypyridinoline concentration
HP_0033154.definition: An increased concentration of lysyl-pyridinoline (deoxypyridinoline) cross-links in the blood circulation.

HP_0033155.label: elevated circulating l - alloisoleucine concentration
HP_0033155.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033156.label: elevated urine l - alloisoleucine level
HP_0033156.definition: Abnormally increased level of L-alloisoleucine in the urine.

HP_0033157.label: elevated circulating 3 - methylhistidine concentration
HP_0033157.definition: Abnormal increase of the concentration of 3-methylhistidine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033158.label: reduced respiratory ciliary beating frequency
HP_0033158.definition: An abnormal reduction in the number of beats per unit time of the respiratory cilia.

HP_0033159.label: reduced urinary inosine level
HP_0033159.definition: The amount of inosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Inosine is a purine nucleoside in which hypoxanthine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.

HP_0033160.label: decreased urinary guanosine level
HP_0033160.definition: The amount of guanosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal. Guanosine is a purine nucleoside in which guanine is attached to ribofuranose via a beta-N(9)-glycosidic bond.

HP_0033161.label: abnormal urinary purine level
HP_0033161.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a purine compound in the urine. Purines are aromatic heterocyclic compounds containing a purine moiety, which is formed a pyrimidine-ring ring fused to an imidazole ring. Two of the four deoxyribonucleotides (deoxyadenosine and deoxyguanosine) and two of the four ribonucleotides (adenosine, or AMP, and guanosine, or GMP) are purines.

HP_0033162.label: abnormal urinary pyrimidine level
HP_0033162.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a pyrimidine compound in the urine. Pyrimidines and pyrimidine derivatives are compounds containing a pyrimidne ring, which is a six-member aromatic heterocycle which consists of two nitrogen atoms (at positions 1 and 3) and four carbon atoms. The nucleotides cytosine, thymine and uracil are pyrimidines.

HP_0033163.label: small intestinal bacterial overgrowth
HP_0033163.definition: An increased number and/or abnormal type of bacteria in the small bowel. Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth has been defined as the presence of greater than one hundred thousand bacteria (i.e. colony-forming units, CFU) per mL of proximal jejunal aspiration. The normal value is ten thousand or few CFU/ml.
HP_0033163.UMLS synonyms: Small intestinal bacterial overgrowth, unspecified | small bowel bacterial overgrowth, hydrogen subtype | small bowel bacterial overgrowth, hydrogen sulfide subtype | Small intestine bacterial overgrowth breath test each test

HP_0033164.label: focal active colitis
HP_0033164.definition: Focal active colitis (FAC) is characterized by focal crypt damage caused by neutrophils. FAC is characterized by an inflammatory infiltrate consisting of intraepithelial neutrophils and/or neutrophils invading the lumen of the criptae, with no other microscopic alteration of the colonic mucosa and, in particular, without the presence of signs of chronic inflammation.

HP_0033165.label: necrotizing enterocolitis
HP_0033165.definition: Inflammation of the intestine leading to bacterial invasion causing cellular damage and death which causes necrosis of the colon and intestine.
HP_0033165.UMLS synonyms: Necrotizing Enterocolitis | Necrotizing enterocolitis in fetus OR newborn | Neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis | Adult necrotizing enterocolitis | Suspected Necrotizing Enterocolitis | Necrotizing Enterocolitis Totalis | necrotizing; enterocolitis, fetal | Necrotizing enterocolitis, unspecified | Necrotizing Enterocolitis, Adverse Event | stage 1 necrotizing enterocolitis | stage 3 necrotizing enterocolitis | stage 2 necrotizing enterocolitis | Necrotizing enterocolitis with perforation | Clostridium; difficile, necrotizing enterocolitis | Necrotizing enterocolitis in newborn, unspecified | stage I neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis | stage II neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis | stage III neonatal necrotizing enterocolitis | Grade 4 Necrotizing Enterocolitis, AE | Grade 3 Necrotizing Enterocolitis, AE | Grade 5 Necrotizing Enterocolitis, AE | Necrotizing enterocolitis of newborn, Stage 3B | Necrotizing enterocolitis of newborn, stage 1A | Necrotizing enterocolitis of newborn, stage 2B | Necrotizing enterocolitis of newborn, stage 2A

HP_0033166.label: recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections
HP_0033166.definition: An increased susceptibility to viral upper respiratory tract infections as manifested by a history of recurrent viral upper respiratory tract infections (otitis, sinusitis, pharyngitis, tonsillitis).

HP_0033167.label: neutrophilic urticarial dermatosis
HP_0033167.definition: A neutrophilic interstitial, perivascular and/or perieccrine infiltrate with leukocytoclasia. Notably, leukocytoclastic vasculitis is not present.

HP_0033168.label: reduced mevalonate kinase activity
HP_0033168.definition: Abnormally reduced activity of mevalonate kinase, which is a key enzyme in the mevalonate biosynthetic pathway that leads to the synthesis of both cholesterol and nonsterol isoprenoids.

HP_0033169.label: reduced total lung capacity
HP_0033169.definition: Abnormally reduced volume of air in the lungs upon the maximum effort of inspiration.

HP_0033170.label: abnormal skinfold thickness measurement
HP_0033170.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of a skinfold thickness, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.

HP_0033171.label: abnormal triceps skinfold thickness
HP_0033171.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of the thickness of the triceps skinfold, which quantifies the amount of subcutaneous fat when the skin is pinched by specialized calipers.

HP_0033172.label: increased triceps skinfold thickness
HP_0033172.definition: Increased thickness of the triceps skinfold, which is measured halfway down the back of the upper arm is increased.

HP_0033173.label: milky appearance of bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
HP_0033173.definition: Return of lavage fluid with a milky appearance due to the accumulation of a mixture of pulmonary surfactant, which is a lipoprotein complex, in the alveolar space.

HP_0033174.label: bloody bronchoalveolar lavage fluid
HP_0033174.definition: Return of lavage fluid characteristically has a bloody appearance in pulmonary alveolar hemorrhage. This is due to admixture of blood, which typically increases with each consecutive lavage portion. Microscopically erythrocytes can be seen. After 24 to 48 h macrophages contain phagocytosed erythrocytes, indicating previous bleeding.

HP_0033175.label: elevated circulating 5 - oxoproline concentration
HP_0033175.definition: Concentration of L-pyroglutamic acid in the blood is above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033175.synonyms: elevated circulating l - pyroglutamic acid concentration

HP_0033176.label: submandibular lymph node enlargement
HP_0033176.definition: Increased size of the lymph nodes that are located beneath the mandible (lower jaw).
HP_0033176.UMLS synonyms: Submandibular lymphadenopathy | enlarged left submandibular lymph node | enlarged submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged right submandibular lymph nodes | enlarged, fixed left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, hard left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, suppurative left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, fluctuant left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, mobile left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, tender left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, rubbery left submandibular lymph node | enlarged, fixed right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, fixed submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, fluctuant submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, rubbery submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, fluctuant right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, hard right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, hard submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, tender submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, mobile right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, suppurative right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, tender right submandibular lymph node | enlarged, mobile submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, suppurative submandibular lymph nodes bilaterally | enlarged, rubbery right submandibular lymph node

HP_0033177.label: elevated circulating suberic acid concentration
HP_0033177.definition: An increased concentration of suberic acid in the blood circulation. Suberic acid is an alpha,omega-dicarboxylic acid that is the 1,6-dicarboxy derivative of hexane.

HP_0033178.label: increased circulating interleukin 8 concentration
HP_0033178.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-8 in the circulation.
HP_0033178.synonyms: increased serum il - 8 | increased serum interleukin 8 | increased serum interleukin - 8

HP_0033179.label: elevated circulating aconitic acid concentration
HP_0033179.definition: Concentration of aconitic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033180.label: torsion of appendix of testis
HP_0033180.definition: The appendix testis or hydatid of Morgagni, is a vestigial remnant of the Müllerian duct located on the superior pole of the testicle between the testis and epididymis. Although this appendage has no vital function, it is present in 50% of males. Torsion of twisting of this vestigial remnant can be incredibly painful, but usually requires no medical intervention.
HP_0033180.synonyms: twisted vestigial remnant of the muellerian duct

HP_0033181.label: spinal epidural abscess
HP_0033181.definition: Spinal epidural abscess (SEA) is caused by a suppurative infection in the epidural space. The mass effect of the abscess can compress and reduce blood flow to the spinal cord, conus medullaris, or cauda equina.
HP_0033181.synonyms: a severe pyogenic infection of the epidural space
HP_0033181.UMLS synonyms: Epidural Abscess, Spinal | Fungal spinal epidural abscess | Abscess of spinal epidural space caused by Mycobacterium | Abscess of spinal epidural space caused by bacterium | tuberculosis; abscess, epidural (cerebral) (spinal) (manifestation) | abscess; tuberculous, epidural (cerebral) (spinal) (manifestation) | SPINAL EPIDURAL ABSCESS OR GRANULOMA NON TUBERCULOUS | Abscess in epidural space of cervical spine | Abscess in epidural space of lumbar spine | Embolic abscess of spinal cord, extradural | Extradural abscess of spinal cord, any part

HP_0033182.label: increased circulating cathepsin d level
HP_0033182.definition: An increase in concentration of cathepsin D in the blood circulation.

HP_0033183.label: bilobed right lung
HP_0033183.definition: A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only two lobes of the right lung.

HP_0033184.label: triggered by infection
HP_0033184.UMLS synonyms: Rhabdomyolysis (triggered by infection) | Myopathic episodes triggered by exercise, fasting, infection, cold temperatures

HP_0033185.label: triggered by ebv infection
HP_0033185.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by the Epstein-Barr virus.
HP_0033185.synonyms: triggered by epstein barr virus infection

HP_0033186.label: misalignment of the pulmonary veins
HP_0033186.definition: The term is commonly used to describe a putative abnormal location of pulmonary vein branches adjacent to pulmonary arteries within the same adventitial sheath. However, evidence has been provided that the vessels in question are not pulmonary veins, however represent dilated bronchial veins.

HP_0033187.label: hyperimidodipeptiduria
HP_0033187.definition: Elevated levels of proline-containing dipeptides in urine.

HP_0033188.label: cystic acne
HP_0033188.definition: A severe type of acne characterized by the formation of cysts enclosing a mixture of keratin and sebum.
HP_0033188.UMLS synonyms: Cystic acne | Severe cystic acne | Pyogenic Arthritis, Pyoderma Gangrenosum and Acne | Documentation of medical reason(s) for prescribing or dispensing antibiotic (e.g., intestinal infection, pertussis, bacterial infection, lyme disease, otitis media, acute sinusitis, acute pharyngitis, acute tonsillitis, chronic sinusitis, infection of the pharynx/larynx/tonsils/adenoids, prostatitis, cellulitis/ mastoiditis/bone infections, acute lymphadenitis, impetigo, skin staph infections, pneumonia, gonococcal infections/venereal disease (syphilis, chlamydia, inflammatory diseases [female reproductive organs]), infections of the kidney, cystitis/uti, acne, hiv disease/asymptomatic hiv, cystic fibrosis, disorders of the immune system, malignancy neoplasms, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, bronchiectasis, extrinsic allergic alveolitis, chronic airway obstruction, chronic obstructive asthma, pneumoconiosis and other lung disease due to external agents, other diseases of the respiratory system, and tuberculosis

HP_0033189.label: radiculomegaly
HP_0033189.definition: Tooth root length more than 2 SD above mean, or subjectively apparently increased tooth root length.
HP_0033189.synonyms: long dental root | rhizomegaly | root gigantism

HP_0033190.label: hypertrichotic hyperpigmented patch
HP_0033190.definition: A large nonpalpable spot of the skin over 1 cm in dimension with increased pigmentation and increased hair growth.

HP_0033191.label: increased circulating selenium concentration
HP_0033191.definition: An increased concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.

HP_0033192.label: decreased circulating selenium concentration
HP_0033192.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration of selenium in the blood circulation.

HP_0033193.label: ballooning hepatocyte degeneration
HP_0033193.definition: Swelling of the hepatocyte, rounding of its contour, and alteration of the cytoplasm, which takes on a reticulated, rarefied, or flocculant quality. The cytoplasm of the ballooned hepatocytes often contains clumps of eosinophilic ropey material known as Mallory-Denk bodies (MDBs) or Mallory hyaline, which is composed of hyperphosphorylated misfolded intermediate filaments, ubiquitin, and ubiquitin-binding protein P62.

HP_0033194.label: perioral erythema
HP_0033194.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the mouth.

HP_0033195.label: perianal erythema
HP_0033195.definition: Erythema (Redness of the skin caused by hyperemia of the capillaries in the lower layers of the skin) localized to the region surrounding the anus.

HP_0033196.label: portal inflammation
HP_0033196.definition: Infiltration of portal fields by inflammatory cells.
HP_0033196.UMLS synonyms: Portal inflammation | Portal Inflammation Assessment | Portal tract inflammation | Portal and septal inflammation | Lobular and portal inflammation | Portal inflammation, mild to moderate Portal fibrosis, mild | Nonspecific portal inflammation shown on biopsy | Portal triaditis

HP_0033197.label: hepatic lobular inflammation
HP_0033197.definition: Infiltration of inflammatory cells in lobules of the liver. A focus of lobular inflammation can be defined as two or more inflammatory cells (neutrophils, lymphocytes and other mononuclear cells, eosinophils and microgranulomas) within the lobule present within the sinusoids or surrounding injured hepatocytes (ballooned or apoptotic hepatocytes).

HP_0033198.label: triggered by viral infection
HP_0033198.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by infection by a virus.

HP_0033199.label: increased circulating interleukin 10 concentration
HP_0033199.definition: An elevation of the concentration of interleukin 10 in the blood circulation.

HP_0033200.label: triceps hyporeflexia
HP_0033200.definition: Reduced intensity of the triceps tendon reflex.

HP_0033201.label: biceps hyporeflexia
HP_0033201.definition: Reduced intensity of the biceps tendon reflex.

HP_0033202.label: brachioradialis hyporeflexia
HP_0033202.definition: Reduced intensity of the brachioradialis tendon reflex.

HP_0033203.label: brachioradialis hyperreflexia
HP_0033203.definition: Increased intensity of the brachioradialis reflex.

HP_0033204.label: triceps hyperreflexia
HP_0033204.definition: Increased intensity of the triceps reflex.

HP_0033205.label: biceps hyperreflexia
HP_0033205.definition: Increased intensity of the biceps reflex.

HP_0033206.label: hyperactive achilles reflex
HP_0033206.definition: Increased intensity of the Achilles reflex.
HP_0033206.synonyms: hyperactive ankle jerk reflex | hyperactive ankle reflex

HP_0033207.label: increased proportion autoreactive unresponsive cd21 - / low b cells
HP_0033207.definition: Increased proportion relative to B-lymphocytes of a subset of B lymphocytes characterized by dim/low levels of CD21, i.e., CD21-/low, in flow cytometry, and additionally enriched in autoreactive clones as determined for instance by clonse showing rheumatoid factor (anti-IgG) reactivity and antibodies recognizing cytoplasmic and to a lesser extent nuclear structures.

HP_0033208.label: alveolar capillary dysplasia
HP_0033208.definition: A developmental defect of the alveolar airspace during cananicular lung development characterized by a decreased number of pulmonary capillaries located away from the alveolar epithelium, thickened alveolar septae, media hypertrophy of small pulmonary arteries and muscularization of distal arterioles, and in some cases lymphangiectasis.
HP_0033208.UMLS synonyms: Alveolar capillary dysplasia | Alveolar capillary dysplasia (ACD) | alveolar capillary dysplasia with vein misalignment | Alveolar capillary dysplasia with pulmonary venous misalignment | Persistent Fetal Circulation Syndrome

HP_0033209.label: acinar dysplasia
HP_0033209.definition: Arrest of lung development in the pseudoglandular stage (weeks 8 to 16 of human gestation) resulting in small sized lungs, predominantly composed of bronchial and bronchiolar structures embedded in abundant loose mesenchyme that is poorly vascularized. Acinar structures are essentially absent, with no significant formation of saccules and no alveoli.

HP_0033210.label: congenital alveolar dysplasia
HP_0033210.definition: Arrest of lung development in the cananicular stage (weeks 18 to 26 of human gestation) resulting in simplified acinar spaces, frequently with abundant intervening mesenchyme and no alveoli. In later arrest growth stages early saccular formations may be seen. May resemble the lobular maldevelopment often seen in alveolar capillary dysplasia/misaligment of the pulmonary veins without vein misalignment or marked hypertensive changes of the pulmonary arteries.
HP_0033210.UMLS synonyms: Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Newborn | Alveolar capillary dysplasia | Persistent Fetal Circulation Syndrome

HP_0033211.label: decreased total iron binding capacity
HP_0033211.definition: A reduction in the total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added. The latent (or free) iron binding capacity is the difference between the TIBC and the measured serum iron, corresponding to the transferrin not bound to iron, i.e., free iron binding capacity.
HP_0033211.UMLS synonyms: SERUM TOTAL IRON-BINDING CAPACITY DECREASED | Total iron binding capacity below reference range

HP_0033212.label: abnormal total iron binding capacity
HP_0033212.definition: Any deviation from the normal total-iron binding capacity, which measures how much serum iron is bound if an excess of radioactive iron is added.

HP_0033213.label: elevated urine suberic acid level
HP_0033213.definition: The concentration of suberic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033214.label: recurrent viral pneumonia
HP_0033214.definition: Increased susceptibility to viral pneumonia, as manifested by recurrent episodes of viral pneumonias.

HP_0033215.label: obliterative abnormality of the renal glomerulus

HP_0033216.label: glomerular hyalinosis
HP_0033216.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus. Distribution can include vascular pole, perihilar, tip or neither tip, perihilar or vascular.
HP_0033216.UMLS synonyms: Hyalinosis, Segmental Glomerular | idiopathic; hematuria, with glomerular lesion, focal and segmental hyalinosis or sclerosis

HP_0033217.label: perihilar glomerular hyalinosis
HP_0033217.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the vascular pole/perihilum.

HP_0033218.label: glomerular hyalinosis at the tubular pole
HP_0033218.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at the tip/tubular pole.

HP_0033219.label: glomerular hyalinosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
HP_0033219.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material in the glomerulus at neither tip nor perihilar/vascular poles. Both the vascular and the tubular pole are present in the glomerular cross section.

HP_0033220.label: 2 - ethylhydracylic aciduria
HP_0033220.definition: An increased concentration of 2-ethylhydracylic acid in the urine.
HP_0033220.synonyms: elevated urinary 2 - ethylhydracylic acid | elevated urinary 2 - methylbutyrylglycine

HP_0033221.label: increased cd4 : cd8 ratio
HP_0033221.definition: An abnormal elevation of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.

HP_0033222.label: decreased cd4 : cd8 ratio
HP_0033222.definition: An abnormal reduction of the relative proportion of CD4+ to CD8+ T cells.
HP_0033222.synonyms: inverted cd4 / cd8 ratio | inverted cd4 : cd8 ratio

HP_0033223.label: abnormal glomerular parietal epithelial cell morphology
HP_0033223.definition: Any structural abnormality of the parietal epithelial cells that line the inside of Bowman's capsule and form an inconspicuous sheet of flat epithelial cells in continuity with the proximal tubular epithelial cells at the urinary pole and with the podocytes at the vascular pole.

HP_0033224.label: glomerular parietal epithelial cell hyperplasia
HP_0033224.definition: Increased number of parietal epithelial cells lining Bowman's capsule. Hyperplasia leads to the cells being present in 2 or more layers, often with crowding and multilayering.
HP_0033224.synonyms: hyperplasia of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell

HP_0033225.label: glomerular parietal epithelial cell hypertrophy
HP_0033225.definition: An abnormality of the glomerular parietal epithelial cells characterized by (1) Increased parietal epithelial cell size, with or without cytoplasmic protein droplets; or (2) enlarged nuclei with prominent nucleoli. Both features can be present
HP_0033225.synonyms: hypertrophy of the glomerular parietal epithelial cell

HP_0033226.label: bowman capsular hyaline drops
HP_0033226.definition: An insudative accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material protruding from Bowman's capsule into the urinary space. Although not always evident by light microscopy, this material is located between Bowman's capsule and the parietal epithelial cells, in some cases associated with newly formed matrix material.
HP_0033226.synonyms: capsular hyaline drops within bowman 's capsule

HP_0033227.label: glomerular synechial adhesion
HP_0033227.definition: An area of basement membrane continuity between the glomerular tuft and Bowman's capsule, without intervening crescent and not adjacent to an area of segmental sclerosis.

HP_0033228.label: triceps areflexia
HP_0033228.definition: Inability to elicit triceps tendon reflex.

HP_0033229.label: brachioradialis areflexia
HP_0033229.definition: Inability to elicit brachioradialis tendon reflex.

HP_0033230.label: biceps areflexia
HP_0033230.definition: Inability to elicit biceps tendon reflex.

HP_0033231.label: abnormal glomerular mesangial cellularity
HP_0033231.definition: Abnormal number of its constituent cells of the mesangium of the glomerulus of the kidney.

HP_0033232.label: abnormal glomerular mesangial matrix morphology
HP_0033232.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glomerular matrix. Mesangial cells generate and embed in their own extracellular matrix. The mesangial matrix is different in composition from the glomerular basement membrane. Its constituents are type IV collagen (but only the alpha1 and alpha2 chains); type V collagen; laminin A, B1, and B2; and considerable amounts of fibronectin, heparan sulfate and chondroitin sulfate proteoglycans, entactin, and nidogen. Furthermore, small amounts of the proteoglycans decorin and biglycan are found in the mesangial matrix.

HP_0033233.label: paramesangial deposits
HP_0033233.definition: Mesangial immune deposit located adjacent to the paramesangial glomerular basement membrane.

HP_0033234.label: mesangial hyaline deposition
HP_0033234.definition: Extracellular mesangial accumulation of moderately electron-dense, generally homogenous, amorphous-appearing extracellular material.

HP_0033235.label: difficulty descending stairs
HP_0033235.UMLS synonyms: Difficulty walking down stairs | Degree of difficulty experienced due to your hip while descending stairs in the last W | Degree of difficulty experienced due to your knee while descending stairs in the last W | Degree of difficulty experienced due to your knee while descending stairs in the last W:Find:1W:^Patient:Ord:KOOS | Degree of difficulty experienced due to your hip while descending stairs in the last W:Find:1W:^Patient:Ord:HOOS

HP_0033236.label: cognitive fatigue
HP_0033236.definition: A failure to sustain attention that requires self-motivation to optimize performance.
HP_0033236.UMLS synonyms: Reduce demand for cognitive functioning when ill or fatigued | Reduce demand for cognitive functioning when patient is ill or fatigued

HP_0033237.label: visceral epithelial cell detachment
HP_0033237.definition: Detachment of visceral epithelial cells (podocytes) from underlying glomerular basement membrane with intervening new loose basement membrane material (pale on Hematoxylin and eosin, periodic acid-Shiff, trichrome, or silver stain) forming a so-called 'halo'.
HP_0033237.synonyms: detachment of visceral epithelial cells | podocyte detachment

HP_0033238.label: podocyte microvillous transformation
HP_0033238.definition: Cytoplasmic projections into the urinary space from the luminal side of the podocyte.

HP_0033239.label: visceral epithelial cell capping
HP_0033239.definition: Layer of hypertrophied visceral epithelial cells overlying a sclerosed segment of the tuft of the glomerulus.

HP_0033240.label: elevated rv / tlc ratio
HP_0033240.definition: An increase in the ratio of residual volume (RV) to total lung capacity (TLC) on pulmonary function testing. RV is the amount of air remaining aftermaximal expiration and TLC is the total amount of air in theungs at full inspiration. These volumes cannot be determined by spirometry, but can be measured by inert gas dilution, nitrogen washout, and (3) body plethysmography. An elevated RV/TLC can be interpreted as a sign of air trapping and hyperinflation.
HP_0033240.synonyms: hyperinflation on pulmonary function test | overinflation on pulmonary function test

HP_0033241.label: polyalveolar lobe
HP_0033241.definition: An elevation of the total count of alveoli as determined by microscopic point-counting of randomly taken lung sections, not secondary to abnormalities in number, size and structure of the airways. In polyaveolar lobe, the number of alveoli is generally increased three to fivefold.

HP_0033242.label: horseshoe lung
HP_0033242.definition: A horseshoe lung is an uncommon congenital abnormality caused by the partial fusion of the bases of both lungs behind the pericardial sac.

HP_0033243.label: pulmonary necrosis
HP_0033243.definition: Cellular death affecting one or more parts of the lung. Necrosis is caused by diverse external and internal factors which result in the unregulated digestion of cell components.
HP_0033243.UMLS synonyms: Pulmonary necrosis | Gangrenous or necrotic pneumonia | Observe for signs of late complications (e.g., consumption coagulopathy, renal failure, hypothermia, pulmonary edema, hyperkalemia, neurological sequelae, muscle necrosis, and reoccurrence of symptoms after treatment of initial episode)

HP_0033244.label: glycogen accumulation in pulmonary interstitial cells
HP_0033244.definition: Accumulation of immature interstitial cells containing abundant cytoplasmic glycogen defined by periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) positive cells.

HP_0033245.label: abnormal alveolar type ii pneumocyte morphology
HP_0033245.definition: Any structural abnormality of alveolar type 2 (ATII) cells.
HP_0033245.synonyms: abnormal alveolar epithelial type ii cell morphology | abnormal pulmonary type ii cell morphology | abnormal type ii pneumocyte morphology

HP_0033246.label: type ii pneumocyte hypertrophy
HP_0033246.definition: Increase in size of type II pneumocytes, characterized by qualitative morphologic alterations, including cuboidal shapes, increased nucleocytoplasmic ratio, enlarged nuclei, prominent nucleoli, and various alterations in their nuclear chromatin.
HP_0033246.synonyms: hypertrophic alveolar type ii cells | hypertrophic alveolar type ii pneumocytes

HP_0033247.label: pulmonary amyloidosis
HP_0033247.definition: Extracellular deposition in lung tissue of a proteinaceous material that, when stained with Congo red, demonstrates apple-green birefringence under polarized light and that has a distinct color when stained with sulfated Alcian blue. Viewed with electron microscopy, the amyloid deposits are seen to be composed of a beta-sheet fibrillar material. These nonbranching fibrils have a diameter of 7.5 to 10 nm and are the result of protein misfolding.
HP_0033247.UMLS synonyms: Pulmonary amyloidosis | PULMONARY AMYLOIDOSIS TRACHEOBRONCHIAL AND NODULAR PARENCHYMAL FORMS

HP_0033248.label: multiple pulmonary interstitial hyalinized nodules
HP_0033248.definition: Fibrosing nodules, consisting of either unilateral or bilateral central whorled deposits of lamellar collagen hyalin.

HP_0033249.label: focal substantia nigra t2 hyperintensity
HP_0033249.definition: Hyperintense lesion in the substantia nigra on magnetic resonance T2 imaging.
HP_0033249.synonyms: focal substantia nigra t2 hyperintense lesion

HP_0033250.label: nailfold capillary tortuosity
HP_0033250.definition: An increased number of turns of the blood vessels of the nailfold with a charactereistic winded or twisted appearance of the blood vessels.

HP_0033251.label: elevated residual volume
HP_0033251.definition: Increase in the amount of air remaining in a person's lungs after full exhalation.

HP_0033252.label: palmar hyperlinearity
HP_0033252.definition: Exaggerated skin markings (dermatoglyphics) on the palms of the hand.

HP_0033253.label: reduced circulating interferon gamma concentration
HP_0033253.definition: A reduction in the concentration of interferon gamma measured in the blood circulation.

HP_0033254.label: anorectal stricture
HP_0033254.definition: Narrowing of the anorectum associated with inflammation or scar tissue.

HP_0033255.label: congenital lobar overinflation
HP_0033255.definition: A congenital malformation characterized by an overdistended segment of lung, affecting an party of a lobe or the entire one. It results in progressive overinflation of one or more lobes.

HP_0033256.label: pancolitis
HP_0033256.UMLS synonyms: Ulcerative pancolitis | Pancolitis, macroscopic | Chronic ulcerative pancolitis | Acute ulcerative pancolitis | Ulcerative pancolitis in remission | ulcerative pancolitis with abscess | ulcerative pancolitis with complications | ulcerative pancolitis with fistula | ulcerative pancolitis without complications | chronic ulcerative pancolitis with complications | chronic ulcerative pancolitis without complications | ulcerative pancolitis with rectal bleeding | ulcerative pancolitis with intestinal obstruction | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with fistula | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with abscess | Complication due to chronic ulcerative pancolitis | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with rectal bleeding | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with other complication | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with intestinal obstruction | Ulcerative (chronic) pancolitis with unspecified complications | Rectal hemorrhage due to chronic ulcerative pancolitis | Intestinal obstruction due to chronic ulcerative pancolitis | Fistula of intestine due to chronic ulcerative pancolitis | Abscess of intestine co-occurrent and due to chronic ulcerative pancolitis

HP_0033257.label: delayed ability to walk with support
HP_0033257.definition: A failure to achieve the ability to walk with support (cruise) at an appropriate developmental stage.

HP_0033258.label: sudden unexpected death in epilepsy
HP_0033258.definition: Sudden unexpected death in epilepsy (SUDEP) is a sudden, unexpected, witnessed or unwitnessed, non-traumatic and non-drowning death, occurring in benign circumstances, in an individual with epilepsy, with or without evidence for a seizure and excluding documented status epilepticus, in which postmortem examination has not revealed a cause of death.

HP_0033259.label: non - motor seizure
HP_0033259.definition: A seizure with clinical manifestation but without motor signs (other than possible behavior arrest) as its initial clinical manifestation. The electrographic onset may be generalized, focal, or unknown.
HP_0033259.UMLS synonyms: Non-motor epileptic seizure | Neonatal focal non-motor electro-clinical epileptic seizure | motor partial seizure, non-intractable | Absence Epilepsy | Absence Seizures | Focal onset nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset aware nonmotor onset epileptic seizure | Focal onset impaired awareness nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0033260.label: livedo racemosa
HP_0033260.definition: Livedo racemosa describes a reddish-blue mottling of the skin in an irregular, reticular pattern. It differs from the more common livedo reticularis by its shape. Livedo racemosa consists of broken circular segments resulting in a seemingly larger pattern, as opposed to the fine, regular, complete network of livedo reticularis. Livedo racemosa results from permanent impairment of peripheral blood flow and, unlike livedo reticularis, it persists on warming.
HP_0033260.UMLS synonyms: Livedo Racemosa | Livedo Reticularis | Skin Diseases, Vascular | Sneddon Syndrome | Livedo racemosa (usually on trunk and/or lower extremities)

HP_0033261.label: renal artery aneurysm
HP_0033261.definition: Increase in diameter of a segment of the renal artery that can be defined as a focal, isolated dilatation of all three layers of the arterial wall over 1.5 times the diameter of the disease-free proximal adjacent arterial segment.
HP_0033261.UMLS synonyms: Aneurysm of renal artery | Congenital renal artery aneurysm | Acquired renal artery aneurysm | Aneurysm of right renal artery | Aneurysm of left renal artery | Dissecting aneurysm of renal artery | surgery for renal artery aneurysm | aneurysm of left inferior renal artery | aneurysm of right superior renal artery | aneurysm of right inferior renal artery | aneurysm of left superior renal artery | Operation on aneurysm of renal artery | Embolization of aneurysm of renal artery | Direct repair of renal artery aneurysm | Direct repair of ruptured renal artery aneurysm | Excision of renal artery aneurysm and anastomosis of artery | Repair of aneurysm with graft of renal artery | Repair of aneurysm without graft of renal artery | Excision of ruptured renal artery aneurysm and anastomosis of artery | Repair of renal artery aneurysm with bypass graft | surgery for dilated or occluded renal artery aneurysm | computed tomography of abdomen: aneurysm of right renal artery | computed tomography of abdomen: aneurysm of left renal artery | Repair of ruptured aneurysm with graft of renal artery | Excision of renal artery aneurysm and repair of artery using graft

HP_0033262.label: transphyseal fracture of the distal humerus
HP_0033262.definition: A fracture through the distal humeral physis that separates the entire distal humeral epiphysis from the metaphysis.

HP_0033263.label: absent platelet dense granules
HP_0033263.definition: Lack of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelles.

HP_0033264.label: enlarged platelet dense granules
HP_0033264.definition: Increased size of platelet dense granules.

HP_0033265.label: podocyte myelin figures
HP_0033265.definition: Lamellated intracytoplasmic lipid inclusions within podocytes.

HP_0033266.label: glomerular pseudocrescent
HP_0033266.definition: Visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia with resulting cellular crowding of the the urinary space. In contrast with true crescents, these proliferations lack inflammatory cells and fibrin. The cells are typically plump (not spindle-shaped) and often vacuolated, and Bowman's capsule is usually intact.

HP_0033267.label: abnormal glomerular capillary lumen morphology
HP_0033267.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the capillary of the renal glomerulus.

HP_0033268.label: deflation of the glomerular tuft
HP_0033268.definition: Wrinkling and folding of the capillaries without epithelial cell (podocyte) hyperplasia (formerly called ischemic type of collapse) involving o 80% of the glomerular tuft. The wrinkling is generally made by small regular folds of the glomerular basement membrane.

HP_0033269.label: glomerular capillary collapse
HP_0033269.definition: Collapse is generally accompanied by other descriptors such as hypertrophy and hyperplasia of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, halo, protein droplets in podocytes and glomerular parietal epithelial cells (PECs).

HP_0033270.label: glomerular capillary congestion
HP_0033270.definition: Global distention of glomerular capillaries with intraluminal intact red blood cells.

HP_0033271.label: glomerular capillary microaneurysm
HP_0033271.definition: Glomerular capillary dilatation due to loosening/detachment of the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) from its anchoring points, usually in the context of mesangiolysis or nodular glomerulosclerosis.

HP_0033272.label: abnormal glomerular endothelial cell morphology
HP_0033272.definition: An abnormal structure of the glomerular endothelial cells, which are highly specialized cells with fenestrae and a charged luminal glycocalyx layer that contribute to the filtration barrier.

HP_0033273.label: loss of glomerular endothelial cell fenestration
HP_0033273.definition: Loss of round to oval discontinuities normally present in the glomerular capillary endothelial cell cytoplasm.

HP_0033274.label: glomerular endotheliosis
HP_0033274.definition: Enlargement of glomerular endothelial cells by cytoplasmic swelling with resulting partial or complete occlusion of the lumen.

HP_0033275.label: glomerular endothelial tubuloreticular inclusion
HP_0033275.definition: Inter-anastomosing tubular structures located within cisternae of endoplasmic reticulum, most often within endothelial cells and associated with exposure to interferon.

HP_0033277.label: glomerular fibrinoid necrosis
HP_0033277.definition: Fibrin associated with glomerular basement membrane disruption and/or lysis of the mesangial matrix; this lesion does not require the presence of karyorrhexis.

HP_0033278.label: reduced cd95 - induced lymphocyte apoptosis
HP_0033278.definition: Reduced amount of programmed cell death in peripheral blood lymphocytes following exposure to CD95 (APO-1/Fas), which is a member of the death receptor family, a subfamily of the TNF-R superfamily. Crosslinking of CD95 with its natural ligand CD95L (CD178) or with agonistic antibodies such as anti-APO-1 induces apoptosis in sensitive cells.

HP_0033279.label: enterocutaneous fistula
HP_0033279.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the intra-abdominal intestinal tract and the skin.
HP_0033279.UMLS synonyms: Enterocutaneous Fistula | Radical repair of enterocutaneous fistula | Irritant contact dermatitis related to enterocutaneous fistula | x-ray series of small bowel: enterocutaneous fistula | Closure of intestinal cutaneous fistula

HP_0033280.label: paratracheal lymphadenopathy
HP_0033280.definition: Enlargement of lymph nodes surrounding the trachea.
HP_0033280.UMLS synonyms: Paratracheal lymphadenopathy | x-ray of chest: paratracheal mediastinal lymphadenopathy

HP_0033281.label: circulating nucleated red blood cells
HP_0033281.definition: The presence of nucleated red blood cells in the peripheral blood circulation.

HP_0033282.label: abnormal glomerular basement membrane morphology
HP_0033282.definition: Any abnormal sttructure of the glomerular basement membrane.

HP_0033283.label: segmentally thickened glomerular basement membrane
HP_0033283.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a segmental and increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.

HP_0033284.label: diffusely thickened glomerular basement membrane
HP_0033284.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an diffuse and relativly uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by EM. Thickening is measured from endothelial to visceral epithelial plasma membrane and mainly attributable to an increase in thickness of the lamina densa, generally to an overall thickness more than 2 standard deviations greater than that of the normal mean GBM thickness for health age- and sex matched individuals.

HP_0033285.label: thickened glomerular basement membranes with no electron dense deposits
HP_0033285.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting an increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with no evidence of electron dense deposits by electron microscopy.

HP_0033286.label: thickened glomerular basement membranes with electron dense deposits

HP_0033287.label: glomerular basement membrane lucencies
HP_0033287.definition: Lucent zones within the glomerular basement membranes. May reflect remote/resolved deposits.

HP_0033289.label: glomerular basement membrane wrinkling
HP_0033289.definition: Irregular folding of the glomerular basement membrane with an intact lamina densa.

HP_0033290.label: glomerular subendothelial widening
HP_0033290.definition: Expansion of the space between the glomerular endothelium and lamina densa by electron-lucent material.

HP_0033291.label: glomerular karyhorrhectic debris
HP_0033291.definition: Apoptotic, pyknotic, and fragmented nuclei within the glomerulus.

HP_0033292.label: glomerular fibrin thrombus
HP_0033292.definition: An aggregate of coagulated blood containing fibrin, with or without entrapped cellular elements, within a glomerular capillary lumen.

HP_0033293.label: glomerular hyaline pseudothrombus
HP_0033293.definition: Intracapillary amorphous, eosinophilic material consisting of immune deposits.

HP_0033294.label: glomerular lipoprotein thrombus
HP_0033294.definition: Intracapillary silver-positive material that is finely vacuolated and laminated, and stains with oil red O on frozen sections.

HP_0033295.label: mesangial immune complex deposition
HP_0033295.definition: Extracellular meangial accumulation of finely granular material corresponding to immunoglobulin and/or complement by immunofluorescence/immunohistochemistry; most typically electron-dense although this may decrease with resorption of the deposit.

HP_0033296.label: binucleated visceral epithelial cells
HP_0033296.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with 2 nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.

HP_0033297.label: multinucleated visceral epithelial cells
HP_0033297.definition: Visceral epithelial cells with more than two nuclei. Can be observed on light or ultrastructral microscopy.

HP_0033298.label: abnormal circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration
HP_0033298.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration in blood of factor H-related protein 1 (FHR-1)

HP_0033299.label: reduced circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration
HP_0033299.definition: Decreased level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation.

HP_0033300.label: increased circulating complement factor h related protein 1 concentration
HP_0033300.definition: Elevated level of circulating complement factor H related protein 1 concentration in the blood circulation.

HP_0033301.label: elevated circulating 1 - methylhistidine concentration
HP_0033301.definition: An abnormally increased level of 1-methylhistidine in the blood circulation. 1-methylhistidine is a derivative of L-histidine.

HP_0033302.label: elevated circulating 4 - hydroxyphenylacetic acid concentration
HP_0033302.definition: The concentration of 4-Hydroxyphenylacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033303.label: elevated urinary monocarboxylic acid level
HP_0033303.definition: Abnormally increased amount of a monocarboxylic acid in the urine. Monocarboxylic acids are molecules with one COOH functional group.

HP_0033304.label: obsolete elevated urine 4 - hydroxyphenylacetic acid level

HP_0033305.label: abnormal circulating fetuin a concentration
HP_0033305.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of fetuin A in the blood circulation.

HP_0033306.label: decreased circulating fetuin a concentration
HP_0033306.definition: A reduction below normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation.

HP_0033307.label: increased circulating fetuin a concentration
HP_0033307.definition: An elevation above normal of fetuin A in the blood circulation.

HP_0033309.label: ileoileal intussusception
HP_0033309.definition: A type of intussusception of the small intestine in which one part of the ileum invaginates (telescopes) into another part of the ileum.

HP_0033310.label: osmotic diarrhea
HP_0033310.definition: Osmotic diarrhea results from the presence of osmotically active, poorly absorbed solutes in the bowel lumen that inhibit normal water and electrolyte absorption.

HP_0033311.label: abdominal aortic dissection
HP_0033311.definition: A tear in the intimal layer of the abdominal aorta causing a separation between the intima and the medial layers.

HP_0033312.label: abnormal bowman space morphology
HP_0033312.definition: Structural anomaly located in Bowman's space, which represents the beginning of the urinary space and is contiguous with the proximal convoluted tubule of the nephron.

HP_0033313.label: urinary space collagenization
HP_0033313.definition: Acellular collagenous matrix within Bowman's space, not associated with extracapillary hypercellularity or necrosis, associated with sclerosis or deflation of the tuft.

HP_0033314.label: visceral epithelial cell hyperplasia
HP_0033314.definition: Increased number of visceral epithelial cells (2 or more layers), often with crowding and multilayering, but without continuity with the parietal epithelium.
HP_0033314.synonyms: hyperplasia of visceral epithelial cells | podocyte hyperplasia

HP_0033315.label: visceral epithelial hyaline droplets
HP_0033315.definition: Round to ovoid, Periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, fuchsinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions within visceral epithelial cells.

HP_0033316.label: glomerular crescent formation
HP_0033316.definition: Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin.

HP_0033317.label: cellular crescent
HP_0033317.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of greater than two cell layers and involving more than 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of greater than 75% cells with or without fibrin, and less than 25% fibrous matrix.

HP_0033318.label: fibrocellular crescent
HP_0033318.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary hypercellularity of more than 2 cell layers and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference, composed of 25% to 75% cells with or without fibrin, and the remainder fibrous matrix.

HP_0033319.label: fibrous crescent
HP_0033319.definition: A type of glomerular crescent characterized by extracapillary fibrosis composed of greater than 75% matrix and of less than 25% cells with or without fibrin, usually associated with disruption of Bowman's capsule and involving over 10% of the capsular circumference.

HP_0033320.label: mesangial cell loss
HP_0033320.definition: Loss of mesangial cells segmentally or globally.

HP_0033321.label: glomerular obsolescence
HP_0033321.definition: Globally sclerotic glomeruli are that are small and without hyalinosis and may appear with collapse of the tuft with collagenization of the urinary space. Bowman's capsule is completely or partially absent and there is no periglomerular fibrosis and glomerular size is decreased by more than 50% compared to all other glomeruli in the same biopsy. Obsolescent glomeruli may appear to be receding into the interstitium.

HP_0033322.label: glomerular capillary wall duplication without cellular interposition
HP_0033322.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix, with or without endocapillary hypercellularity and no evidence of interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.

HP_0033323.label: glomerular capillary wall duplication with cellular interposition
HP_0033323.definition: Double contouring of the original glomerular basement membrane (GBM)/additional layer(s) of overlying basement membrane matrix with interposed migrated cells (mesangial, endothelial, monocytes) between the layers of original GBM and de novo GBM.

HP_0033324.label: elevated circulating homovanillic acid concentration
HP_0033324.definition: The concentration of homovanillic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033325.label: elevated circulating sebacic acid concentration
HP_0033325.definition: Increased concentration of sebacic acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0033326.label: elevated circulating hydroxyphenlyllactic acid concentration
HP_0033326.definition: An increased concentration of 4-hydroxyphenlyllactic acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0033327.label: nail psoriasis
HP_0033327.definition: Psoriatic nail abnormality characterized by the presence of neutrophils in the nail bed epithelium, hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, presence of exudates on the corneal epithelium, focal hypogranulosis and psoriasiform hyperplasia of the nail bed.
HP_0033327.UMLS synonyms: Psoriasis of nail | Do you have nail psoriasis | Do you have nail psoriasis:Find:Pt:^Patient:Ord:PhenX | Psoriatic nail hypertrophy | Psoriasis, skin or nails

HP_0033328.label: type ii pneumocyte hyperplasia
HP_0033328.definition: Increase in the number of type II pneumocytes.

HP_0033329.label: abnormal postural reflex
HP_0033329.definition: Anomaly of the physiological response to maintain the body's posture when movement and position is altered.

HP_0033330.label: impaired neck - righting reflex
HP_0033330.definition: Abnormal neck-righting response, which is said to be a physiological response when a child is placed flat on his or her back and the head is turned 90 degrees to the right or the left. With a normal neck-righting response, there follows a reflected torsion of the vertebral column in the same direction as the induced rotation of the neck. That is, the whole body follows the direction in which the head was turned. The response is present from birth to the age of five years.

HP_0033331.label: acute phase response
HP_0033331.definition: Presence of one or more manifestations of the acute phase response. Acute phase proteins (APP) are blood proteins primarily synthesized by hepatocytes as part of the acute phase response (APR). The APR is part of the early-defense or innate immune system, which is triggered by different stimuli including trauma, infection, stress, neoplasia, and inflammation. The APR results in a complex systemic reaction with the goal of reestablishing homeostasis and promoting healing.
