HP_0033332.label: elevated circulating amyloid a
HP_0033332.definition: An increased concentration of serum amyloid A in the blood circulation.

HP_0033333.label: jaw contracture
HP_0033333.definition: Limitation of motion of the jaw due to structural changes in a muscle such as the massseter responsible for jaw movement.
HP_0033333.UMLS synonyms: Limited mouth opening due to jaw contractures | Arthrogryposis, distal, type 2E

HP_0033334.label: abnormal embryonic development
HP_0033334.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo, that is, of the early developmental stage of development that follows the fertilization of an egg by sperm.

HP_0033335.label: abnormal preimplantation embryonic development
HP_0033335.definition: An anomaly in the development of the embryo in a stage prior to implantation.

HP_0033336.label: zygotic cleavage failure
HP_0033336.definition: Failure of a fertilized oocyte to undergo the first round of cell division.

HP_0033337.label: abnormal gametogenesis
HP_0033337.definition: An anomaly in the process by a a haploid cell is formed from a diploid cells through meiosis. In males, diploid spermatogonia produce two haploid cells (secondary spermatocytes) in meiosis I and four haploid spermatids in meiosis II. In females, primordial germ cells under meiosis II before birth to form primary oocytes. Once puberty cell begins, these cells form secondary oocytes through meiosis II.

HP_0033339.label: increased circulating inosine concentration
HP_0033339.definition: An increased concentration of inosine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033340.label: increased circulating guanosine concentration
HP_0033340.definition: Increased concentration of guanosine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033341.label: elevated circulating sitosterol concentration
HP_0033341.definition: An increased concentration of beta-sitosterol in the blood circulation.

HP_0033342.label: anti - aquaporin 4 antibody positivity
HP_0033342.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against aquaporin-4.

HP_0033343.label: mucoid diarrhea
HP_0033343.definition: Passage of an increased number of stools containing mucus, a thick fluid substance secreted by mucous membranes.

HP_0033344.label: pleural cobblestoning
HP_0033344.definition: A pleural cobblestone appearance characterized by irregular bumps surrounded by depressed lines in open lung biopsy. Caused by underlying scarring causing retraction of the interlobular septa where they insert on the pleura.

HP_0033345.label: neuralgia
HP_0033345.definition: Pain (An unpleasant sensory and emotional experience) along the course of a nerve.
HP_0033345.UMLS synonyms: Neuralgia | Trigeminal Neuralgia | Postherpetic neuralgia | Glossopharyngeal Neuralgia | Facial Neuralgia | Sphenopalatine Neuralgia | Cervico-occipital neuralgia | Neuralgia, Atypical | Cranial neuralgia | Neuralgia, Supraorbital | Pudendal Neuralgia | Peripheral neuralgia | Brachial Neuralgia | Hypoglossal Neuralgia | Intercostal neuralgia | Neuralgia, Vidian | Neuralgia, Stump | Cervico-Brachial Neuralgia | Neuralgia, Perineal | Hallucinatory neuralgia | Reminiscent neuralgia | Nasociliary neuralgia | Postinfectious neuralgia | Femoral neuralgia | Ischial neuralgia

HP_0033346.label: psychic epileptic aura
HP_0033346.definition: Aura with affective, mnemonic or composite perceptual phenomena including illusory or composite hallucinatory events.

HP_0033347.label: cognitive epileptic aura
HP_0033347.definition: A purely subjective manifestation of an epileptic seizure pertaining to altered cognition.

HP_0033348.label: epileptic aura
HP_0033348.definition: An epileptic aura is a purely subjective clinical manifestation of an epileptic seizure. If an epileptic aura is not followed by loss of awareness or propagation to a bilateral tonic-clonic seizure then it is a type of focal aware non-motor seizure.
HP_0033348.UMLS synonyms: Epileptic aura | Focal onset nonmotor onset epileptic seizure

HP_0033349.label: seizure cluster
HP_0033349.definition: A fourfold or greater increase of usual seizure frequency within a 3-day period, where the patient demonstrates full recovery between seizure events within the cluster. The seizure cluster should be recognisable by the primary clinician, carer or patient.
HP_0033349.synonyms: acute repetitive seizures | crescendo seizures | cyclical seizures | recurrent seizures | seizure flurries | serial seizures
HP_0033349.UMLS synonyms: Acute repetitive seizure | Seizures occur in clusters | Seizures, nocturnal, usually occur in clusters | Seizures occur in clusters over 1 or several days | Motor seizures, nocturnal, usually occur in clusters (up to 8 per night) during dozing or on awakening

HP_0033350.label: elevated forced expiratory volume in one second
HP_0033350.definition: An increase in the amount of air a person can forcefully expel in one second, compared to some standard or previous measure of same subject.

HP_0033351.label: candida esophagitis
HP_0033351.definition: Candida infections of the esophagus are considered opportunistic infections and are seen most commonly in immunosuppressed patients, the most common symptoms being dysphagia, odynophagia, and retrosternal pain.
HP_0033351.UMLS synonyms: Candidiasis of the esophagus | ESOPHAGITIS CANDIDA TREATED

HP_0033352.label: pulmonary hypertensive crisis
HP_0033352.definition: Pulmonary hypertensive crisis involves sudden and potentially lethal increases in PAP and PVR that cause acute rise in right atrial and right ventricular end-diastolic pressure accompanied by low cardiac output.

HP_0033353.label: abnormal blood vessel morphology
HP_0033353.definition: Any structural anomaly of a blood vessel (artery, arteriole, capillary, venule, or vein).
HP_0033353.UMLS synonyms: Blood Vessel Tumors | Blood vessel hyperplasia | Malignant Blood Vessel Neoplasm | Benign neoplasm of blood vessel | Malignant blood vessel neoplasm, metastatic | Neoplasm of uncertain behavior of blood vessel

HP_0033354.label: abnormal urine metabolite level
HP_0033354.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of a metabolite in urine.

HP_0033355.label: increased urine deoxypyridinoline level
HP_0033355.definition: An increased level of deoxypyridinoline in the urine. Deoxypyridinoline is a crosslink product of collagen molecules found in bone and excreted in urine during bone degradation, has been described as a marker of bone turnover.

HP_0033356.label: elevated circulating o - phosphoserine concentration
HP_0033356.definition: An abnormally increased level of o-phosphoserine in the blood circulation. o-phosphoserine is a derivative of serine.

HP_0033357.label: limited head rotation
HP_0033357.definition: Reduced range of motion turning the head side to side.

HP_0033358.label: abnormal urine osmolality
HP_0033358.definition: A deviation from the normal range of concentration of particles in urine.

HP_0033359.label: hyperosthenuria
HP_0033359.definition: An abnormally high urinary specific gravity, i.e., increased concentration of solutes in the urine.
HP_0033359.synonyms: elevated urine osmolality | elevated urine osmolarity

HP_0033360.label: impaired ability to shift attention
HP_0033360.definition: A behavioral abnormality whereby a person is unable to move freely from one situation, activity or aspect of aa problem to another as circumstances demand. Key aspects of shifting include the ability to make transitions, problem solve flexibly, switch or alternate attention, and change focus from one mind-set or topic to another. Mild deficits in the ability to shift compromise the efficiency of problem solving, whereas more severe difficulties are reflected in perseverative behaviors. Sometimes this is described as being rigid or inflexible.

HP_0033361.label: nasal ulcer
HP_0033361.definition: An open sore of the nasal mucosa.
HP_0033361.UMLS synonyms: Ulcer of nose | Ulcer of nasal septum | Nasal mucosal ulcer | varicose; ulcer, nasal septum | Ulcer of nasal turbinate | Ulcer of nasal planum | nasal varices with ulcer | ulcer; nasal (cavity), varicose (bleeding) | Ulcerated nasal mucosa | Varicose veins of nasal septum with ulcer | NASAL SINUS ULCERATION | Ulcerative rhinitis | Classical histoplasmosis nasal ulceration | Oral/nasal mucosal ulcers | Trigeminal trophic syndrome

HP_0033362.label: recurrent coughing spasms
HP_0033362.definition: Repeated occurrence of episodes of coughing, with each episode consisting of at least five minutes of continuous coughing.

HP_0033363.label: hyaline membranes
HP_0033363.definition: Hyaline membranes are homogeneous eosinophilic material composed of cellular debris, plasma proteins, and surfactant plastered against alveolar ducts and alveolar walls. The hyaline membranes are deposited along the walls of the alveoli, where gas exchange typically occurs, thereby making gas exchange difficult.
HP_0033363.UMLS synonyms: Hyaline membrane | Absence of hyaline membranes | Fibrin-rich alveolar deposits, 'hyaline membranes' | Hyaline Membrane Disease | Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Newborn | Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Adult | Hyaline Membrane Syndrome | Hyaline dystrophy of Bruch's membrane | hyaline; disease, membrane (lung) (newborn) | disease (or disorder); hyaline membrane, adult | Respiratory Distress Syndrome In Premature Infants

HP_0033364.label: lipoid pneumonia
HP_0033364.definition: A specific form of lung inflammation that results from accumulation of lipids in the alveoli. Lipoid pneumonia can be either exogenous or endogenous in cause based on the source of the lipid.
HP_0033364.UMLS synonyms: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia | Pneumonia, Lipid | Endogenous Lipid Pneumonia | Chronic exogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Acute endogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Acute exogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Chronic endogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Lipoid pneumonitis due to vaping | pneumonia; bronchopneumonia, lipids, lipoids | pneumonia; bronchopneumonia, lipids, lipoids, endogenous

HP_0033365.label: endogenous lipoid pneumonia
HP_0033365.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is the body itself. When an airway is obstructed, it is often the case that distal to the obstruction, lipid-laden macrophages and giant cells fill the lumen of the disconnected airspace.
HP_0033365.UMLS synonyms: Endogenous Lipid Pneumonia | Acute endogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Chronic endogenous lipoid pneumonitis | pneumonia; bronchopneumonia, lipids, lipoids, endogenous

HP_0033366.label: exogenous lipoid pneumonia
HP_0033366.definition: A type of lipoid pneumonia in which the source of the lipids is external to the body.
HP_0033366.UMLS synonyms: Exogenous lipoid pneumonia | Pneumonia, Lipid | Chronic exogenous lipoid pneumonitis | Acute exogenous lipoid pneumonitis

HP_0033367.label: orthodeoxia
HP_0033367.definition: Low level of blood oxygen induced by changing from a recumbent to an upright position.

HP_0033368.label: platypnea
HP_0033368.definition: A type of dyspnea that occurs when the affected person changes from a recumbent to an upright position.

HP_0033369.label: cavitating leukodystrophy
HP_0033369.definition: A type of leukodystrophy characterized by multiple small cavitations typically in the periventricular and deep cerebral white matter. The cavitations are visible as a central cavity with cerebrospinal fluid-like signal intensity.
HP_0033369.UMLS synonyms: Dalmatian leukodystrophy | Cavitating leukodystrophy, posterior regions, seen on brain imaging | Non-progressive predominantly posterior cavitating leukodystrophy with peripheral neuropathy

HP_0033370.label: bronchial telangiectasia
HP_0033370.definition: Telangiectasias (small dilated blood vessels located near the surface of the skin or mucous membranes) located in the trachoebronchial system.
HP_0033370.UMLS synonyms: bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left lower lobe superior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left anteromedial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left main bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left superior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left posterior basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left upper lobe anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left upper lobe anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left main bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left anteromedial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of left lateral basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of right main bronchus | bronchoscopy circumferential telangiectasia of left lower lobe superior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of superior aspect of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of inferior aspect of left upper lobe anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of posterior aspect of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of inferior aspect of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of anterior aspect of left superior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of lateral aspect of left anteromedial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of anterior aspect of left main bronchus | bronchoscopy telangiectasia of posterior aspect of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus

HP_0033371.label: bronchocentric granulomatosis
HP_0033371.definition: Granulomatous inflammation that surrounds the bronchi and bronchioles, replacing bronchial walls and mucosa. In bronchocentric granulomatosis, the lumen of the airway contains necrotic debris, and palisaded histiocytes surround the lumen.

HP_0033372.label: abnormal kco
HP_0033372.definition: Any deviation from the normal range of KCO. The KCO is a measurement of the rate constant for alveolar uptake of CO during breath-holding in the single breath measurement of DLCO at full inflation. The DLCO is derived as the product of the KCO and the single breath alveolar volume (VA) divided by PB-PH2O.

HP_0033373.label: increased kco
HP_0033373.definition: Increased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).

HP_0033374.label: decreased kco
HP_0033374.definition: Decreased diffusion capacity of the lung for carbon monoxide (CO) rate constant (efficiency index).

HP_0033375.label: anthracosis
HP_0033375.definition: Anthracosis is the deposition of black carbon pigment. It is commonly seen in perihilar lymph nodes as well as within lung parenchyma. There can be prominent storiforming (i.e., spiral patterning) of histiocytes, to such an extent as to mimic a neoplastic lesion histologically. Anthracosis is a common finding in smokers and polluted city dwellers.
HP_0033375.UMLS synonyms: Anthracosis | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of mid trachea | diagnostic bronchoscopy: anthracosis of mucosal surface of carina | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left main bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right main bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left superior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right apical segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left anteromedial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left lateral basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left posterior basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right medial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right anterior basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right posterior basal segment bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left lower lobe superior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of left upper lobe anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right lower lobe superior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right middle lobe lateral segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right upper lobe anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy anthracosis of mucosal surface of right middle lobe medial segmental bronchus

HP_0033376.label: alveolar septal thickening
HP_0033376.definition: Increased width of the alveolar septum, which is the structure that separates neighboring alveoli. This finding can be appreciated on histology.

HP_0033377.label: increased airway neuroendocrine cells
HP_0033377.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cells (NECs) within distal airways. There are no formal criteria for an increase (which is also dependend on the sensitivity of the staining method), findings of neuroendocrine cells in at least 70% of bronchioles by lung biopsy and at least 10% NECs in an individual airway are consistent with the diagnosis of Neuroendocrine cell hyperplasia of infancy in the appropriate clinical setting. Increases are also seen in other clicnial settings. Neuroendocrine neoplasms of the lung encompass NE tumors (NETs), which split into typical and atypical carcinoids, and NE carcinomas (NECs).

HP_0033378.label: increased airway neuroepithelial bodies
HP_0033378.definition: Presence of increased numbers of bombesin-immuno-positive neuroendocrine cell cluster (neuroepithelial bodies) in the alveolar ducts.

HP_0033379.label: bilateral superior vena cava
HP_0033379.definition: The presence of a left and a right superior vena cava.
HP_0033379.UMLS synonyms: Bilateral Superior Vena Cava | echocardiography: bilateral superior vena cava | cardiac catheterization situs bilateral superior vena cava veins

HP_0033380.label: nasal chondritis
HP_0033380.definition: Inflammation of the cartilage of the nose.

HP_0033381.label: elevated circulating stearoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033381.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of O-stearoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033382.label: elevated circulating palmitoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033382.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of palmitoylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033383.label: decreased compound muscle action potential amplitude
HP_0033383.definition: Reduced level of the compound muscle action potential (CMAP), which is recorded following electrical stimulation of a nerve from surface electrodes overlying a muscle supplied by that nerve.

HP_0033384.label: elevated urinary collagen degradation products
HP_0033384.definition: Increased level in the urine of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.

HP_0033385.label: elevated urine pyridinoline level
HP_0033385.definition: An increased amount of pyridinoline in the urine.

HP_0033386.label: abnormal circulating collagen degradation product concentration
HP_0033386.definition: Abnormal concentration in the blood circulation of a metabolite that results from collagen degradation, e.g., a fragment of a collagen produced by a collagenase or serine protease.

HP_0033387.label: elevated circulating pyridinoline concentration
HP_0033387.definition: An increased concentration of hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (pyridinoline) in the blood circulation.

HP_0033388.label: abnormal bronchial artery morphology
HP_0033388.definition: Any structural abnormality of a bronchial artery.

HP_0033389.label: bronchopulmonary anastomosis
HP_0033389.definition: Abnormal arterial anastomosis (connection) between bronchial and pulmonary arteries.

HP_0033390.label: bronchial artery dilatation
HP_0033390.definition: Increased caliber of a bronchial artery, which can be defined as a bronchial artery diameter that exceeds 2 mm.
HP_0033390.synonyms: bronchial artery enlargement | dilatation of a bronchial artery

HP_0033391.label: bronchial artery hypertrophy
HP_0033391.definition: Increase in the volume of bronchial artery wall due to the enlargement of its component cells.

HP_0033392.label: perivascular pre - capillary pulmonary artery inflammation
HP_0033392.definition: Inflammatory cell infiltration surrounding precapillary pulmonary arteries (arterioles; 20-70 micrometer).
HP_0033392.synonyms: perivascular inflammation of arterioles in the pulmonary circulation | perivascular inflammation of pre - capillary pulmonary arteries

HP_0033393.label: irregularly shaped sperm tail
HP_0033393.definition: Irregular or changing caliber (diameter) along the tail of the sperm.
HP_0033393.synonyms: sperm flagella with irregular caliber | sperm flagella with irregular calibre

HP_0033394.label: anti - carbonic anhydrase ii antibody positivity
HP_0033394.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against carbonic anhydrase II.

HP_0033395.label: antilactoferrin antibody positivity
HP_0033395.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against lactoferrin.

HP_0033396.label: glomerular extracapillary fibrin
HP_0033396.definition: Presence of ropey, eosinophilic material (brght red on Trichrome staining) consistent with extracapillary fibrin outside of capillary lumina.

HP_0033397.label: bowman - space proteinaceous debris
HP_0033397.definition: The presence of eosinophilic Periodic Acid Schiff (PAS)-positive cell free, protein-derived material occupying Bowman's space.

HP_0033398.label: pleural plaque
HP_0033398.definition: Deposits of hyalinized collagen fibres in the parietal pleura (preferentially pleura adjacent to ribs, particularly the sixth through ninth ribs).
HP_0033398.UMLS synonyms: Pleural plaque | Asbestos-induced pleural plaque | Pleural plaque without asbestos | PLEURAL BASED PLAQUE | x-ray of chest: pleural thickening with plaques

HP_0033399.label: persistent fever
HP_0033399.definition: Fever that persists longer than expected for an acute infectious disease. No precise threshold exists, and the clinical interpretation of fever is context-dependent, but as a rule of thumb, this term refers to fever that persists longer than 2-3 weeks.
HP_0033399.UMLS synonyms: Fever, Familial Lifelong Persistent | Unexplained long-lasting fever/inflammatory syndrome | Instruct on signs and symptoms of infection (e.g., fever, chills or sweats, persistent cough, sore throat, difficulty breathing, any new pain, vomiting, diarrhea, bloody urine, skin rash, redness or swelling at IV site) | Monitor for signs of decreased venous circulation in affected extremity (e.g., increased extremity circumference; painful swelling and tenderness; pain worsening in dependent position; pain persisting with extremity use; palpable hard vein; enlargement of the superficial veins; severe cramping; redness and warmth; numbness and tingling; discoloration of skin; fever)

HP_0033400.label: acute abdomen
HP_0033400.definition: A sudden onset of abdominal pain with associated nausea or vomiting. The acute abdomen may be caused by an infection, inflammation, vascular occlusion, or obstruction.
HP_0033400.UMLS synonyms: Abdomen, Acute | Abdomen mimicking acute | Acute abdomen in children | Radiologic examination of abdomen, complete acute abdomen series | Acute abdominal pain | x-ray series for acute abdomen | ABDOMEN LUQ PAIN ACUTE | Radiologic examination, complete acute abdomen series, including 2 or more views of the abdomen (eg, supine, erect, decubitus), and a single view chest | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine and decubitus views, and single chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine and erect views, and anteroposterior chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine and erect views, and single chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, erect and decubitus views, and anteroposterior chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, erect and decubitus views, and single chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine and decubitus views, and anteroposterior chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine, erect, and decubitus views, and anteroposterior chest view | Complete acute abdomen x-ray series, supine, erect, and decubitus views, and single chest view

HP_0033401.label: tissue ischemia
HP_0033401.definition: Ischemia is defined as a restriction of arterial blood supply to a tissue associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolis requirements of the tissue. Depending on the involved tissues, clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis. Additional associated manifestations include hemodynamic parameters (reduced blood pressure distal to the site of restricted arterial supply) and angiographic evidence of arterial occclusion.

HP_0033402.label: digital ischemia
HP_0033402.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to a digit (finger or toe) associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the digit. Clinical manifestations may include pain, pallor, lack of pulse, coldness, paresthesia, and paralysis.

HP_0033403.label: testicular ischemia
HP_0033403.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to a testis associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Clinical manifestations may include pain and swelling of the affected testis.

HP_0033404.label: intestinal ischemia
HP_0033404.definition: Restriction of arterial blood supply to the intestine associated with insufficient oxygenation to support the metabolic requirements of the tissue. Acute intestinal ischemia can involve the small or large intestine, and usually presents with sudden severe non-specific abdominal pain.
HP_0033404.UMLS synonyms: Vascular insufficiency of intestine | Gastrointestinal tract vascular insufficiency | Acute vascular insufficiency of intestine (disorder) | Chronic mesenteric ischemia | Acute intestinal ischemia due to obstruction of vasculature of intestine | acute ischemia of intestine | diffuse acute ischemia of intestine | focal acute ischemia of intestine | acute ischemia of small intestine | acute ischemia of large intestine | diffuse acute ischemia of large intestine | focal acute ischemia of large intestine | diffuse acute ischemia of small intestine | focal acute ischemia of small intestine | Focal segmental ischemia of small intestine | Acute (reversible) ischemia of small intestine | Acute (reversible) ischemia of large intestine | Ischemic enteritis of intestine | Diffuse acute (reversible) ischemia of small intestine | Diffuse acute (reversible) ischemia of large intestine | Acute (reversible) ischemia of intestine, part unspecified | Diffuse acute (reversible) ischemia of intestine, part unspecified | Acute (reversible) ischemia of small intestine, extent unspecified | Focal (segmental) acute (reversible) ischemia of large intestine | Focal (segmental) acute (reversible) ischemia of small intestine

HP_0033405.label: abnormal circulating organic amino compound concentration
HP_0033405.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of an organic amino compound, defined as a compound formally derived from ammonia by replacing one, two or three hydrogen atoms by organyl groups.

HP_0033406.label: elevated circulating o - phosphoethanolamine concentration
HP_0033406.definition: An increased concentration of o-phosphoethanolamine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033407.label: elevated urine acetoacetic acid level
HP_0033407.definition: Elevated amount of acetoacetic acid in the urine.

HP_0033408.label: elevated circulating acetoacetic acid concentration
HP_0033408.definition: An increased level of acetoacetic acid in the blood circulation. Acetoacetic acid is one of the predominant ketone bodies.

HP_0033409.label: elevated urinary 2 - hydroxybutyric acid
HP_0033409.definition: An increased amount of 2-hydroxybutyric acid in the urine.

HP_0033410.label: elevated circulating cartilage oligomeric matrix protein concentration
HP_0033410.definition: An increased blood concentration of cartilage oligomeric matrix protein (COMP).

HP_0033411.label: lower extremity akinesia
HP_0033411.definition: Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the lower extremities.

HP_0033412.label: upper extremity akinesia
HP_0033412.definition: Inability to initiate changes in activity or movement and to perform ordinary volitional movements rapidly and easily in the upper extremities.

HP_0033413.label: upper extremity hypokinesia
HP_0033413.definition: Abnormally diminished movement of the upper extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency.

HP_0033414.label: lower extremity hypokinesia
HP_0033414.definition: Abnormally diminished movement of the lower extremities. In contrast to paralysis, hypokinesia is not characterized by a lack of motor strength, but rather by a poverty of movement. The typical habitual movements (e.g., folding the arms, crossing the legs) are reduced in frequency.

HP_0033415.label: cardiac tamponade
HP_0033415.definition: The accumulation of pericardial fluid with subsequent compression of all cardiac chambers which prevents cardiac filling.
HP_0033415.UMLS synonyms: Cardiac Tamponade | Postoperative cardiac tamponade | Hemorrhagic cardiac tamponade | Decompression of cardiac tamponade | Open decompression of cardiac tamponade | Closed decompression of cardiac tamponade | cardiac catheterization in-lab complications: cardiac tamponade | cardiac catheterization perforation of heart with resulting cardiac tamponade | cardiac catheterization out-of-lab postprocedural complication: cardiac tamponade | Follow protocol for care of the patient experiencing cardiac tamponade. | Patients with cardiac tamponade and/or pericardiocentesis occurring within 30 days | Patients without cardiac tamponade and/or pericardiocentesis occurring within 30 days | Re-exploration required due to mediastinal bleeding with or without tamponade, graft occlusion, valve dysfunction or other cardiac reason | Re-exploration not required due to mediastinal bleeding with or without tamponade, graft occlusion, valve dysfunction or other cardiac reason | Monitor for potential complications associated with pacemaker insertion (e.g., pneumothorax, hemothorax, myocardial perforation, cardiac tamponade, hematoma, PVCs, infections, hiccups, muscle twitches) | Monitor for potential complications associated with defibrillator insertion (e.g., pneumothorax, hemothorax, myocardial perforation, cardiac tamponade, hematoma, PVCs, infections, hiccups, muscle twitches) | Monitor for complications (e.g., pneumothorax, cardiac tamponade, arterial puncture, hemorrhage, hemothorax, hydro-thorax, air embolus, brachial nerve plexus injury, thoracic duct injury, infection, misplacement) | Ensure that special resuscitation protocols (e.g., asthma, anaphylaxis, pregnancy, morbid obesity, pulmonary embolism, electrolyte imbalance, ingestion of toxic substances, trauma, accidental hypothermia, avalanche, drowning, electric shock or lightning strikes, percutaneous coronary interventions, cardiac tamponade, cardiac surgery) are instituted, when appropriate

HP_0033416.label: hip adductor weakness
HP_0033416.definition: Reduced ability to bring the leg toward the midline of the body.

HP_0033417.label: elevated circulating hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP_0033417.definition: An increased concentration in the blood circulation of a hydroxybutyric acid, that is, of a compound comprising a butyric acid core carrying at least one hydroxy substituent.

HP_0033418.label: elevated circulating 2 - hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP_0033418.definition: Elevation of the 2-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range.

HP_0033419.label: elevated circulating 3 - hydroxybutyric acid concentration
HP_0033419.definition: Elevation of the 3-hydroxybutyric acid concentration in the blood above the normal range.

HP_0033420.label: pulmonary arterial plexiform lesion
HP_0033420.definition: Focal proliferation of pulmonary artery endothelial cells, leading to the formation of complex capillary-like channels.

HP_0033421.label: pulmonary artery intimal thickening
HP_0033421.definition: Increased thickness of the intimal layer of the pulmonary artery. Throughout the pulmonary arterial tree, the thin intima consists of a non-fenestrated monolayer of endothelial cells lining the vessel lumen, as well as a sub-endothelial interstitium that extends to the internal elastic lamina. Intimal thickness in human lung ranges from 1-16% of total wall thickness. Pulmonary artery intimal thickening can be defined as a relative intima thickness to the thickness of the vessel wall of over 10%.

HP_0033422.label: pulmonary artery adventitial fibrosis
HP_0033422.definition: Increased amount of collagen, proteoglycans, and other extracellular matrix proteins resulting in scarring and thickening in the adventia of the pulmonary arterial tree.

HP_0033423.label: pulmonary arterial hypertension with positive acute response to no challenge
HP_0033423.definition: A form of pulmonary arterial hypertension in which there is a reduction of mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP) at leasy 10 mmHg to reach an absolute value of mPAP not more than 40 mmHg with an increased or unchanged cardiac output (CO) in response to inhaled nitric oxide at 10-20 ppm.

HP_0033424.label: pulmonary arterial hypertension with lack of acute response to no challenge
HP_0033424.definition: A form of pulmonary arterial hypertension with lack of adequate hemodynamic response to NO challenge (adequate response is defined as a reduction of mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP) of at least 10 mmHg to reach an absolute value of mPAP 40 mmHg or less with an increased or unchanged cardiac output (CO) in response to inhaled nitric oxide at 10-20 ppm).

HP_0033425.label: periungual erythema
HP_0033425.definition: Erythema (redness of the skin caused by hyperemia in superficial capillaries) in the region surrounding a fingernail or toe nail.

HP_0033426.label: pulmonary air embolism
HP_0033426.definition: Venous air embolism is a consequence of air being introduced into the venous circulation, and subsequently to the right heart, and pulmonary circulation. When small amounts of air reach pulmonary circulation they can be removed by gas diffusion across the arteriolar wall into the alveoli, amounts of gas exceeding 50 ml can cause pulmonary outflow tract obstruction with or without concomitant arterial embolisation.
HP_0033426.UMLS synonyms: Pulmonary air embolism | obstetrical air pulmonary embolism - delivered | post-procedural pulmonary air embolism | Obstetric air pulmonary embolism with postnatal complication | Obstetric air pulmonary embolism with antenatal complication | Obstetric air embolism | obstetrical air pulmonary embolism - delivered with postpartum complication | obstetrical air pulmonary embolism - antepartum condition or complication | Air embolism in childbirth | Air embolism following infusion, transfusion and therapeutic injection

HP_0033427.label: pulmonary capillary angioectasia
HP_0033427.definition: Focal accumulation of dilated pulmonary capillaries.

HP_0033428.label: systemic autoinflammation
HP_0033428.definition: Dysregulation of the innate immune system characterized by systemic pathobiology, i.e., with symptoms that can affect the entire body.

HP_0033429.label: neuroinflammation
HP_0033429.definition: Activation of the brain's innate immune system in response to an inflammatory challenge and is characterized by a host of cellular and molecular changes within the brain.

HP_0033430.label: non - infectious meningitis
HP_0033430.definition: Inflammation of the layers of tissue that cover the brain and spinal cord (meninges) and of the fluid-filled space between the meninges (subarachnoid space) when it is caused by disorders that are not infections or by drugs or vaccines.

HP_0033431.label: cytomegalovirus colitis
HP_0033431.definition: A form of cytomegalovirus infection characterized by infection and inflammation of the colon.

HP_0033432.label: opportunistic viral infection
HP_0033432.UMLS synonyms: Frequent fungal, viral, and opportunistic infections | Frequent bacterial, viral, and opportunistic infections

HP_0033433.label: ileocecal ulcer
HP_0033433.definition: An erosion of the mucous membrane in the region connecting the ileum and cecum.

HP_0033434.label: nasal septum perforation
HP_0033434.definition: A full-thickness defect of the nasal septum.
HP_0033434.synonyms: nasal - septum perforation | perforation of the nasal septum
HP_0033434.UMLS synonyms: Perforation of nasal septum | Congenital perforation of nasal septum | Acquired perforation of nasal septum | nasal septum size of perforation | perforation of mid nasal septum | perforation of posterior nasal septum | perforation of anterior nasal septum | perforation; nasal septum, syphilitic (manifestation) | Enlargement of perforation of nasal septum | Endoscopic closure of perforation of nasal septum | Repair of nasal septal perforation

HP_0033435.label: abnormal circulating keto acid concentration
HP_0033435.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of a keto acid in the blood circulation. Keto acids or ketoacids are organic compounds that contain a carboxylic acid group and a ketone group.

HP_0033436.label: elevated circulating 3 - methyl - 2 - oxovaleric acid concentration
HP_0033436.definition: The concentration of 3-methyl-2-oxovaleric acidin the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033437.label: elevated circulating 4 - methyl - 2 - oxopentanoic acid concentration
HP_0033437.definition: The concentration of 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033437.synonyms: increased circulating alpha - ketoisocaproic acid concentration

HP_0033438.label: elevated circulating myoglobin concentration
HP_0033438.definition: An increased blood concentration of myoglobin.

HP_0033439.label: elevated circulating decenoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033439.definition: Concentration of decenoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033439.synonyms: elevated circulating c10:1 acylcarnitine concentration | elevated circulating o - decenoylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma decenoylcarnitine , c10:1

HP_0033440.label: elevated circulating octenoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033440.definition: Concentration of octenoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033440.synonyms: elevated circulating c8:1 acylcarnitine concentration | elevated circulating o - octenoylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma octenoylcarnitine , c8:1

HP_0033441.label: elevated circulating hexanoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033441.definition: Concentration of hexanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033441.synonyms: elevated circulating c6:0 acylcarnitine concentration | elevated circulating o - hexanoylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma hexanoylcarnitine , c6:0

HP_0033442.label: elevated circulating glutarylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033442.definition: Concentration of glutarylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033442.synonyms: elevated circulating c5 - dc acylcarnitine concentration | elevated circulating o - glutarylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma glutarylcarnitine , c5 - dc

HP_0033443.label: elevated circulating propionylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033443.definition: Increased concentration of propionylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033444.label: elevated circulating dodecanoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033444.definition: Concentration of dodecanoylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0033444.synonyms: elevated circulating o - dodecanoylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma dodecanoylcarnitine , c12:0

HP_0033445.label: reduced circulating acylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033445.definition: An abnormally reduced concentration in the blood circulation of acylcarnitine, which is produced by reversible esterification of the 3-hydroxyl group of carnitine.

HP_0033446.label: elevated circulating butyrylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033446.definition: Concentration of O-butyrylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033447.label: elevated circulating isovalerylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033447.definition: Concentration of O-isovalerylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033448.label: increased mid - arm muscle circumference
HP_0033448.definition: Elevation of the midupper arm circumference midway between the acromion and olecranon processes of the ulna with the use of a steel or fiberglass tape. This measure is a proxy for the muscle mass of the upper arm and can be used as a part of the assessment of nutritional status in children.

HP_0033449.label: decreased mid - arm muscle circumference
HP_0033449.definition: Reduction of the midupper arm circumference midway between the acromion and olecranon processes of the ulna with the use of a steel or fiberglass tape. This measure is a proxy for the muscle mass of the upper arm and can be used as a part of the assessment of nutritional status in children.

HP_0033450.label: abnormal circulating prealbumin concentration
HP_0033450.definition: Any deviation from normal concentration of albumin in the blood circulation.

HP_0033451.label: increased circulating prealbumin concentration
HP_0033451.definition: An elevation above the normal concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation.

HP_0033452.label: decreased circulating prealbumin concentration
HP_0033452.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of prealbumin in the blood circulation.

HP_0033453.label: limited neck extension
HP_0033453.definition: Reduced abilty to move the head back towards the ceiling so that one is looking upwards.

HP_0033454.label: tube feeding
HP_0033454.definition: Feeding problem necessitating food and nutrient delivery via a tube.

HP_0033458.label: elevated urine 4 - methyl - 2 - oxopentanoic acid level
HP_0033458.definition: Increased amount of 4-methyl-2-oxopentanoic acid in the urine.
HP_0033458.synonyms: increased urine alpha - ketoisocaproic acid level

HP_0033459.label: decreased circulating apolipoprotein concentration
HP_0033459.definition: Reduced concentration in the blood circulation of a lipid-transport protein (apoliprotein).

HP_0033460.label: increased circulating apolipoprotein circulation
HP_0033460.definition: Elevated concentration in the blood circulation of a lipid-transport protein (apoliprotein).

HP_0033461.label: elevated circulating 3 - hydroxylinoleylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033461.definition: Increased concentration of 3-hydroxylinoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP_0033461.synonyms: elevated plasma 3 - oh - linoleylcarnitine , c18:1 - oh

HP_0033462.definition: Increased concentration of oleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.

HP_0033464.label: elevated circulating 3 - hydroxypalmitoleylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033464.definition: Concentration of 3-hydroxypalmitoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0033465.label: elevated circulating tetradecanoylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033465.synonyms: elevated circulating c14 carnitine concentration | elevated circulating myristoylcarnitine concentration

HP_0033466.label: weak grip
HP_0033466.definition: Reduced grip strength. Gripping is the motion by which the hand tightly grasps an object or other hand.
HP_0033466.UMLS synonyms: weak grip in left hand | weak grip in right hand | weak grip in both hands | weak grip with heavy objects | weak grip with light objects | HAND GRIP MUSCLE WEAKNESS | HAND WEAKNESS GRIP DECREASED

HP_0033467.label: low 10 - minute apgar score
HP_0033467.definition: A normal APGAR score can be coded as 'not Low 10-minute APGAR score'.

HP_0033475.label: limited shoulder abduction
HP_0033475.definition: Decreased ability to move the arm away from the midline of the body.
HP_0033475.UMLS synonyms: physical therapy precautions limit abduction of left shoulder | physical therapy precautions limit abduction of right shoulder

HP_0033476.label: extractable nuclear antigen positivity
HP_0033476.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the serum that react against extractable nuclear components that are referred to as extractable because they can be extracted from cell nuclei with saline solution.
HP_0033476.UMLS synonyms: Anti-Extractable nuclear antigen (ENA) positive | Antibody to extractable nuclear antigen detected

HP_0033477.label: abnormal circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP_0033477.definition: A deviation from the normal concentration of lipoprotein lipase in the blood circulation.

HP_0033478.label: increased circulating lipoprotein lipase concentration
HP_0033478.definition: Increased concentration of lipoprotein lipase in the blood circulation.

HP_0033480.label: hypobilirubinemia
HP_0033480.definition: Concentration of bilirubin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0033481.label: limited lateral neck flexion
HP_0033481.definition: Reduced range of motion resulting in decreased ability to move the ear toward the top of the shoulder.

HP_0033482.label: limited shoulder flexion
HP_0033482.definition: A reduced ability to flex the shoulder. Shoulder flexion is the motion that moves the arms from a resting position by the side of the body to a position above the head.
HP_0033482.UMLS synonyms: physical therapy precautions limit flexion of left shoulder | physical therapy precautions limit flexion of right shoulder

HP_0033483.label: podocyte infolding
HP_0033483.definition: Folding of cytoplasmic processes of podocytes into the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) with thickening of the lamina densa and microspheres and/or microtubular structures within the GBM.

HP_0033484.label: elevated circulating linoleylcarnitine concentration
HP_0033484.definition: Increased concentration of linoleylcarnitine in the blood circulation.
HP_0033484.synonyms: elevated circulating c18:2 acylcarnitine concentration | elevated plasma linoleylcarnitine , c18:2

HP_0033485.label: glomerular basement membrane disruption
HP_0033485.definition: A point of rupture in the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) where the discontinuous portions of GBM are still identifiable with a basement membrane stain such as Periodic acid Schiff (PAS) or silver.
HP_0033485.synonyms: disruption of the glomerular basement membrane | glomerular basement membrane rupture

HP_0033486.label: abnormal glomerular basement membrane texture
HP_0033486.definition: Anomalous appearance or structure of the surface of the glomerular basement membrane.

HP_0033487.label: glomerular basement membranes powdery deposit
HP_0033487.definition: Punctate electron-dense material typically in a band-like distribution along the lamina rara interna and within tubular basement membranes within the subendothelial aspect of the glomerular basement membrane.
HP_0033487.synonyms: glomerular basement membranes with powdery deposit

HP_0033488.label: glomerular endocapillary leukocyte hypercellularity
HP_0033488.definition: Increased number of leukocytes internal to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), but not limited to within glomerular capillaries.
HP_0033488.synonyms: glomerular endocapillary hypercellularity consisting of leukocytes

HP_0033489.label: glomerular endocapillary neutrophil hypercellularity
HP_0033489.definition: Increased number of neutrophils internal to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), but not limited to within glomerular capillaries.

HP_0033490.label: glomerular endocapillary foam - cell hypercellularity
HP_0033490.definition: Presence of lipid-filled cells, often a macrophage, with a vacuolated appearance in the glomerulus often occupying the endocapillary space.

HP_0033491.label: global mesangial sclerosis
HP_0033491.definition: A generalized global (over 80%) increase of mesangial matrix that is present throughout the mesangial stalk (with or without associated mesangial hypercellularity).

HP_0033492.label: podocyte cytoskeletal condensation
HP_0033492.definition: Reorganization of podocyte cytoskeletal proteins at the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) aspect of the cell, with associated cytoplasmic electron density at the GBM aspect of the podocyte.

HP_0033493.label: mesangial matrix expansion
HP_0033493.definition: Increased mesangial extracellular material with interspace width of over 2 mesangial cell nuclei, in one or more peripheral mesangial areas.

HP_0033494.label: glomerular basement membrane amyloid spicule
HP_0033494.definition: Amyloid spicules are projections of typically silver-positive material from the outer aspect of the glomerular capillary wall, perpendicular to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), most often caused by amyloidosis with the latter confirmed by additional stains.

HP_0033495.label: segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP_0033495.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration and can include hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, podocyte depletion, halo and adhesion of the tuft to the Bowman capsule.

HP_0033496.label: perihilar segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP_0033496.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration is present at the vascular pole, involving less than 50% of the tuft. It can be accompanied by other descriptors such as hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells, podocyte depletion, halo and adhesion of the tuft to the Bowman's capsule.

HP_0033497.label: tip variant segmental glomerulosclerosis
HP_0033497.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft characterized by an adhesion at the tip of the glomerular tuft abutting the proximal tubular taek-off can be accompanied by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration at the glomerular tip. Features including hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells can also be observed.
HP_0033497.UMLS synonyms: Focal Segmental Glomerulosclerosis Tip Lesion Variant

HP_0033498.label: segmental glomerulosclerosis away from the vascular and tubular poles
HP_0033498.definition: Segmental solidification of the glomerular tuft characterized by increased extracellular matrix, causing glomerular capillary obliteration at neirhter the tubular or vascular poles. Features including hyalinosis, foam cells, hypertrophy of overlying glomerular epithelial cells can also be observed.

HP_0033499.label: glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP_0033499.definition: Electron-dense deposits in the lamina densa with a ribbon or a sausage structure.

HP_0033500.label: subendothelial glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP_0033500.definition: Electron dense deposits in the glomerular basement membrane (GBM) subendothelial space associated with a prominent GBM reflecting an increase in thickness. This feature can be associated with GBM remodeling along the endothelial aspect.

HP_0033501.label: subepithelial glomerular basement membrane electron dense deposits
HP_0033501.definition: Prominent glomerular basement membrane (GBM) reflecting a diffuse and relativly uniform increase in thickness (subjective estimate) with exogenous material deposited between the outer (epithelial) aspect of the GBM and the visceral epithelial cell, with varying degrees of incorporation into the GBM.

HP_0033502.label: abnormal esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP_0033502.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.

HP_0033503.label: elevated csf fumarate concentration
HP_0033503.definition: An increased concentration of fumarate, an intermediate in the citric acid cycle, in the cebrebrospinal fluid.

HP_0033504.label: elevated circulating fumarate concentration
HP_0033504.definition: An increased concentration of fumarate, an intermediate in the citric acid cycle, in the blood circulation.

HP_0033505.label: livedo reticularis
HP_0033505.definition: Livedo reticularis is characterized by the presence of a bluish purple, mottled or netlike pattern in unbroken circles on the skin. Exposure to cold environments usually intensifies the vascular pattern. Presumably, the condition results from slow or stagnant blood flow, vessel-wall pathology, and decreased oxygen tension.

HP_0033506.label: increased esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP_0033506.definition: An elevated ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.

HP_0033507.label: decreased esterified to free carnitine ratio
HP_0033507.definition: A reduced ratio of acylcarnitine (i.e., esterified carnitine) to free carnitine.

HP_0033508.label: ebv meningitis
HP_0033508.definition: Inflammation of the meninges related to infection by Epstein-Barr virus.

HP_0033509.label: ebv encephalitis
HP_0033509.definition: Inflamation of the brain related to infection by Epstein-Barr virus.

HP_0033510.label: cutaneous horn
HP_0033510.definition: A cutaneous horn is a keratinized non-malignant protrusion on the surface of the skin. Diagnosis is established by biopsy of the horn and biopsy of the horn and the underlying skin.
HP_0033510.UMLS synonyms: Cutaneous horn | Cutaneous horn of eyelid | Generalized hyperkeratotic cutaneous papillomatosis with cutaneous horns

HP_0033511.label: addictive substance use
HP_0033511.definition: Chronic compulsive drug seeking and continued use despite harmful consequences.
HP_0033511.UMLS synonyms: Drug Dependence | Heavy use of an addictive substance over time | Psychologist - Addiction (Substance Use Disorder) | Counselor - Addiction (Substance Use Disorder) | Registered Nurse - Addiction (Substance Use Disorder)

HP_0033512.label: addictive stimulant use
HP_0033512.definition: Addiction to a stimulant drug is defined as a drug that typically increases alertness, attention, and energy while also elevating blood pressure, heart rate, and breathing.

HP_0033514.label: addictive amphetamine use
HP_0033514.definition: Addiction to amphetamine or dextroamphetamine is a serious concern.
HP_0033514.synonyms: amphetamine addiction | amphetamine dependence | dextroamphetamine addiction | dextroamphetamine dependence

HP_0033520.label: paradoxical embolism
HP_0033520.definition: Paradoxical embolism describes the passage of a venous or right-sided cardiac thrombus into the arterial or systemic circulation.
HP_0033520.UMLS synonyms: Embolism, Paradoxical | Arterial obstruction due to paradoxical embolism

HP_0033521.label: nasal dryness
HP_0033521.definition: A lack of humidification of the nasal mucosa.

HP_0033522.label: cerebral cavernous malformation
HP_0033522.definition: A cerebral cavernous malformation (also known as cavernoma, cavernous angioma, cavernous hemangioma) is a collection of structurally abnormal slow-flow capillaries predominantly in the central nervous system. These are multiple mulberry-like distended caverns of dilated thin-walled capillaries without the normal intervening brain parenchymal architecture. Often, individual cavernomas are surrounded by hemosiderin representing remote oozing due to the abnormal capillaries.

HP_0033523.label: abnormal sperm principal piece morphology
HP_0033523.definition: A structural anomaly of the part of the sperm flagellum that is distal to the sperm midpiece and mitochondrial sheath and which leads into the end piece.

HP_0033524.label: abnormal sperm axoneme morphology
HP_0033524.definition: Abnormal structure of the sperm axonemal structure which consists of a ring of nine microtubular doublets and a central pair of microtubules, giving the classical 9+2 microtubular arrangement. The axoneme contains a central pair of microtubules (C1 and C2) that are connected by a bridge-like structure forming the central pair complex (CPC). Each of the nine outer doublets is composed of type A and B microtubules and connected by radial spokes to the CPC.

HP_0033525.label: absent sperm axoneme central pair complex
HP_0033525.definition: Absense of the central pair of microtubules in the sperm axoneme, thereby forming a 9+0 pattern instead of the normal 9+2 pattern.

HP_0033526.label: limited ankle dorsiflexion
HP_0033526.definition: Reduced ability to move the foot up toward the shin.
HP_0033526.synonyms: heel cord tightness | tight heel cord
HP_0033526.UMLS synonyms: Ankle dorsiflexion limits straight leg raise | physical therapy precautions limit dorsiflexion of left ankle | physical therapy precautions limit dorsiflexion of right ankle

HP_0033527.label: decreased gonadotropin - stimulated testosterone - to - androstenedione ratio
HP_0033527.definition: A reduced amount of testosterone relative in androstenedione in the blood circulation following administration of hCG (Human Chorionic Gonadotropin).
HP_0033527.synonyms: decreased plasma testosterone - to - androstenedione ratio

HP_0033528.label: abnormal cardiac output
HP_0033528.definition: A deviation from normal Cardiac output, which is defined as the amount of blood pumped by the heart minute and is the mechanism whereby blood flows around the body, especially providing blood flow to the brain and other vital organs.

HP_0033529.label: abnormal cardiac index
HP_0033529.definition: Any deviation from the normal value of the cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.

HP_0033530.label: increased cardiac index
HP_0033530.definition: An elevated cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.

HP_0033531.label: decreased cardiac index
HP_0033531.definition: A reduced cardiac index, defined as cardiac output divided by body surface area.
HP_0033531.UMLS synonyms: Decreased cardiac index | Decreased cardiac stroke volume index

HP_0033532.label: decreased cardiac output
HP_0033532.definition: A decreased volume of blood pumped by the left and right ventricle, per unit time. Cardiac output (CO) is the product of the heart rate (HR), i.e. the number of heartbeats per minute (bpm), and the stroke volume (SV), which is the volume of blood pumped from the ventricle per beat.

HP_0033533.label: increased cardiac output
HP_0033533.definition: An increased volume of blood pumped by the left and right ventricle, per unit time. Cardiac output (CO) is the product of the heart rate (HR), i.e. the number of heartbeats per minute (bpm), and the stroke volume (SV), which is the volume of blood pumped from the ventricle per beat.

HP_0033534.label: increased circulating brain natriuretic peptide concentration
HP_0033534.definition: An increased concentration of brain natriuretic peptide in the blood circulation.
HP_0033534.synonyms: elevated circulating bnp concentration | increased b - type natriuretic peptide | increased ventricular natriuretic peptide

HP_0033535.label: reduced platelet dense granules
HP_0033535.definition: Decreased number of platelet dense granules, a type of platelet organelle.

HP_0033536.label: reduced platelet alpha granules
HP_0033536.definition: A reduced number of platelet alpha granules.

HP_0033537.label: mosaic pulmonary attenuation pattern
HP_0033537.definition: Mosaic attenuation refers to heterogeneous areas of differing pulmonary attenuation on CT imaging.

HP_0033538.label: aortic annulus calcification
HP_0033538.definition: Pathological deposition of calcium salts in the aortic annulus, a fibrous ring-like structure found at the insertion point of the basal attachments of the aortic valve leaflets within the left ventricular outflow tract.
HP_0033538.UMLS synonyms: Calcification of aortic valve annulus | echocardiography: calcification of aortic valve annulus

HP_0033539.label: bilateral apical pulmonary fibrosis
HP_0033539.definition: A reticular pattern of linear or lineonodular densities in apical portions of both the right and left lungs seen initially on high-resolution computed tomography and in case of progression also on standard chest x-ray.

HP_0033540.label: reversible airflow obstruction
HP_0033540.definition: Airflow obstruction with a significant response to a bronchodilator defined as an increase in FEV1 and/or FVC by 12 percent or more and by at least 200 mL.

HP_0033541.label: irreversible airflow obstruction
HP_0033541.definition: Airflow obstruction without significant response to a bronchodilator defined as an increase in FEV1 and/or FVC by 12 percent or more and by at least 200 mL.

HP_0033542.label: bronchial wall thickening
HP_0033542.definition: Radiological appearance of increased density around the walls of a bronchus or large bronchiole. This feature is thought to be related to edema involving the bronchial wall as well as the peribronchial interstitial space. If the cross section of a bronchus is captured in a radiograph or computed tomography image, it is said to have the appearance of a donut because of the central lucency representing the airway of the bronchus surrounded by a circular region of increased density.

HP_0033543.label: addictive nicotine use
HP_0033543.definition: Nicotine addiction can be defined as a chronic, compulsive craving for nicotine and continued usage despite harmful consequences.

HP_0033544.label: mesangial fibril deposition
HP_0033544.definition: Extracellular mesangial accumulation of slender proteinaceous fibers.

HP_0033545.label: mesangial fibrillary deposits
HP_0033545.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of randomly arranged, straight, non-branching fibrils that are thicker than amyloid fibrils (average diameter about 20 nm) and are often admixed with smudgy, electron-dense material.

HP_0033546.label: mesangial microfibril deposition
HP_0033546.definition: Unbranched noncollagenous microfibrils within the mesangial matrix, composed of proteins not present within the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), most notably fibrillin-1, that attach to mesangial cells and GBM structural proteins.

HP_0033547.label: mesangial immunotactoid deposits
HP_0033547.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of non-branching fibrils, focally parralel over 30 nM in diameter. The term immunotactoid refers to highly organized immune depositions appearing as rod-like microtubular structures in ultrastructural examination.

HP_0033548.label: mesangial amyloid deposition
HP_0033548.definition: Extracellular mesangial aggregates composed of fine, randomly oriented, non-branching fibrils 8-12 nm in diameter, often forming a cottony mass.

HP_0033549.label: nodular mesangiosclerosis
HP_0033549.definition: Lobular, round to oval mesangial lesions with an acellular hyaline/matrix core surrounded by compressed mesangial nuclei.

HP_0033550.label: necrotizing pulmonary granulomatosis
HP_0033550.definition: A granuloma that is associated with necrotic changes. Caseation necrosis is defined as a region in granulomas with eosinophilic, granular and cheese-like cellular debris with necrosis. The word caseous itself means pertaining or related to cheese, and comes from the Latin word caseus, meaning cheese.

HP_0033551.label: non - necrotizing pulmonary granulomatosis
HP_0033551.definition: A granuloma located in the lung that is not associated with necrotic changes.

HP_0033552.label: chronic villitis
HP_0033552.definition: Villitis of unknown etiology (synonymous with villitis of unknown aetiology) is a histologic diagnosis and, although it may have a variable distribution, evidence indicates that 3 parenchymal blocks will identify 62% of villitis, reaching an asymptote of 6 and 7 blocks identifying 85% of villitis. Villitis of unknown etiology by definition excludes those cases where an etiology is identified, such as viral or acute infections, and thus is preferred to the term nonspecific chronic villitis. It is usually lymphohistiocytic: although the presence of rare plasma cells does not exclude the diagnosis, thorough evaluation for an infectious etiology, such as cytomegalovirus, is required in a predominantly plasma cell villitis.
HP_0033552.synonyms: chronic villitis ( non - infectious ) | nonspecific chronic villitis | villitis of unknown aetiology | villitis of unknown etiology

HP_0033553.label: septic embolism
HP_0033553.definition: Embolization of intravascular thrombus containing microorganisms into the distant tissues via arterial system.

HP_0033554.label: anti - mi2 antibody positivity
HP_0033554.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against the Mi-2 antigen.

HP_0033555.label: anti - ro / ss - a antibody positivity
HP_0033555.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against Ro/SSA autoantigens.

HP_0033556.label: anti - nucleoporin 62 antibody positivity
HP_0033556.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against nucleoporin 62.

HP_0033557.label: anti - proteinase 3 antibody positivity
HP_0033557.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against proteinase 3. Proteinase 3 (PR3) antigen is a 29-kD serine protease that exists as a protein triplet in human neutrophils

HP_0033558.label: anti - histone antibody positivity
HP_0033558.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone antigens.

HP_0033559.label: anti - myeloperoxidase antibody positivity
HP_0033559.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against myeloperoxidase.

HP_0033560.label: anti - pm - scl antibody positivity
HP_0033560.definition: Anti-PM-Scl antibodies target components of RNA-processing exosome complex in the nucleolus. There are ten proteins in this complex and antibodies to eight of them are found at varying frequencies; PM/Scl-100, PM/Scl-75, hRrp4, hRrp42, hRrp46, hCs14, hRrp41, and hRrp40.

HP_0033561.label: anti - bactericidal / permeability - increasing protein antibody positivity
HP_0033561.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against bactericidal/permeability-increasing protein (BPI). BPI is an endotoxin-binding host protein with important antibacterial effects against Gram-negative bacteria, such as Pseudomonas aeruginosa. BPI is a 55 kDalton protein that is most abundant in the azurophilic granules of neutrophils. BPI also acts as a target antigen for antineutrophil cytoplasmic autoantibodies.

HP_0033562.label: anti - glycoprotein - 210 antibody positivity
HP_0033562.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against glycoprotein-210.

HP_0033563.label: anti - tissue transglutaminase antibody positivity
HP_0033563.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against tissue transglutaminase.

HP_0033564.label: stasis dermatitis
HP_0033564.definition: Stasis dermatitis commonly occurs in older age. It is caused by venous hypertension resulting from retrograde flow due to incompetent venous valves, valve destruction, or obstruction of the venous system. Further tissue changes arise from an inflammatory process mediated by metalloproteinases, which are up-regulated by ferric ion from extravasated red blood cells. Stasis dermatitis presents initially as poorly demarcated erythematous plaques of the lower legs bilaterally, classically involving the medial malleolus.

HP_0033566.label: abnormal ventricular axis
HP_0033566.definition: Any deviation from the normal direction of the ventricular axis. The left ventricle makes up most of the heart muscle under normal circumstances and therefore generates the most electrical force visible on the EKG. The normal ventricular axis is directed downward and slightly towards the left. The ventricular axis can be determined by analyzing the QRS complex, which represents ventricular depolarization.

HP_0033567.label: right axis deviation
HP_0033567.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis falls between +90 degrees and 180 degrees, or beyond +100 degrees if the adult range is used.

HP_0033568.label: left axis deviation
HP_0033568.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis falls between -30 degrees and -90 degrees.

HP_0033569.label: extreme axis deviation
HP_0033569.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS axis fall sbetween -90 degrees and 180 degrees. In this case, the ventricular vector is directed upward and to the right.

HP_0033570.label: indeterminate ventricular axis
HP_0033570.definition: A kind of abnormal ventricular axis in the EKG whereby the QRS complex is isoelectric or equiphasic in all leads with no dominant QRS deflection.

HP_0033571.label: peripheral lung neovascularity
HP_0033571.definition: The presence of small, tortuous, micronodular, serpiginous intrapulmonary vessels often in the subpleural lung or in proximity to centrilobular arterioles, coursing in directions inconsistent with known arteriolar anatomy.

HP_0033572.label: anti - h1 antibody positivity
HP_0033572.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H1.

HP_0033573.label: anti - h4 antibody positivity
HP_0033573.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H4.

HP_0033574.label: anti - h3 antibody positivity
HP_0033574.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H3.

HP_0033575.label: anti - h2a antibody positivity
HP_0033575.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H2A.

HP_0033576.label: anti - h2b antibody positivity
HP_0033576.definition: The presence of autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against histone H2B.

HP_0033577.label: in situ pulmonary artery thrombosis
HP_0033577.definition: Localized thrombosis in pulmonary arteries frequently found in patients with idiopathic and hereditary pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease.

HP_0033578.label: pre - capillary pulmonary hypertension
HP_0033578.definition: Pre-capillary pulmonary hypertension is a haemodynamic condition characterised by elevated mean pulmonary artery pressure (mPAP over 20 mmHg) and pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR 3 Wood units or more) accompanied by normal pulmonary artery wedge pressure (PAWP not more than 15 mmHg).

HP_0033579.label: decreased growth hormone responses to growth hormone - releasing hormone challenge
HP_0033579.definition: Insufficient growth hormone secretion following administration of growth hormone-releasing hormone.
HP_0033579.synonyms: impaired growth hormone secretory responses after growth hormone - releasing hormone challenge

HP_0033580.label: compound motor action potential abnormality
HP_0033580.definition: An abnormal finding in a compound motor action potential measurement in EMG. Nerve conduction studies involve the application of a depolarising square wave electrical pulses to the skin over a peripheral nerve producing: (1) a propagated nerve action potential (NAP) recorded at a distant point over the same nerve: and (2) a compound muscle action potential (CMAP) arising from the activation of muscle fibres in a target muscle supplied by the nerve. In both cases these may be recorded with surface or needle electrodes. The CMAP is a summated voltage response from the individual muscle fibre action potentials. The shortest latency of the CMAP is the time from stimulus artefact to onset of the response and is a biphasic response with an initial upward deflection followed by a smaller downward deflection. The CMAP amplitude is measured from baseline to negative peak (the neurophysiological convention is that negative voltage is demonstrated by an upward deflection) and measured in millivolts (mV).

HP_0033581.label: absent peripheral lymph nodes in presence of infection
HP_0033581.definition: The absence of any palpable lymph nodes in the presence of symptoms suggesting infection in that drainage area should raise suspicion for immunodeficiency diseases.

HP_0033582.label: pulmonary interstitial lymphocyte infiltration
HP_0033582.definition: Abnormal accumulation of lymphocytes in the interstitium of the lung.

HP_0033583.label: follicular bronchiolitis
HP_0033583.definition: Follicular bronchiolitis is a polyclonal hyperplasia of bronchiolar associated lymphoid tissue characterized by the is characterized by the development of lymphoid follicles with germinal centers in walls of the small airways.

HP_0033584.label: nonspecific interstitial pneumonia
HP_0033584.definition: Temporally uniform (all lesions are in the same stage of evolution) pattern of diffuse inflammatory interstitial process, mostly symmetric over the entire lung, involving mainly the alveolar septa.
HP_0033584.synonyms: nonspecific interstitial pneumonitis | temporally uniform pulmonary inflammation
HP_0033584.UMLS synonyms: Nonspecific interstitial pneumonia | interstitial pneumonia nonspecific due to known underlying cause | Interstitial pneumonia (nonspecific) (usual) in diseases classified elsewhere | Interstitial pneumonia (nonspecific) (usual) due to collagen vascular disease

HP_0033585.label: fibrotic non - specific interstitial pneumonia
HP_0033585.definition: A type of non-specific interstitial pneumonia in which interstitial thickening is due to uniform dense or loose fibrosis and mild chronic inflammation.

HP_0033586.label: cellular non - specific interstitial pneumonia
HP_0033586.definition: A type of non-specific interstitial pneumonia in which interstitial thickening is mainly due to infiltration of inflammatory cells and type II pneumocyte hyperplasia.

HP_0033587.label: vulvar abscess
HP_0033587.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the vulvar region.
HP_0033587.UMLS synonyms: Abscess of vulva | VULVAR INFECTION ABSCESS | VULVAR INFECTION ABSCESS WIDE EXCISION

HP_0033588.definition: Synechia vulvae (adhesions of the labia minora) are characterized by a complete or partial fusion of the labia minora in the midline.

HP_0033589.label: flatulence
HP_0033589.definition: Passage of excessive amounts of gas and the feeling of abdominal fullness and bloating.

HP_0033590.definition: A circumscribed area of pus or necrotic debris in the groin (inguinal region).

HP_0033591.definition: Large branching stones that fill part of all of the renal pelvis and renal calyces and they can be complete or partial depending on the level of occupancy of the collecting system.
