HP_0033858.label: organized thrombi within interlobular vein lumen
HP_0033858.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

HP_0033859.label: abnormal peritubular capillary morphology
HP_0033859.definition: Anomalous structure of the capillaries that are derived from the efferent arteriole, forming a capillary network that surrounds the distal portions of the nephron tubule,

HP_0033860.label: abnormal cortical peritubular capillary morphology
HP_0033860.definition: Anomalous structure of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney.

HP_0033861.label: multilamellation of cortical peritubular capillary basement membranes
HP_0033861.definition: Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers.
HP_0033861.synonyms: multilamellation of basement membranes within cortical peritubular capillaries

HP_0033862.label: cortical peritubular capillaritis
HP_0033862.definition: Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the cortex of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells.

HP_0033863.label: abnormal cortical peritubular capillary lumen morphology
HP_0033863.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the cortex of the kidney.

HP_0033864.label: abnormal medullary peritubular capillary morphology
HP_0033864.definition: Anomalous structure of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney.

HP_0033865.label: medullary peritubular capillaritis
HP_0033865.definition: Inflammation of the peritubular capillaries in the medulla of the kidney characterized by Inflammatory cells in over 10 percent of the interstitial capillaries in the cortex with at least some capillaries having three or more luminal cells.

HP_0033866.label: medullary peritubular capillary erythrocyte congestion
HP_0033866.definition: Substantially increased numbers of red blood cells within capillaries surrounding tubules in the medulla of the kidney. This feature is assessed in histological images as the presence of numerous erythrocytes in a segment of the capillary such that the vessel appears to be congested (not open).

HP_0033867.label: multilamellation of medullary peritubular capillary basement membranes
HP_0033867.definition: Duplicated basement membranes of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney and arranged in multiple concentric layers.
HP_0033867.synonyms: multilamellation of basement membranes within medullary peritubular capillaries

HP_0033868.label: abnormal medullary peritubular capillary lumen morphology
HP_0033868.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the peritubular capillary in the medulla of the kidney.

HP_0033869.label: medullary peritubular capillary lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033869.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.
HP_0033869.synonyms: cholesterol emboli within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen

HP_0033870.label: medullary peritubular capillary intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033870.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the peritubular capillaries located in the medulla of the kidney.
HP_0033870.synonyms: intraluminal thrombi within medullary peritubular capillaries

HP_0033871.label: medullary peritubular capillary lumen organized thrombi
HP_0033871.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the peritubular capillaries of the medulla of the kidney.
HP_0033871.synonyms: organised thrombi within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen | organized thrombi within the medullary peritubular capillary lumen

HP_0033872.label: cortical peritubular capillary lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033872.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

HP_0033873.label: cortical peritubular capillary intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033873.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the peritubular capillaries located in the cortex of the kidney.
HP_0033873.synonyms: intraluminal thrombi within cortical peritubular capillaries

HP_0033874.label: cortical peritubular capillary lumen organized thrombi
HP_0033874.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the peritubular capillaries of the cortex of the kidney.

HP_0033875.label: abnormal arcuate vein lumen morphology
HP_0033875.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space (lumen) of the arcuate vein of the kidney.

HP_0033876.label: arcuate vein lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033876.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of arcuate veins of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.
HP_0033876.synonyms: cholesterol emboli within arcuate vein lumen

HP_0033877.label: arcuate vein intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033877.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

HP_0033878.label: arcuate vein lumen organized thrombi
HP_0033878.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the arcuate veins of the kidney.
HP_0033878.synonyms: organised thrombi within arcuate vein lumen | organized thrombi within arcuate vein lumen

HP_0033879.label: abnormal arcuate vein intima / media morphology
HP_0033879.definition: Any structural anomaly located in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

HP_0033880.label: arcuate vein intimal mucoid edema
HP_0033880.definition: Accumulation of edematous extracellular matrix in the inner layer (intima) of arcuate veins of the kidney. The material resembles mucus and appears pale blue on hematoxylin and eosin staining.
HP_0033880.synonyms: intimal mucoid edema within arcuate veins | intimal mucoid oedema within arcuate veins

HP_0033881.label: arcuate vein intimal / medial myxomatous degeneration
HP_0033881.definition: Accumulation of myxoid material (mucus-like material) within the inner or middle layer of the arcuate vein of the kidney.
HP_0033881.synonyms: myxomatous change within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033882.label: arcuate vein intima / medial amyloidosis
HP_0033882.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney. Amyloidosis stains Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy.
HP_0033882.synonyms: amyloidosis within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033883.label: abnormal cortical radial artery morphology
HP_0033883.definition: Any structural anomaly of the radial arteries that branch off at right angles from the arcuate artery and carry blood toward the cortex of the kidney.

HP_0033884.label: abnormal cortical radial artery lumen morphology
HP_0033884.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space of the cortical radial arteries of the kidney.

HP_0033885.label: cortical radial artery lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033885.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of cortical radial arteries (interlobular arteries) of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.

HP_0033886.label: abnormal arcuate artery intima / media morphology
HP_0033886.definition: Anomalous structure of the inner or middle layer of the arc-shaped arteries located at the border of the renal cortex and renal medulla.
HP_0033886.synonyms: abnormalities of the arcuate arterial intima / media

HP_0033887.label: cortical radial artery intimal / medial amyloidosis
HP_0033887.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the glomerular, interstitial or vascular compartments of the interlobular arteries of the kidney. Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy
HP_0033887.synonyms: amyloidosis within interlobular arterial intima / media | interlobular arterial intima / media amyloidosis

HP_0033888.label: abnormal cortical radial artery intima / media morphology
HP_0033888.definition: Any structural anomaly of the inner or middle layer of the cortical radial arteries (also known as interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033888.synonyms: abnormalities of the interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033889.label: abnormal renal arteriole morphology
HP_0033889.definition: Any structural anomaly of the glomerular arterioles. The interlobar arteries of the kidney branch into arcuate arteries, cortical radiate arteries, and then into afferent arterioles. After passing through the renal corpuscle, the capillaries form the efferent arteriole. The afferent and efferent arterioles are difficult to distinguish histologically and are thus both included in this term and its descendents.

HP_0033890.label: abnormal renal arteriole lumen morphology
HP_0033890.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space (lumen) of renal arterioles.

HP_0033891.label: renal arteriolar lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033891.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of arterioles of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.
HP_0033891.synonyms: cholesterol emboli within the arteriolar lumen

HP_0033892.label: abnormal renal arteriole intima / media morphology
HP_0033892.definition: Any structural anomaly located in the inner or middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033893.label: renal arteriolar lumen organized thrombi
HP_0033893.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033894.label: renal arteriolar intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033894.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033895.label: abnormal renal arteriole endothelium morphology
HP_0033895.definition: Any structural anomaly of the lining (endothelium) of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033896.label: abnormal arcuate artery lumen morphology
HP_0033896.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the interior space (lumen) of the arcuate artery of the kidney.
HP_0033896.synonyms: abnormalities of the arcuate arterial lumen

HP_0033897.label: arcuate artery lumen cholesterol emboli
HP_0033897.definition: Needle-like or slit-like clefts within the interior space of arcuate arteries of the kidney. Cholesterol emboli are visualized as clear spaces (cholesterol clefts) where the cholesterol crystals have been dissolved by routine processing. Acute lesions can be accompanied by inflammation and fibrin.
HP_0033897.synonyms: cholesterol emboli within arcuate arterial lumen

HP_0033898.label: arcuate artery intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033898.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding the vascular lumen of the arcuate arteries of the kidney.
HP_0033898.synonyms: intraluminal thrombi within arcuate arterial lumen

HP_0033899.label: arcuate artery lumen organized thrombi
HP_0033899.definition: Thrombi containg fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels located within the lumen of the arcuate arteries of the kidney.
HP_0033899.synonyms: organised thrombi within arcuate arterial lumen | organized thrombi within arcuate arterial lumen

HP_0033900.label: renal arteriole intima / media amyloidosis
HP_0033900.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the inner or middle layer of renal arterioles. Amyloidosis stains Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy.
HP_0033900.synonyms: amyloidosis within renal arteriolar intima / media

HP_0033901.label: abnormal arcuate artery endothelium morphology
HP_0033901.definition: Any structural anomaly of the lining (endothelium) of the arcuate arteries of the kidney.

HP_0033902.label: arcuate artery endotheliosis
HP_0033902.definition: Enlargement of endothelial cells of the arcuate arteries of the kidney because of cytoplasmic swelling.

HP_0033903.label: arcuate artery endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033903.definition: Proliferation of endothelial cells (increased number of cells) of the lining (endothelium) of the arcuate arteries of the kidney.

HP_0033904.label: renal arteriole intima / media hyalinosis
HP_0033904.definition: Accumulation of amorphous, eosinophilic, glassy, periodic acid-Schiff (PAS)-positive, silver-negative material (hyalinosis) in the inner or middle layer of the renal arterioles. This feature may be accompanied by hypertrophy of the media and intima fibrosis.

HP_0033905.label: arcuate artery intima / media arteriosclerosis
HP_0033905.definition: Thickening of the intima of the arcuate arteries of the kidney with fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina.
HP_0033905.synonyms: arteriosclerosis within arcuate arterial intima / media

HP_0033906.label: renal intimal / medial arteriolitis
HP_0033906.definition: Inflammation of an arteriole of the kidney, which may involve only the intma or can be transmural.

HP_0033907.label: renal arteriole intima / media arteriolosclerosis
HP_0033907.definition: Thickening of the intima of renal arterioles with fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina.

HP_0033908.label: renal arteriole medial atrophy
HP_0033908.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decreased thickness) of of the middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033909.label: arcuate vein medial hypertrophy
HP_0033909.definition: Increased thickness of middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

HP_0033910.label: arcuate vein medial atrophy
HP_0033910.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decreased thickness) of the middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

HP_0033911.label: cortical radial artery medial hypertrophy
HP_0033911.definition: Increased thickness of the middle layer of the cortical radial arteries (also known as the interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033911.synonyms: interlobular artery medial hypertrophy | medial hypertrophy within interlobular arteries

HP_0033912.label: cortical radial artery medial atrophy
HP_0033912.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decreased thickness) of the middle layer of the cortical radial arteries (also known as the interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033912.synonyms: interlobular artery medial atrophy | medial atrophy within interlobular arteries

HP_0033913.label: cortical radial artery medial / intimal arteriitis
HP_0033913.definition: Inflammation of a the intima or the entire wall of cortical radial arteries (also known as the interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033913.synonyms: arteritis within interlobular arterial intima / media | interlobular artery medial / intimal arteriitis

HP_0033914.label: arcuate artery intima / media amyloidosis
HP_0033914.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate arteries of the kidney. Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy.
HP_0033914.synonyms: amyloidosis within arcuate arterial intima / media

HP_0033915.label: arcuate artery intimal mucoid edema
HP_0033915.definition: Accumulation of edematous extracellular matrix in intima resembling mucus. This feature appears pale blue on hematoxylin and eosin staining.

HP_0033916.label: medial / intimal arcuate venosclerosis
HP_0033916.definition: Thickening of the intima with fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina in arcuate veins.

HP_0033917.label: arcuate intimal / medial venulitis
HP_0033917.definition: Inflammation of the inner or middle layer of arcuate venules. This feature may involve only the intima or it can be transmural.
HP_0033917.synonyms: medial / intimal arcuate venulitis | venulitis within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033918.label: renal arteriole medial hypertrophy
HP_0033918.definition: Increased thickness of middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033920.label: renal arteriole intima / media storage material accumulation
HP_0033920.definition: Deposition of storage material other than amyloid (glycogen, glycosphingolipid in Fabry's disease, sphingomyelin in Nieman Pick disease, glucosylceramide in Gaucher's disease, gangliosides, mucopolysaccahrides, phytanic acid in Refsum disease) in the inner or middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.
HP_0033920.synonyms: accumulated storage material within arteriolar intima / media

HP_0033921.label: renal arteriole endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033921.definition: Abnormal and excessive number of cells (hypercellularity) in the lining (endothelium) of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033922.label: renal arteriole leukocytic endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033922.definition: A type of renal arteriole endoarterial hypercellularity due to increased number of white blood cells (leukocytes).

HP_0033923.label: renal arteriole foam cell endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033923.definition: A type of renal arteriole leukocytic endoarterial hypercellularity due to the presence of lipid-filled cells, often a macrophage, with a vacuolated appearance in arteriolar lumen.
HP_0033923.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arterioles consisting of foam cells

HP_0033924.label: renal arteriole neutrophil endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033924.definition: A type of renal arteriole leukocytic endoarterial hypercellularity due to the presence of increased numbers of neutrophils within the arteriolar lumen.
HP_0033924.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arterioles consisting of neutrophils

HP_0033925.label: renal arteriole lymphocyte endoarterial hypercellularity
HP_0033925.definition: A type of renal arteriole leukocytic endoarterial hypercellularity due to the presence of increased number of lymphocytes in the arteriolar lumen.
HP_0033925.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arterioles consisting of lymphocytes

HP_0033926.label: renal arteriole intimal / medial multilamellation
HP_0033926.definition: Myointimal hyperplasia arranged in multiple concentric layers in the inner or middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.
HP_0033926.synonyms: multilamellation ( onion skinning ) within renal arteriole intima / media | renal arteriole intima / media multilamellation | renal arteriole intimal / medial onion skinning

HP_0033927.label: arcuate artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity
HP_0033927.definition: Arcuate artery endoarterial hypercellularity due to increased numbers of white blood cells (leukocytes).
HP_0033927.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arcuate artery consisting of leukocytes

HP_0033928.label: arcuate artery endoarterial foam cell hypercellularity
HP_0033928.definition: A type of arcuate artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of lipid-filled cells, often a macrophage, with a vacuolated appearance in arteriolar lumen.
HP_0033928.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arcuate artery consisting of foam cells

HP_0033929.label: arcuate artery endoarterial neutrophil hypercellularity
HP_0033929.definition: A type of arcuate artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of increased numbers of neutrophils withinin the lumen of arcuate artery.
HP_0033929.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arcuate artery consisting of neutrophils

HP_0033930.label: arcuate artery endoarterial lymphocyte hypercellularity
HP_0033930.definition: A type of arcuate artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of increased number of lymphocytes in the lumen of arcuate artery.
HP_0033930.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within arcuate artery consisting of lymphocytes

HP_0033931.label: arcuate artery intima / media necrosis
HP_0033931.definition: Death of tissue in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate artery of the kidney.

HP_0033932.label: arcuate artery intima / media coagulative necrosis
HP_0033932.definition: A type of arcuate artery intima/media necrosis in which the necrotic tissue retains the outlines of the dead (necrotic) structures.
HP_0033932.synonyms: coagulative necrosis within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033933.label: arcuate artery intima / media liquefactive necrosis
HP_0033933.definition: A type of arcuate artery intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue breaks down such that cellular detail is no longer recognized.
HP_0033933.synonyms: liquefactive necrosis of the arcuate artery intima / media

HP_0033934.label: arcuate vein intimal / medial storage material accumulation
HP_0033934.definition: Accumulation of material other than amyloid (glycogen, glycosphingolipid in Fabry's disease, sphingomyelin in Nieman Pick disease, glucosylceramide in Gaucher's disease, gangliosides, mucopolysaccahrides, phytanic acid in Refsum disease) in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.
HP_0033934.synonyms: multilamellation ( onion skinning ) within arteriolar intima / media | renal arteriole intima / media onion skinning

HP_0033935.label: cortical radial artery intima / media necrosis
HP_0033935.definition: Cell death (necrosis) in the inner or middle layer of the cortical radial arteries (also known as the interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033935.synonyms: necrosis within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033936.label: cortical radial artery intima / media liquefactive necrosis
HP_0033936.definition: A type of cortical radial artery intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue breaks down such that cellular detail is no longer recognized.
HP_0033936.synonyms: liquefactive necrosis within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033937.label: cortical radial artery intima / media coagulative necrosis
HP_0033937.definition: A type of cortical radial artery intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue retains the outlines of the dead structures.

HP_0033938.label: renal arteriole intima / media necrosis
HP_0033938.definition: Cell death (necrosis) in the inner or middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.

HP_0033939.label: renal arteriole intima / media liquefactive necrosis
HP_0033939.definition: A type of renal arteriole intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue breaks down such that cellular detail is no longer recognized.
HP_0033939.synonyms: liquefactive necrosis of the renal arteriolar intima / media

HP_0033940.label: renal arteriole intima / media coagulative necrosis
HP_0033940.definition: A type of renal arteriole intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue retains the outlines of the dead structures.

HP_0033941.label: granulomatous arteriolitis of the arteriolar intima / media
HP_0033941.definition: A type of renal intimal/medial arteriolitis characteriezed by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed arteries.
HP_0033941.synonyms: granulomatous arteriolitis within arteriolar intima / media

HP_0033942.label: arcuate vein medial / intimal necrosis
HP_0033942.definition: Cell death (necrosis) of the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.
HP_0033942.synonyms: necrosis within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033943.label: arcuate vein medial / intimal coagulative necrosis
HP_0033943.definition: A type of arcuate vein medial/intimal necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue retains the outlines of the dead structures.
HP_0033943.synonyms: coagulative necrosis within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033944.label: arcuate vein medial / intimal liquefactive necrosis
HP_0033944.definition: A type of arcuate vein medial/intimal necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue breaks down such that cellular detail is no longer recognized.
HP_0033944.synonyms: liquefactive necrosis within arcuate vein intima / media

HP_0033945.label: arcuate intimal / medial granulomatous venulitis
HP_0033945.definition: A type of arcuate intimal/medial venulitis characterized by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed veins.

HP_0033946.label: arcuate vein intima / media crystal accumulation
HP_0033946.definition: Deposition of crystals such as uric acid, oxalate, or cystine in the inner or middle layer of the arcuate veins of the kidney.

HP_0033947.label: renal arteriole intima / media crystal accumulation
HP_0033947.definition: Deposition of crystals such as uric acid, oxalate, or cystine in the inner or middle layer of the arterioles of the kidney.
HP_0033947.synonyms: accumulated crystals within renal arteriolar intima / media

HP_0033948.label: arcuate artery intima / media arteriitis
HP_0033948.definition: Inflammation of the inner or middle layer of the arcuate arteries of the kidney.
HP_0033948.synonyms: arteritis within arcuate arterial intima / media

HP_0033949.label: arcuate artery intima / media granulomatous arteriitis
HP_0033949.definition: A type of arcuate artery intima/media granulomatous arteriitis characterized by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed arteries.
HP_0033949.synonyms: granulomatous arteritis within arcuate arterial intima / media

HP_0033950.label: cortical radial artery intraluminal thrombi
HP_0033950.definition: Mixture of fibrin, red blood cells, platelets partly or completely occluding vascular lumen within the interior space of cortical radial arteries (interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033950.synonyms: intraluminal thrombi within interlobular arterial lumen

HP_0033951.label: cortical radial artery intraluminal organized thrombi
HP_0033951.definition: Thrombi containing fibrous tissue and capillary-like vascular channels within the interior space of cortical radial arteries (interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033951.synonyms: organised thrombi within interlobular arterial lumen | organized thrombi within interlobular arterial lumen

HP_0033952.label: abnormal cortical radial artery endothelium morphology
HP_0033952.definition: Abnormal structural characteristics of the lining (endothelium) of the cortical radial arteries (also known as interlobular arteries) of the kidney.
HP_0033952.synonyms: abnormalities of the interlobular arterial endothelium

HP_0033953.label: cortical radial artery endotheliosis
HP_0033953.definition: Enlargement of endothelial cells of the cortical radial arteries (also known as the interlobular arteries) of the kidney because of cytoplasmic swelling.

HP_0033954.label: cortical radial artery hypercellularity
HP_0033954.definition: Proliferation of endothelial cells (increased number of cells) of the lining (endothelium) of the cortical radial arteries (also known as interlobular arteries) of the kidney.

HP_0033955.label: cortical radial artery leukocyte hypercellularity
HP_0033955.definition: A type of cortical radial artery endoarterial hypercellularity due to increased numbers of white blood cells (leukocytes).
HP_0033955.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within interlobular artery consisting of leukocytes

HP_0033956.label: cortical radial artery lymphocyte hypercellularity
HP_0033956.definition: A type of cortical radial artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of increased number of lymphocytes in the lumen of cortical radial arteries.
HP_0033956.synonyms: endoarterial hypercellularity within interlobular artery consisting of lymphocytes

HP_0033957.label: cortical radial artery neutrophil hypercellularity
HP_0033957.definition: A type of cortical radial artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of increased numbers of neutrophils in the lumen of cortical radial arteries.
HP_0033957.synonyms: endocapillary hypercellularity within interlobular arterial endothelium consisting of neutrophils

HP_0033958.label: cortical radial artery foam cell hypercellularity
HP_0033958.definition: A type of cortical radial artery endoarterial leukocyte hypercellularity due to the presence of lipid-filled cells, often macrophages, with a vacuolated appearance in the lumen of cortical radial artery (also known as the interlobular artery) of the kidney.
HP_0033958.synonyms: endocapillary hypercellularity within interlobular arterial endothelium consisting of foam cells

HP_0033959.label: cortical radial artery intima / media arteriosclerosis
HP_0033959.definition: Thickening of the intima of the cortical radial artery (also known as the interlobular artery) of the kidney characterized by fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina.
HP_0033959.synonyms: arteriosclerosis within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033960.label: cortical radial artery intimal mucoid edema
HP_0033960.definition: Accumulation of edematous extracellular matrix in the intima of the cortical radial artery (also known as the interlobular artery) of the kidney. This material resembles mucus and stains pale blue on hematoxylin and eosin staining.
HP_0033960.synonyms: intimal mucoid edema within interlobular arterial intima / media | intimal mucoid oedema within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033961.label: cortical radial artery intima / media multilamellation
HP_0033961.definition: Myointimal hyperplasia of the inner and middle layer of the cortical radial artery (also known as the interlobular artery) of the kidney, arranged in multiple concentric layers.
HP_0033961.synonyms: cortical radial artery intima / media onion skinning | multilamellation ( onion skinning ) within interlobular arterial intima / media

HP_0033962.label: cortical radial artery medial / intimal granulomatous arteriitis
HP_0033962.definition: A type of cortical radial artery medial/intimal arteriitis that is characterized by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed arteries.

HP_0033963.label: abnormal interlobular vein intima / media morphology
HP_0033963.definition: Any structural anomaly of the inner or middle layer of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

HP_0033964.label: interlobular intima / media venosclerosis
HP_0033964.definition: Thickening of the intima with fibrosis and/or duplication of the elastic lamina in interlobular veins of the kidney.
HP_0033964.synonyms: venosclerosis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033965.label: interlobular vein intimal mucoid edema
HP_0033965.definition: Accumulation of edematous extracellular matrix in the intima of the interlobular vein of the kidney. This material resembles mucus and stains pale blue on hematoxylin and eosin staining.
HP_0033965.synonyms: intimal mucoid edema within interlobular veins | intimal mucoid oedema within interlobular veins

HP_0033966.label: interlobular vein intima / media amyloidosis
HP_0033966.definition: Amorphous extracellular substance in the glomerular, interstitial or vascular compartments of the interlobular veins of the kidney. Congo-red positive with typically an apple green birerfingence on polarization microscopy, and 8-12 nm fibrils on electron microscopy
HP_0033966.synonyms: amyloidosis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033967.label: interlobular vein intima / media venulitis
HP_0033967.definition: Inflammation of the interlobular veins of the kidney which may affect only the intima or may be transmural.
HP_0033967.synonyms: venulitis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033968.label: interlobular vein intima / media granulomatous venulitis
HP_0033968.definition: A type of interlobular vein intima/media venulitis that is characterized by circumscribed inflammatory lesions comprised primarily of macrophages present in inflamed veins.
HP_0033968.synonyms: granulomatous venulitis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033969.label: interlobular vein intima / media necrosis
HP_0033969.definition: Cell death (necrosis) in the inner or middle layer of the interlobular vein of the kidney.
HP_0033969.synonyms: necrosis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033970.label: interlobular vein intima / media liquefactive necrosis
HP_0033970.definition: A type of interlobular vein intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue breaks down such that cellular detail is no longer recognized.
HP_0033970.synonyms: liquefactive necrosis within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033971.label: interlobular vein intima / media coagulative necrosis
HP_0033971.definition: A type of interlobular vein intima/media necrosis in which the dead (necrotic) tissue retains the outlines of the dead structures.

HP_0033972.label: interlobular vein medial atrophy
HP_0033972.definition: Atrophy (wasting, decreased thickness) of the medial layer pf the interlobular veins of the kidney.

HP_0033973.label: interlobular vein medial hypertrophy
HP_0033973.definition: Increased thickness of middle layer of the interlobular veins of the kidney.

HP_0033974.label: interlobular vein intima / media multilamellation
HP_0033974.definition: Myointimal hyperplasia of the inner and middle layer of the interlobular veins of the kidney, arranged in multiple concentric layers.
HP_0033974.synonyms: interlobular vein intima / media onion skinning | multilamellation ( onion skinning ) within interlobular vein intima / media

HP_0033975.label: absent second fingernail
HP_0033975.definition: Absence of the fingernail of the index (second) finger.

HP_0033976.label: volar fingernail
HP_0033976.definition: The presence of an extra nail on the palmar (volar, ventral) surface of the finger.

HP_0033977.label: talar aplasia
HP_0033977.definition: Absent talus owing to a congenital defect.

HP_0033978.label: reduced beta - hexosaminidase activity
HP_0033978.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme beta-hexosaminidase in the blood circulation.

HP_0033979.label: excessive dynamic airway collapse
HP_0033979.definition: Excessive anterior displacement of the tracheal and/or bronchial membranous wall.

HP_0033980.label: paroxysmal tonic upgaze
HP_0033980.definition: Recurrent episodes of sustained upward deviation of the eyes and incomplete downward saccades, and normal horizontal eye movements without impairment of consciousness.
HP_0033980.UMLS synonyms: Paroxysmal Tonic Upgaze, Benign Childhood, With Ataxia

HP_0033981.label: vertebral artery tortuosity
HP_0033981.definition: Abnormal tortuous (i.e., twisted) form of the vertebral arteries.

HP_0033982.label: celiac artery dissection
HP_0033982.definition: A separation (dissection) of the layers of the celiac artery wall.

HP_0033983.label: decreased circulating apolipoprotein c - ii concentration
HP_0033983.definition: Reduced concentration of apolipoprotein C-II in the blood circulation.

HP_0033984.label: increased urinary 8 - oxo - 7,8 - dihydroguanosine level
HP_0033984.definition: An elevated amount of 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanosine in the urine.
HP_0033984.synonyms: increased urinary 8 - oxo - 7,8 - dihydroguanosine | increased urinary 8 - oxo - gsn level | increased urine 8 - oxo - 7,8 - dihydroguanosine | increased urine 8 - oxo - gmp

HP_0033985.label: elongated femoral neck
HP_0033985.definition: Increased length of the neck of the femur.

HP_0033986.label: tortuous lymphatic vessels
HP_0033986.definition: The presence of an increased number of twists and turns of lymphatic vessels.

HP_0033987.label: phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor
HP_0033987.definition: A rare, endocrine active tumor that causes severe renal phosphate wasting, which in turn can lead to critical osteomalacia. Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumors (PMTs) are typically small and mostly benign tumors producing fibroblast growth factor 23 (FGF-23). FGF-23 lowers the expression of sodium/phosphate cotransporters, which are the primary transport proteins responsible for phosphate reabsorption in the kidneys. The paraneoplastic overproduction of FGF-23 lowers reabsorption of phosphate and causes severe paraneoplastic renal phosphate wasting and hypophosphatemia. FGF-23 also affects vitamin D levels by lowering 25-hydroxyvitamin D 1-alpha-hydroxylase in the proximal renal tubules and by increasing the expression of vitamin D 24-hydroxylase, a mitochondrial enzyme responsible for inactivating vitamin D metabolites.
HP_0033987.UMLS synonyms: Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor | Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, benign | Phosphaturic mesenchymal tumor, malignant | Appendicular Skeleton Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor | Head and Neck Phosphaturic Mesenchymal Tumor

HP_0033988.label: amygdala microinfarct
HP_0033988.definition: An infarct located in the almond-shaped body of basal nuclei anterior to the inferior horn of the lateral ventricle of the brain, within the temporal lobe that can only be observed microscopically.

HP_0033989.label: hippocampal microinfarct
HP_0033989.definition: An infarct located in the structure of the cerebrum involved with memory storage and spatial navigation that can only be observed microscopically.

HP_0033990.label: cartilaginous tracheobronchomalacia
HP_0033990.definition: Softening of the tracheal and/or bronchial cartilage resulting in segmental tracheal and/or bronchial weakness.

HP_0033991.label: vasa previa
HP_0033991.definition: Vasa previa occurs when the membranes that contain the umbilical cord traverse the membranes overlying the internal os of the cervix. There is a high risk of fetal mortality if not identified perinatally.
HP_0033991.UMLS synonyms: Vasa Previa | cord vasa previa | vasa previa; hemorrhage | c.delivery; vasa previa | vasa previa affecting newborn | vasa previa; affecting fetus | c.delivery; cord, vasa previa | Fetal blood loss from vasa previa | vasa previa with baby delivered | Vasa previa with antenatal problem | vasa previa as antepartum condition | GAIA Level 2 Vasa Previa | GAIA Level 1 Vasa Previa | transvaginal ultrasound: umbilical cord vasa previa | hemorrhage; fetal, fetus, from, vasa previa | fetus or newborn affected by vasa previa | Vasa previa complicating labor and delivery, antepartum | vasa previa; hemorrhage, affecting fetus or newborn | Vasa previa complicating labor and delivery, delivered, with or without mention of antepartum condition | fetal or neonatal effect of vasa previa of cord | Fetal disorder due to vasa previa of umbilical cord | Neonatal disorder due to vasa previa of umbilical cord | Labor and delivery complicated by vasa previa, other fetus | Labor and delivery complicated by vasa previa, fetus 1 | Labor and delivery complicated by hemorrhage from vasa previa

HP_0033992.label: chronotropic incompetence
HP_0033992.definition: Inability of the heart to increase its rate commensurate with increased activity or demand.
HP_0033992.UMLS synonyms: Chronotropic incompetence | stress test-induced chronotropic incompetence

HP_0033993.label: viral encephalitis
HP_0033993.definition: An inflammation of brain parenchyma due to infection with a virus. Viral encephalitis can occur as a rare complication of common infections (eg, herpes virus infections) or can occur as a characteristic presentation of rare viruses (eg, rabies virus infection). Encephalitis may be the only neurologic manifestation of infection, or may occur in association with meningitis, myelitis, radiculitis, or neuritis. Viral encephalitis is associated with neurological dysfunction.
HP_0033993.UMLS synonyms: Viral Encephalitis | Acute viral encephalitis | Chronic viral encephalitis | Late effects of viral encephalitis | Primary viral encephalitis | viral; infection, encephalitis | Mosquito-borne viral encephalitis | Other specified viral encephalitis | Arthropod-borne viral encephalitis, unspecified | Rio Bravo viral encephalitis | Encephalitis of viral origin | Other mosquito-borne viral encephalitis | Other tick-borne viral encephalitis | Cordonnier Grade 3 Viral Complication, Viral Encephalitis | Dementia associated with viral encephalitis | Encephalitis (viral, affecting the brainstem) | viral encephalitis due to meningitis | viral; infection, enterovirus, encephalitis (manifestation) | Encephalitis/meningitis, California serogroup viral | Encephalitis, California | Powassan Encephalitis | Adenoviral encephalitis | Japanese Encephalitis | Prophylactic vaccination against arthropod-borne viral encephalitis | Other viral encephalitis, not elsewhere classified

HP_0033994.label: dependency on parenteral nutrition
HP_0033994.definition: Inability to ingest sufficient quantities of nutrition by mouth or by tube-feeding with the corresponding requirement for intravenous administration of nutrition.

HP_0033995.label: microvillus inclusions
HP_0033995.definition: The presence of vacuoles bearing centripetal microvilli in small gut villus enterocytes.
HP_0033995.UMLS synonyms: Intracellular microvillus inclusions | Microvillus inclusion disease | RETINAL DYSTROPHY AND MICROVILLUS INCLUSION DISEASE | DIARRHEA 12, WITH MICROVILLUS ATROPHY | HEMOPHAGOCYTIC LYMPHOHISTIOCYTOSIS, FAMILIAL, 5, WITH MICROVILLUS INCLUSION DISEASE | HEMOPHAGOCYTIC LYMPHOHISTIOCYTOSIS, FAMILIAL, 5, WITHOUT MICROVILLUS INCLUSION DISEASE | HEMOPHAGOCYTIC LYMPHOHISTIOCYTOSIS, FAMILIAL, 5

HP_0033996.label: microvillar pas - positive secretory granules
HP_0033996.definition: The presenceaccumulationof periodic acid-Schiff (PAS) granules in the subapical region of small intenstinal microvilli, appearing as different kinds of vesicular/tubular structures.

HP_0033997.label: perinuclear cardiomyocyte vacuolization
HP_0033997.definition: Formation of vacuoles, i.e., membrane-bound organelles, in the portion of the cytoplasm near the nucleus within myocytes of the heart.

HP_0033998.label: single - lobed right lung
HP_0033998.definition: A developmental defect of pulmonary lobation characterized by the presence of only one lobe of the right lung, which normally has three lobes.

HP_0033999.label: bronchial hemorrhage
HP_0033999.definition: Bronchial hemorrhage is a focal bleeding located in the bronchial system. It can be diagnosed by tracheobronchoscopy.
HP_0033999.UMLS synonyms: Bronchial hemorrhage | Bronchial anastomotic hemorrhage | Tracheobronchial hemorrhage | Bronchial varices haemorrhage | BRONCHIAL BULLA, HEMORRHAGIC | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left inferior lingular bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left apicoposterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left anterior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left lower lobe superior segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left main bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left anteromedial basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left posterior basal segmental bronchus | bronchoscopy hemorrhagic mass of left lateral basal segmental bronchus

HP_0034000.label: tracheal hemorrhage
HP_0034000.definition: Tracheal hemorrhage is a focal bleeding within the trachea. It be diagnosed by tracheobronchoscopy.
HP_0034000.UMLS synonyms: Tracheal Hemorrhage | Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Grade 5 Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Grade 1 Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Grade 2 Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Grade 3 Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Grade 4 Tracheal Hemorrhage, CTCAE | Tracheobronchial hemorrhage | Neonatal traumatic hemorrhage of trachea following procedure on lower respiratory tract

HP_0034001.label: anti - complement factor h antibody positivity
HP_0034001.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against complement factor H.

HP_0034002.label: anti - phospholipase a2 receptor antibody positivity
HP_0034002.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against the phospholipase A2 receptor.

HP_0034003.label: broad medial eyebrow
HP_0034003.definition: Regional increase in the width (height) of the middle portion of the eyebrow.
HP_0034003.UMLS synonyms: Broad medial eyebrows that taper laterally

HP_0034004.label: parosmia
HP_0034004.definition: Misperception of existing odor, that is, distorted or altered olfactory perception in the presence of known stimuli.
HP_0034004.UMLS synonyms: Sense of smell altered | Dysosmia | Olfaction Disorders

HP_0034005.label: decreased dendritic spine number
HP_0034005.definition: An abnormal reduction in the amount of spines on a given dendrite.

HP_0034006.label: decreased urinary lysyl - pyridinoline - hydroxylysyl - pyridinoline ratio
HP_0034006.definition: A decreased amount of the urinary cross-links lysyl-pyridinoline (LP, or deoxypyridinoline DPD) as compared to hydroxylysyl-pyridinoline (HP, or pyridinoline PYD). Both are established biochemical markers of osteoclastic bone resorption and collagen degradation.

HP_0034007.label: posterior atrophy of corpus callosum
HP_0034007.definition: The presence of atrophy (wasting) of the posterior portion of the corpus callosum.

HP_0034009.label: pelvic lipomatosis
HP_0034009.definition: Overgrowth of fat in the perivesical and perirectal area.
HP_0034009.UMLS synonyms: Pelvic lipomatosis | Pelvic Lipomatosis with Crossed Renal Ectopia

HP_0034010.label: increased megakaryocyte colony forming unit count
HP_0034010.definition: Increased numbers of megakryocyte precursors (megakaryocyte colony forming units) in the bone marrow.

HP_0034011.label: reduced progressive sperm motility
HP_0034011.definition: A reduced proportion of sperm that move in a straight line or large circles; alternatively, an increased proportion of sperm that move in tight circles or in some other non-linear fashion.
HP_0034011.UMLS synonyms: Reduced progressive sperm motility, severe | Severely reduced progressive motility of sperm | Reduced or no progressive sperm motility | Reduced or absent progressive motility of sperm | Reduced or absent sperm with progressive motility | Severely reduced or absent progressive sperm motility

HP_0034012.label: palmoplantar hypohidrosis
HP_0034012.definition: Decreased sweating on the palms and soles.
HP_0034012.UMLS synonyms: Hypohidrosis, enamel hypoplasia, palmoplantar keratoderma, intellectual disability syndrome

HP_0034013.label: curvilinear pericallosal lipoma
HP_0034013.definition: A type of pericallosal lipoma that is thin and curves around the posterior end of the splenium of the corpus callosum.

HP_0034014.label: tubulonodular pericallosal lipoma
HP_0034014.definition: A type of pericallosal lipoma with a rounded or lobular appearance and a diameter that is usually above 2 cm. They are anteriorly situated and are associated with extensive callosal and often fronto-facial anomalies. A tubulonodular pericallosal lipoma can extend into the choroid plexus or lateral ventricles.

HP_0034015.label: cavitating pulmonary nodule
HP_0034015.definition: Thick-walled abnormal gas-filled interstitial nodule within a lung.

HP_0034016.label: anti - hla antibody positivity
HP_0034016.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen (HLA).
HP_0034016.synonyms: anti - human leukocyte antigen antibody positivity
HP_0034016.UMLS synonyms: Anti-HLA antibody test positive | Anti-HLA Class I Antibody Positive

HP_0034017.label: anti - class i hla antibody positivity
HP_0034017.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a class I human leukocyte antigen (HLA). Class I HLA corresponds to MHC class I (A, B, and C).

HP_0034018.label: anti - class ii hla antibody positivity
HP_0034018.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a class II human leukocyte antigen (HLA). Class I HLA corresponds to MHC class II (DP, DM, DO, DQ, and DR).

HP_0034019.label: anti - hla - a antibody positivity
HP_0034019.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

HP_0034020.label: anti - hla - a igg1 antibody positivity
HP_0034020.definition: The presence of IgG1 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

HP_0034021.label: anti - hla - a igg3 antibody positivity
HP_0034021.definition: The presence of IgG3 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-A (HLA-A).

HP_0034022.label: anti - hla - b antibody positivity
HP_0034022.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

HP_0034023.label: anti - hla - b igg1 antibody positivity
HP_0034023.definition: The presence of IgG1 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

HP_0034024.label: anti - hla - b igg3 antibody positivity
HP_0034024.definition: The presence of IgG3 autoantibodies in the blood circulation that react against a human leukocyte antigen-B (HLA-B).

HP_0034025.label: abnormal circulating gaba concentration
HP_0034025.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) in the blood circulation.

HP_0034026.label: elevated circulating sacchoropine concentration
HP_0034026.definition: An increased concentration of saccharopine in the blood circulation. L-saccharopine is the N(6)-(1,3-dicarboxypropan-1-yl) derivative of L-lysine.

HP_0034027.label: abnormal urinary non - proteinogenic amino acid level
HP_0034027.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount in the urine of an alpha-amino acid which is not a member of the group of 23 proteinogenic amino acids.

HP_0034028.label: saccharopinuria
HP_0034028.definition: Presence of saccharopine in the urine.

HP_0034029.label: hepatic foam cells
HP_0034029.definition: The presence of foam cells, a type of macrophage that localizes to fatty deposits on blood vessel walls, in the liver.

HP_0034030.label: lip cyanosis
HP_0034030.synonyms: bluish lips | cyanotic lips | labial cyanosis

HP_0034031.label: facial cyanosis
HP_0034031.definition: Bluish discoloration of one or more regions of the face.

HP_0034032.label: central cyanosis
HP_0034032.definition: Generalized bluish discoloration of the body and the visible mucous membranes, which occurs due to inadequate oxygenation secondary to conditions that lead to an increase in deoxygenated hemoglobin or presence of abnormal hemoglobin.
HP_0034032.UMLS synonyms: Central cyanosis | Cyanosis central aggravated | Monitor for central and peripheral cyanosis

HP_0034033.label: peripheral cyanosis
HP_0034033.definition: Bluish discoloration of the distal extremities (hands, fingertips, toes), and can sometimes involve circumoral and periorbital areas. Mucous membranes are generally not involved.
HP_0034033.UMLS synonyms: Peripheral cyanosis | Monitor for central and peripheral cyanosis

HP_0034034.label: differential cyanosis
HP_0034034.definition: Differential degree of bluish discoloration between the upper and lower extremities.

HP_0034035.label: pharyngeal exudate
HP_0034035.definition: Fluid exuded from the posterior wall of the pharynx.
HP_0034035.synonyms: fluid from the pharynx | pharyngeal fluid
HP_0034035.UMLS synonyms: exudate of posterior wall of pharynx

HP_0034036.label: pseudo - chilblains on toes
HP_0034036.definition: Inflammatory chilblain-like nodules on the feet and/or toes.
HP_0034036.synonyms: chilblain - like toe lesions | chilblain - like toes | covid toe

HP_0034037.label: pseudo - chilblains on fingers
HP_0034037.definition: Inflammatory chilblain-like nodules on the hands and/or fingers.

HP_0034038.label: silent hypoxemia
HP_0034038.definition: Abnormally low blood oxygen level without the presence of dyspnea.

HP_0034039.label: ventricular couplet
HP_0034039.definition: Two consecutive premature ventricular contractions (PVCs) with no intervening normal beats.
HP_0034039.UMLS synonyms: Paired ventricular premature complexes | electrocardiogram: ventricular premature depolarization consecutive couplet | continuous electrocardiogram monitoring: ventricular premature depolarization consecutive couplets | Premature ventricular contractions, including couplets and triplets of variable morphology

HP_0034040.label: bidirectional ventricular tachycardia
HP_0034040.definition: Bidirectional ventricular tachycardia (BDVT) is a regular ventricular tachyarrhythmia (VT) with two different QRS morphologies alternating at a rate typically between 140 and 180 bpm.
HP_0034040.UMLS synonyms: Bidirectional tachycardia | Polymorphic catecholergic ventricular tachycardia

HP_0034042.label: dorsal hirsutism
HP_0034042.definition: Abnormally increased hair growth in the lskin of the back.

HP_0034043.label: increased fecal bile acid
HP_0034043.definition: Elevated amount of bile acids in the feces.

HP_0034044.label: trident pelvis
HP_0034044.definition: Spurs at the medial and lateral acetabular margin and in the center of the acetabulum gives rise to shape resembling a three-pronged spear known as trident.

HP_0034045.label: angulated muscle fibers
HP_0034045.definition: Normal muscle fibers are polygonal-shaped in cross section, are multinucleated, and have minimal amounts of endomysial connective tissue. In contrast, angulated (also known as angular) muscle fibers have long and narrow vertices (corners) with sharp edges and a pointed tip.
HP_0034045.synonyms: angular muscle fibers | angular muscle fibres
HP_0034045.UMLS synonyms: Angulated atrophic muscle fibers | Angulated fibers seen on muscle biopsy | Muscle biopsy shows neurogenic angulated fibers | Small, angulated muscle fibers seen on muscle biopsy | Muscle biopsy shows groups of small angulated fibers consistent with denervation

HP_0034046.label: mandibular osteolysis
HP_0034046.definition: Osteolysis (destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium) localized to the mandible.

HP_0034047.label: rib osteolysis
HP_0034047.definition: Osteolysis (destruction of bone through bone resorption with removal or loss of calcium) localized to a rib.
HP_0034047.UMLS synonyms: Osteolysis, severe (of mandible, clavicles, ribs, distal phalanges, and radii)

HP_0034048.label: decreased circulating chenodeoxycholic acid concentration
HP_0034048.definition: A reduced concentration of chenodeoxycholic acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0034049.label: elevated urinary prostaglandin e2 level
HP_0034049.definition: An increased amount of prostaglandin E2 in the urine.

HP_0034050.label: elevated urinary prostaglandin e2 metabolite level
HP_0034050.definition: An increased amount of prostaglandin E2 metabolite (PGE-M) in the urine.

HP_0034051.label: hypoplastic anterior limbs of the internal capsule
HP_0034051.definition: Underdevelopment of the frontal part (anterior crus or anterior limb) of the internal capsule.

HP_0034052.label: impaired toe - walking ability
HP_0034052.definition: Difficulty or reduced ability to walk on toes. Toe-walking can be tested as a part of the neurological examination. Foot plantar flexion weakness leads to difficulties in walking on toes.

HP_0034054.label: probst bundles
HP_0034054.definition: Probst bundles (also known as longitudinal callosal fascicles) are neuroanatomical homologues to the corpus callosum and can occur in association with callosal agenesis. Probst bundles are white matter fibers that normally cross the corpus callosum but (because of the agenesis of the corpus callosum) fail to cross the midline, such that when they reach the corticoseptal boundary, they turn and run parallel to the interhemispheric fissure within the septal leaves, indenting the medial walls of the lateral ventricles.
HP_0034054.UMLS synonyms: Probst bundles present | Large Probst bundles | Thick Probst bundles | bundle of Probst

HP_0034055.label: anti - side - chain cleavage enzyme antibody positivity
HP_0034055.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against cytochrome P450 cholesterol side-chain cleavage enzyme (P450scc), which is encoded by CYP11A1 cytochrome P450 family 11 subfamily A member 1 (Gene ID:1583).

HP_0034056.label: increased fecal calprotectin level
HP_0034056.definition: An increased amount of calprotectin in the feces.

HP_0034057.label: fetal anomaly
HP_0034057.definition: Structural or functional abnormalities of the fetus. Note that this section comprises terms that describe abnormalities that are specific to the fetus or differ from the corresponding general terms. A term from anywhere in the Human Phenotype Ontology can be applied to a fetus if appropriate.

The higher the echogenicity of tissues, the brighter they appear on ultrasound imaging.

HP_0034181.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the liver.

HP_0034182.label: segmental hypoplasia of liver
HP_0034182.definition: Anatomically the liver is divided into right and left lobes based on the attachment of its peritoneal ligaments. This term refers to a developmental anomaly characterzied by the underdevelopment of one of the lobes of the liver. This is a rare and usually asymptomatic anomaly that can be detected incidentally on cross sectional imaging with computed tomography or magnetic resonance imaging.

HP_0034183.label: spastic triplegia
HP_0034183.definition: Spastic weakness found in both lower extremities and one upper extremity.

HP_0034184.label: increased insulin like growth factor binding protein acid labile subunit concentration

HP_0034185.label: median pseudocleft lip
HP_0034185.definition: A type of mild median cleft lip in which the central tubercle of the upper lip is replaced by a mucosal cleft in the midline.

HP_0034186.label: patella alta
HP_0034186.definition: Patella alta is a patella that rides abnormally high in relation to the femur, the femoral trochlea, or the tibia, with decreased bony stability requiring increased knee flexion angles to engage the trochlea.

HP_0034187.label: clavicular pseudarthrosis
HP_0034187.definition: A developmental defect in a the clavicule leading to bending and pathologic fracture, with inability to form a normal bony callus with subsequent fibrous nonunion, leading to the pseudarthrosis (or false joint).

HP_0034188.label: midline liver
HP_0034188.definition: Position of the liver across the middle of the body instead of being in its normal position to the right of the stomach.
