HP_0034190.definition: Abnormal functionality of the fetal cardiovascular system.

HP_0034191.label: elevated fetal middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity
HP_0034191.definition: Increased peak systolic velocity of the fetal middle cerebral artery (MCA) as evaluated by Doppler ultrasound.

HP_0034192.label: pulmonary thromboembolism
HP_0034192.definition: Pulmonary embolism is caused by emboli, which have originated from venous thrombi, travelling to and occluding the arteries of the lung.
HP_0034192.UMLS synonyms: Pulmonary Thromboembolisms | Acute pulmonary thromboembolism | Chronic pulmonary thromboembolism | Postoperative pulmonary thromboembolism | pulmonary artery thromboembolism | Chronic pulmonary thromboembolism without pulmonary hypertension | pulmonary (acute) (artery)(vein) thromboembolism | Obstetric blood-clot pulmonary embolism | Chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension | Pulmonary Thromboembolic Disease Associated with Post-Acute Sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 Infection | Group 4: Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension (CTEPH) | LINC01094 gene | PULMONARY HYPERTENSION, CHRONIC THROMBOEMBOLIC, WITHOUT DEEP VEIN THROMBOSIS, SUSCEPTIBILITY TO

HP_0034193.label: stratum basale cleavage
HP_0034193.definition: Cleavage within the epidermal keratinocytes, which is the innermost layer of the epidermis and consists of proliferating cells that give rise to the outer layers of the epidermis.
HP_0034193.synonyms: blistering with cleavage within basal keratinocytes | cleavage within the basal keratinocyte layer

HP_0034194.label: suprabasal cleavage
HP_0034194.definition: Cleavage within the suprabasal cell layer of the epidermis, which lies directly above the basal layer and is composed of five to ten layers of cells.

HP_0034195.label: triggered by muscle relaxant
HP_0034195.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a muscle relaxant such as suxamethonium and mivacurium.

HP_0034196.label: ductus venosus agenesis
HP_0034196.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the ductus venosus (a shunt that allows oxygenated blood in the umbilical vein to bypass the liver in the fetal circulation).

HP_0034197.label: third trimester onset
HP_0034197.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the third trimester, which is defined as 28 weeks and zero days (28+0) of gestation and beyond.
HP_0034197.UMLS synonyms: Rupture of uterus before onset of labor, third trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, onset of labor within 24 hours of rupture, third trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, onset of labor more than 24 hours following rupture, third trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, unspecified as to length of time between rupture and onset of labor, third trimester

HP_0034198.label: second trimester onset
HP_0034198.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth during the second trimester, which comprises the range of gestational ages from 14 0/7 weeks to 27 6/7 (inclusive).
HP_0034198.UMLS synonyms: Rupture of uterus before onset of labor, second trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, onset of labor within 24 hours of rupture, second trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, onset of labor more than 24 hours following rupture, second trimester | Preterm premature rupture of membranes, unspecified as to length of time between rupture and onset of labor, second trimester

HP_0034199.label: late first trimester onset
HP_0034199.definition: This term refers to a phenotypic feature that was first observed prior to birth in the first trimester during the early fetal period, which is defined as 11 0/7 to 13 6/7 weeks of gestation (inclusive).
HP_0034199.synonyms: early fetal onset | early foetal onset

HP_0034200.label: abnormal csf homovanillic acid concentration
HP_0034200.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine.

HP_0034201.label: increased csf homovanillic acid concentration
HP_0034201.definition: Elevated concentration of homovanillic acid (HVA) in the cerebrospinal fluid. HVA is a metabolite of dopamine.

HP_0034203.label: decreased iduronate sulfatase level
HP_0034203.definition: An decreased level of iduronate-2-sulfatase activity in the blood circulation.

HP_0034204.label: decreased circulating c1 - esterase inhibitor concentration
HP_0034204.definition: Decreased concentration of C1-esterase inhibitor (C1INH) in the blood circulation.

HP_0034205.label: iniencephaly
HP_0034205.definition: Iniencephaly is a rare neural tube defect involving dysmorphic spine and abnormal fusion of the portion of the occipital skull with the back. It results in extreme fixed head retroflexion.

HP_0034206.label: abnormal fetal central nervous system morphology
HP_0034206.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal central nervous system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.
HP_0034206.synonyms: abnormal fetal cns morphology | abnormal foetal cns morphology

HP_0034207.label: abnormal fetal gastrointestinal system morphology
HP_0034207.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal gastrointestinal system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.

HP_0034208.label: fetal intracranial hemorrhage
HP_0034208.definition: Abnormal bleeding inside the skull (cranium) of a fetus.
HP_0034208.UMLS synonyms: Fetal subdural intracranial hemorrhage | Fetal nontraumatic intracranial hemorrhage | Fetal extradural intracranial hemorrhage | Fetal non-traumatic intracranial subdural hemorrhage

HP_0034209.label: fetal subependymal hemorrhage
HP_0034209.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage located in the subependymal germinal matrix below the frontal horns of the lateral ventricles in the caudothalamic notch.
HP_0034209.synonyms: grade i fetal intracranial hemorrhage | grade i foetal intracranial haemorrhage

HP_0034210.label: fetal intraventricular hemorrhage
HP_0034210.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the ventricular system of the brain.
HP_0034210.UMLS synonyms: Fetal non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 1 during fetal period | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 2 during fetal period | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 3 during fetal period | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 1 during fetal intrapartum period | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 2 during fetal intrapartum period | Non-traumatic intraventricular hemorrhage grade 3 during fetal intrapartum period

HP_0034211.label: fetal cerebral parenchymal hemorrhage
HP_0034211.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding into the parenchyma (tissue) of the brain.

HP_0034212.label: fetal extra - axial hemorrhage
HP_0034212.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage with bleeding that occurs within the skull but outside of the brain tissue itself (into the epidural, subdural, or arachnoid space).

HP_0034213.label: fetal posterior fossa hemorrhage
HP_0034213.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the posterior cranial fossa, which is the part of the cranial cavity that is located between the foramen magnum and tentorium cerebelli and contains the brainstem and cerebellum.

HP_0034214.label: fetal intraventricular hemorrhage without ventriculomegaly
HP_0034214.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage characterized by clear hemorrhage spillover to the ventricles filling less than 50% of the lateral ventricle and without ventriculomegaly of greater than 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium.
HP_0034214.synonyms: grade ii fetal intracranial hemorrhage | grade ii foetal intracranial haemorrhage

HP_0034215.label: fetal cerebellar hemisphere hemorrhage
HP_0034215.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the hemisphere of the cerebellum.

HP_0034216.label: fetal cerebellar vermis hemorrhage
HP_0034216.definition: A type of fetal intracranial hemorrhage that occurs in the vermis of the cerebellum.

HP_0034217.label: sonographic non - visualized fetal bladder
HP_0034217.definition: Inability to visualize the fetal bladder on targeted prenatal sonography examination. The fetal bladder can be visualized with sonography as a midline, fluid-filled structure in the pelvis as early as 10-12 weeks of gestation. The normal fetus voids at least once an hour but never completely empties the urinary bladder. The fetal bladdder should be consistently imaged after 13 weeks of gestation.

HP_0034218.label: fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with ventriculomegaly
HP_0034218.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) characterized by spillover to ventricles with flooding of 50% or more of one or both lateral ventricles accrued accompanying ventriculomegaly, but with no apparent brain parenchymal injury. This type of IVH may be defined as a diameter exceeding 15 mm in the transverse diameter of the lateral ventricular atrium as visualiuzed by prenatal sonography.
HP_0034218.synonyms: grade iii fetal intracranial hemorrhage | grade iii foetal intracranial haemorrhage

HP_0034219.label: fetal intraventricular hemorrhage with periventricular hemorrhage
HP_0034219.definition: A type of fetal intraventricular hemorrhage that additionally includes hemorrhage in a large part of the periventricular parenchyma.
HP_0034219.synonyms: grade iv fetal intracranial hemorrhage | grade iv foetal intracranial haemorrhage

HP_0034220.label: temporal lobe megalencephaly
HP_0034220.definition: Expansion of the temporal lobes of the brain along all axes, including rostrocaudal, superoinferior, and mediolateral, resulting in a globular appearance of the brain.

HP_0034221.label: abnormal temporal lobe morphology
HP_0034221.definition: An abnormal strcutural of the zone (lobe) of the cerebral cortex that is located inferior to the lateral fissure on other cerebral hemispheres.

HP_0034222.label: temporal lobe dysplasia
HP_0034222.definition: A developmental defect of the temporal lobe of the cerebral cortex that is characterized by prominent sulcations and radially directed gyrations.

HP_0034223.label: elevated umbilical artery pulsatility
HP_0034223.definition: Human umbilical artery (UA) blood flow pulsatility measured by Doppler ultrasound is a widely used biomarker for the detection of elevated placental vascular resistance. Elevated UA pulsatility, which in the most extreme cases manifests as absent or even reversed end-diastolic velocity, is associated with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) and still-birth.
HP_0034223.synonyms: elevated umbilical artery dopplers | increased umbilical artery pulsatility index

HP_0034224.label: absent end - diastolic umbilical artery flow
HP_0034224.definition: An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an absence of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole.

HP_0034225.label: reversed end - diastolic umbilical artery flow
HP_0034225.definition: An anomaly that is visualized by umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry. Flow in the umbilical artery should be in the forward direction in normal circumstances. This anomaly is characterized by an reversal of flow in the umbilical artery at the end of diastole (i.e., backwards flow).

HP_0034226.label: champagne cork sign
HP_0034226.definition: Characteristic appearance of the chest and abdomen in the sagittal view on prenatal ultrasound when the chest is small and the abdomen protruding.

HP_0034227.label: aortic isthmus hypoplasia
HP_0034227.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the isthmus (arch between the left subclavian and insertion of the patent ductus arteriosus/ligamentum arteriosum) has a diameter of less than 40% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.

HP_0034228.label: proximal aortic arch hypoplasia
HP_0034228.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the proximal aortic arch (arch proximal to the origin of the left subclavian artery) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.

HP_0034229.label: distal aortic arch hypoplasia
HP_0034229.definition: A type of aortic arch hypoplasia whereby the distal aortic arch (arch distal to the ductus arteriosus) has a diameter of less than 60% of the diameter of the ascending aorta.
HP_0034229.UMLS synonyms: Aortic arch hypoplasia distal to subclavian artery

HP_0034230.label: inferior crossed fused renal ectopia
HP_0034230.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia characterized by fusion between the upper pole of the cross-fused ectopic kidney (located more inferiorly relative to the other kidney) and the lower pole of the other orthotopic kidney (located in a more superior position).
HP_0034230.synonyms: type a cross fused renal ectopia

HP_0034231.label: sigmoid kidney
HP_0034231.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia where the normal side kidney is present superiorly and the direction of pelvic is medial, the kidney which crosses positioned inferiorly with direction of pelvic toward the lateral side. As kidneys fuse after complete rotation on the vertical axis, both renal pelves lie in correct orientation.
HP_0034231.synonyms: s - shaped kidney | type b cross fused renal ectopia

HP_0034232.label: unilateral lump kidney
HP_0034232.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia where fusion occurs over a wide margin, both renal pelves anteriorly directed and placed more inferiorly.
HP_0034232.synonyms: type c cross fused renal ectopia

HP_0034233.label: disc kidney
HP_0034233.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which kidneys fuse along their medial borders.
HP_0034233.synonyms: type d cross fused renal ectopia

HP_0034234.label: l - shaped kidney
HP_0034234.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the crossed kidney lies inferiorly and transversely, fused with the lower pole of the normal kidney.
HP_0034234.synonyms: tandem kidney | type e cross fused renal ectopia

HP_0034235.label: superior crossed - fused renal ectopia
HP_0034235.definition: A type of cross fused renal ectopia in which the ectopic kidney lies superiorly and its lower pole fuses with the upper pole of the normal kidney. The renal pelvis of both kidneys lies anteriorly.

HP_0034236.label: apnea of prematurity
HP_0034236.definition: Recurrent episodes of apnea occurring in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation, defined specifically as a pause of breathing for more than 15-20 s, or accompanied by oxygen desaturation (SpO2 not more than 80% for at least 4 s) and bradycardia (heart rate less than 2/3 of baseline for at least 4 s), in infants born less than 37 weeks of gestation.
HP_0034236.UMLS synonyms: Apnea of prematurity | Primary central sleep apnea of prematurity | Primary apnea of premature newborns

HP_0034237.label: open neural tube defect
HP_0034237.definition: A type of neural tube defect that is not covered by skin.
HP_0034237.UMLS synonyms: Maternal screen for fetal abnormalities such as Open Neural Tube Defects, Trisomy 21 or Trisomy 18 panel | Maternal screen for fetal abnormalities such as Open Neural Tube Defects, Trisomy 21 or Trisomy 18 panel:-:Pt:Ser/Plas:- | maternal screen for fetal abnormalities such as open neural tube defects, trisomy 21 or trisomy 18 panel in serum or plasma | Maternal screen for fetal abnormalities such as Open Neural Tube Defects, Trisomy 21 or Trisomy 18 panel | Serum or Plasma | Chemistry Panels

HP_0034238.label: closed neural tube defect
HP_0034238.definition: A type of neural tube defect that is covered by skin.

HP_0034239.label: renal vein thrombosis
HP_0034239.definition: The presence of a thrombus (blood clot) in the major renal veins or its tributaries, generally leading to passive congestion that develops causes the affected kidney to swell and become engorged, leading to degeneration of nephrons and causing symptoms of flank pain, hematuria, and decreased urine output.
HP_0034239.UMLS synonyms: Thrombosis of renal vein | Transplant renal vein thrombosis | Thrombosis of left renal vein | Thrombosis of right renal vein | Embolism and thrombosis of the renal vein | Renal Vein or Vena Cava Thrombosis or Other Coagulopathies | Thrombosis of bilateral renal veins

HP_0034240.label: fetal neck mass
HP_0034240.definition: An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue in the neck region of a fetus. Masses may be simple cystic,, cystic with a few simple septations (fewer than three septations and less than 3-mm thick), cystic with multiple or thick septations (greater than three septations or septations 3-mm-thick or more), a mass that is than is less than 50% solid, and a mass that is 50% solid or more.

HP_0034241.label: prenatal death
HP_0034241.definition: Death of a fetus in the uterus.
HP_0034241.UMLS synonyms: Fetal Death | Stillborn or infantile death usual in prenatal form | visit for: prenatal exam with history of neonatal death

HP_0034242.label: abnormal fetal genitourinary system morphology
HP_0034242.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal genitourinary system. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.

HP_0034243.label: abnormal fetal pulmonary morphology
HP_0034243.definition: An anomalous structural finding of the fetal lungs. Terms in this subhierarchy are restricted to findings that can only be observed in the prenatal period. Other HPO terms can also be used to describe fetal phenotypes.

HP_0034244.label: gastric pseudomass
HP_0034244.definition: At US examination from the second trimester onward, the fetal stomach appears as a uniformly anechoic, sharply circumscribed round structure in the left upper quadrant. However, debris is commonly visualized in the stomach, forming a pseudomass.

HP_0034245.label: fetal head anomaly
HP_0034245.UMLS synonyms: Congenital anomaly of fetal head bones

HP_0034246.label: fetal scalp mass
HP_0034246.definition: An abnormal growth (lump) of tissue that projects from the fetal scalp.

HP_0034247.label: fetal lower urinary tract obstruction
HP_0034247.definition: An obstruction in the ureter leading to bladder outlet obstruction. Special criteria are used for lower urinary tract obstruction (LUTO) in the fetus. Prenatal LUTO has classically been suspected on the basis of three ultrasonographic findings: megacystis, dilated posterior urethra (known as the keyhole sign) and hydronephrosis.
HP_0034247.UMLS synonyms: Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction | Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction due to atresia of urethra | Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction due to anterior urethral valve | Fetal lower urinary tract obstruction due to posterior urethral valve

HP_0034248.label: increased fetal lens echogenicity
HP_0034248.definition: Increased echogenicity (increased brightness in the gray-scale sonography image) of the lens of a fetus.

HP_0034249.label: severe influenza infection
HP_0034249.definition: An unusually severe infection by an influenza virus.
HP_0034249.UMLS synonyms: Infectious disease (viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific RNA, 3 targets (severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 [SARS-CoV-2], influenza A, influenza B), upper respiratory specimen, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected | Infectious disease (viral respiratory tract infection), pathogen-specific RNA, 4 targets (severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 [SARS-CoV-2], influenza A, influenza B, respiratory syncytial virus [RSV]), upper respiratory specimen, each pathogen reported as detected or not detected

HP_0034250.label: fetal nuchal edema
HP_0034250.definition: Nuchal edema is considered present in a fetus at gestational week 14 or more if in the midsagittal plane of the neck, there is subcutaneous edema that produces a characteristic tremor on ballotment of the fetal head. This constitutes the severe end of the spectrum of increased nuchal fold thickness, which is defined as soft-tissue thickening of 6 mm or more, seen in the suboccipitobregmatic view of the fetal head. Nuchal edema may be confined to the neck or it may be generalized, as part of hydrops fetalis.

HP_0034251.label: abnormal corneal reflex
HP_0034251.definition: An anomaly of the corneal reflex that normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea.
HP_0034251.UMLS synonyms: Abnormal corneal reflex | Corneal light reflex test abnormal

HP_0034252.label: absent corneal reflex
HP_0034252.definition: Absence of the corneal blinking reflex, which normally induces involuntary blinking of the eyelids following contact of the cornea. The corneal blink reflex is caused by a loop between the trigeminal sensory nerves and the facial motor (VII) nerve innervation of the orbicularis oculi muscles.
HP_0034252.UMLS synonyms: Reflex, Corneal, Absent | Left corneal reflex absent | Right corneal reflex absent | Reflex corneal diminished absent | Absent corneal reflex response | CRANIAL DYSINNERVATION DISORDER, CONGENITAL, WITH ABSENT CORNEAL REFLEX AND DEVELOPMENTAL DELAY | Decreased or absent corneal reflexes

HP_0034253.label: eosinophil nuclear hypersegmentation
HP_0034253.definition: An excessive division of the lobes of the nucleus of eosinophils. Eosinophils with more than two nuclear lobes are commonly regarded as hypersegmented, because seventy to ninety percent of peripheral blood eosinophils have two nuclear lobes.
HP_0034253.UMLS synonyms: Eosinophil nuclear hypersegmentation, hypogranulation, and negative peroxidase and phospholipid staining

HP_0034254.label: face of the giant panda sign
HP_0034254.definition: The face of the giant panda sign on T2-weighted MRI is characterized by preservation of normal signal intensity in the red nuclei and lateral portion of the pars reticulata of the substantia nigra, high signal in the tegmentum, and hypointensity of the superior colliculus. The findings are said to resemble the face of a giant panda.

HP_0034255.label: colovesical fistula
HP_0034255.definition: An aberrant, pathological communication between the colon and the bladder.

HP_0034256.label: absent dermoepidermal hemidesmosomes
HP_0034256.definition: Lack of demonstrable hemidesmosomes at the dermoepidermal junction. Hemidesmosomes are the specialized junctional complexes, that contribute to the attachment of epithelial cells to the underlying basement membrane in stratified and other complex epithelia, such as the skin.

HP_0034257.label: c4 nephritic factor positivity
HP_0034257.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that recognize C4b2a, the C3 convertase of the classical pathway of complement.

HP_0034258.label: aplasia / hypoplasia of the midbrain
HP_0034258.definition: Absence or underdevelopment of the midbrain (mesencephalon).

HP_0034259.label: hypoplasia of the midbrain
HP_0034259.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the mesencephalon.
HP_0034259.synonyms: hypoplasia of the mesencephalon | hypoplastic mesencephalon
HP_0034259.UMLS synonyms: Hypoplasia of the pons and midbrain

HP_0034260.label: aplastic zygomatic arch
HP_0034260.definition: Developmental defect characterized by the absence of the zygomatic arch.

HP_0034261.label: aplasia / hypoplasia of facial bones
HP_0034261.definition: A developmental defect characterized by absence or underdevelopment of one or more facial bone.

HP_0034262.label: absent lanugo
HP_0034262.definition: Lack of development of lanugo, the fine, soft, unpigmented hair on the body of a fetus or newborn baby.
HP_0034262.UMLS synonyms: Sparse/absent lanugo | lanugo hair mostly absent | lanugo hair totally absent | Sparse to absent lanugo-like scalp hair

HP_0034263.label: abnormal vaginal bleeding
HP_0034263.definition: Abnormal vaginal bleeding occurs between menstrual periods, after sex, or after menopause. Menstrual periods that are heavier or last longer than usual or last more than seven days also are considered abnormal.
HP_0034263.UMLS synonyms: Abnormal vaginal bleeding | abnormal bleeding/vaginal discharge | Other abnormal uterine and vaginal bleeding | Abnormal uterine and vaginal bleeding, unspecified | Other specified abnormal uterine and vaginal bleeding

HP_0034264.label: postcoital vaginal bleeding
HP_0034264.definition: Postcoital bleeding (PCB) consists of spotting or bleeding after sexual intercourse that is not related to a person's menstrual cycle.

HP_0034265.label: mastalgia
HP_0034265.UMLS synonyms: Mastodynia | BREAST PAIN FEMALE | Cyclical mastalgia | Mastalgia male | Persistent mastalgia | female mastalgia | Mastalgia, primary | Mastalgia of puberty | Trigger point mastalgia | Non-cyclical mastalgia | Pain of left breast | Pain of right breast | Premenstrual breast pain

HP_0034267.label: pelvic pain
HP_0034267.definition: Pain perceived in the area of the pelvis, the lower part of the abdomen located between the hip bones.
HP_0034267.UMLS synonyms: Pelvic Pain | Pelvic pain female | male pelvic pain | pelvic pain in front | pelvic pain decreasing in severity | pelvic pain to the rear | pelvic pain increasing in frequency | pelvic pain increasing in severity | pelvic pain occurs with intercourse | pelvic pain decreasing in frequency | pelvic pain occurs with urination | pelvic pain on the left | pelvic pain on the right | pelvic pain occurs with bowel movement | pelvic pain causes awakening at night | Pelvic Girdle Pain | Acute pelvic pain | Bony pelvic pain | Pelvic Pain, CTCAE_5 | Cyclic pelvic pain | Pelvic bone pain | Premenstrual pelvic pain | Pelvic pain, severe | unrelenting pelvic pain | menstrual pelvic pain

HP_0034269.label: abnormal vaginal discharge
HP_0034269.definition: Anomalous amount, odor, or consistency of the fluid or mucus that comes from the vagina
HP_0034269.UMLS synonyms: Abnormal Vaginal Discharge | abnormal bleeding/vaginal discharge | Observe for presence of abnormal vaginal discharge, odor, itching, or vaginal color change | Vaginal discharge abnormality

HP_0034270.label: serrated incisors
HP_0034270.definition: Incisor teeth with irregular edges said to resemble a saw.

HP_0034271.label: copper beaten skull
HP_0034271.definition: Diffuse prominent gyral impressions on the inner table of skull vault said to resemble beaten copper.

HP_0034272.label: perifoveal hypoautofluorescence
HP_0034272.definition: Decreased amount of autofluorescence (emission of fluorescent light from ocular structures in the absence of sodium fluorescein) in the retina in the region surrounding the fovea.

HP_0034273.label: premature sagging cheeks
HP_0034273.definition: Drooping or sinking of tissues of the cheeks more than would be expected at a given age. Sagging can occur due to a relative excess of skin and/or lack of elastic recoil as well as fat accumulation.

HP_0034274.label: gastrointestinal ulcer
HP_0034274.definition: A deep defect in the esophageal, gastric, duodenal or intestinal wall involving the entire mucosal thickness and penetrating through the muscularis mucosae.
HP_0034274.UMLS synonyms: Gastrointestinal ulcer | Gastrointestinal Ulcer, CTCAE | Gastrointestinal ulcer haemorrhage | Gastrointestinal ulcer management | Cytomegalovirus gastrointestinal ulcer | Gastrointestinal ulcer perforation | Prophylaxis against gastrointestinal ulcer | Hemorrhage from gastrointestinal ulcer | Gastrointestinal anastomotic ulcer due to Crohn disease | gastrointestinal ulcer (peptic) or erosion | Peptic Ulcer | Curling Ulcer | Gastrointestinal perforation, ulcer, haemorrhage, obstruction non-specific findings/procedures (SMQ) | Peptic ulcer with obstruction | Ulcerative gastrointestinal mucositis | Gastrointestinal ulceration (SMQ) | Gastrointestinal ulceration due to sepsis | Gastrointestinal ulcers and perforation, site unspecified | Mucosal ulceration of the gastrointestinal tract | Gastrointestinal perforation, ulceration, haemorrhage or obstruction (SMQ) | systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) related gastrointestinal ulceration | Cytosolic phospholipase-A2 alpha deficiency associated bleeding disorder | Assist with diagnostic tests and assessments to rule out conditions with similar signs and symptoms (e.g., acute myocardial infarction; pericarditis; aortic dissection; pneumonia; pneumothorax; anxiety with hyperventilation; asthma; heart failure; pericardial tamponade; and gastrointestinal abnormalities such as peptic ulcer, esophageal rupture, gastritis) | Documentation of medical reason(s) for a colonoscopy performed on a patient greater than or equal to 86 years of age (e.g., iron deficiency anemia, lower gastrointestinal bleeding, crohn's disease (i.e., regional enteritis), familial history of adenomatous polyposis, lynch syndrome (i.e., hereditary non-polyposis colorectal cancer), inflammatory bowel disease, ulcerative colitis, abnormal finding of gastrointestinal tract, or changes in bowel habits) | Patients greater than or equal to 86 years of age who underwent a screening colonoscopy and did not have a history of colorectal cancer or other valid medical reason for the colonoscopy, including: iron deficiency anemia, lower gastrointestinal bleeding, crohn's disease (i.e., regional enteritis), familial adenomatous polyposis, lynch syndrome (i.e., hereditary non-polyposis colorectal cancer), inflammatory bowel disease, ulcerative colitis, abnormal finding of gastrointestinal tract, or changes in bowel habits

HP_0034275.label: verrucous epidermal nevus
HP_0034275.definition: A type of epidermal nevus (which represent Blaschkoid hamartomas of the skin that result from mosaic post-zygotic mutations) that appears as skin-colored-to-brown, sharply demarcated, papillomatous papules that coalesce into plaques. The majority of these nevi are either present at birth or occur within the first year of life.
HP_0034275.UMLS synonyms: Verrucous epidermal nevus | Linear Verrucous Epidermal Nevus | Inflammatory linear verrucous epidermal nevus | Nevus Sebaceus of Jadassohn | Organoid Nevus Phakomatosis | Epidermolytic epidermal nevus

HP_0034276.label: elevated circulating thymidine concentration
HP_0034276.definition: Concentration of thymidine in the blood circulation above the normal range.

HP_0034277.label: elevated circulating deoxyuridine concentration
HP_0034277.definition: Concentration of 2-deoxyuridine in the blood circulation is above the normal range.

HP_0034278.label: multinucleated erythroblast
HP_0034278.definition: Erythroblasts with multiple nuclei. Erythroblasts are nucleated precrusor cells of erythrocytes that are localized to the bone marrow. Normally, erythroblasts have a single nucleus. The abnormal finding of erythrocytes with two or more nuclei may be related to defects in cytokinesis.
HP_0034278.synonyms: binucleated erythroblast | bone marrow : multinucleated erythroblasts | double - nucleated erythroblast | multinucleate erythroblast
HP_0034278.UMLS synonyms: Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia, type III | Multinucleated erythroblasts on bone marrow biopsy | Multinucleated erythroblasts seen on bone marrow biopsy

HP_0034279.label: 2,8 - dihydroxyadenine crystalluria
HP_0034279.definition: The presence of 2,8-dihydroxyadenine crystals in the urine. The crystals appear as round, yellow-brown crystals.

HP_0034280.label: target cells
HP_0034280.definition: Target cells (codocytes) have a centrally located disk of hemoglobin surrounded by an area of pallor with an outer rim of hemoglobin adjacent to the cell membrane giving the cell the appearance of a target.

HP_0034281.label: phalangeal cone - shaped epiphyses
HP_0034281.definition: Cone-shaped epiphyses of the phalanges of the hands or feet. Cone-shaped epiphyses (also known as coned epiphyses) are epiphyses that invaginate into cupped metaphyses. That is, the epiphysis has a cone-shaped distal extension resulting from increased growth of the central portion of the epiphysis relative to its periphery.
HP_0034281.synonyms: cone - shaped epiphyses of phalanges | cone - shaped phalangeal epiphyses

HP_0034282.label: subcutaneous ossification
HP_0034282.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the soft tissue beneath the skin. Subcutaneous ossifications may be observed by radiography or by palpation.

HP_0034283.label: increased fecal protoporphyrin concentration
HP_0034283.definition: Abnormally high concentration of protoporphyrin (derivative of porphyrin with propionic acid groups) in feces.

HP_0034284.label: recurrent gingivitis
HP_0034284.definition: Repeated occurrences of inflammatory condition of the gums (gingival tissue), most commonly caused by bacterial infection.

HP_0034285.label: enteroviral encephalitis
HP_0034285.definition: Inflamation of the brain related to infection by an enterovirus.

HP_0034286.label: pneumocystis carinii pneumonia
HP_0034286.definition: Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia is an opportunistic infection that occurs in immunosuppressed populations.
HP_0034286.UMLS synonyms: Acute pneumocystis carinii pneumonia | Pneumonia, particularly pneumocystis carinii | Pneumocystis jiroveci pneumonia | HIV disease resulting in Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia | Aerosol inhalation of pentamidine for pneumocystis carinii pneumonia treatment or prophylaxis

HP_0034287.label: afibrinogenemia
HP_0034287.definition: Lack of detectable fibrinogen in the blood circulation.
HP_0034287.UMLS synonyms: Afibrinogenemia | Acquired afibrinogenemia | Afibrinogenemia - postpartum | abortion; afibrinogenemia | puerperium; afibrinogenemia | Miscarriage with afibrinogenemia | Antepartum hemorrhage with afibrinogenemia | afibrinogenemia; molar pregnancy | afibrinogenemia; intrapartum hemorrhage | afibrinogenemia; ectopic pregnancy | Postpartum afibrinogenemia with hemorrhage | Illegal abortion with afibrinogenemia | Legal abortion with afibrinogenemia | Afibrinogenemia following molar pregnancy | Afibrinogenemia following ectopic pregnancy | placenta abruption with afibrinogenemia | afibrinogenemia; hemorrhage, complicating delivery | Congenital hypofibrinogenemia | Parturient hemorrhage associated with afibrinogenemia | Placental abruption due to afibrinogenemia | intrapartum hemorrhage due to afibrinogenemia | abortion; attempted, complicated by afibrinogenemia | Afibrinogenemia following incomplete spontaneous abortion | Failed attempted termination of pregnancy with afibrinogenemia | hemorrhage; complicating delivery, coagulation defect, afibrinogenemia

HP_0034288.label: elevated circulating reverse t3 concentration
HP_0034288.definition: Abnormally increased concentration of reverse T3 (3,3',5'-triiodothyronine or rT3) in the blood circulation.
HP_0034288.synonyms: elevated circulating reverse triiodothyronine concentration | elevated rt3

HP_0034289.label: elevated circulating rt3 / t3 ratio
HP_0034289.definition: An abnormally increased ratio of the concentrations of reverse T3 to T3 in the blood circulation.

HP_0034290.label: elevated circulating tiglylglycine concentration
HP_0034290.definition: Concentration of tiglylglycine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034291.label: elevated circulating creatine concentration
HP_0034291.definition: An elevation above the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation.

HP_0034292.label: reduced circulating creatine concentration
HP_0034292.definition: An reduction below the normal range of creatine in the blood circulation.

HP_0034293.label: temporal lobe calcification
HP_0034293.definition: The presence of calcium deposition within the temporal lobe of the brain.
HP_0034293.UMLS synonyms: computed tomography of head: calcification of temporal lobe | computed tomography of brain: calcification of left temporal lobe | computed tomography of brain: calcification of right temporal lobe | Intracranial calcifications in the anterior mesial temporal lobes

HP_0034294.label: ductal bile plugs
HP_0034294.definition: Bile thrombi that form an obstruction (plug) in a dilated bile duct.

HP_0034295.label: reduced cerebral white matter volume
HP_0034295.definition: An abnormally low volume of the white matter of the brain.

HP_0034297.label: elevated circulating tetracosanoic acid concentration
HP_0034297.definition: Elevated concentration of tetracosanoic acid (a C24 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation.

HP_0034298.label: elevated circulating hexacosanoic acid concentration
HP_0034298.definition: Elevated concentration of hexacosanoic acid (a C26 straight-chain saturated fatty acid) in the blood circulation.

HP_0034299.label: sertoli cell - only phenotype
HP_0034299.definition: A histological phenotype observed on testicular biopsy in which only Sertoli cells line the seminiferous tubules of the testis.

HP_0034300.label: decreased acid sphingomyelinase activity
HP_0034300.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme acid sphingomyelinase activity in the blood circulation.

HP_0034301.label: congenital pouch colon
HP_0034301.definition: A malformation of the colon in which a pouch-like dilatation of a varying degree of shortened colon is associated with an anorectal malformation. The pouch usually terminates in a fistulous communication with the genitourinary tract.

HP_0034302.label: megalopapilla
HP_0034302.definition: A congenitally anomalous enlarged optic disk (surface area greater than 2.50 square millimeters). It is considered to be a normal variant without physiological defects.

HP_0034303.label: notched t wave
HP_0034303.definition: A bifid T-wave with a notch duration between the 2 peaks at leasy 0.04 sec and an amplitude at least 0.05 mV.

HP_0034304.label: epsilon wave
HP_0034304.definition: An electric signal of depolarization observed between the end of the QRS complex and the beginning of the T wave.

HP_0034305.label: 2:1 atrioventricular block
HP_0034305.definition: A type of second-degree atrioventricular block in which every other P wave is not conducted through the AV node such that only every other P wave is followed by a QRS complex.
HP_0034305.UMLS synonyms: 2:1 atrioventricular block | 2:1 Atrioventricular Block by ECG Finding | ECG: partial atrioventricular block - 2:1 | Atrioventricular block, 2:1, on ECG | Atrioventricular node block, 2:1, intermittent | Mobitz type I incomplete atrioventricular block | Mobitz type I atrioventricular block with 2:1 atrioventricular response | interim stress electrocardiogram atrioventricular block second degree 2:1 block | electrocardiogram: second degree atrioventricular block with 2:1 conduction 2:1 | stress test electrocardiogram: 2:1 atrioventricular block at rest | continuous electrocardiogram second degree atrioventricular block with 2:1 conduction | stress test electrocardiogram: 2:1 atrioventricular block at peak response

HP_0034306.label: ventricular bigeminy
HP_0034306.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of a normal QRS followed by a premature ventricular contraction; a rhythmic pairing of normal and atypical beats originating in the ventricles in a 1-1 ratio such that an ectopic ventricular beat follows each regular heartbeat.
HP_0034306.UMLS synonyms: Ventricular bigeminy | Ventricular Bigeminy by ECG Finding | Extrasystole ventricular bigeminy | VENTRICULAR ECTOPY BIGEMINY | Junctional escape ventricular capture bigeminy | VENTRICULAR ECTOPY BIGEMINY NEW ONSET

HP_0034307.label: elevated left ventricular end - diastolic diameter
HP_0034307.definition: The LV end-diastolic internal diameter was measured from two-dimensional (2D) images in the parasternal long-axis view, timed with mitral valve closure at the level of the mitral valve chordae.

HP_0034308.label: prolonged p wave
HP_0034308.definition: Abnormal increased in the duration of the P wave, which is a marker of delayed inter-atrial conduction.
HP_0034308.UMLS synonyms: Prolonged P wave | Monitor for signs and symptoms of hypercalcemia: deep bone pain; excessive thirst; anorexia; lethargy; weakened muscles; shortened QT segment; wide T wave; widened QRS complex; and prolonged P-R interval | Prolongation of P-wave on ECG in heterozygous carriers

HP_0034309.label: multiflagellar spermatozoa
HP_0034309.definition: Spermatozoa with multiple flagella attached to the sperm head.
HP_0034309.UMLS synonyms: Male Infertility with Large-Headed, Multiflagellar, Polyploid Spermatozoa

HP_0034310.label: post - vaccination yellow fever
HP_0034310.definition: Infection with the yellow fever virus of the live-attenuated vaccine.

HP_0034311.label: hypoplastic optic chiasm
HP_0034311.definition: Developmental defect characterized by undergrowth of the optic chiasm.

HP_0034312.label: nocturnal hypoxemia
HP_0034312.definition: Abnormally reduced oxyhemoglobin saturation during sleep (nocturnal). Different thresholds are used in the literature, including more than 10 percent of total sleep time below a SpO2 of 90 percent.

HP_0034313.label: hyperdynamic left ventricular ejection fraction
HP_0034313.definition: An abnoramlly increased ejection fraction of the left ventricle, usually defined as a left ventricular ejection fraction greater than 70 percent.

HP_0034314.label: abnormal left ventricular ejection fraction
HP_0034314.definition: Any abnormality of the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF), which is the fraction of chamber volume ejected in systole (stroke volume) in relation to the volume of the blood in the ventricle at the end of diastole (end-diastolic volume). Stroke volume (SV) is calculated as the difference between end-diastolic volume (EDV) and end-systolic volume (ESV). LVEF is calculated as [SV/EDV] in percent.

HP_0034315.label: chronic cough
HP_0034315.definition: A persistent cough, defined as a cough lasting longer than eight weeks in adults or longer than four weeks in children.
HP_0034315.UMLS synonyms: Chronic Cough | Chronic refractory cough | Unexplained chronic cough | Chronic wet-cough | constant chronic cough | recurrent chronic cough | chronic smokers cough | COUGH CHRONIC NONPRODUCTIVE | COUGH CHRONIC PRODUCTIVE | chronic difficulty breathing preceded by chronic cough | chronic cough gradually getting worse | sudden exacerbation of chronic cough | chronic cough with no change | chronic cough lasting more than three months per year for over two years | Cough, chronic, paroxysmal, triggered by noxious odors or pressure in the external auditory canal | Encourage persons with respiratory infections or chronic pulmonary diseases to deep breathe and cough every 2 hours while awake | chronic coughing up blood | Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) symptoms assessed (Includes assessment of at least 1 of the following: dyspnea, cough/sputum, wheezing), or respiratory symptom assessment tool completed (COPD)

HP_0034316.label: thinning of the substantia nigra pars compacta
HP_0034316.definition: Reduced volume of pars compacta of the substantia nigra.

HP_0034318.label: unusual virus reactivation
HP_0034318.definition: Reactivation is the mechanism whereby a latent virus that has infected a host cell switches to a lytic stage, undergoing productive viral replication and allowing the virus to spread. This term refers to reactivation regarded as unusual because of frequency, intensity, location, or nature of the virus, in the sense that the reactivation would not be observed in an immunocompetent host.

HP_0034319.label: cns vasculitis with reactivation of varicella - zoster virus
HP_0034319.definition: A vasculopathy in the central nervous system (CNS) following reactivation of varicella-zoster virus due to a productive viral infection of both large and small cerebral arteries.

HP_0034320.label: muscle fiber intracytoplasmic reducing inclusion bodies
HP_0034320.definition: Intracytoplasmic inclusions in myofibers that reduce nitro-blue tetrazolium (NBT) and thus stain strongly with the menadione-NBT stain.

HP_0034321.label: elevated circulating guanidinoacetic acid concentration
HP_0034321.definition: Concentration of guanidinoacetic acid in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034323.label: reduced circulating growth hormone concentration
HP_0034323.definition: Concentration of growth hormone in the blood circulation below normal limits.

HP_0034324.label: brachiocephalic artery aneurysm
HP_0034324.definition: An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the brachiocephalic artery
HP_0034324.synonyms: dilatated brachiocephalic artery | innominate artery aneurysm

HP_0034325.label: common carotid artery aneurysm
HP_0034325.definition: An abnormal widening (dilatation) of the common carotid artery.
HP_0034325.UMLS synonyms: Aneurysm of common carotid artery | Aneurysm of right common carotid artery | Aneurysm of left common carotid artery | aneurysm of external common carotid artery | aneurysm of right external common carotid artery | aneurysm of left external common carotid artery

HP_0034326.label: adenomyosis
HP_0034326.definition: Inappropriate (ectopic) endometrial tissue proliferation within the uterine myometrium, often presenting clinically with painful menses and heavy menstrual bleeding.
HP_0034326.UMLS synonyms: Adenomyosis | Endometriosis of uterus | endometriosis adenomyosis | Adenomyosis of fallopian tube | Abnormal uterine bleeding due to adenomyosis | Adenomyoma of gallbladder | Endometriosis of fallopian tube

HP_0034327.label: posterior corneal stroma punctiform multicolored opacities
HP_0034327.definition: Thin, punctiform elements of various colors in the posterior stroma of the cornea, immediately anterior to Descemet membrane. The elements are visible to direct and indirect illumination.
HP_0034327.synonyms: punctiform multicolored opacities in the posterior corneal stroma | punctiform multicoloured opacities in the posterior corneal stroma
HP_0034327.UMLS synonyms: Punctiform multicolored opacities in posterior corneal stroma (just anterior to Descemet membrane)

HP_0034328.label: fibro - obliterative bile - duct lesion
HP_0034328.definition: A condition in which the lumen of a bile duct has been filled by fibrous scar material, in effect replacing the bile duct with a fibrous scar.
HP_0034328.synonyms: fibro - obliterative bile - duct scarring | fibro - obliterative loss of bile ducts

HP_0034329.label: dysplastic megalencephaly
HP_0034329.definition: A congenital brain malformation characterized by marked overgrowth and dysplasia affecting one or both cerebral hemispheres, and, in some cases, subcortical brain regions as well. The presence of dysplasia in dysplastic megalencephaly distinguishes it from other forms of generalized megalencephaly.

HP_0034330.label: regional right ventricular hypokinesis
HP_0034330.definition: Decreased range of right ventricular motion in a portion of the right ventricle of the heart.

HP_0034331.label: mcconnell sign
HP_0034331.definition: Severe hypokinesia of the mid-free wall of the right ventricle of the heart with a normal contraction of the apical segment of the right ventricle.

HP_0034332.label: cognitive regression
HP_0034332.definition: Loss of cognitive developmental skills, as manifested by loss of developmental cognitive milestones.
HP_0034332.UMLS synonyms: Cognitive regression, mild | Infantile-onset mesial temporal lobe epilepsy with severe cognitive regression | Childhood-onset motor and cognitive regression syndrome with extrapyramidal movement disorder

HP_0034333.label: increased circulating hypoxanthine concentration
HP_0034333.definition: Elevated concentration of hypoxanthine in the blood circulation.

HP_0034335.label: inheritance qualifier
HP_0034335.definition: The terms in this hierarchy can be used to specificy the context in which inheritance of a disease is typically observed.
HP_0034335.UMLS synonyms: Inheritance types | X-linked inheritance | Autosomal dominant inheritance | Autosomal recessive inheritance

HP_0034336.label: splenic infarction
HP_0034336.definition: Ischemia and necrosis of part or all of the spleen resulting from compromise of blood supply resulting from arterial or venous occlusion.
HP_0034336.synonyms: spleen infarct | spleen infarction | splenic infarct

HP_0034337.label: claw hand deformity
HP_0034337.definition: An abnormality of the hand characterized by metacarpophalangeal (MCP) hyperextension and proximal interphalangeal (PIP) and distal interphalangeal (DIP) flexion. The position of the affected hand is said to resemble a claw.
HP_0034337.UMLS synonyms: Claw hand deformity | HAND DEFORMITY CLAW HAND | Congenital cleft hand (disorder) | lobster claw deformity of left hand | lobster claw deformity of right hand | Acquired claw hand | Acquired left claw hand | Acquired right claw hand | Left split hand | Right split hand | lobster-claw both hands | lobster claw deformity of both hands

HP_0034338.label: imprinted
HP_0034338.definition: Requires that the abnormal allele be paternal or maternal in origin, depending on the disease-gene relationship. Imprinting refers to a normal developmental process in which either the paternal or maternal allele is inactivated, depending on the specific locus, thus leading to expression from only one copy of the gene. Disease typically manifests when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be expressed, but not when a deleterious variant is inherited from a parent whose copy of the gene would normally be inactivated.
HP_0034338.UMLS synonyms: Imprinted | Imprinting (Psychology) | Imprinted Protein | Molecularly Imprinted Polymers | Zinc Finger Imprinted 2 | Imprinting Gene | H19 Imprinted Maternal Untranslated mRNA | maintenance of DNA methylation at imprinted genes | ZIM2 gene | COPG2IT1 gene | ZIM3 gene | Universal Donor Expanded TGF-beta-imprinted NK Cells | H19 gene | SLC22A18 gene | PHLDA2 gene | SLC22A18 protein, human | IPW gene | IRAIN gene | HYMAI gene | MEG8 gene | Impact protein, mouse | MIMT1 gene | Tumor Suppressing Subtransferable Candidate 3 Protein | ZIM2 wt Allele | ZIM2 protein, human

HP_0034339.label: pseudoautosomal inheritance
HP_0034339.definition: A pattern of inheritance observed for alleles in the X-Y identical regions is referred to as pseudoautosomal inheritance, because it resembles the pattern seen for alleles located on autosomes.

HP_0034340.label: pseudoautosomal dominant inheritance
HP_0034340.definition: A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is dominant and in which heterozygous males and females both manifest a disease phenotype.

HP_0034341.label: pseudoautosomal recessive inheritance
HP_0034341.definition: A type of pseudoautosomal inheritance that is recessive and in which biallelic males and females both manifest a disease phenotype.

HP_0034342.label: trapezius muscle aplasia
HP_0034342.definition: A developmental defect characterized by lack of formation of the trapezius muscle, which is broad superficial muscle that extends from the posterior neck to the posterior part of the trunk (thorax).

HP_0034343.label: requires heterozygosity
HP_0034343.definition: A rarely encountered phenomenon in which condition is most severe in the heterozygous state. Such disorders are rare and currently all are X-linked. Most X-linked recessive conditions manifest if hemizygous in males, or biallelic in females, though may have a mild phenotype in the heterozygous state in females.

HP_0034344.label: female - limited expression
HP_0034344.definition: Used to refer to a monogenic trait linked to an autosomal locus in which the phenotypic effects of allelic differences are expressed only in the female sex.

HP_0034345.label: mendelian inheritance
HP_0034345.definition: A mode of inheritance of diseases whose pathophysiology can be traced back to deleterious variants in a single gene. The inheritance patterns of these single-gene (monogenic) diseases are often referred to as Mendelian in honor of Gregor Mendel.
HP_0034345.UMLS synonyms: Online Mendelian Inheritance In Man | Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man, 2024_08_09 | online mendelian inheritance in man (OMIM ) database

HP_0034346.label: nesidioblastosis
HP_0034346.definition: An abnormality of pancreatic beta cells characterized by a proliferation of abnormal beta cells throughout the entire pancreas, with enlarged islet size and number (hypertrophic islets), increased periductular islets, enlarged beta-cell nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm. Occasionally beta cells with pleomorphic nuclei, ductuloinsular complexes, and neoformation of islets from ducts are observed.
HP_0034346.UMLS synonyms: Nesidioblastosis | Congenital Hyperinsulinism | Nesidioblastosis of Pancreas Gene Anomaly Detection Reagents | Familial Hyperinsulinism with Pancreatic Nesidioblastosis Gene Anomaly Detection Reagents

HP_0034347.label: greater auricular nerve thickening
HP_0034347.definition: Increase in thickness of the great auricular nerve, a cutaneous nerve of the head. It originates from the cervical plexus, with branches of spinal nerves C2 and C3. Thickening may lead to the nerve being palpable or even visible in this region.

HP_0034348.label: subpulmonary stenosis
HP_0034348.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately below the pulmonary valve.
HP_0034348.synonyms: infundibular pulmonary stenosis | infundibular pulmonic stenosis | subvalvar pulmonary stenosis | subvalvar pulmonic stenosis | subvalvular pulmonary stenosis | subvalvular pulmonic stenosis
HP_0034348.UMLS synonyms: Subpulmonary stenosis | Infundibular pulmonic stenosis | Acquired stenosis of subpulmonary area | Subpulmonary stenosis as complication of procedure | Acquired subpulmonary stenosis associated with functionally univentricular heart | repair of transposition of great arteries in presence of ventricular septal defect and subpulmonary stenosis | Taussig-Bing Anomaly | Subpulmonary stenosis associated with functionally univentricular heart as complication of procedure | Acquired subpulmonary stenosis due to restrictive ventricular defect associated with functionally univentricular heart | Congenital subpulmonary stenosis due to restrictive ventricular defect associated with functionally univentricular heart | Repair of transposition of great arteries with ventricular septal defect and subpulmonary stenosis | repair of transposition of great arteries with subpulmonic stenosis, with ventricular septal defect enlargement | Repair of transposition of the great arteries with ventricular septal defect and subpulmonary stenosis; with surgical enlargement of ventricular septal defect | Repair of transposition of the great arteries with ventricular septal defect and subpulmonary stenosis; without surgical enlargement of ventricular septal defect

HP_0034349.label: supravalvar pulmonary stenosis
HP_0034349.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing at the level of the pulmonary sinotubular junction above the pulmonic valve.
HP_0034349.synonyms: supravalvar pulmonnic stenosis | supravalvular pulmonary stenosis | supravalvular pulmonic stenosis

HP_0034350.label: valvular pulmonary stenosis
HP_0034350.definition: A cardiovascular malformation associated with narrowing of the outflow tract of the right ventricle immediately at the level of the pulmonary valve.
HP_0034350.UMLS synonyms: nonrheumatic pulmonary valvular stenosis with insufficiency | echocardiography: valvular stenosis of pulmonary valve | Ventricular septal defect Pulmonary valvular stenosis | Congenital stenosis of pulmonary valve | Pulmonary stenosis, non-rheumatic | Rheumatic pulmonary valve stenosis | infundibular pulmonary valve stenosis | Combined valvular-subvalvular pulmonic stenosis | Rheumatic pulmonary valve stenosis with insufficiency | Family history of pulmonic valve stenosis

HP_0034351.label: neuromyotonia
HP_0034351.definition: Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability manifesting as spontaneous discharges originating from motor axons or their terminals, lead to overactivity of muscles, typically manifesting as twitches, cramps and stiffness.
HP_0034351.UMLS synonyms: Isaacs syndrome | Ocular neuromyotonia | Acquired Neuromyotonia | Neuromyotonia [Isaacs] | Autosomal recessive axonal neuropathy with neuromyotonia | electromyography of extremity or paraspinal area: insertional activity neuromyotonia | Episodic ataxia type 1 | Morvan syndrome

HP_0034352.label: bile duct polyp
HP_0034352.definition: An elevated growth from the the mucosa of the bile duct.
HP_0034352.UMLS synonyms: Destruction of polyp or growth of gallbladder and/or bile duct using a flexible endoscope

HP_0034353.label: appendicular spasticity
HP_0034353.definition: A type of spasticity that affects one or more limbs (arms or legs).

HP_0034354.label: trichoschisis
HP_0034354.definition: Transverse fractures through the hair shafts (trichoschisis). Trichoschisis is characterized by a sharp transverse fracture of the hair shaft.

HP_0034355.label: white cerebellum sign
HP_0034355.definition: On computed tomography of the brain,the white (or dense) cerebellum sign is seen when the cerebellum appears dense with respect to the cerebral parenchyma. The increase in attenuation of cerebellum is in fact a relative hyperdensity caused by decreased attenutation of the brain. It represents anoxic-ischemic cerebral injury, and has a very poor prognosis.

HP_0034356.label: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of low molecular weight protein
HP_0034356.definition: Increased loss of low-molecular weight proteins by the kidneys, measured in terms of the fractional excretion (FE). The FE of low-molecular-weight proteins such as beta2-microglobulin can be measured in terms of plasma and urine concentrations, since urinary low-molecular-weight protein concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.
HP_0034356.synonyms: increased low molecular weight protein excretion

HP_0034357.label: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of glucose
HP_0034357.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the urine. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the glucose filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine glucose, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.

HP_0034358.label: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of sodium
HP_0034358.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of sodium in the urine. The FE of sodium is the percentage of the sodium filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine sodium, rather than by the interpretation of urinary glucose concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.

HP_0034359.label: impaired renal tubular reabsorption of phosphate
HP_0034359.definition: Increased fractional excretion (FE) of glucose in the phosphate. The FE of glucose is the percentage of the phosphate filtered by the kidney which is excreted in the urine. It is measured in terms of plasma and urine phosphate, rather than by the interpretation of urinary phosphate concentration alone, as urinary glucose concentrations can vary with water reabsorption.

HP_0034360.label: action myoclonus
HP_0034360.definition: A type of myoclonus (arrhythmic muscular jerking) that is induced by voluntary movement. It is made worse by attempts at precise or coordinated movement (intention myoclonus) and may also be provoked by certain sensory stimuli.
HP_0034360.UMLS synonyms: Myoclonus, Action | Action Myoclonus-Renal Failure Syndrome | Action-induced dystonia and myoclonus | Action myoclonus (triggered by voluntary movements) | Glomerular disease due to action myoclonus renal failure syndrome

HP_0034361.label: redundant umbilical skin
HP_0034361.definition: Greater than normal amount of skin surrounding the umbilicus (belly button) with protrusion of the umbilicus above the plane of the abdomen.

HP_0034362.label: dull foveal reflex
HP_0034362.definition: Reduced brigthness of the foveal reflex, which normally is a bright pinpoint of light that is observed to move sideways or up and down in response to movement of the opthalmoscope.
HP_0034362.synonyms: decreased foveal light reflex | muted foveal light reflex | poor foveal light reflex

HP_0034363.label: corneal pterygium
HP_0034363.definition: Corneal pterygium is an ocular surface disease characterized mainly by a wing-shaped growth of limbal and conjunctival tissue over the adjacent cornea.
HP_0034363.UMLS synonyms: Pterygium of eye | Excision of pterygium with corneal graft | Stocker line

HP_0034364.label: fibrofatty replacement of right ventricular myocardium
HP_0034364.definition: Replacement of the myocardium of the right ventricular free wall by fat and fibrous tissue.

HP_0034365.label: elevated circulating alpha - aminoadipic semialdehyde concentration
HP_0034365.definition: Increased concentration of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde in the blood circulation.
HP_0034365.synonyms: elevated circulating piperideine - 6 - carboxylic acid concentration

HP_0034366.label: fracture blister
HP_0034366.definition: Fracture blister is a type of blister that forms following acute bone fractures, typically near the ankle, wrist elbow or foot, where skin adheres tightly to bone with little subcutaneous fat cushioning. The blister that results resembles that of a second degree burn.

HP_0034367.label: decreased circulating beta - mannosidase activity
HP_0034367.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase below the lower limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

HP_0034368.label: urolithiasis
HP_0034368.definition: Renal stones are formed within the kidneys, and this is called nephrolithiasis. Urolithiasis is a condition that occurs when these stones exit the renal pelvis and move into the remainder of the urinary collecting system, which includes the ureters, bladder, and urethra.

HP_0034369.label: decreased level of coenzyme q10 in skeletal muscle
HP_0034369.definition: Reduced amount of coenzyme Q10,a naturally occurring quinone, in skeletal muscle tissue.

HP_0034371.label: reduced circulating prekallikrein concentration
HP_0034371.definition: Reduced concentration of prekallikrein (PK; also known as Fletcher factor) in the blood circulation. PK is the precursor of plasma kallikrein, a serine protease that activates kinins. PK is cleaved to produce kallikrein by activated Factor XII.

HP_0034372.label: internal tibial torsion
HP_0034372.UMLS synonyms: Internal tibial torsion | Acquired internal tibial torsion | Congenital internal tibial torsion | Congenital bilateral internal tibial torsion

HP_0034373.label: external tibial torsion
HP_0034373.definition: External twisting of the tibia resulting in the toes of each foot pointing outward (outtoeing) .
HP_0034373.UMLS synonyms: External tibial torsion | Acquired external tibial torsion

HP_0034374.label: trident acetabulum
HP_0034374.definition: Abnormal appearance of the acetabulum characterized by spurs at the medial and lateral acetabular margin and in the center of the acetabulum, giving rise to shape resembling a three-pronged spear sadi to resemble a trident.
HP_0034374.UMLS synonyms: Trident acetabulum with spurs | Trident configuration of acetabula | Trident-shaped acetabula

HP_0034375.label: spherophakia
HP_0034375.definition: Spherophakia is a rare congenital condition that presents with weak zonules around a smaller and more spherical crystalline lens with an increased anteroposterior thickness of the lens, and highly myopic eye. The lens zonules are developmentally hypoplastic and abnormally weak and due to non-attachment of the posterior zonules to the equatorial zone of the lens, the lens changes its normal shape to spherical.

HP_0034376.label: atrioventricular valve regurgitation
HP_0034376.definition: Regurgitation of a heart valve that controls blood flow from a an atrium to a ventricle, including mitral, tricuspid, or, rarely, single atrioventicular valve.

HP_0034377.label: single atrioventricular valve regurgitation
HP_0034377.definition: Regurgitation of the single atrioventricular valve regurgitation (AVVR) in the context of a congenital heart defect with a single ventricle. Roughly three quarters of patients following Fontan procedure display AVVR.

HP_0034378.label: urethrovesical occlusion
HP_0034378.definition: Blockage of the flow of urine from the bladder into the urethra.

HP_0034379.label: obsolete vascular granular osmiophilic material deposition
HP_0034379.definition: Accumulation of granular osmiophilic material in blood vessel walls. Osmiophilic material becomes black upon staining with osmium tetroxide.

HP_0034380.label: juvenile type testicular granulosa cell tumor
HP_0034380.definition: Juvenile granulosa cell tumor of the testis of neonates and infants is an uncommon lesion frequently associated with abnormal sex chromosome and ambiguous genitalia.

HP_0034381.label: central nervous system axonal spheroid
HP_0034381.definition: Axonal spheroids are bubble-like biological features that form on most degenerating axons. During neurodegeneration, bubble-like swellings form along the length of the axon, a primary and early effect of dynamic axonal deformation. These varicosities, spheroids, or swellings have been described as beads on a string and branches bearing fruit, and they frequently appear on degenerating axons. The focal swellings on degenerating axons, axonal spheroids, are often filled with cellular debris such as organelles, pathological proteins, and disorganized cytoskeletal elements.

HP_0034382.label: disease remission
HP_0034382.definition: A decrease in or disappearance of signs and symptoms typically associated with a disease course.
HP_0034382.UMLS synonyms: Disease remission | Hodgkin's disease in remission | Crohn's disease in remission | Graves' disease in remission | Sézary disease, in remission | temporary remission of disease | heavy chain disease in remission | Bilateral Meniere's disease in remission | malignant immunoproliferative disease in remission | Franklin disease with failed remission | Immunoproliferative small intestinal disease, in remission | Alpha heavy chain disease, in remission | Gamma heavy chain disease, in remission | Malignant immunoproliferative disease, unspecified, in remission | Crohn disease of colon in remission | Crohn disease of rectum in remission | Mu heavy chain disease in remission | Immunoproliferative disease NOS with failed remission | gamma heavy chain disease not having achieved remission | Inactive Ménière's disease | Crohn disease of small intestine in remission | heavy chain disease not having achieved remission | malignant immunoproliferative disease not having achieved remission | Malignant immunoproliferative disease, unspecified with failed remission | Alpha heavy chain disease with failed remission

HP_0034383.label: elevated circulating biliverdin concentration
HP_0034383.definition: Increased concentration of biliverdin, a green tetrapyrrolic bile pigment, in the blood circulation.

HP_0034384.label: elevated circulating insulin : c - peptide ratio
HP_0034384.definition: Increased ratio of insulin to C-peptide in the blood circulation.

HP_0034385.label: abnormal left ventricular endsystolic diameter
HP_0034385.definition: A deviation from the normal range of the left ventricular endsystolic diameter.

HP_0034386.label: reduced left ventricular endsystolic diameter
HP_0034386.definition: A lower than normal left ventricular endsystolic diameter.

HP_0034387.label: bacterial encephalitis
HP_0034387.UMLS synonyms: Bacterial encephalitis | bacterial encephalitis actinomycotic | Late syphilitic encephalitis | Encephalitis, myelitis and encephalomyelitis in bacterial diseases classified elsewhere | encephalitis due to Mycoplasma pneumoniae | Tuberculous encephalitis or myelitis, tubercle bacilli not found (in sputum) by microscopy, but found by bacterial culture

HP_0034388.label: hilar lymph node enlargement
HP_0034388.definition: Hilar lymphadenopathy is swelling or enlargement of lymph nodes localised in hila, wedge-shaped anatomical structures containing pulmonary vessels, major bronchi, nerves and lymph nodes. Hilar lymph nodes are not visible on chest X-ray if they are not enlarged. Hilar lymph node enlargement can be caused by benign and malignant conditions and can be symmetrical (bilateral) or asymmetrical (unilateral).
HP_0034388.UMLS synonyms: Hilar lymphadenopathy | CHEST XRAY HILAR LYMPH NODE ENLARGEMENT

HP_0034389.label: pulmonary vein varix
HP_0034389.definition: Pulmonary vein varix (PVV), refers to a localised dilatation of a pulmonary vein. PVV is a rare condition and can be congenital or acquired. PVV typically occur at the confluence of the veins adjacent to the left atrium. PVVs are sometimes classified into three morphological types: saccular, tortuous and confluent.

HP_0034390.label: decreased csf glycine concentration
HP_0034390.definition: Abnormally decreased levels of glycine in cerebrospinal fluid.

HP_0034391.label: elbow contracture
HP_0034391.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of the elbow resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin.

HP_0034392.label: joint contracture
HP_0034392.definition: A limitation in the passive range of motion of the elbow resulting from loss of elasticity in the periarticular tissues owing to structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules or skin. A contracture prevents movement of the associated body part.

HP_0034393.label: elbow extension contracture
HP_0034393.definition: An elbow contracture that limits the ability of the elbow joint to flex (flexion of the the elbow joint refers to bending the elbow joint to bring the hand closer to the shoulder), meaning that the elbow is fixed in an extended (straight) position.
HP_0034393.UMLS synonyms: Extension contracture - elbow | contracture of left elbow extension | contracture of right elbow on extension | contracture of both elbows on extension

HP_0034394.label: forearm supination contracture
HP_0034394.definition: A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in pronation (pronation refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face downwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a upward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between.

HP_0034395.label: forearm pronation contracture
HP_0034395.definition: A contracture that limits the ability of the forearm to stabilize the hand in supiation (supination refers to a rotation of the forearm that causes the palm and forearm to face upwards), meaning that the palm is fixed in a downward orientation. Restriction of supination/pronation can occur at the elbow (radial-humeral joint), at the wrist (radial-ulnar joint), and anywhere in between.

HP_0034396.label: hippocampal malrotation
HP_0034396.definition: Hippocampal malrotation, also termed incomplete inversion of the hippocampus or hippocampal malformation, is an increasingly recognized neuroimaging finding of undetermined clinical significance. It is characterized by features including (i) Round or pyramidal shape instead of ovoid shape; (ii) Medial position of the hippocampus on the hippocampal sulcus; (iii) The collateral sulcus is excessively deep or verticalized; (iv) Fimbria located medial to the hippocampus; (v) Small or displaced fornix; (vi) Enlarged temporal horn and empty choroid fissure; (vii) Thickened subiculum; (viii) Reduced upper horizontal portion of the parahippocampal gyrus.

HP_0034397.label: claw toe deformity
HP_0034397.definition: Claw toes are characterized by hyperextension at the metatarsal-phalangeal joints and flexion of the interphalangeal joints.

HP_0034398.label: toe deformity
HP_0034398.definition: Abnormal positioning of toe phalanges. Deformities of the lesser toes often occur gradually, though they can be brought on by trauma. The main adult sagittal plane deformities consist of claw toes, hammer toes and mallet toes. Axial plane deformities include crossover toes.

HP_0034399.label: prolonged central motor conduction time
HP_0034399.definition: Increased duration of the central motor conduction time (CMCT). The CMCT estimates the conduction time of corticospinal fibers between motor cortex and spinal (or bulbar) motoneurons. It includes the times for excitation of cortical cells, conduction via the corticobulbar-corticospinal tract and excitation of the motoneuron sufficient to reach its firing threshold. CMCT is calculated by subtracting the peripheral conduction time from the MEP latency recorded after cortical stimulation.

HP_0034400.label: circumferential skin creases on extremities
HP_0034400.definition: Ringed creases of the skin of the extremities related to folding of excess skin.

HP_0034401.label: atypical teratoid / rhabdoid tumor
HP_0034401.definition: An aggressive malignant embryonal neoplasm arising from the central nervous system. It is composed of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm. Mutations of the SMARCB1 gene or very rarely SMARCA4 (BRG1) gene are present. The vast majority of cases occur in childhood. Symptoms include lethargy, vomiting, cranial nerve palsy, headache, and hemiplegia.

HP_0034402.label: rhabdoid tumor of the kidney
HP_0034402.definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the kidney that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers, and pathologic diagnosis requires familiarity with these microscopic features plus awareness that adult onset is possible. It can be associated with abnormalities of chromosome 22. It is characterized by the presence of cells with a large eccentric nucleus, prominent nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm.

HP_0034403.label: subcutaneous panniculitis - like t - cell lymphoma
HP_0034403.definition: A form of T-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma in which cytotoxic CD8+ T cells infiltrate adipose tissue forming subcutaneous nodules.

HP_0034404.label: fungal hyphae in sputum
HP_0034404.definition: Presence of hyphae (long, branching, filamentous structures produced by fungi) in sputum.

HP_0034405.label: enlarged tectum
HP_0034405.definition: Increasaed size of the tectum, which is the region of the midbrain posterior to the cerebral aqueduct of Sylvius. The midbrain is the most superior portion of the brainstem.

HP_0034406.label: elevated csf angiotensin - converting enzyme concentration
HP_0034406.synonyms: angiotensin - converting enzyme ( ace ) high in csf | angiotensin - converting enzyme high in csf

HP_0034407.label: reduced circulating 3 - ketoacyl - coa thiolase concentration
HP_0034407.definition: Decreased concentration of 3-ketoacyl-CoA thiolase in th blood circulation.

HP_0034408.label: solitary angiokeratoma
HP_0034408.definition: A dark, keratotic papule about 2-10 mm in diameter, usually occuring on the lower extremeities. Usually the lesions begin as bright, soft, and nonkeratotic paules which grow larger and change to a firm, blue to black and keratotic stage.

HP_0034409.label: fordyce angiokeratoma
HP_0034409.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that most commonly occurs on the scrotum of patients who are 40 years old or older. The typical single lesion is a dark red to blue dome-shaped papule 2-4 mm in diameter with a very discrete keratotic surface. Typically, they are multiple and arranged in a line parallel to the raphe mediana of the scrotum. They also occur on the vulva and less commnly on the penis.
HP_0034409.UMLS synonyms: Angiokeratoma of Fordyce | Angiokeratoma of vulva

HP_0034410.label: angiokeratoma circumscriptum naeviforme
HP_0034410.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in childhood as a large, mostly linear and unilateral hyperkeratotic plaque which is composed of confluent keratotic papules. The size ranges from a few centimeters up to a major part of the body surface. Initially the lesions present asa multile reddish macules, clinically similar to a nevus flammeus. Within several years they develop into acanthokeratotic papules that agrregate into plaques which may have a hyperkeratotic surface.

HP_0034411.label: angiokeratoma of mibelli
HP_0034411.definition: A type of angiokeratoma that typically presents in women on the dorsa of fingers and toes and multiple dark red papules with a slightly verrucous surface, each measuring about 3-5 mm in diameter.

HP_0034412.label: laryngeal mass
HP_0034412.definition: A lump in the region of the larynx. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup. Laryngeal masses can be visualized by multiple methods include computed tomography.

HP_0034413.label: palate mass
HP_0034413.definition: A lump in the region of the palate. A mass is any lump in the body that can be caused by the abnormal growth of cells, a cyst, hormonal changes or an immune reaction. Typically a mass is an initial finding that will lead to additional workup.
