HP_0034414.label: thick oral frenulum
HP_0034414.definition: Increased thickness of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip.

HP_0034415.label: tooth avulsion
HP_0034415.definition: A type of dental trauma characterized by total dislocation of the tooth from its socket.
HP_0034415.UMLS synonyms: Tooth Avulsion | tooth displacement with avulsion | x-ray of teeth: displacement of tooth with avulsion | Extrusive luxation of tooth | Replanted avulsed tooth | Tooth Reimplantation

HP_0034416.label: torn oral frenulum
HP_0034416.definition: Laceration or tear of an oral frenulum, flaps of mucous membrane that extend from the midline gingiva to the upper or lower lip.
HP_0034416.synonyms: laceration of oral frenulum | oral frenulum , torn

HP_0034417.label: intraoral laceration
HP_0034417.definition: A wound of the mucosa within the oral cavity covering lips, tongue, palate, gingiva, pharynx, or retropharynx.
HP_0034417.UMLS synonyms: Laceration of intraoral surface of lip

HP_0034418.label: erythematous oral mucosa
HP_0034418.definition: An erythematous lesion of the oral mucosa may result from a variety of tissue alterations, including inflammation, erythrocyte extravasation, and atrophy or reduced keratinization of the surface epithelium.
HP_0034418.UMLS synonyms: Erythema of mucous membrane of mouth

HP_0034419.label: mitral chordae tendinae rupture
HP_0034419.definition: Breakage of the chordae tendinae of the mitral valve. This can lead to loss of tension of one of the mitral valve leaflets and mitral regurgitation.
HP_0034419.UMLS synonyms: Repair of rupture of mitral chordae tendinae | Rupture of left atrioventricular (not morphologically mitral) valve chordae tendinae | Mitral chordae rupture

HP_0034420.label: history of cardiovascular procedure
HP_0034420.definition: Indicates that a cardiovascular procedure such as stenting, bypass, catherization was performed on a patient.

HP_0034421.label: ejection click
HP_0034421.definition: A high-pitched sound that occurs at the moment of maximal opening of the aortic or pulmonary valves. They are heard just after the first heart sound. The sounds occur in the presence of a dilated aorta or pulmonary artery or in the presence of a bicuspid or flexible stenotic aortic or pulmonary valve. Ejection clicks may also be called ejection sounds.
HP_0034421.UMLS synonyms: Ejection click | PULMONARY EJECTION CLICK | Single non-ejection systolic click | Multiple non-ejection systolic clicks

HP_0034422.label: cryofibrinogenemia
HP_0034422.definition: Cryofibrinogen is an abnormal protein that forms precipitate only in plasma. consisting of fibrinogen, fibronectin, alpha1-antitrypsin and alpha2-macroglobulin.
HP_0034422.UMLS synonyms: Cryofibrinogenemia | Secondary cryofibrinogenemia | Primary cryofibrinogenemia | Mixed cryofibrinogenemia | Cryofibrinogenemia, Familial Primary | Cryofibrinogenemic purpura

HP_0034423.label: triggered by allergens
HP_0034423.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to allergens.

HP_0034424.label: clicking tinnitus
HP_0034424.definition: A type of tinnitus that presents as clicks, resembling the noise made by the snapping together of 2 fingers.

HP_0034425.label: reduced hair sulfur content
HP_0034425.definition: Abnormally low amount of sulfur in hair.
HP_0034425.synonyms: hair sulfur content reduced | hair sulphur content reduced

HP_0034427.label: purulent eye discharge
HP_0034427.definition: Secretion of pus-like (purulent) material from the eye, which may caused the eyelids to be matted together.

HP_0034429.label: bacteria in cerebrospinal fluid
HP_0034429.definition: Presence of bacteria in the cerebrospinal fluid, as manifested by visual inspection or bacterial culture results.
HP_0034429.UMLS synonyms: Identification of central nervous system pathogenic bacteria by metagenomic next-generation DNA sequencing in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) specimen

HP_0034431.label: joint crepitus
HP_0034431.definition: A popping, clicking or crackling sound that accompaniees movement of a joint.

HP_0034432.label: intertriginous distribution
HP_0034432.definition: Applies to the localization of a skin lesion involving any area of the body where two opposing skin surfaces can touch and rub or chaff.

HP_0034433.label: distributed along skin tension lines
HP_0034433.definition: Applies to the localization of a skin lesion that correspond to skin tension lines, which are linear clefts in the skin that indicate the direction of orientation of the underlying collagen fibers. Skin tension lines are also known as Langer's lines or lines of cleavage.
HP_0034433.synonyms: distributed along langer 's lines | lesions follow lines of cleavage

HP_0034434.label: abnormal communication
HP_0034434.definition: Presence of any form of communication (e.g., verbal or non-verbal) that does not align with cultural expectations or developmental level.

HP_0034435.label: abnormal eye contact
HP_0034435.definition: Any abnormality of eye contact behavior. We define eye contact as a form of nonverbal communication between two individuals who are facing each other in which an individual directs the eyes towards the eyes or face of the other individual. Eye contact occurs frequently and voluntarily during face-to-face verbal communication. The duration and frequency of eye contact that is interpreted to be appropriate may follow social and situational norms.

HP_0034436.label: gaze avoidance

HP_0034437.definition: Tendency to maintain sustained eye contact for an inappropriately long period of time.
HP_0034437.UMLS synonyms: Use non-threatening verbal and nonverbal communication patterns, avoiding excessive stimulation, aggressive postures and prolonged eye contact (i.e., relax shoulders with arms down and hands open outwards)

HP_0034440.definition: Applies to a skin lesion that is improved or made more bearable by exposure to ultraviolet light (sunshine or phototherapy).

HP_0034441.definition: An reduced concentration of aspartic acid in the blood circulation.

HP_0034442.label: abnormal circulating erythropoietin concentration
HP_0034442.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production.

HP_0034443.definition: Decreased concentration of erythropoietin in the blood circulation. Erythropoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the peritubular cells of the kidney that stimulates red blood cell production.

HP_0034444.label: abnormal gamma - glutamyltransferase level
HP_0034444.definition: Any deviation from the normal level of the enzyme gamma-glutamyltransferase (GGT). GGT is mainly present in kidney, liver, and pancreatic cells, but small amounts are present in other tissues.

HP_0034446.definition: Increased concentration of histamine in the blood circulation.

HP_0034447.label: increased circulating interleukin 18 concentration
HP_0034447.definition: An increased concentration of interleukin-18 in the blood circulation.

HP_0034448.label: abnormal phytanic acid : pristanic acid ratio
HP_0034448.definition: Any deviation from the normal ratio of blood phytanic acid concentration to pristanic acid concentration.

HP_0034451.label: rectovesical fistula
HP_0034451.definition: An aberrant, pathological communication between the rectum and the bladder.

HP_0034452.label: rectoureteral fistula
HP_0034452.definition: An abnormal connection (fistula) between the rectum and the ureter.

HP_0034454.label: arachnoid granulation
HP_0034454.definition: Arachnoid granulations (AGs) are tufts of arachnoid membrane invaginated into the dural sinuses through which cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) enters the venous system. The lesions are primarily located in the parasagittal region along the superior sagittal sinus, which is occasionally seen at the transverse sinus. Normally dural venous sinus AGs typically range from 2 to 8 mm in size, but may grow enough to expand the dural sinuses, and even the inner table, diploic space and outer table of the skull.
HP_0034454.UMLS synonyms: Giant arachnoid granulation | Structure of Pacchionian granulation | Space of arachnoid granulation | Wall of arachnoid granulation | Cerebrospinal fluid otorrhea due to giant arachnoid granulation

HP_0034455.label: increased csf taurine concentration
HP_0034455.definition: Increased concentration of taurine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

HP_0034456.label: elevated circulating glutathione concentration
HP_0034456.definition: An abnormally increased level of glutathione in the blood circulation.

HP_0034457.label: hawkinsinuria
HP_0034457.definition: The concentration of hawkinsin in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034458.label: elevated urinary phenylpyruvic acid level
HP_0034458.definition: An abnormally increased amount of phenylpyruvic acid in the urine.

HP_0034459.label: ameliorated by lumbar puncture
HP_0034459.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by lumbar puncture.

HP_0034460.label: increased csf uracil concentration
HP_0034460.definition: An increased level of uracil in the cerebrospinal fluid.

HP_0034461.label: elevated urine kynurenine level
HP_0034461.definition: An abnormally increased amount of kynurenine in the urine.

HP_0034462.label: increased csf l - alloisoleucine concentration
HP_0034462.definition: An abnormally increased concentration of L-alloisoleucine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

HP_0034463.label: hydroxylysinemia
HP_0034463.definition: An increased concentration of hydroxylysine in the blood circulation. Hydroxylysine arises from a post-translational hydroxy modification of lysine and is unique to collagen and proteins containing collagen-like sequences. Elevated concentrations of hydroxylysine may indicate increased bone turnover.

HP_0034464.label: homocitrullinuria
HP_0034464.definition: An increased amount of L-homocitrulline in the urine. L-homocitrulline is an L-lysine derivative that is L-lysine having a carbamoyl group at the N(6)-position. It is found in individuals with urea cycle disorders.

HP_0034465.label: 2 - hydroxyadipic aciduria
HP_0034465.definition: An increase in the level of 2-hydroxyadipic acid in the urine.

HP_0034466.label: homoargininuria
HP_0034466.definition: An increased amount of homoarginine in the urine. Homoarginine is a nonproteinogenic alpha amino acid.

HP_0034467.label: increased urinary cysteine level
HP_0034467.definition: An increased concentration of cysteine in the urine.

HP_0034468.label: gastric xanthoma
HP_0034468.definition: Gastric xanthomas (also known as xanthelasmas) are are plaque-like red lesions defined by the presence of histiocytic containing lipids.

HP_0034469.label: decreased stool elastase level
HP_0034469.definition: Reduced amount of pancreatic elastase in the stool. This feature may be observed with pancreatic insufficiency.

HP_0034470.label: elevated stool chloride content
HP_0034470.definition: Elevated amount of chloride in the stool.

HP_0034474.definition: Abnormally high concentration of pentacarboxylporphyrin in feces.

HP_0034475.label: increased fecal isocoproporphyrin
HP_0034475.definition: Abnormally high concentration of isocoproporphyrin in feces.

HP_0034476.label: positive fecal clostridium botulinum test
HP_0034476.definition: Identification of Clostridium botulinum toxin in the feces.

HP_0034477.label: perihepatic adhesions
HP_0034477.definition: Abnormal union of the membranous surfaces of the liver capsule and the parietal peritoneum due to inflammation or injury. Adhesions may be visualized by laparoscopy and may have a violin string appearance.

HP_0034483.label: bone marrow vacuolated lymphocytes
HP_0034483.definition: The presence of lymphocytes with multilple vacuoles (a membrane-bound cell organelle) in the bone marrow.

HP_0034485.label: neuroepithelial cyst
HP_0034485.definition: A benign epithelial-lined cystic lesion that can occur anywhere in the neuraxis. Neuroepithelial cysts are ependymal or epithelial lined fluid collections of unknown etiology within the central nervous system parenchyma with no obvious ventricular or subarachnoid connection. Most cysts are asymptomatic, however, some present with seizures, mass effect, or rarely with movement disorders. On imaging, they present as CSF-like parenchymal cysts with smooth, rounded borders and minimal or no surrounding signal intensity abnormality.

HP_0034498.label: hepatic focal nodular hyperplasia
HP_0034498.definition: Hepatic focal nodular hyperplasia (FNH) is a benign hepatic tumor. FNH develops within hepatic parenchymal tissue that is otherwise histologically normal. Macroscopically, the tumor is characterized by the presence of depressed, grayish-white scar, which is generally (but not always) located at the center of the lesion, with fibrous septa radiating outward, toward the periphery of the tumor. This stellate scar is found in only 50% of all FNH nodules, but its presence is regarded as pathognomonic. The lesion itself is usually lighter in color than the tissue that surrounds it, and it sometimes has a yellowish hue. FNH nodules are generally not capsulated; their margins are well defined, and they are sometimes lobulated.

HP_0034499.label: increased bone marrow iron
HP_0034499.definition: An increased amount of iron in the bone marrow.

HP_0034504.definition: Septate gallbladder is characterized by the presence of a septum that divides the gallbladder in two chambers. HP_0034508.definition: Fingerprint bodies are inclusion bodies located at the periphery of the muscle fibers underneath the sarcolemma (subsarcolemmal), consisting of non-membrane-bound packed lamellae arranged in concentric patterns resembling fingerprints.

HP_0034509.definition: An accumulation of myofilamentous material within individual muscle fibers, forming usually round but occasionally elongated bodies ranging from 2 to 15 pm in size. HP_0034512.label: transitional - cell carcinoma of the ureter
HP_0034512.definition: A cancer of the ureter that most often arises in the distal third of the ureter and is often diagnosed during the sixth and seventh decades of life. The most common presentation is gross hematuria or flank pain.

HP_0034525.label: adamantinoma
HP_0034525.definition: A primary low-grade, malignant bone tumor that is predominantly located in the mid-portion of the tibia. Histologically, classic adamantinoma is a biphasic tumor characterized by epithelial and osteofibrous components that may be intermingled with each other in various proportions and differentiating patterns.
HP_0034525.UMLS synonyms: Adamantinoma of Long Bones | Ameloblastoma | Tibial adamantinoma | Dedifferentiated adamantinoma | Adamantinoma of femur | Primary tibial adamantinoma | adamantinoma of bone | adamantinoma; malignant, jaw | upper jaw; adamantinoma | Craniopharyngioma | Primary adamantinoma of femur | Osteofibrous dysplasia-like adamantinoma | malignant adamantinoma of joint | Malignant Ameloblastoma | Primary adamantinoma of long bone | Malignant dedifferentiated adamantinoma of bone | Ameloblastoma of jaw | Adamantinoma of long bone of lower limb | Basal cell carcinoma - adamantinoid | ameloblastoma; malignant, jaw, upper jaw | Primary malignant adamantinoma of long bone of lower limb | Adamantinoma, NOS (except of Tibia and Long bones, M-92613) | Primary malignant adamantinoma of long bone of left lower limb | Primary malignant adamantinoma of long bone of right lower limb

HP_0034526.label: abnormal enzyme activity in muscle tissue
HP_0034526.definition: Deviation from the normal activity of an enzyme in muscle tissue.

HP_0034527.label: reduced muscle phosphoglycerate kinase activity
HP_0034527.definition: Reduced activity of phosphoglycerate kinase (PGK) in muscle tissue. PGK is a glycolytic enzyme that catalyses one of the two ATP-producing reactions in the glycolytic pathway, through the conversion of 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate to 3-phosphoglycerate.

HP_0034528.label: reduced fibroblast type iii procollagen synthesis
HP_0034528.definition: Diminished production of type III procollagen by cultured skin fibroblasts.
HP_0034528.synonyms: type iii procollagen synthesis by fibroblasts low

HP_0034529.label: reduced muscle myoadenylate deaminase activity
HP_0034529.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme myoadenylate deaminase. Myoadenylate deaminase is the muscle isoform of adenosine monophosphate (AMP) deaminase and catalyzes the deamination of AMP to inosine monophosphate and ammonia.

HP_0034530.label: bent long bone
HP_0034530.definition: A developmental defect of a long bone, such as the femur or the humerus, characterized by a sharply curve deviation located in the metaphysis (shaft) of the bone.

HP_0034531.label: tracheal rupture
HP_0034531.definition: A break or tear in the trachea.

HP_0034532.label: increased myocardial glycogen content
HP_0034532.definition: Elevated amount of glycogen in the myocardium.

HP_0034533.label: triggered by monoamine oxidase inhibitor
HP_0034533.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a monoamine oxidase inhibitor.
HP_0034533.synonyms: mao inhibitors trigger attacks | triggered by mao inhibitor

HP_0034534.label: triggered by serotonin reuptake inhibitor
HP_0034534.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a serotonin reuptake inhibitor.

HP_0034535.label: ameliorated by acetazolamide
HP_0034535.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with acetazolamide.

HP_0034536.label: ameliorated by exposure to medication
HP_0034536.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a medication. Terms in this subhierarchy are intended to be used for cases in which the fact that a manifestation of a disease responds to a specific treatment can be used in the differential diagnosis.

HP_0034537.label: ameliorated by vitamin b12
HP_0034537.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with vitamin B12.

HP_0034538.label: ameliorated by thiamine
HP_0034538.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with thiamine.

HP_0034539.label: ameliorated by dantrolene
HP_0034539.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with dantrolene.

HP_0034540.label: ameliorated by biotin
HP_0034540.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with biotin.

HP_0034541.label: reduced bone - marrow megakaryocyte size
HP_0034541.definition: Decreased in average size (diameter) of megakaryocytes in the bone marrow. Megakaryocyte diameter can be assessed as using automated cellular imaging systems.

HP_0034542.label: hairshafts with longitudinal grooves
HP_0034542.definition: Long narrow depressions running lengthwise in hairshafts. This feature can be appreciated by scanning electron microsopy.

HP_0034543.label: mycobacterium bacteremia
HP_0034543.definition: Presence of viable mycobacteria in the blood.
HP_0034543.UMLS synonyms: MYCOBACTERIUM AVIUM COMPLEX BACTEREMIA | bacteremia due to Mycobacterium avium-intracellulare group | MAC bacteremia

HP_0034544.label: decreased delta - aminolevulinate dehydratase activity
HP_0034544.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme delta-aminolevulinate dehydratase. The enzyme is active in erythrocytes.
HP_0034544.synonyms: delta - aminolevulinate dehydratase activity low | delta - aminolevulinate dehydratase deficiency

HP_0034545.label: elevated circulating pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor activity
HP_0034545.definition: Increased activity of the enzyme pancreatic secretory trypsin inhibitor in the blood circulation.
HP_0034545.synonyms: elevated circulating serine protease inhibitor kazal type i | elevated circulating spink1 activity

HP_0034546.label: presence of uterus in 46 , xy individual
HP_0034546.definition: A developmental anomaly in which an individual with an X chromosome and a Y chromosome (usually 46,XY) has a uterus. The uterus and Fallopian tubes are derived from the Müllerian duct and thus this phenotype is generally also associated with the presence of Fallopian tubes.

HP_0034547.label: intraluminal meconium calcification
HP_0034547.definition: Deposition of calcium in meconium present in the internal cavity of the fetal bowel. This manifestation may be the result of any distal intestinal obstruction.

HP_0034548.label: portal vein hypoplasia
HP_0034548.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of hte portal vein.

HP_0034549.label: adrenal leiomyoma
HP_0034549.definition: Adrenal leiomyoma is a rare, benign solid tumor that develops from the smooth muscle of the adrenal vein and its tributaries

HP_0034550.label: small intestinal lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
HP_0034550.definition: Infiltration of the wall of the small intestine by lymphocytes and mature plasma cells.

HP_0034551.label: triggered by neuroleptic medication
HP_0034551.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to neuroleptic (also known as antipsychotic) medication.

HP_0034552.label: abnormal peroxisomal morphology
HP_0034552.definition: Structural anomaly of peroxisomes, which are small, membrane-enclosed metabolic organelles with roles in the metabolism of complex lipids and reactive ionic species.

HP_0034553.label: absence of peroxisomes
HP_0034553.definition: Lack of observable peroxisomes. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.
HP_0034553.UMLS synonyms: Complete absence of peroxisomes in fibroblasts

HP_0034554.label: paucity of peroxisomes
HP_0034554.definition: Reduced number of observable peroxisomes per cell. This feature can be observed by immunohistochemical staining of cultured cells (such as fibroblasts) or by electronmicroscopy.

HP_0034555.label: reduced sulfide : quinone oxidoreductase activity
HP_0034555.definition: Reduced activity of the enzyme sulfide:quinone oxidoreductase, which typically is measured in a biopsy specimen from liver or muscle.

HP_0034556.label: deficit at segmental level
HP_0034556.definition: Refers to distribution of neurological deficits that corresponds to a deficit of a specific spinal segment and all segments below it.

HP_0034557.label: rhabdoid tumor
HP_0034557.definition: Rhabdoid tumors are rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis. The most common anatomic localizations are the central nervous system, the kidneys, and other soft tissues.
HP_0034557.UMLS synonyms: Rhabdoid Tumor | Extrarenal rhabdoid tumor | Atypical Teratoid Rhabdoid Tumor | Teratoid Rhabdoid Tumor | Advanced Rhabdoid Tumor | Unresectable Rhabdoid Tumor | Recurrent Rhabdoid Tumor | Metastatic Rhabdoid Tumor | Refractory Rhabdoid Tumor | Rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome | Rhabdoid Tumor of the Kidney | rhabdoid tumor of liver | Malignant Rhabdoid Tumor, Somatic | Primary malignant rhabdoid tumor | Primary extrarenal rhabdoid tumor | Typical Teratoid Rhabdoid Tumor | Refractory Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor | Recurrent Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor | Unresectable Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor | Rhabdoid Tumor Predisposition Syndrome 2 | Rhabdoid Tumor Predisposition Syndrome 1 | Childhood Atypical Teratoid/Rhabdoid Tumor

HP_0034558.label: rhabdoid tumor of the ovary
HP_0034558.definition: A highly aggressive, extremely rare neoplasm of the ovary that is usually seen in children. The term rhabdoid is used because the tumor cells resemble rhabdomyoblasts but lack myogenic markers.
HP_0034558.UMLS synonyms: Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor of the Ovary | Recurrent Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor of the Ovary | Refractory Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor of the Ovary

HP_0034559.label: cardiac rhabdoid tumor
HP_0034559.definition: A rare and aggressive neoplasms developing mainly in the kidney but also in cerebral and extra-cerebral tissues and rarely in the heart. Histologically, rhabdoid renal and extrarenal tumors share common characteristics. The cells are polygonal, with eccentric, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, eosinophilic cytoplasmic inclusions. The tumors have an infiltrative growth pattern, necrosis, and high proliferative index. The immunohistochemistry tools of investigation facilitate differential diagnosis by showing loss of INI-1 expression, usually accompanied by germline mutations of the SMARCB1 gene. When INI-1 is still expressed in the affected tissues, a rhabdoid tumor with SMARCA4 mutations should be considered.

HP_0034560.label: malignant rhabdoid tumor of the bladder
HP_0034560.definition: A rhabdoid tumor (a rare aggressive malignancies in infants and young children with a poor prognosis) originating in the urinary bladder.

HP_0034561.label: malignant rhabdoid tumor of liver
HP_0034561.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in the liver. MRT are best characterized by the presence of round or polygonal cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm, typical eosinophilic perinuclear inclusions, vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli. Immunohistochemical expression of vimentin and epithelial markers and lack of staining for S-100, myoglobin and desmin are commonly found, but are non-specific.
HP_0034561.UMLS synonyms: Extrarenal Rhabdoid Tumor of the Liver

HP_0034562.label: malignant rhabdoid tumor of muscle
HP_0034562.definition: A malginant rhabdoid tumor (MRT) originating in muscle tissue.

HP_0034563.label: neck teratoma
HP_0034563.definition: A teratoma located in the neck.

HP_0034564.label: kidney teratoma
HP_0034564.definition: A teratoma located in a kidney.

HP_0034565.label: elevated urinary 5 - amino - 4 - imidazolecarboxamide - riboside level
HP_0034565.definition: Increased amount of 5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide(AICA)-riboside in the urine. AICA-riboside is the dephosphorylated counterpart of AICAR, an intermediate of de novo purine biosynthesis.

HP_0034566.label: aplasia of posterior communicating artery
HP_0034566.definition: A developmental anomnaly characterized by the lack of development of the posterior communicating artery.
HP_0034566.synonyms: absence of both posterior communicating arteries

HP_0034567.label: optic pit
HP_0034567.definition: A developmental anomaloy characterized by congenital excavation of the optic nerve head.
HP_0034567.synonyms: optic disc pit | optic nerve pit
HP_0034567.UMLS synonyms: Optic nerve head pit | Acquired pit of optic disc | Congenital pit of optic disc | Congenital pit of bilateral optic discs | pit of optic disc of left eye | pit of optic discs of both eyes | pit of optic disc of right eye | Central serous retinopathy with pit of optic disc | Congenital pit of optic disc of left eye | Congenital pit of optic disc of right eye | pit of nasal aspect of optic disc of left eye | pit of inferior aspect of optic disc of left eye | pit of superior aspect of optic disc of left eye | pit of temporal aspect of optic disc of left eye | pit of superior aspect of optic disc of right eye | pit of inferior aspect of optic disc of right eye | pit of nasal aspect of optic disc of right eye | pit of temporal aspect of optic disc of right eye | Do you have a coloboma, absence or defect of ocular tissue ranging from a small pit in the optic disk to extensive defects in the iris, ciliary body, choroid, retina, or optic disk | Do you have a coloboma, absence or defect of ocular tissue ranging from a small pit in the optic disk to extensive defects in the iris, ciliary body, choroid, retina, or optic disk:Find:Pt:^Patient:Ord:PhenX | Excavation of optic disc (pits) | Coloboma of optic disc | Absence of foveal pit on optical coherence tomography

HP_0034568.label: ameliorated by naloxone
HP_0034568.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with naloxone, an opioid antagonist.

HP_0034569.label: ameliorated by pyridoxal phosphate
HP_0034569.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by ingestion of pyridoxal phosphate (activated vitamin B6).

HP_0034570.label: thickened intrahepatic portal venules
HP_0034570.definition: Increased width of the vascular wall of portal venules within the liver.

HP_0034571.label: ovarian fibrosis
HP_0034571.definition: Excessive proliferation of fibroblasts and deposition of extracellular matrix within the ovary.
HP_0034571.UMLS synonyms: IMMUNODEFICIENCY, OVARIAN DYSGENESIS, AND PULMONARY FIBROSIS

HP_0034572.label: pigment incontinence
HP_0034572.definition: A process in which melanosomes (melanin granules) are deposited in the dermis. The dermal melanosomes are observed to be mainly in macrophages. This phenomenon of pigmentary incontinence usually follows an inflammatory process with the basic feature of basal cell damage, such as in lichen planus, lupus erythematosus, Riehl's melanosis, incontinentia pigmenti (Bloch-Sulzberger), and fixed drug eruption. Incontinence of pigment, or dropping off of epidermal melanin into the dermis, frequently produces a clinically recognizable and characteristic slate-gray pigmentation.
HP_0034572.UMLS synonyms: No incontinence of pigment | Pigment incontinence in the papillary dermis

HP_0034574.label: reduced epidermal keratin 10 protein expression
HP_0034574.definition: Amount of keratin 10 in the epidermis below the lower limit of normal. The findiong is typically ascertained by immunofluorescent microscopy.

HP_0034575.label: reduced epidermal collagen iv protein expression
HP_0034575.synonyms: skin biopsy : collagen iv antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034576.label: reduced epidermal bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 protein expression
HP_0034576.definition: Lower than normal amount of bullous pemphigoid antigen 1 (BP230) in the epidermis.
HP_0034576.synonyms: skin biopsy : bpag1 - e antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034577.label: reduced epidermal collagen vii protein expression
HP_0034577.synonyms: skin biopsy : collagen vii antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034578.label: reduced epidermal collagen xvii protein expression
HP_0034578.synonyms: skin biopsy : collagen xvii antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034579.label: reduced epidermal integrin alpha6beta4 protein expression
HP_0034579.synonyms: skin biopsy : integrin alpha6beta4 antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034580.label: reduced epidermal plectin protein expression
HP_0034580.synonyms: skin biopsy : plectin antibody staining abnormal or absent

HP_0034581.label: bloodstream trypanosoma cruzi
HP_0034581.definition: Presence of Trypanosoma cruzi in the blood stream. Trypanosoma cruzii is the etiological agent of Chagas disease.
HP_0034581.synonyms: trypanosoma cruzi present on peripheral blood smear

HP_0034582.label: abnormal lymph node cell composition
HP_0034582.definition: A deviation from the normal distribution of cell types or their relative proprotions in a lymph node.

HP_0034583.label: lipid - laden lymph node macrophages
HP_0034583.definition: Lymph node with increased numbers of macrophages heavily laden with lipids.

HP_0034585.label: cochlear nerve hypoplasia
HP_0034585.definition: A developmental defect characterized by underdevelopment of the cochlear nerve.

HP_0034586.label: glutathionuria
HP_0034586.definition: Level of glutathione in the urine above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0034586.UMLS synonyms: gamma-Glutamyltransferase deficiency | Glutathione high in urine

HP_0034587.label: nevus psiloliparus
HP_0034587.definition: Nevus psiloliparus is a rare fatty tissue nevus that is a marker for encephalocraniocutaneous lipomatosis, a neurocutaneous syndrome with ocular and central nervous system anomalies. Clinically, nevus psiloliparus is often described as a congenital alopecia and appears as an irregularly shaped, circumscribed area of alopecia on the scalp. Histopathology demonstrates a near-complete absence of mature hair follicles with preservation of arrector pili muscles and mature adipocytes within the dermis.

HP_0034588.label: crypt hyperplasia
HP_0034588.definition: Crypt hyperplasia denotes elongation of the length of the crypts of Lieberkuhn, a process that initially precedes villous atrophy. Elongation may be caused by expansion of the lamina propria as a result of the proliferation of stromal cells, an influx of inflammatory cells and tissue remodelling.
HP_0034588.UMLS synonyms: Hyperplasia of duodenal crypt epithelium, mild

HP_0034589.label: increased circulating dehydroepiandrosterone - sulfate concentration
HP_0034589.definition: Concentration of dehydroepiandrosterone-sulfate in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034590.label: abnormal circulating thyroxine - binding globulin concentration
HP_0034590.definition: Any deviation from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood circulation.

HP_0034591.label: decreased circulating thyroxine - binding globulin concentration
HP_0034591.definition: A reduction from the normal concentration of thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) in the blood circulation.
HP_0034591.synonyms: thyroxine - binding globulin low in blood

HP_0034592.label: elevated circulating beta - aminoisobutyric acid concentration
HP_0034592.definition: An increased concentration of beta-aminoisobutyric acid in the blood circulation.
HP_0034592.synonyms: beta - aminoisobutyric acid high in blood

HP_0034593.label: elevated circulating dihydrouracil concentration
HP_0034593.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrouracil in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of uracil that is also known as 5,6-dihydrouracil.
HP_0034593.synonyms: dihydrouracil high in blood | elevated circulating 5,6 - dihydrouracil concentration

HP_0034594.label: elevated circulating dihydrothymine concentration
HP_0034594.definition: An increased concentration of dihydrothymine in the blood circulation. Dihydrouracil is an intermediate in the catabolism of thymine.

HP_0034595.label: elevated circulating n - carbamyl - beta - alanine concentration
HP_0034595.definition: An increased concentrationof N-carbamyl-beta-alanine in the blood circulation.
HP_0034595.synonyms: n - carbamyl - beta - aminoisobutyric acid high in blood

HP_0034596.label: elevated ciculating 5 - hydroxymethyluracil concentration
HP_0034596.definition: An increased concentration of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the blood circulation.

HP_0034597.label: decreased csf creatinine concentration
HP_0034597.definition: Concentration of creatinine in the cerebrrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034598.label: elevated urinary creatine level
HP_0034598.definition: An increased amount of creatine in the urine.

HP_0034599.label: decreased circulating biotin concentration
HP_0034599.definition: Concentration of biotin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034600.label: elevated circulating thrombopoietin concentration
HP_0034600.definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.

HP_0034601.label: decreased circulating c1q concentration
HP_0034601.definition: Concentration or activity of the C1q protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. C1q is the first component of the classical pathway and is composed of the C1qA chain, C1qB chain, and C1qC chain, which are encoded by C1qA, C1qB, and C1qC genes.

HP_0034602.label: decreased circulating apolipoprotein a - ii concentration
HP_0034602.definition: Concentration of apolipoprotein A-II below the lower limit of normal.
HP_0034602.synonyms: apolipoprotein a - ii low in blood

HP_0034603.label: elevated circulating ca19 - 9 concentration
HP_0034603.definition: Concentration of CA19-9 above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0034603.synonyms: elevated circulating cancer antigen 19 - 9 concentration | elevated circulating carbohydrate antigen 19 - 9 concentration | elevated circulating sialylated lewis a antigen concentration

HP_0034604.label: elevated circulating dopa concentration
HP_0034604.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0034604.synonyms: dopa high in blood | elevated circulating 3,4 - dihydroxyphenylalanine concentration

HP_0034605.label: elevated csf dopa concentration
HP_0034605.definition: Concentration of DOPA (3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine) in the cerebrospinal fluid above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034606.label: elevated circulating porphyrin concentration
HP_0034606.definition: Concentration of porphyrins or of a specific porphryin above the upper limit of normal. The most commonly tested circulating porphyrins are coproporphyrin, protoporphyrin, and uroporphyrin. Normally protoporphyrin is present in the highest concentration.

HP_0034607.label: decreased circulating 17 - hydroxyprogesterone concentration
HP_0034607.definition: Concentration of 17-hydroxyprogesterone in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034608.label: decreased circulating transcobalamin ii concentration
HP_0034608.definition: Concentration of transcobalamin II in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034609.label: polychromasia
HP_0034609.definition: Increased variation in the color of the erythrocytes (red blood cells), including pale red, normal or dark colors, indicating a highly variable hemoglobin concentration. Typically this indicates the release of immature erythrocytes in states of anemia.
HP_0034609.UMLS synonyms: Polychromatophilic stain reaction | Lenticular polychromasia | Normochromic polychromasia | Normocytic/Normochromic polychromasia | Peripheral blood smear shows polychromasia | Polychromasia | Blood | Hematology and Cell counts | Polychromatic red blood cells | Polychromasia:PrThr:Pt:Bld:Ord | Normocytic/Normochromic polychromasia | Blood | Hematology and Cell counts | Polychromasia:PrThr:Pt:Bld:Ord:Microscopy.light | Normocytic/Normochromic polychromasia:PrThr:Pt:Bld:Ord:Microscopy.light

HP_0034610.label: decreased circulating myo - inositol concentration
HP_0034610.definition: Concentration of myo-inositol in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034611.label: elevated circulating arabitol concentration
HP_0034611.definition: Concentration of arabitol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034612.label: elevated urine arabitol level
HP_0034612.definition: Amount of arabitol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034613.label: elevated urine erythritol level
HP_0034613.definition: Amount of erythritol in the urine above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034614.label: elevated circulating erythritol concentration
HP_0034614.definition: Concentration of erythritol in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034615.label: reduced circulating matrix metalloproteinase 2 concentration
HP_0034615.definition: Concentration of matrix metalloproteinase 2 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034616.label: abnormal circulating coenzyme concentration
HP_0034616.definition: Concentration of a coenzyme (an organic molecule that binds to the active sites of an enzyme to promote the catalysis of a reaction) is above or below the limits of normal.

HP_0034617.label: elevated circulating s - adenosyl methionine concentration
HP_0034617.definition: Concentration of S-adenosyl methionine (SAM) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal. SAM is a cosubstrate involved in methyl group transfers, transsulfuration, and aminopropylation.

HP_0034618.label: abnormal circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP_0034618.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal. Membrane cofactor protein (MCP, CD46) is a cell surface complement regulatory protein which acts as a cofactor for the factor I-mediated cleavage of the activated complement components C3b/C4b.

HP_0034619.label: decreased circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP_0034619.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.
HP_0034619.synonyms: decreased circulating cd46 concentration | mcp ( membrane cofactor protein ) low in blood

HP_0034620.label: elevated circulating membrane cofactor protein concentration
HP_0034620.definition: Concentration of membrane cofactor protein in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034621.label: hepatic xanthomatosis
HP_0034621.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the liver. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034622.label: adrenal xanthomatosis
HP_0034622.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the adrenal gland. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034623.label: splenic xanthomatosis
HP_0034623.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spleen. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034624.label: spinal cord xanthomatosis
HP_0034624.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the spinal cord. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034625.label: brain xanthomatosis
HP_0034625.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the brain. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034626.label: pulmonary xanthomatosis
HP_0034626.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the lung. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034627.label: bone marrow xanthomatosis
HP_0034627.definition: Lipid deposits localized within the bone marrow. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034628.label: lymph node xanthomatosis
HP_0034628.definition: Lipid deposits localized within one or more lymph nodes. Xanthomas are benign but are often an important visible sign of systemic conditions such as familial hypercholesterolemia.

HP_0034629.label: xanthoma of bone
HP_0034629.definition: Xanthoma of bone is an exceedingly rare benign primary bone tumor histologically characterized by mononuclear macrophage-like cells, abundant foam cells, and multinucleated giant cells.

HP_0034630.label: ameliorated by folinic acid
HP_0034630.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with folinic acid.

HP_0034631.label: triggered by succinylcholine anesthetic
HP_0034631.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to a succinylcholine anesthetic such as suxamethonium.

HP_0034632.label: exogenous androgen exposure
HP_0034632.definition: History of having been treated with an exogenous androgen medication.

HP_0034633.label: reduced muscle enolase activity
HP_0034633.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme enolase in muscle tissue. The enzyme enolase catalyzes the interconversion of 2-phosphoglycerate and phosphoenolpyruvate. In adult human muscle, over 90% of enolase activity is accounted for by the beta-enolase subunit, the protein product of the ENO3 gene.
HP_0034633.synonyms: muscle biopsy : beta - enolase activity low

HP_0034634.label: dopamine antagonist exposure
HP_0034634.definition: History of having been treated with a dopamine antagonist including metaclopramide, phenothiazine; haloperidol, chlorpromazine, promethazine, prochlorperazine, ziprasidone, and quetiapine.

HP_0034635.label: muscle fiber granulofilamentous inclusion bodies
HP_0034635.definition: The presence of inclusion bodies within the cytoplasm of muscle cells that contain a mxiture of granules and filaments.

HP_0034636.label: bone marrow myeloid vacuolization
HP_0034636.definition: Formation of vacuoles (a space within a cell that is empty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in the cytoplasm of myeloid precursors in the bone marrow.
HP_0034636.synonyms: bone marrow : myeloid vacuolization | vacuolization of bone marrow myeloid precursors
HP_0034636.UMLS synonyms: Vacuolization in myeloid cell lines in the bone marrow

HP_0034637.label: pulmonary cylindroma
HP_0034637.definition: A cylindroma located in the lung. Cylindromas are well-circumscribed, smooth, pale pink nodular tumors, often with arborizing vessels visible. The tumors are slow growing and vary in size from a few millimeters to over 5 mm.

HP_0034638.label: colonic fibrinopurulent exudate
HP_0034638.definition: Fluid visible on the colonic surface containing fibrin, inflammatory cells, and cellular debris.

HP_0034639.label: bloodstream microfilaria
HP_0034639.definition: Presence of filaria in the blood stream. Filariasis is a common cause of elephantiasis in Coastal Districts of India. The initial manifestations are repeated episodes of fever with chills and rigor, lymphadenopathy which gradually progress to elephantiasis. In India filarial infestation is commonly caused by W. bancrofti and Brugia malayi, the former responsible for almost 98 percent of all cases.

HP_0034640.label: skin infectious agent
HP_0034640.definition: The presence of an infectious agent in the skin.

HP_0034641.label: dermal microfilaria
HP_0034641.definition: Presence of filariae in the skin.

HP_0034642.label: dermal papillary iga deposition
HP_0034642.definition: Accumulation of immunoglobulin A (IgA) surrounding dermal papillae, which are specialized cells that support the hair follicle.
HP_0034642.synonyms: granular iga deposits at the dermal papillae

HP_0034643.label: dermal immune complex deposition
HP_0034643.definition: Accumulation of antigen-bound antibody in the skin.

HP_0034644.label: abnormal liver metabolite concentration
HP_0034644.definition: The concentration of a metabolite in the liver is above or below the limits of normal.

HP_0034645.label: hepatic polyglucosan accumulation
HP_0034645.definition: Intracellular accumulation of polyglucosan bodies-containing amylopectinlike polysaccharide-in the liver.
HP_0034645.synonyms: accumulation of polyglucosan bodies in the liver

HP_0034646.label: urinary bladder neurofibroma
HP_0034646.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) located in the urinary bladder.

HP_0034647.label: synovial granuloma
HP_0034647.definition: An aggregation of macrophages (forming in response to chronic inflammation) localized in the lining of a joint (synovium).

HP_0034659.label: elevated urine tiglylglycine level

HP_0034665.definition: Lack of full passive range of motion (restrictions in flexion, extension, or other movements) of the shoulder joint resulting from structural changes of non-bony tissues, such as muscles, tendons, ligaments, joint capsules and/or skin.

HP_0034683.label: reduced muscle telethonin level
HP_0034683.definition: Amount of telethonin protein expression in muscle tissue below lower limit of normal. Telethonin is a 19-kDa sarcomeric protein, localized to the Z-disc of skeletal and cardiac muscles.
HP_0034683.synonyms: muscle biopsy : telethonin low or absent

HP_0034684.label: abnormal enzyme concentration or activity
HP_0034684.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal.

HP_0034685.label: abnormal liver enzyme activity or concentration
HP_0034685.definition: Concentration or activity of an enzyme is above or below the limits of normal in liver tissue.
HP_0034685.synonyms: abnormal hepatic enzyme activity or concentration

HP_0034686.label: reduced hepatic urocanase activity
HP_0034686.definition: Activity of urocanase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034687.label: impaired cerebroside sulfate hydrolysis
HP_0034687.definition: Reduced hydrolysis (splitting of a bond and the addition of the hydrogen anion of water) of the sulfuric ester linkage in the molecule of cerebroside sulfate, possibly leading to accumuation of cerebroside sulfate.

HP_0034688.label: reduced peroxisomal glutaryl - coa oxidase activity
HP_0034688.definition: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.

HP_0034689.label: reduced sterol 27 - hydroxylase activity
HP_0034689.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme sterol 27-hydroxylase, which participates in the degradation of cholesterol to bile acid. Sterol 27-hydroxylase catalyzes the first step in the normal oxidation of the steroid side chain, converting cholesterol, as well as different 7a-hydroxylated cholesterol metabolites, to 27-oxygenated steroids.

HP_0034690.label: reduced short - chain acyl - coa dehydrogenase activity
HP_0034690.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme Short-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (SCAD), a key enzyme of fatty acid beta-oxidation that catalyses the first step in mitochondrial beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

HP_0034691.label: reduced 3 - phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase activity
HP_0034691.definition: Diminished activity of the enzyme 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (PGDH), which catalyzes the first step in the pathway by converting D-3-phosphoglycerate (PGA), an intermediate in glycolysis, to phosphohydroxypyruvate concomitant with the reduction of NAD+.

HP_0034692.label: elongated mitochondria
HP_0034692.UMLS synonyms: Elongated mitochondria (fibroblasts) | Fibroblasts show elongated mitochondria | Skeletal muscle biopsy shows elongated mitochondria | Fibroblasts show elongated, tangled, tubular mitochondria | Subsarcolemmal accumulation of enlarged mitochondria with variably sized rectangular or elongated rhomboidal paracrystalline inclusions | Fatty Acid Elongation Pathway in Mitochondria | TEFM protein, human

HP_0034693.label: reduced hepatic methionine adenosyltransferase activity
HP_0034693.definition: Activity of methionine adenosyltransferase in the liver below the lower limit of normal. Note that there are multiple methionine adenosyltransferase isoezymes.

HP_0034694.label: substantia nigra dopaminergic neuron loss
HP_0034694.definition: Degeneration and loss of neruons in the substantia nigra of the brain.

HP_0034696.label: intramuscular lipoma
HP_0034696.definition: A lipoma that is located within a muscle.
HP_0034696.UMLS synonyms: Intramuscular lipoma | Infiltrating Intramuscular Lipoma | Excision of intramuscular lipoma

HP_0034697.label: cutaneous telangiectasia
HP_0034697.definition: Dilated blood vessels on the skin.
HP_0034697.UMLS synonyms: Cutaneous telangiectasia | Primary idiopathic cutaneous telangiectasia | CUTANEOUS TELANGIECTASIA AND CANCER SYNDROME, FAMILIAL | Familial cutaneous telangiectasia and oropharyngeal cancer predisposition syndrome | Glomerulonephritis sparse hair telangiectases

HP_0034698.label: abnormal aromatase activity
HP_0034698.definition: Aromatase activity outside of the normal range.

HP_0034699.label: elevated aromatase activity
HP_0034699.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034700.label: reduced aromatase activity
HP_0034700.definition: Enzyme activity of aromatase below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034701.label: corneal amyloidosis
HP_0034701.definition: A form of amyloidosis that is located in the cornea.
HP_0034701.UMLS synonyms: Corneal dystrophy, Lattice type 3 | Isolated corneal amyloidosis | Amyloid of cornea | Meretoja syndrome

HP_0034702.label: abnormal keratinocyte morphology
HP_0034702.definition: Any structural anomaly of the keratinocyte. The keratinocyte is the major cell type of the epidermis and is responsible for generating the protective barrier.

HP_0034703.label: keratinocyte vacuolization
HP_0034703.definition: Increased number of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in keratinocytes.
HP_0034703.UMLS synonyms: Vacuolation of superficial keratinocytes | Perinuclear vacuolization of keratinocytes | Subnuclear vacuolization in basal keratinocytes | Intracytoplasmic vacuoles in basal keratinocytes (with negative oil red O-staining)

HP_0034704.label: parotid gland adenocarcinoma
HP_0034704.definition: An adenocarcinoma that arises from the parotid gland.
HP_0034704.UMLS synonyms: Adenocarcinoma of the Rat Parotid Gland | Primary adenocarcinoma of parotid gland | Parotid gland adenoma and adenocarcinoma

HP_0034705.label: pulmonary vasculitis
HP_0034705.definition: Cellular inflammation, vessel destruction, and tissue necrosis of the blood vessels of the lung.
HP_0034705.UMLS synonyms: AUTOINFLAMMATION WITH PULMONARY AND CUTANEOUS VASCULITIS | Post-arteritic pulmonary hypertension

HP_0034706.label: reduced hepatic d - glycerate kinase activity
HP_0034706.definition: Activity of D-glycerate kinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034707.label: lymph - node hemophagocytosis
HP_0034707.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages in a lymph node.
HP_0034707.UMLS synonyms: Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow and lymph nodes | Hemophagocytosis in bone marrow, lymph nodes, spleen, liver, and central nervous system

HP_0034708.label: superior pubic ramus hypoplasia
HP_0034708.definition: Underdevelopment of the upper branch of the pubis bone (inferior pubic ramus).

HP_0034709.label: uterine adenofibroma
HP_0034709.definition: A rare benign mullerian mixed tumor of the uterus composed of benign epithelial and mesenchymal components.
HP_0034709.UMLS synonyms: Uterine Corpus Adenofibroma | adenofibroma of uterus

HP_0034710.label: pulmonary hamartoma
HP_0034710.definition: A benign malformation of the lung that includes an abnormal mixture of tissue components such as cartilage, epithelium, fat, or muscle which are common to the lung but without preservation of the organ architecture.
HP_0034710.UMLS synonyms: Hamartoma of lung | Congenital Peribronchial Myofibroblastic Tumor | Solitary hamartoma of lung | Multiple hamartoma of lung

HP_0034711.label: peripheral axonal distension
HP_0034711.definition: An abnormal histological finding characterized by an increase in the cross-section area of peripheral nerve axons (up to 20-25 micrometers in diameter).

HP_0034712.label: decreased circulating alpha - mannosidase activity
HP_0034712.definition: Concentration or activity of alpha mannosidase below the lower limit of normal in the blood circulation.

HP_0034713.label: abnormal hepatocyte morphology
HP_0034713.definition: A structural anomaly of the hepatocyte, which is the main cell type that makes up the liver perncyhma. Hepatocytes are usually binucleated and appear as sheets in the liver tissue.

HP_0034714.label: hepatic melanin - like lysosomal pigmentation
HP_0034714.definition: Accumulation of dark, coarsely granular pigment localized in lysosomes of centrilobular hepatocytes.

HP_0034715.label: reduced uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase activity
HP_0034715.definition: Activity of the enzyme uroporphyrinogen decarboxylase (UROD; EC 4.1.1.37) below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034716.label: reduced heme oxygenase activity
HP_0034716.definition: Activity of the enzyme heme oxygenase below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034717.label: swollen achromatic neurons in the cerebral cortex
HP_0034717.definition: The presence of enlarged and swollen neurons that lack Nissl bodies (the rough endoplasmic reticulum-achromasia refers to neurons that lack Nissl bodies) in the cortex of the brain.
HP_0034717.synonyms: cerebral cortex pick cells | cerebral cortex swollen achromatic neurons

HP_0034718.label: vacuolated hepatocytes
HP_0034718.definition: Presence of vacuoles (membrane-bound organelles that areempty of cytoplasm, lined with a membrane, and filled with fluid) in hepatocytes, which normally rarely contain vacuoles.

HP_0034719.label: lack of oocyte pronucleus formation
HP_0034719.definition: An abnormality of oocyte maturation characterized by the inability of oocytes to form pronuclei after in vitro fertilization procedures. Oocytes normally show two pronuclei 17 to 20 hours after in vitro insemination.

HP_0034720.label: self - healing squamous epithelioma
HP_0034720.definition: A type of skin tumor that initially presents as a reddish macule and subsequently becomes papular, enlarged, ulcerated and ultimately heals leaving pitted scars.
HP_0034720.UMLS synonyms: Multiple self-healing squamous epithelioma | MULTIPLE SELF-HEALING SQUAMOUS EPITHELIOMA, SUSCEPTIBILITY TO | TGFBR1 gene | Multiple Self Healing Squamous Epithelioma (MSSE) Gene Anomaly Detection Reagents | TGFBR1 wt Allele

HP_0034721.label: elevated circulating pristanic acid concentration
HP_0034721.definition: Concentration of pristanic acid in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034722.label: sarcoplasmic bodies
HP_0034722.definition: Rounded or oval structures that appeared brown on hematoxylin and eosin and red on the modified Gomori trichrome stain.
HP_0034722.UMLS synonyms: Sarcoplasmic bodies | Sarcoplasmic bodies seen on muscle biopsy | Nemaline bodies are usually subsarcolemmal or sarcoplasmic | Myopathy, desmin storage | MYOPATHY, SARCOPLASMIC BODY

HP_0034724.label: reduced csf cystine concentration
HP_0034724.definition: Concentration of cystine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal. Cystine is sulfur-containing amino acid obtained by the oxidation of two cysteine molecules which are then linked via a disulfide bond.

HP_0034725.label: abnormal circulating beta - mannosidase activity
HP_0034725.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase outside normal limits. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

HP_0034726.label: elevated circulating beta - mannosidase activity
HP_0034726.definition: Activity of the enzyme beta-mannosidase above the upper limit of normal. Beta-mannosidase is a lysosomal enzyme that catabolizes oligosaccharides.

HP_0034727.label: reduced circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP_0034727.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034728.label: abnormal circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP_0034728.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase in the blood circulation outside the limits of normal.

HP_0034729.label: elevated circulating alpha - l - fucosidase activity
HP_0034729.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-L-fucosidase above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034730.label: elevated circulating s - adenosyl - l - homocysteine concentration
HP_0034730.definition: Increased concentration of S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine in the blood circulation.

HP_0034731.label: elevated circulating s - adenosyl - l - methionine concentration
HP_0034731.definition: Concentration S-adenosyl-L-methionine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034732.label: exercise - triggered malignant hyperthermia
HP_0034732.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by exercise-induced life-threatening hyperthermia with a body temperature over 40 degrees C and signs of encephalopathy ranging from confusion to convulsions or coma. Incidence increases with rising ambient temperature and relative humidity. Manifestations may include rhabdomyolysis (presenting with myalgia, muscle weakness, and myoglobinuria), tachycardia, and in severe cases multiorgan failure.
HP_0034732.synonyms: exertional heat stroke | malignant hyperthermia due to exercise

HP_0034733.label: anesthesic - triggered malignant hyperthermia
HP_0034733.definition: Malignant hyperthermia that is characterized by a rapid increase in temperature to 39-42 degrees C in response to inhalational anesthetics such as halothane or to muscle relaxants such as succinylcholine.
HP_0034733.synonyms: malignant hyperthermia with anaesthesia | malignant hyperthermia with anesthesia

HP_0034734.label: elevated csf argininosuccinic acid concentration
HP_0034734.definition: Concentration of argininosuccinic acid in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034735.label: elevated csf aspartylglucosamine concentration
HP_0034735.definition: Concentration of aspartylglucosamine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034736.label: elevated circulating alpha - oxoadipic acid concentration
HP_0034736.definition: Concentration of alpha-oxoadipic acid in the blood above the upper limit of normal.
HP_0034736.synonyms: alpha - oxoadipic acid high in blood

HP_0034737.label: abnormal erythrocyte metabolite concentration
HP_0034737.definition: A deviation from the normal range of a metabolite in red blood cells.

HP_0034738.label: reduced erythrocyte glutathione concentration
HP_0034738.definition: Concentration of glutathione in red blood cells below the lower limit of normal. Glutathione (GSH) is an important redox active biomolecule critical in the maintenance and regulation of cellular and organismal health.

HP_0034739.label: elevated csf sarcosine concentration
HP_0034739.definition: Concentration of sarcosine in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034740.label: reduced csf methionine concentration
HP_0034740.definition: Concentration of methionine in the cerebrospinal fluid below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034741.label: elevated circulating homoarginine concentration
HP_0034741.definition: Concentration of homoarginine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034742.label: elevated urinary formiminoglutamic acid level
HP_0034742.definition: The concentration of formiminoglutamic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034743.label: elevated csf proline concentration
HP_0034743.definition: Concentration of proline in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034744.label: elevated urinary s - sulfocysteine level

HP_0034745.label: elevated circulating s - sulfocysteine concentration
HP_0034745.definition: Concentration of S-sulfocysteine in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034746.label: sertoli cell hyperplasia
HP_0034746.definition: Abnormal increase in the number of Sertoli cells in the testis.

HP_0034749.label: fungal bloodstream infection
HP_0034749.definition: Detection of a fungal organism (such as candida or coccidioides) in the blood stream.

HP_0034750.label: supraclavicular lymphadenopathy

HP_0034752.definition: Enlarged lymph node located in the axillary region (armpit).

HP_0034753.label: positive murphy sign
HP_0034753.definition: Murphy's sign is elicited in patients with acute cholecystitis by asking the patient to take in and hold a deep breath while palpating the subcostal region. In practice, Murphy's sign is performed by palpating the subcostal region during inspiration. If pain is elicited and the patient suddenly stops their inspiratory effort, a positive Murphy's sign has been elicited.
HP_0034753.synonyms: murphy 's sign | murphy 's sign positive | sweeney 's sign

HP_0034754.label: bilious emesis
HP_0034754.definition: Vomiting whereby the vomit has the color of bile, yellowish-green.

HP_0034755.label: ameliorated by nsaid
HP_0034755.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
HP_0034755.synonyms: ameliorated by nonsteroidal anti - inflammatory drug

HP_0034756.label: fetal exposure history
HP_0034756.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to a medication or other substance.
HP_0034756.synonyms: fetal medication or drug exposure | foetal medication or drug exposure | maternal exposure history

HP_0034757.label: fetal barbiturate exposure
HP_0034757.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to barbiturate medications such as phenobarbital. Barbiturates are used medically as anxiolytics, hypnotics, and anticonvulsants.

HP_0034758.label: fetal narcotic exposure
HP_0034758.definition: A history of exposure during pregnancy of the mother of a fetus or child to narcotic medications such as morphine or codeine. Narcotics are used medically to treat moderate or severe pain.

HP_0034759.label: ameliorated by ethosuximide
HP_0034759.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by administration of ethosuximide. Ethosuximide is most often used to treat absence seizures.

HP_0034760.label: reduced epidermal extracellular matrix protein 1 protein expression
HP_0034760.definition: Lower than normal amount of extracellular matrix protein 1 (ECM1) in the epidermis.

HP_0034761.label: neurofibroma by anatomical location
HP_0034761.definition: Neurofibroma categorized according to the anatomical site of origin.

HP_0034762.label: tongue neurofibroma
HP_0034762.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the tongue.

HP_0034763.label: cardiac neurofibroma
HP_0034763.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the heart.

HP_0034764.label: gastric neurofibroma
HP_0034764.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the stomach.

HP_0034765.label: renal neurofibroma
HP_0034765.definition: A neurofibroma (benign peripheral nerve sheath tumor) localized in the kidney.

HP_0034766.label: muscle fiber polyglucosan inclusion bodies
HP_0034766.definition: Accumulation of a poorly branched and poorly spherical amylopectin-like glycogen (polyglucosan) in muscle fibers.

HP_0034767.label: abnormal rete ridge morphology
HP_0034767.definition: Abnormal structure of the rete ridges (also known as rete pegs), which are downward projections of epithelium surrounding the connective tissue papillae in between the dermal papillae.

HP_0034768.label: rete ridge elongation
HP_0034768.definition: Increased length of the rete rdiges of the epidermis.
HP_0034768.synonyms: elongation of rete ridges | rete ridges elongated

HP_0034769.label: pulmonary langerhans cell histiocytosis
HP_0034769.definition: Accumulation of monoclonal CD1a-positive Langerhans cells in the bronchioles and alveolar interstitium that can cause damage to the lungs.
HP_0034769.UMLS synonyms: Adult pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis | Feline pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis | Pulmonary Histiocytosis X | Pulmonary hypertension in Langerhans cell histiocytosis

HP_0034770.label: lumbar hypolordosis
HP_0034770.definition: Flattening of a curve in the spine in the lumbar (lower back) region.

HP_0034771.label: battle sign
HP_0034771.definition: Battle sign is bruising over the mastoid process that is typically the result of head trauma. It is retroauricular or mastoid ecchymosis that is typically the result of head trauma. Battle sign typically requires significant head trauma and may indicate significant internal injury to the brain and not just the posterior cranial vault or mastoid.

HP_0034772.label: decreased skull base length
HP_0034772.definition: Reduced anterioposterior dimension of the skull base.
HP_0034772.synonyms: decreased cranial base length | short skull base

HP_0034773.label: oscillopsia
HP_0034773.definition: A visual disturbance in which objects in the visual field appear to oscillate (jump, jiggle, vibrate).

HP_0034774.label: decreased blink rate
HP_0034774.definition: The frequency with which the eye is blinked is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_0034775.label: abnormal blink rate
HP_0034775.definition: A deviation from the normal frequency of blinking the eye.

HP_0034776.label: elevated blink rate
HP_0034776.definition: The frequecy with which the eye is blinked is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_0034777.label: purulent sputum
HP_0034777.UMLS synonyms: Purulent sputum | SPUTUM APPEARANCE PURULENT | macroscopic examination of sputum purulent | coughing up thick yellow-green sputum

HP_0034778.label: maternal hyperthyroidism
HP_0034778.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of hyperthyroidism during the corresponding pregnancy.

HP_0034779.label: perineal
HP_0034779.definition: Applies to an abnormality that affects the perineum (the region of skin between the genitals and the anus).
HP_0034779.synonyms: perineal distribution to finding | perineal location

HP_0034780.label: gadolinium exposure
HP_0034780.definition: History of exposure to gadolinium, a contrast medium often used for magnetic resonance imaging.

HP_0034781.label: purulent parotid gland drainage
HP_0034781.definition: Excretion of pus (purulent discharge) from the opening of the parotid duct.

HP_0034782.label: obstipation
HP_0034782.definition: Obstipation is the inability to pass either stool or flatus (gas).
HP_0034782.synonyms: lack of flatulence | no gas passage | tympanic distended abdomen

HP_0034784.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to the anatomical site where the finding is localized.

HP_0034785.label: vasculitis by histology
HP_0034785.definition: Vasculitis categorized according to type of histological abnormality.

HP_0034786.label: leukocytoclastic vasculitis
HP_0034786.definition: A type of vasculitis characterized by the presence of debris of neutrophils within the blood vessel walls.

HP_0034788.definition: A pericardial friction rub is a grating, to-and-fro sound that occurs in phase with the heart sounds.
HP_0034788.UMLS synonyms: Pericardial friction rub | Pericardial friction rub absent

HP_0034790.label: abnormal muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
HP_0034790.definition: Any deviation from the normal amount of staining of succinate dehydrogenase in skeletal muscle tissue.

HP_0034792.label: decreased muscle succinate dehydrogenase staining
HP_0034792.UMLS synonyms: Decreased succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) staining seen on muscle biopsy

HP_0034793.label: small intestinal hamartoma
HP_0034793.definition: A benign (noncancerous) tumorlike malformation made up of an abnormal mixture of cells and tissues that originates in the small intestine.
HP_0034793.UMLS synonyms: Small Intestinal Hamartoma | Hamartoma of small intestine | Peutz-Jeghers polyps of small bowel

HP_0034794.label: pyriform sperm head
HP_0034794.definition: Pyriform spermatozoa consist of a normally shaped acrosomal structure which can be normal in size or enlarged, while the post-acrosomal region shows severe elongation and an acute narrowing to the posterior end, ending in about the same thickness as the connecting mid-piece.

HP_0034795.label: excess residual spermatozoal cytoplasm
HP_0034795.definition: Excess residual cytoplasm is associated with abnormal spermatozoa produced from a defective spermiation process. This abnormal excess cytoplasm should not be confused with more physiological cytoplasmic residues that can be observed in direct microscopy of the ejaculate but not in dried, fixed and stained morphology smears.

HP_0034796.label: cardiomyocyte hyaline bodies
HP_0034796.definition: Subsarcolemmal, eosinophilic glass-like regions within the cytoplasm of cardiomyocytes.

HP_0034797.label: hepatic hemophagocytosis
HP_0034797.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the liver.

HP_0034798.label: csf hemophagocytosis
HP_0034798.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

HP_0034799.label: splenic hemophagocytosis
HP_0034799.definition: Phagocytosis of erythrocytes, lymphocytes or other hematopoietic precursors by histiocytes or macrophages observed in the spleen.

HP_0034800.label: urinary bladder granulomatosis
HP_0034800.definition: The presence of multiple granulomas in the urinary bladder as based on pathological examination. Granulomas are small 0.5 to 2 mm collections of modified macrophages called epithelioid cells usually surrounded by lymphocytes.

HP_0034801.label: epidermal necrosis
HP_0034801.definition: Death of keratinocytes in the epidermis layer of the skin, which generally manifests as extensive exfoliation (separation of the epidermis from the underlying dermis).

HP_0034802.label: exacerbated by flexion
HP_0034802.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is aggravated by (or made more painful by) bending of a limb or joint.
HP_0034802.UMLS synonyms: elbow pain exacerbated by wrist flexion

HP_0034803.label: hemolacria
HP_0034803.definition: The presence of blood in tears.
HP_0034803.synonyms: bloody epiphora | bloody tears | red tears

HP_0034804.label: corneal foreign body sensation
HP_0034804.definition: A perception that an object is in contact with the eye.

HP_0034805.label: buttock pain
HP_0034805.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the buttock (round fleshy area at the lower rear area of a human trunk).
HP_0034805.UMLS synonyms: Pain in buttock | Buttock Pain, CTCAE_3 | Buttock Pain, CTCAE_5 | left buttock pain | right buttock pain | Leg/buttock pain | dull or aching buttock pain | Grade 1 Buttock Pain, CTCAE | Grade 3 Buttock Pain, CTCAE | Grade 2 Buttock Pain, CTCAE | Grade 4 Buttock Pain, CTCAE | pain in left buttock causing difficulty sitting | pain in right buttock causing difficulty sitting | buttock pain radiating to back of thigh | buttock pain radiating to back of leg | lower back pain radiating to left buttock | lower back pain radiating to right buttock | soft tissue hip pain radiating to buttock | decreased pain and temperature sensation of buttock and perianal region (S3, S4, S5 dermatomes) | decreased pain and temperature sensation of left buttock and perianal region | decreased pain and temperature sensation of right buttock and perianal region | pain in both buttocks | Muscle pain in buttocks | lower back pain radiating to buttocks | lower back pain radiating to both buttocks

HP_0034806.label: vaginal foreign body sensation
HP_0034806.definition: A perception that an object located in the vagina.

HP_0034807.label: paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea
HP_0034807.definition: Attacks of breathlessness that occur at night and may awaken the sleeping patient.

HP_0034808.label: eyelid pain
HP_0034808.definition: An unpleasant sensation characterized by physical discomfort (such as pricking, throbbing, or aching) localized to the eyelid.
HP_0034808.UMLS synonyms: Observe the ABCs: Appearance of the eyes (e.g., crossed, wandering, red, watery, drooping eyelids); Behavior (e.g., squinting, blinking, rubbing eyes, turning head to use only one eye, tilting head, tripping); Complaints (e.g., headaches, eye pain, dizziness, itching eyes, blurred vision, unusual sensitivity to light)

HP_0034809.label: abnormal sperm physiology
HP_0034809.definition: Abnormality of a sperm function including protection of paternal DNA, traversing the female reproductive tract, oocyte localisation, penetration of the zona pellucida, oocyte activation and centriole deposition.

HP_0034810.label: small acrosomal area
HP_0034810.definition: Reduction in size of the acrosome below the lower limit of normal. The acrosome is a unique membranous organelle located over the anterior part of the sperm nucleus. According to the World Health Organization criteria, the acrosome must be clearly visible, comprising approximately 40-70 percent of the sperm head.
HP_0034810.UMLS synonyms: Small acrosomal area of sperm head

HP_0034811.label: bent sperm flagella
HP_0034811.definition: The proportion of sperm cells whose flagella is sharply curved or has a sharp angle is above normal limits.

HP_0034812.label: spermiation failure
HP_0034812.definition: Spermiation failure is indicated by apparently normal spermiogenesis, but the presence of retained Sd2 spermatids in stages III-V of human spermatogenesis, whereas maturation arrest is indicated by a lack of late Sd1 and Sd2 spermatids in the epithelium.

HP_0034813.label: hypospermatogenesis
HP_0034813.definition: A morphological abnormality visible upon biopsy of the germinal epithelium of the testis in which the cellularity of the germinal epithelium is reduced in general, so that all stages of germ cells (spermatogonia, spermatocytes, and spermatids) are present but reduced in number. This term applies to biopsies with some tubules showing diminished amounts of qualitatively complete spermatogenesis in combination with a vast majority of tubules that lack germ cells.
HP_0034813.UMLS synonyms: Hypospermatogenesis | Oligospermia | History of hypospermatogenesis | Cytotoxic drug-induced hypospermatogenesis | Drug abuse-induced hypospermatogenesis | Testicular biopsy shows hypospermatogenesis | HYPOSPERMATOGENESIS, NONOBSTRUCTIVE, Y-LINKED | oligospermia due to hypospermatogenesis | Male infertility due to hypospermatogenesis | Hypospermatogenesis due to and following radiotherapy | Testicular hypofunction due to and following radiotherapy | Infertility due to oligospermia

HP_0034814.label: conjunctival membrane
HP_0034814.definition: Formation of a sheet of tissue by coagulum of exudate over the conjunctiva of the eye that if removed leaves behind a denuded bleeding surface.
HP_0034814.UMLS synonyms: CONJUNCTIVAL MEMBRANE, WHITE | Reconstruction of conjunctival cul-de-sac using buccal mucous membrane graft | Repair of symblepharon with free graft of conjunctiva

HP_0034815.label: extreme oligozoospermia
HP_0034815.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than zero but less than 2 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than zero but less than one million sperm per milliliter.

HP_0034816.label: mild oligozoospermia
HP_0034816.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 30 but less than 39 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 10 but less than 15 million sperm per milliliter.

HP_0034817.label: moderate oligozoospermia
HP_0034817.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 10 but less than 29 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 5 but less than 10 million sperm per milliliter.

HP_0034818.label: severe oligozoospermia
HP_0034818.definition: A type of oligozoospermia characterized by a total number of more than 2 but less than 10 million sperm in the ejaculate or a concentration of more than 1 but less than 5 million sperm per milliliter.

HP_0034819.label: iris nodule
HP_0034819.definition: The presence of a nodule (small rounded lump of tissue) in the iris.
