HP_5201005.definition: Cleft soft palate in which the cleft goes through the entire length of the soft palate, i.e. from the posterior border of the hard palate until the uvula.
HP_5201005.UMLS synonyms: Complete cleft of soft palate | complete cleft hard palate with cleft soft palate | Complete cleft hard and soft palate | Complete cleft of right hard and soft palate | Complete cleft of left hard and soft palate

HP_5201006.label: incomplete cleft soft palate
HP_5201006.definition: Cleft soft palate in which the cleft does not go through the entire length of the soft palate, i.e. the cleft does not go from the posterior border of the hard palate until the uvula.
HP_5201006.UMLS synonyms: Incomplete cleft of soft palate | incomplete cleft hard palate with cleft soft palate | Incomplete cleft hard and soft palate

HP_5201007.label: incomplete cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
HP_5201007.definition: Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge in which the cleft does not go through the entire length of the maxillary alveolar ridge.

HP_5201008.label: complete cleft maxillary alveolar ridge
HP_5201008.definition: Cleft maxillary alveolar ridge in which the cleft goes through the entire length of the maxillary alveolar ridge.

HP_5201009.label: complete cleft of the upper lip
HP_5201009.definition: Cleft of the upper lip that starts from the bottom of the upper lip and reaches the nasal cavity.

HP_5201010.label: microform cleft of the upper lip
HP_5201010.definition: Notch, groove, or scar of the upper lip without noticeable rupture of the lip.

HP_5201011.label: complete bilateral cleft lip
HP_5201011.definition: Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides is complete, i.e. start from the bottom of the upper lip and reach the nasal cavity.
HP_5201011.UMLS synonyms: Complete bilateral cleft lip | Bilateral complete cleft palate with cleft lip | bilateral complete cleft lip or alveolus | Bilateral complete and incomplete cleft lip | Bilateral complete cleft lip and bilateral complete cleft of alveolar process of maxilla | Bilateral complete and incomplete cleft lip and alveolus

HP_5201012.label: incomplete bilateral cleft lip
HP_5201012.definition: Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides are incomplete (i.e. start from the bottom of the upper lip but do not reach the nasal cavity), or the cleft lip on one is incomplete and a microform on the other side.
HP_5201012.UMLS synonyms: Incomplete bilateral cleft lip | Bilateral incomplete cleft palate and bilateral incomplete cleft lip | Cleft palate with cleft lip, bilateral, incomplete | Bilateral complete and incomplete cleft lip | Bilateral incomplete cleft lip and bilateral incomplete cleft of alveolar process of maxilla | Bilateral complete and incomplete cleft lip and alveolus

HP_5201013.label: microform bilateral cleft lip
HP_5201013.definition: Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on both sides are microform, i.e. a notch, groove, or scar without noticeable rupture of the lip.

HP_5201014.label: asymmetric bilateral cleft lip
HP_5201014.definition: Bilateral cleft lip in which the cleft lip on one side is complete (i.e. starts from the bottom of the upper lip and reaches the nasal cavity), and the one on the other side is incomplete (i.e. starts from the bottom of the upper lip but does not reach the nasal cavity) or microform (i.e. a notch, groove, or scar without noticeable rupture of the lip).

HP_5201015.label: craniofacial cleft
HP_5201015.definition: Congenital abnormality with cleft (gap or opening) in the craniofacial bones. Craniofacial cleft includes facial cleft, orofacial clef, and cleft of the jaw.
HP_5201015.UMLS synonyms: Craniofacial cleft | Cleft and Craniofacial | Cleft and Craniofacial|ANYTypeOfService|ANYKindOfNote|ANYSetting | Genetic facial cleft | Note:Find:Pt:Outpatient:Doc:Cleft and Craniofacial | Note:Find:Pt:Telehealth:Doc:Cleft and Craniofacial | Cleft lip and palate, craniofacial dysmorphism, congenital heart defect, hearing loss syndrome | Craniofacial malformations: Other (e.g., ear dysplasia, oral facial clefting, white forelock, microphthalmia)

HP_5201016.label: submucous cleft palate
HP_5201016.definition: A cleft of the muscular portion of the palate that is covered by mucous membrane.
HP_5201016.UMLS synonyms: Submucous cleft palate | Occult submucous cleft palate | Submucous cleft of hard palate | Submucous cleft lip and palate | Submucous cleft palate Median groove of tongue

HP_6000000.label: left - right disorientation
HP_6000000.definition: A tendency to mix up left and right in one's own body space, typically elicited by asking a person to perform a two-stage command involving specified lateralized anatomy.
HP_6000000.synonyms: left - right confusion | right - left confusion | right - left disorientation

HP_6000001.label: elevated circulating dnajb9 protein concentration
HP_6000001.definition: Concentration of DnaJ homolog subfamily B member 9 (DNAJB9) in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_6000001.synonyms: dnajb9 protein level in serum elevated

HP_6000002.label: olecranon fracture
HP_6000002.definition: A partial or complete break in the olecranon,which is the proximal articular portion of the ulna and makes up part of the elbow.
HP_6000002.UMLS synonyms: Olecranon Fracture | OLECRANON FRACTURE CLOSED | OLECRANON FRACTURE AVULSION | OLECRANON FRACTURE FIXATION | OLECRANON FRACTURE SUBTROCHANTERIC | Fracture of left olecranon | Fracture of right olecranon | nondisplaced fracture of olecranon process | displaced fracture of olecranon process | Closed fracture olecranon, intra-articular | Closed fracture olecranon, extra-articular | Open fracture olecranon, intra-articular | Open fracture olecranon, extra-articular | fracture of olecranon, intra-articular | Closed fracture of olecranon process of ulna | fracture of olecranon, extra-articular | Open fracture of olecranon process of ulna | Closed reduction of fracture of olecranon | Open reduction of fracture of olecranon | closed treatment of fracture of olecranon | closed fracture of left olecranon process | Fracture of olecranon process of ulna | closed fracture of right olecranon process | open treatment of fracture of olecranon | Open reduction of fracture of olecranon with partial ostectomy of olecranon fragment

HP_6000003.label: history of mastectomy
HP_6000003.definition: Past medical history of surgical breast removal.
HP_6000003.UMLS synonyms: History of mastectomy | Family history of mastectomy | History of left mastectomy | History of prophylactic mastectomy | History of right mastectomy | History of bilateral mastectomy | History of bilateral prophylactic mastectomy | History of prophylactic mastectomy of left breast | History of prophylactic mastectomy of right breast | Women who had a bilateral mastectomy or who have a history of a bilateral mastectomy or for whom there is evidence of a right and a left unilateral mastectomy (M1280) | Women who had a bilateral mastectomy or who have a history of a bilateral mastectomy or for whom there is evidence of a right and a left unilateral mastectomy (G9708)

HP_6000004.label: lymphangiosarcoma
HP_6000004.definition: A malignant neoplasm arising from the endothelial cells of the lymphatic vessels.
HP_6000004.UMLS synonyms: lymphangiosarcoma | Skin Lymphangiosarcoma | lymphangiosarcoma of soft tissue | lymphangiosarcoma of digestive tract | connective tissue sarcoma lymphangiosarcoma | Lymphangiosarcoma of the Mouse Skin

HP_6000005.label: exposure to inhaled lipids
HP_6000005.definition: Aspiration or inhalation of lipid-containing products.

HP_6000006.label: holster sign
HP_6000006.definition: Symmetric poikiloderma of hips and lateral thighs below the greater trochanter.

HP_6000007.label: salivary basal cell adenoma
HP_6000007.definition: A rare neoplasm consisting of a monomorphic population of basaloid epithelial cells, and it accounts for approximately 1-2% of all salivary gland tumors.
HP_6000007.UMLS synonyms: biopsy of salivary gland: basal cell adenoma | Basal Cell Adenoma of the Mouse Salivary Glands | Adenoma, Basal Cell

HP_6000008.label: hemidiaphragm elevation
HP_6000008.definition: Elevated Hemidiaphragm is a condition where one portion of the diaphragm is higher than the other. Elevated hemidiaphragm occurs when one side of the diaphragm becomes weak from muscular disease or loss of innervation due to phrenic nerve injury.
HP_6000008.UMLS synonyms: Elevated right hemidiaphragm | Elevated hemidiaphragm in symptomatic carrier females

HP_6000009.label: cerebriform connective tissue nevus
HP_6000009.definition: The cerebriform connective tissue nevus (CCTN) is one of the most characteristic skin findings. It commonly occurs on the soles of the feet, and frequently causes problems because of pain, pruritus, infection, bleeding,exudation, odor, and walking impairment.

HP_6000010.label: linear hyperpigmentation along blaschko 's lines
HP_6000010.definition: Linear streaks and swirls of macular hyperpigmentation along the lines of Blaschko.

HP_6000011.label: excessive guilt
HP_6000011.definition: Guilt that is excessive in that it is based on an incorrect judgment (that one is responsible for a negative outcome) or is out of proportion to the committed offense.
HP_6000011.UMLS synonyms: CDRS-R - Excessive Guilt | CDRS-R - Excessive Guilt Comment

HP_6000012.label: mediastinal shift
HP_6000012.definition: A deviation of the mediastinum from its normal position in the midline of the thoracic cavity. The mediastinum is a compartment of the thoracic cavity that contains the heart and its blood vessels, the esophagus, trachea, thymus, as well as nerves and lymph nodes.
HP_6000012.UMLS synonyms: Mediastinal shift | Fetal mediastinal shift to left | Fetal mediastinal shift to right

HP_6000013.label: bendopnea
HP_6000013.definition: Dyspnea as a result of bending forward while not holding one's breath; dyspnea or shortness of breath onset within 30 seconds of bending forward.

HP_6000014.label: pain worse when lying flat
HP_6000014.definition: Refers to pain that is worse when the affected individual lies down (flat).

HP_6000015.label: tympanic membrane hypermobility
HP_6000015.definition: Abnormally increased ability to move of the tympanic membrane.

HP_6000016.label: elevated circulating vitamin b12 concentration
HP_6000016.definition: Concentration of vitamin B12 in the blood circulation above the upper limit of normal.
HP_6000016.synonyms: elevated plasma vitamin b12 level | elevated serum cobalamin level | elevated serum vitamin b12 level

HP_6000017.label: elevated circulating soluble fasl concentration
HP_6000017.definition: The concentration of soluble FASL in the blood circulation is above the upper limit of normal. The first apoptosis signal receptor (FAS) pathway regulates apoptosis and is critical for proper development and functioning of the immune system. FAS ligand (FASL) can bind to FAS receptors.

HP_6000018.label: internal anal sphincter achalasia
HP_6000018.definition: A disorder of the internal anal sphincter (IAS) in which the IAS fails to relax that manifests clinically as intractable constipation.

HP_6000019.label: anthracycline exposure
HP_6000019.definition: History of treatment with an anthracycline chemotherapy agent.

HP_6000020.label: binge drinking
HP_6000020.definition: A pattern of episodic heavy alcohol use characterized by the consumption of a high number of drinks per occasion.
HP_6000020.UMLS synonyms: Binge Drinking | Uses strategies to eliminate binge drinking

HP_6000021.label: decreased circulating thrombopoietin concentration
HP_6000021.definition: Concentration of thrombopoietin in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal. Thrombopoietin is a glycoprotein hormone produced by the liver and kidney that stimulates the production and differentiation of megakaryocytes.

HP_6000022.label: collagenoma
HP_6000022.definition: A rare hamartomatous malformation characterized by the predominant proliferation of normal collagen fibers and normal, decreased, or increased elastic fibers. Collagenomas may be solitary or multiple, sporadic, acquired or inherited.
HP_6000022.UMLS synonyms: Connective tissue nevus, NOS | Collagen nevus of skin | Eruptive Collagenoma | Storiform collagenoma | Collagenoma, Familial Cutaneous | Circumscribed storiform collagenoma | Verrucous perforating collagenoma | Eruptive collagenoma of skin | Giant cell storiform collagenoma | Cardiomyopathy hypogonadism collagenoma syndrome

HP_6000023.label: lack of sufficient daily physical activity
HP_6000023.definition: Physical activity levels less than those required for optimal health and prevention of premature death.

HP_6000024.label: synesthesia
HP_6000024.definition: A phenomenon whereby stimulation of one sensory or cognitive pathway leads to automatic, involuntary experiences in a second sensory or cognitive pathway. For instance, people with synaesthesia may experience unusual colours, tastes, and other sensations when engaged in everyday activities like reading or listening to music.
HP_6000024.UMLS synonyms: Synesthesia | Colored Hearing Synesthesia | Lexical-Gustatory Synesthesia | Grapheme-Color Synesthesia | Synesthesialgia

HP_6000025.label: dark cerumen
HP_6000025.definition: Abnormally dark color of cerumen (earwax), which is a waxy substance secreted in the ear canal that normally has a brown, orange, red, yellowish or gray.

HP_6000026.label: history of spicy food intake
HP_6000026.definition: A history of high intake of spciy foods with ingrediaents such as capsaicin, pepper, chilli, ginger, garlic, onion, fenugreek, and turmeric.

HP_6000027.label: oil - drop brown pigmentation of the corneal limbus
HP_6000027.definition: Brown pigment spots in the limbus (border between the cornea and the sclera).

HP_6000028.label: hazardous alcohol use
HP_6000028.definition: Hazardous drinking is defined as a quantity or pattern of alcohol consumption that places individuals at risk for adverse health events. This could include alcohol use despite potentially hazardous or risky consequences, such as operating heavy machinery or drunk driving.
HP_6000028.UMLS synonyms: hazardous AOD use | alcohol use causing a hazard | alcohol use causing hazard while driving | alcohol use causing hazard at work

HP_6000029.label: social anxiety
HP_6000029.definition: Excessive fear of embarrassment, humiliation, or rejection when exposed to possible negative evaluation by others when engaged in a public performance or social interaction.
HP_6000029.UMLS synonyms: Social Anxiety | Social Anxiety Level | Social anxiety disorder (social phobia) | Liebowitz Social Anxiety Scale | social anxiety disorder, performance only | Phobia, Social | anxiety which interferes with social activities | Social Anxiety Scale for Children-Revised | Invite social conversation to ease anxiety | Avoidant disorder of childhood | Anxiety about behavior or performance | RCADS (Revised Children's Anxiety and Depression Scale) social phobia score | CADS (Revised Children's Anxiety and Depression Scale) social phobia subscale | RCADS (Revised Children's Anxiety and Depression Scale) Parent Version social phobia score | RCADS-P (Revised Children's Anxiety and Depression Scale Parent Version) social phobia subscale | Discuss psychological consequences of negative body image, such as development of eating disorder, depression, low self-esteem, social anxiety

HP_6000030.label: placidity
HP_6000030.definition: Flat affect and reduced response to emotional stimuli. Fear and anger responses that are normally present are blunted.
HP_6000030.UMLS synonyms: Bilateral temporal lobe disorder | Placid character | Placid affect | Phyllastrephus placidus

HP_6000031.label: phaeohyphomycosis
HP_6000031.definition: Phaeohyphomycosis refers to infections due to a large group of heterogenous organisms called dematiaceous or melanized fungi. These fungi are distinguished by the predominance of melanin in their cell walls, which likely acts as a virulence factor. Virtually, everyone is exposed to dematiaceous fungi through inhalation, as they are ubiquitous in the environment, although the development of infection is extremely uncommon.
HP_6000031.UMLS synonyms: Phaeohyphomycosis | Disseminated phaeohyphomycosis | Cerebral Phaeohyphomycosis | Subcutaneous Phaeohyphomycosis | Cutaneous Phaeohyphomycosis | Phaeohyphomycosis of skin | Primary Central Nervous System Phaeohyphomycosis | Pheohyphomycotic subcutaneous cyst

HP_6000032.label: autophony
HP_6000032.definition: Hearing one's own voice resonating loudly in the ear.

HP_6000033.label: high altitude exposure
HP_6000033.definition: A history of being at high altitude in situations such hiking, mountain climbing, travel to mountains, or air travel.
HP_6000033.UMLS synonyms: exposure to residence or prolonged visit at high altitude | Exposure to residence or prolonged visit at high altitude, sequela | Exposure to residence or prolonged visit at high altitude, initial encounter | Exposure to residence or prolonged visit at high altitude, subsequent encounter | High altitude pulmonary hypertension

HP_6000034.label: history of recent hospitalization
HP_6000034.definition: A past medical histry of recently being hospitalized.

HP_6000035.label: palpitations terminated by valsava maneuver
HP_6000035.definition: Cessation of palpitations can be induced by Valsava maneuver.

HP_6000036.label: long telomere length
HP_6000036.definition: Abnormally long telomeres in somatic cells.

HP_6000037.label: reduced circulating aromatic l - amino acid decarboxylase activity
HP_6000037.definition: The activity of aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase (also known as DOPA decarboxylase, tryptophan decarboxylase, and 5-hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase) in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.
HP_6000037.synonyms: reduced circulating 5 - hydroxytryptophan decarboxylase activity | reduced circulating dopa decarboxylase , activity

HP_6000038.label: subclavian artery stenosis
HP_6000038.definition: Abnormal narrowing of the subclavian artery.
HP_6000038.UMLS synonyms: Subclavian Steal Syndrome | Bilateral subclavian artery stenosis | Congenital stenosis of subclavian artery | Stenosis of left subclavian artery | Stenosis of right subclavian artery | duplex scan of left subclavian artery: estimated stenosis __% | duplex scan of right subclavian artery: estimated stenosis __%

HP_6000040.label: neuropathic pain
HP_6000040.definition: Neuropathic pain is triggered by lesions to the somatosensory nervous system that alter its structure and function so that pain occurs spontaneously and responses to noxious and innocuous stimuli are pathologically amplified.
HP_6000040.UMLS synonyms: Neuropathic pain | Neuralgia | Peripheral neuropathic pain | Central neuropathic pain | Chronic neuropathic pain | Orofacial neuropathic pain | Neuropathic corneal pain | Neuropathic Pain Quality Scale | Neuropathic Pain Scale Questionnaire | Chronic central neuropathic pain | Chronic peripheral neuropathic pain | Diabetic peripheral neuropathic pain | pain level by Neuropathic Pain Scale (NPS) | Drugs used in neuropathic pain | Neuropathic pain caused by radiation | Chronic neuropathic pain following brain injury | Congenital insensitivity to pain, anosmia, neuropathic arthropathy | Chronic neuropathic pain following spinal cord injury | Chronic peripheral neuropathic pain following peripheral nerve injury | Pudendal Nerve Entrapment Syndrome | Neuropathy Assessment | Chronic central neuropathic pain due to multiple sclerosis | Chronic central neuropathic pain due to brain injury | Autosomal dominant intermediate Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease with neuropathic pain | Chronic central neuropathic pain due to spinal cord injury

HP_6000041.label: repeated old water exposure ,
HP_6000041.definition: A history of repeated exposure to cold water, as may result, for instance, from surfing, diving, kayaking, or swimming.

HP_6000042.label: tinnitus exacerbated by swallowing
HP_6000042.definition: Tinnitus (sound heard by a subjhect when no corresponding external sound is present) that is made worse by swallowing.

HP_6000043.label: rhythmic movements of the tympanic membrane
HP_6000043.definition: Regularly occuring motion of the tympanic membrane (eardrum), which is located between the inner and middle ear. This can be a manifestation of tensor tympani myoclonus, which can also be ascertained as sawtooth patterns on long-term tympanometry.

HP_6000044.label: elongated temporal styloid process
HP_6000044.definition: The length of the temporal styloid process is above the upper limit of normal. The styloid process is a cylindrical, slender, needle-like projection of varying lengths averaging 2 to 3 cm. The styloid process projects from the inferior part of the petrous temporal bone and offers attachment to the stylohyoid ligament and the stylohyoid, stylopharyngeus, and styloglossus muscles.

HP_6000045.label: ameliorated by nitroglycerin
HP_6000045.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by treatment with nitroglycerin.

HP_6000046.label: pulsus paradoxus
HP_6000046.definition: Pulsus paradoxus refers to a systolic pressure drop greater than 10mmHg during inspiration.
HP_6000046.synonyms: kussmaul pulse | paradoxical pulse | paradoxical pulse volume
HP_6000046.UMLS synonyms: Pulsus paradoxus | Monitor for pulsus paradoxus | RNAx assess for pulsus paradoxus | pulsus paradoxus over 10 mmHg

HP_6000047.label: chest pain triggered by palpitation
HP_6000047.definition: Chest pain can be induced by palpation of the chest, which may be an indication of costochondritis.

HP_6000048.label: chest pain described as pressure
HP_6000048.definition: Discomfort in the chest described as pressure, heaviness, or tightness.

HP_6000049.label: chest pain described as ripping or tearing
HP_6000049.definition: Chest pain described as a tearing or ripping sensation.

HP_6000050.label: ameliorated by flexion
HP_6000050.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by bending (flexing) a joint.

HP_6000051.label: located on the chest
HP_6000051.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring around the thorax (chest).
HP_6000051.UMLS synonyms: Irregular annular keratotic lesions with slightly elevated borders, located primarily on the face but also distributed on the chest and forearms

HP_6000052.label: localized to the penis
HP_6000052.definition: Applies to a finding that is situated or occurring in or on the penis.

HP_6000053.label: snowstorm pattern of uterus on ultrasound
HP_6000053.definition: A sonographic snowstorm pattern of the uterusresults from the presence of a complex vesicular intrauterine mass containing many grape-like cysts.

HP_6000054.label: multiparity
HP_6000054.UMLS synonyms: Multiparity | Encounter due to multiparity | Grand multiparity | Problems related to multiparity | pregnancy; multiparity (grand) | Antenatal care: grand multiparity | pregnancy; supervision for multiparity | Encounter due to grand multiparity | grand multiparity with baby delivered | Grand multiparity with antenatal problem | Grand multiparity, with current pregnancy | Psychosocial problems related to multiparity | grand multiparity as antepartum condition | affecting management of pregnancy; multiparity | Supervision of pregnancy with grand multiparity | Grand multiparity, antepartum condition or complication | pregnant with history of grand multiparity | pregnancy; management affected by multiparity (grand) | Encounter for supervision of pregnancy with grand multiparity | Grand multiparity, delivered, with or without mention of antepartum condition | Encounter due to Problems Related to Multiparity | supervision of high risk pregnancy with grand multiparity | multiparity; affecting management of pregnancy, labor and delivery | Supervision of pregnancy with grand multiparity, third trimester | Supervision of pregnancy with grand multiparity, second trimester

HP_6000055.label: exposure to aquatic animals
HP_6000055.definition: History of exposure to aquatic animals.

HP_6000056.label: superficial blush - like subcutaneous fatty lesions
HP_6000056.definition: Multiple, oblong, fatty lesions in the superficial subcutaneous fatty tissue. They are mostly under 2 cm in long axis diameter. They demonstrate nodular (blush-like) increased fluid signal at unenhanced MRI and are markedly hyperechoic at ultrasound.

HP_6000057.label: dermal multinucleated giant cells
HP_6000057.definition: Presence of giant cells in the dermis. Giant cells are formed by fusion of various cells such as macrophage, epithelioid cells, monocytes, etc., These are multi-nucleated, large in size, and generally present at the site of chronic inflammation and other granulomatous conditions.

HP_6000058.label: exacerbation of eyelid lesion by crying
HP_6000058.definition: Applies to an eyelid lesion such as hemangiomas or varices that swells upon crying.

HP_6000059.label: localized to upper eyelid
HP_6000059.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the upper eyelid.

HP_6000060.label: aerophagia
HP_6000060.definition: Repetitive air swallowing and belching and that may result in abdominal distention.

HP_6000061.label: vaginal passage of hydatidiform mole tissue
HP_6000061.definition: Passage from the vagina of hyatidiform tissue, appearing as clusters of vesicles (similar to small grapes) developed from the transformation of chorionic villi. This is a manifestation of a molar pregnancy (hyatidiform mole).
HP_6000061.synonyms: solid tissue passed by the vagina

HP_6000062.label: abnormal nipple discharge
HP_6000062.definition: Abnormal fluid that seeps out of the nipple of the breast. Nipple discharge is categozied as lactational, physiologic, or pathologic.
HP_6000062.UMLS synonyms: abnormal milky nipple discharge | abnormal findings in nipple discharge | abnormal milky discharge from left nipple | abnormal milky discharge from right nipple | abnormal milky discharge from both nipples

HP_6000063.label: hepatolithiasis
HP_6000063.definition: The presence of gallstones within the intrahepatic bile ducts proximal to the right and left hepatic ducts.

HP_6000064.label: excessive eructation
HP_6000064.definition: Abnormally frequent belching (expelling gas noisily from the stomach through the mouth).
HP_6000064.UMLS synonyms: Excessive belching | belching from excessive swallowing of air | belching after excessive drinking of carbonated beverages

HP_6000065.label: esophageal fibrosis
HP_6000065.definition: Fibrosis located in the subepithelial portion of the esophagus. Fibrosisis is defined by the overgrowth, hardening, and/or scarring of various tissues and is attributed to excess deposition of extracellular matrix components including collagen.
HP_6000065.UMLS synonyms: Bleeding esophageal varices due to hepatic fibrosis

HP_6000066.label: triggered by extension of leg
HP_6000066.definition: This term refers to pain that is triggered by extending (straightening) the leg.

HP_6000067.label: increased myocardial pyrophosphate uptake
HP_6000067.definition: Amount of pyrophosphate uptake by the myocardium as demonstrated by by technetium pyrophosphate (99mTc-PYP) scintigraphy above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000068.label: ameliorated by nerve block
HP_6000068.definition: Refers to a sign or symptom that is improved or made more bearable by anesthetic block of a nerve.

HP_6000069.label: brief tear break - up time
HP_6000069.definition: Tear film break up time (number of seconds that elapse between the last blink and the appearance of the first dry spot in the tear film) below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000070.label: cutaneous granuloma
HP_6000070.definition: A granuloma localized to the skin, that is, a chronic inflammatory manifestation with localized aggregation of histiocytes with or without other inflammatory cells (such as plasma cells, eosinophils, or neutrophils), with or without necrosis, with or without vasculitis, with or without calcification, and with or without foreign bodies. Granulomas may be due to infection or chronic inflammatory disease or reactions to foreign material.
HP_6000070.UMLS synonyms: Granuloma of skin | Necrotizing granuloma of skin | Granulomatous and deep cutaneous inflammatory conditions

HP_6000071.label: heterotopic dermal ossification
HP_6000071.definition: Formation of abnormal, extraskeletal bony tissue in the dermis (i.e., the layer of skin that lies beneath the epidermis and above the subcutaneous layer).

HP_6000072.label: thinning of outer muscular layer of small bowel
HP_6000072.definition: The depth of the outer muscular layer of the small bowel is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000073.label: renal lymphangiectasia
HP_6000073.definition: A developmental anomaly of renal lymphatics that results from a failure of the lymphatics to make communication with the rest of the lymph trunks. The abnormal lymphatics thus dilate and form cystic spaces at the renal sinus and in the perinephric space.
HP_6000073.synonyms: hygroma renale | peripelvic lymphangiectasia | renal lymphangiomatosis

HP_6000074.label: pharyngeal myxoma
HP_6000074.definition: A myxoma (benign, locally infiltrative neoplasms arising from mesenchymal origin) localized to the pharynx.

HP_6000076.label: renal vasculitis
HP_6000076.definition: Vasculitis (inflammation of blood vessels) in the kidney. Renal vasculitis can be observed with numerous disorders and presents clinically as rapidly progressive glomerulonephritis (RPGN) which is characterised by acute kidney injury (AKI), haematuria and proteinuria. Histological examination of the kidney reveals severe inflammation in the form of crescent formation, glomerular necrosis and vasculitis of small and medium sized vessels within the kidney.

HP_6000077.label: pancreatic islet beta cell iron deposition
HP_6000077.definition: Accumulation of abnormally high amounts of iron in beta cells of the pancreas.

HP_6000078.label: nasal hamartoma
HP_6000078.definition: A hamartoma (tissue malformation consisting of an abnormal mixture of constitutive components) originating in the nose.

HP_6000079.label: metachromatic intraneuronal lipid deposits
HP_6000079.definition: Accumulation of metachromatically staining lipid material in neurons. This finding is typically ascertained in a peripheral nerve.

HP_6000080.label: reduced phosphoserine phosphatase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP_6000080.definition: Acitivity of phosphoserine phosphatase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

HP_6000081.label: reduced alpha - aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP_6000081.definition: Acitivity of alpha-aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.
HP_6000081.synonyms: alpha - aminoadipic semialdehyde synthase low in fibroblasts

HP_6000082.label: reduced hepatic beta - ureidopropionase activity
HP_6000082.definition: Activity of beta-ureidopropionase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.
HP_6000082.synonyms: liver biopsy : beta - ureidopropionase activity low

HP_6000083.label: reduced hepatic dihydropyrimidinase activity
HP_6000083.definition: Activity of dihydropyrimidinase in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000084.label: sunken fontanelle
HP_6000084.definition: Fontanelle that is more deeply set than normal. Fontanelles are normally relatively firm and curve only slightly inward. A sunken fontanelle can be a sign of dehydration or marasmus.

HP_6000085.label: angulation of penis
HP_6000085.definition: Abnormally increased curvature of the penis.
HP_6000085.UMLS synonyms: Deformity of erection | Plastic operation on penis to correct angulation

HP_6000086.label: history of urethral procedure or catheterization
HP_6000086.definition: A past medical history of a procedure or catheterization involving the urethra.

HP_6000087.label: penile swelling
HP_6000087.definition: Abormal enlargement of the penis owing to accumulation of fluid.
HP_6000087.UMLS synonyms: Penile swelling | generalized penile swelling | penile swelling on exam | localized penile swelling of foreskin | localized penile swelling of tip | localized penile swelling of shaft | localized swelling of penis

HP_6000088.label: reduced muscle alpha - 1,4 - glucosidase activity
HP_6000088.definition: Activity of the enzyme alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000089.label: brown tumor
HP_6000089.definition: A brown tumor is a bone lesion that results from bony resorption by excess osteoclastic activity, and replacement by fibrous tissue and giant cells. Brown tumor is an uncommon pathognomonic sign of hyperparathyroidism.
HP_6000089.UMLS synonyms: Osteitis Fibrosa Cystica | Brown tumor of hyperparathyroidism | Hibernoma | Melanocytic skin tumors/papules, skin-colored to reddish-brown, dome-shaped or pedunculated, well circumscribed with an average size of 5 mm

HP_6000090.label: dermal flame figures
HP_6000090.definition: Flame-figures are composed of a central part consisting of collagen fibers and eosinophilic granules, surrounded by a histiocytic and eosinophilic infiltrate. Subsequently, eosinophils tend to disappear and are replaced by phagocytic granulomas, consisting of histiocytes and sometimes giant cells, around the flame figures.

HP_6000091.label: postpartum exacerbation
HP_6000091.definition: Applied to a sign or symptom that is present during pregnancy and becomes worse following birth.
HP_6000091.synonyms: symptoms worsen in post - partum state

HP_6000093.label: propylthiouracil exposure
HP_6000093.definition: History of having been treated with propylthiouracil.

HP_6000094.label: history of outdoor activities
HP_6000094.definition: History of spending a substantial amount of time outdoors with occupation or hobbies related to the outdoors, including hunting, gardening, farming, agriculture, horticulture, miners, working in wet fields.

HP_6000095.label: draining sinus tract in skin
HP_6000095.definition: A sinus tract is an abnormal channel that originates from the skin or a mucous surface to a deep-seated focus of suppuration.
HP_6000095.synonyms: discharging sinus | draining tract in skin | tract under skin draining associated abscess

HP_6000096.label: corneal transplant history
HP_6000096.definition: Past medical history of surgical replacement of the cornea with corneal tissue from a donor.

HP_6000097.label: spontaneous lens capsule rupture
HP_6000097.definition: Breakage of the capsule of the lens. This is most often observed as a complication of lens surgery, but this term refers to lens capsule rupture not related to surgery or major trauma.

HP_6000098.label: contact lens wearer
HP_6000098.definition: A past medical history of wearing contact lenses.

HP_6000099.label: airway mucosal thickening
HP_6000099.definition: Increase in thickness of the mucosa of the airways above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000100.label: hyperpolarized transepithelial nasal potential difference
HP_6000100.definition: Increased (more negative) voltage across the nasal epithelium.

HP_6000101.label: corneopalpebral synechiae
HP_6000101.definition: An adhesion between the conjunctiva of the eyelid and the cornea.

HP_6000102.label: breast intraductal papilloma
HP_6000102.definition: Intraductal papilloma is a benign tumor found within breast ducts. The abnormal proliferation of ductal epithelial cells causes growth. A solitary intraductal papilloma is usually found centrally posterior to the nipple affecting the central duct. Multiple intraductal papillomas are located peripherally, found in any breast quadrant affecting the peripheral ducts.
HP_6000102.UMLS synonyms: Intraductal papilloma of breast | Intraductal papilloma of left breast | Atypical intraductal papilloma of breast | Intraductal papilloma of right breast | BREAST BIOPSY BENIGN INTRADUCTAL PAPILLOMA | Excision of intraductal papilloma of breast | biopsy of breast showed intraductal papilloma | Central Breast Papilloma | Breast Atypical Papilloma | Bilateral intraductal papilloma of breasts | Breast Intraductal Papillomatosis

HP_6000103.label: precipitous labor
HP_6000103.definition: Precipitous labor is extremely rapid labor and delivery, usually defined as expulsion of the fetus within less than 3 hours of commencement of regular contractions.
HP_6000103.UMLS synonyms: Precipitate labor | born following precipitous delivery | Review obstetrical history and labor record for risk factors for postpartum hemorrhage (e.g., prior history of postpartum hemorrhage, overdistention of the uterus, rapid labor, prolonged third stage, uterine infection, lacerations, retained placenta, labor, induction, use of anesthesia, preeclampsia, prolonged second stage, assistive birth, cesarean birth, or precipitous birth) | c.delivery; precipitate labor | precipitate labor or delivery | Precipitate labor with antenatal problem | precipitate labor with baby delivered | precipitate labor or delivery; delivery | Precipitate labour, antepartum | labor; precipitate, affecting fetus or newborn | precipitate labor or delivery; affecting fetus | Precipitate labour, with delivery | Fetus and newborn affected by precipitate delivery | precipitate labor or delivery; delivery, affecting fetus or newborn | Supervision of high risk pregnancy with history of previous precipitate labor | Precipitate labour, unspecified as to episode of care | Supervision of high risk pregnancy with history of previous precipitate labor done | Review initial level of labor pain with multidimensional scale (e.g., location, characteristics, onset, duration, frequency, intensity, severity, precipitating factors)

HP_6000104.label: twin pregnancy
HP_6000104.definition: Maternal history of a pregancy with two fetuses in the uterus.
HP_6000104.UMLS synonyms: Pregnancy, Twin | Twin pregnancy, delivered | Undiagnosed twin pregnancy | Conjoined twin pregnancy | FH: Twin pregnancy | Monochorionic twin pregnancy | Dizygotic twin pregnancy | Monozygotic twin pregnancy | Diamniotic twin pregnancy | Monoamniotic twin pregnancy | twin; complicating pregnancy | Twin pregnancy:Find:Pt:^Patient:Ord | Monochorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy | Dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancy | Monochorionic monoamniotic twin pregnancy | twin-to-twin; transfusion syndrome, mother (complicating pregnancy) | Twin pregnancy with antenatal problem | twin pregnancy as antepartum condition | Newborn affected by twin (pregnancy) | Conjoined twin pregnancy, unspecified trimester | Conjoined twin pregnancy, second trimester | Conjoined twin pregnancy, third trimester | Conjoined twin pregnancy, first trimester | pregnancy; twin, affecting fetus or newborn | Fetal disorder due to twin pregnancy

HP_6000105.label: vaginal mass
HP_6000105.definition: A swelling or enlargment localized to the vagina. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP_6000105.UMLS synonyms: Vaginal mass | fixed vaginal mass | tender vaginal mass | vaginal fourchette mass | vaginal cuff mass | mobile vaginal mass | VAGINAL WALL MASS | vaginal lump or mass on either side near vaginal opening | Vaginal lump | mass of anterior wall of vagina | mass of posterior wall of vagina | mass of left anterior wall of vagina | mass of left posterior wall of vagina | mass of right anterior wall of vagina | mass of right posterior wall of vagina | transvaginal ultrasound: mass of placenta | transvaginal ultrasound: mass of ovary | Fibronectin.fetal:MCnc:Pt:Vag:Qn | transvaginal ultrasound: mass of left ovary | transvaginal ultrasound: echogenic mass of uterus | transvaginal ultrasound: mass of uterus | transvaginal ultrasound: calcified mass of ovary | transvaginal ultrasound: masses of both ovaries | transvaginal ultrasound: cystic mass of ovary | transvaginal ultrasound: solid mass of ovary

HP_6000106.label: costovertebral angle tenderness
HP_6000106.definition: Pain that is elicited by palpation of the region inside of the costovertebral angle, which is formed by the 12th rib and the spine.
HP_6000106.UMLS synonyms: left costovertebral angle tenderness | bilateral costovertebral angle tenderness | right costovertebral angle tenderness | Tenderness costovertebral angle (CVA) | Renal angle tenderness | COSTOVERTEBRAL ANGLE TENDERNESS ACUTE ONSET

HP_6000107.label: cervical motion tenderness
HP_6000107.definition: Pain that is elicited by moving the uterine cervix. This finding can be ascertained by pelvic exam. Cervical motion tenderness is a gynecological exam finding that could be indicative of peritoneal infection.
HP_6000107.UMLS synonyms: CERVICAL MOTION TENDERNESS | Uterine cervical motion tenderness

HP_6000108.label: abnormal penile discharge
HP_6000108.definition: Fluid that originates from the urethra that is not urine, pre-ejaculate or semen.

HP_6000109.label: supernumerary finger flexion crease
HP_6000109.definition: The presence of an extra digital crease in and individual with normal joint anatomy.

HP_6000110.label: large joint predominance
HP_6000110.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that mainly affect large joints.

HP_6000111.label: monoarticular
HP_6000111.definition: Refers to a phenotypic abnormality that affects a single joint.
HP_6000111.UMLS synonyms: Monoarticular | monoarticular gout | MONOARTICULAR ARTHRITIS | Monoarticular joint involvement | monoarticular arthritis acute | monoarticular inflammation wrist | monoarticular inflammation hip | monoarticular joint abnormality | monoarticular inflammation knee | acute monoarticular inflammation | monoarticular inflammation of hand | monoarticular inflammation of shoulder | monoarticular inflammation of ankle | monoarticular inflammation of forearm | monoarticular inflammation of foot | monoarticular inflammation of thigh | monoarticular inflammation of elbow | Monoarticular juvenile rheumatoid arthritis | Monoarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis | Monoarticular acute primary gout | monoarticular inflammation hip left | monoarticular inflammation wrist left | monoarticular inflammation knee left | monoarticular inflammation hip right | monoarticular inflammation knee right

HP_6000112.label: hockey - stick palmar crease
HP_6000112.definition: An abnormality of the upper palmar crease whereby the crease widens and ends between the second and third fingers and is said to resemble a hockey stick.

HP_6000113.label: elevated urinary succinyladenosine level
HP_6000113.definition: The amount of succinyladenosine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000114.label: elevated urinary 5 - hydroxymethyluracil level
HP_6000114.definition: The amount of 5-hydroxymethyluracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000115.label: decreased urine creatinine level
HP_6000115.definition: The amount of creatinine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000116.label: elevated urinary deoxyuridine level
HP_6000116.definition: The amount of deoxyuridine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000117.label: obsolete elevated urinary aica - riboside level

HP_6000118.label: elevated urinary dihydrouracil level
HP_6000118.definition: The amount of dihydrouracil in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000119.label: elevated urinary dihydrothymine level
HP_6000119.definition: The amount of dihydrothymine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000120.label: elevated urinary sulfatide level
HP_6000120.definition: The amount of sulfatides in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal. Sulfatides are derived from GalCer via esterification of a sulfate group to 3-hydroxyl of the galactose moiety.

HP_6000121.label: elevated urinary xanthurenic acid level
HP_6000121.definition: The amount of xanthurenic acid in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000122.label: increased urinary n - acetylglucosamine - rich oligosaccharide level
HP_6000122.definition: Presence of N-acetylglucosamine-rich oligosaccharides in the urine.

HP_6000123.label: elevated urinary 2 ' - deoxyadenosine level
HP_6000123.definition: The amount of 2'-deoxyadenosine (dAdo) in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.
HP_6000123.synonyms: 2 ' - deoxyadenosine ( dado ) elevated in urine | elevated urinary dado level

HP_6000124.label: positive 2,4 - dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test
HP_6000124.definition: Positive (abnormal) result of the 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine urine test, which indicates the presence of alpha-ketoacids in the urine.

HP_6000125.label: elevated urinary dolichol level
HP_6000125.definition: The amount of dolichol in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000126.label: decreased urinary bile acid level
HP_6000126.definition: The amount of bile acids in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000127.label: elevated urinary creatine / creatinine ratio
HP_6000127.definition: The ratio of creatine to creatinine concentration in the urine is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000128.label: elevated urinary thymidine level
HP_6000128.definition: The amount of thymidine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000129.label: elevated urinary glutarylglycine level
HP_6000129.definition: The amount of glutarylglycine in the urine, normalized for urine concentration, is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000130.label: elevated urinary indican level
HP_6000130.definition: Detection of indican in the urine. Urinary indican concentration may be elevated in small bowel bacterial overgrowth. Indican is produced by bacterial deconjugation of dietary tryptophan to indole which is absorbed at all levels of the intestine, but principally from the small bowel.

HP_6000131.label: dacrolith
HP_6000131.definition: Dacryolith is a concretion (accumulation of sediment) within the nasolacrimal system.

HP_6000132.label: reduced erythrocyte gamma - glutamyl cysteine synthetase activity
HP_6000132.definition: Activity of gamma-glutamylcysteine synthetase (EC 6.3.2.2) in erythrocytes below the lower limit of normal.
HP_6000132.synonyms: gamma - glutamyl cysteine synthetase low in erythrocytes

HP_6000133.label: decreased circulating nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide - cytochrome b5 reductase activity
HP_6000133.definition: The activity of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NADH)-cytochrome b5 reductase in the blood circulation is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000134.label: reduced alpha - methylacyl - coa racemase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP_6000134.definition: Activity of alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase (AMACR; EC 5.1.99.4) below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

HP_6000135.label: low semen volume
HP_6000135.definition: Volume of semen in ejaculate below the lower limit of normal. This finding can be ascertained by semen analysis. Comment: Sperm are produced within the testis, in the process of spermatogenesis, then travel through the male reproductive tract (the seminiferous tubules, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate and urethra). As the sperm travel, seminal fluid is added from the seminal vesicles, prostate, testis and epididymis and periurethral glands. The function of the ejaculate is to transport sperm into the female genital tract and to provide a suitable environment for sperm survival during this transit.
HP_6000135.UMLS synonyms: Semen volume low: 0.5-1 ml | Semen volume very low: less than 0.5 ml

HP_6000136.label: elbow localization
HP_6000136.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the elbow.
HP_6000136.UMLS synonyms: Local anesthetic elbow block | localized osteoarthritis of elbow | localized osteoarthritis of right elbow | localized osteoarthritis of left elbow | Localized, primary osteoarthritis of elbow | Arthrodesis of elbow | localized secondary osteoarthritis of elbow | localized primary osteoarthritis of both elbows | Repair medial collateral ligament, elbow, with local tissue | elbow arthrodesis with local bone graft | elbow joint pain difficult to localize | localized primary osteoarthritis of right elbow | localized secondary osteoarthritis of left elbow | localized secondary osteoarthritis of right elbow | localized primary osteoarthritis of left elbow | Local destruction of lesion of elbow joint | Local anesthetic median nerve block at elbow | Local anesthetic radial nerve block at elbow | Local anesthetic ulnar nerve block at elbow | Repair lateral collateral ligament, elbow, with local tissue | dry skin localized to creases of elbows, wrists, knees | localized coolness of skin of creases of elbows, wrists, or knees | Other local excision or destruction of lesion of joint, elbow | Excision of lesion of elbow joint

HP_6000137.label: enlarged lunula
HP_6000137.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the visible portion of the distal nail matrix that extends beyond the proximal nail fold, which is refered to as the lunula.

HP_6000138.label: heel localization
HP_6000138.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the heel.

HP_6000139.label: splinter hemorrhages
HP_6000139.definition: Thin, red to reddish-brown lines of blood (hemorrhages) under the nails. Splinter hemorrhages run vertically under the nails.
HP_6000139.UMLS synonyms: Splinter hemorrhage | Splinter hemorrhages under nail | Traumatic splinter hemorrhage | FINGERNAIL SPLINTER HEMORRHAGE | NAIL BED SPLINTER HEMORRHAGE

HP_6000140.label: lateral thrust
HP_6000140.definition: Lateral thrust (LT) refers to an abnormal knee joint motion in the early stance phase where the knee joint center moves laterally. Also known as varus thrust, LR is defined as the dynamic worsening or abrupt onset of varus (bow-leg) alignment as the limb accepts weight (stance phase), with a return to less varus and more neutral alignment during lift-off and the non-weight-bearing (swing) phase of gait, varus thrust is a potent mechanical risk factor for medial knee osteoarthritis progression.

HP_6000141.label: cerebral contusion
HP_6000141.definition: A contusion is a region of injured tissue in which blood capillaries have been ruptured without laceration (bruise). Brain contusions are bruises of the cortical surface that damage the surface from the outside inward, producing disruption of tissue and vessels. The term cerebral contusion describes the pathology of focal necrosis and hemorrhage, typically observed in older children, involving particularly cerebral cortex and subcortical white matter. Such lesions are usually found in coup and contrecoup, as well as inferior orbital, frontal, and temporal locations. Cerebral contusions cause permanent damage to tissues of the cerebrum. The etiology of cerebral contusion is trauma to the head.
HP_6000141.UMLS synonyms: Cerebral Contusion | Closed cerebral contusion | Open cerebral contusion | Focal cerebral contusion | Cerebral cortical contusion | CEREBRAL FRONTO_TEMPORAL CONTUSION | Cerebral laceration and contusion | Contusion of cerebral cortex | cerebral contusion with concussion | left cerebral laceration and contusion | right cerebral laceration and contusion | hematoma; cerebral, with cerebral laceration or contusion (diffuse) | hematoma; cerebral, with cerebral laceration or contusion, focal | cerebral contusion with no loss of consciousness | Closed fracture of skull with cerebral contusion | Open fracture of skull with cerebral contusion | cerebral contusion with unconsciousness of unspecified duration | cerebral contusion with brief (< 1 hr) loss of consciousness | closed fracture of skull with cerebral laceration and contusion | open fracture of skull with cerebral laceration and contusion | cerebral laceration and contusion with loss of consciousness | cerebral laceration and contusion without loss of consciousness | cerebral contusion with moderate (1-24 hrs) loss of consciousness | Cortex laceration and contusion | Cortex (cerebral) contusion without mention of open intracranial wound

HP_6000142.label: fecolith
HP_6000142.definition: A mass of accumulated hardened fecal matter.
HP_6000142.UMLS synonyms: Fecalith | Fecolith in appendix | appendiceal laparoscopy assessment fecolith | appendiceal procedure assessment fecolith | Congenital fecaliths causing obstruction

HP_6000143.label: appendicitis
HP_6000143.definition: Appendicitis is inflammation of the vermiform appendix. Appendix a hollow organ located at the tip of the cecum, usually in the right lower quadrant of the abdomen.
HP_6000143.UMLS synonyms: Appendicitis | Chronic appendicitis | Acute appendicitis NOS (disorder) | Recurrent appendicitis | Other appendicitis | Amebic appendicitis | Subacute appendicitis | Ruptured Appendicitis | Suppurative appendicitis | relapsing appendicitis | Retrocecal appendicitis | Catarrhal appendicitis | Complicated appendicitis | Gangrenous appendicitis | Acute appendicitis with generalized peritonitis | Healed appendicitis | Pelvic appendicitis | Atypical appendicitis | Retroileal appendicitis | Appendicitis, CTCAE | Focal appendicitis | Acute obstructive appendicitis | Necrotising appendicitis | Appendicitis noninfective | Stump appendicitis

HP_6000144.label: left ventricular aneurysm
HP_6000144.definition: A severely scarred portion of infarcted ventricular myocardium that does not contract normally but instead bulges outward while the rest of the ventricle contracts during systole.
HP_6000144.UMLS synonyms: Left ventricular aneurysm | Left ventricular aneurysm operation | Left ventricular aneurysm plication | Congenital left ventricular aneurysm | Postprocedural left ventricular aneurysm | Repair of left ventricular aneurysm | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm | Congenital left ventricular submitral valve aneurysm | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm inferior | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm posterobasal | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm posterolateral | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm anterior | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm apicoseptal | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm lateral | cardiac catheterization left ventricular false aneurysm | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm anterobasal | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm anterolateral | cardiac catheterization left ventricular aneurysm apical | cardiac catheterization: left ventricular basal septal aneurysm | Excision of aneurysm of left cardiac ventricle | Acquired aneurysm of left cardiac ventricle | Aneurysm of patch of left ventricular outflow tract | rest radionuclide ventriculography (feet down): left ventricular aneurysm | rest radionuclide ventriculography (feet up): left ventricular aneurysm | Aortico-left ventricular tunnel with intracardiac aneurysm of septal portion

HP_6000145.label: boot - shaped cardiac silhouette
HP_6000145.definition: An abnormal form of the heart seen upon chest radiography in which the heart displays an upturned apex and slight concave pulmonary artery segment. This configuration is said to resemble a boot.

HP_6000146.label: hydrosalpinx
HP_6000146.definition: Hydrosalpinx is a distension or dilatation of the fallopian tube in the presence of a distal tubal occlusion.
HP_6000146.UMLS synonyms: Hydrosalpinx (disorder) | Hydrosalpinx <Hydrosalpingidae> | Congenital hydrosalpinx | Hydrosalpinx sericea | chronic hydrosalpinx | Laparoscopic excision of hydrosalpinx | laparoscopy of pelvis: left fallopian tube hydrosalpinx | laparoscopy of pelvis: right fallopian tube hydrosalpinx

HP_6000147.label: elevated methylhex - dienedioic level by mrs
HP_6000147.definition: An increase in the level of 3-methylhex-2,4-dienedioic acid or 3-methylhex-3,4-dienedioic acid in the brain identified by magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS).

HP_6000148.label: perihepatic enhancement
HP_6000148.definition: Increased signal (contrast enhancement) surrounding the liver observed on computer tomography or magnetic resonance imaging following administration of contrast agents.

HP_6000149.label: reduced in vitro contracture test threshold
HP_6000149.definition: The in vitro contracture test determines the sensitivity of freshly obtained skeletal muscle specimens to caffeine or halothane applied to a bathing solution. Muscles from persons susceptible to malignant hyperthermia have lower contracture thresholds for these agents than do normal muscle.
HP_6000149.synonyms: caffeine in vitro contracture test positive | halothane in vitro contracture test positive

HP_6000150.label: reduced f - wave amplitude
HP_6000150.definition: Reduced strength (amplitude) of the F-wave, which is an electrophysiological artifact produced by antidromic activation of motoneurons following distal electrical stimulation of motor nerve fibers.

HP_6000151.label: enlarged peroxisomes
HP_6000151.definition: Abnormal increase in size of peroxisomes.
HP_6000151.UMLS synonyms: Enlarged and elongated peroxisomes | Markedly enlarged, incompetent peroxisomes in fibroblasts | Fibroblasts show reduced numbers of enlarged peroxisomes | Liver biopsy shows normal numbers of enlarged peroxisomes

HP_6000152.label: adrenocortical hyperplasia
HP_6000152.definition: A non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands, specifically the cortex, although the cortex cannot be definitively identified by conventional imaging. Adrenal cortical hyperplasia is defined radiologically as a non-malignant growth, or enlargement, of the adrenal glands.
HP_6000152.UMLS synonyms: Adrenocortical hyperplasia | Primary adrenocortical nodular hyperplasia | Congenital virilizing adrenocortical hyperplasia syndrome | Cushing syndrome due to bilateral adrenocortical hyperplasia | Acth-Independent Macronodular Adrenal Hyperplasia

HP_6000153.label: lymphocytic infiltration of the parotid gland
HP_6000153.definition: Accumulation of lymphocytes in the parotid gland. This feature is generally defined as a count of lymphocytes per area that is above normal limits on histopathological examination.

HP_6000154.label: bone marrow granuloma
HP_6000154.definition: A granuloma (a focal aggregate of immune cells that forms in response to a persistent inflammatory stimulus) localiyed to the bone marrow. A granuloma characteristically demonstrates the compact organization of mature macrophages, which may or may not be associated with other inflammatory cell types.
HP_6000154.UMLS synonyms: Hodgkin's granuloma of bone marrow | biopsy of bone marrow showed Hodgkin's granuloma | biopsy of bone marrow showed noncaseating granulomas | Non-caseating granulomas (bone marrow and lymph nodes)

HP_6000155.label: neuronal intranuclear inclusion bodies
HP_6000155.definition: The presence of intracellular inclusion bodies (aggregates of stainable substances, usually proteins) in neurons.

HP_6000156.label: pancreatic atrophy
HP_6000156.UMLS synonyms: Atrophy of pancreas | Pancreatic acinar atrophy | Pancreatic degenerative atrophy | computed tomography of abdomen: pancreatic atrophy | magnetic resonance imaging of abdomen: pancreatic atrophy | magnetic resonance imaging of abdomen: focal pancreatic atrophy | magnetic resonance imaging of abdomen: diffuse pancreatic atrophy

HP_6000157.label: decreased pancreatic acinar cell density
HP_6000157.definition: Number (count) of pancreatic acinar cells reduced below normal. This feature can be ascertained by pancreas biopsy.

HP_6000158.label: unesterified cholesterol accumulation in cultured fibroblasts
HP_6000158.definition: An abnormal result of the the filipin test. In this test is based on the reaction of unesterified cholesterol with fluorescent antibiotic filipin giving a strongly fluorescent, stable cholesterol-filipin complex suitable for in situ detection. An abnormal test result is present if there is a perinuclear accumulation of staining in lysosomal storage organelles (LSOs).

HP_6000159.label: hepatic lipid - laden macrophage infiltration
HP_6000159.definition: Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the liver.
HP_6000159.synonyms: foamy cells on hepatic biopsy | liver biopsy : lipid - laden macrophages

HP_6000160.label: splenic lipid - laden macrophage infiltration
HP_6000160.definition: Accumulation of foamy cells (lipid-laden macrophages) in the parenchyma of the spleen.
HP_6000160.synonyms: spleen biopsy : lipid - laden macrophages | splenic foamy cells

HP_6000161.label: reduced hepatic n - acetylglutamate synthase activity
HP_6000161.definition: Concentration or activity of N-acetylglutamate synthase in liver tissue below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000162.label: excessive licorice consumption
HP_6000162.definition: Ingestion of large amounts of licorice.

HP_6000163.label: shoulder localization
HP_6000163.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in (or predominant in) the shoulder.
HP_6000163.UMLS synonyms: Localized, primary osteoarthritis of the shoulder region | localized osteoarthritis of shoulder | localized osteoarthritis of left shoulder | localized osteoarthritis of right shoulder | localized osteoporosis of shoulder region | Localized, secondary osteoarthritis of the shoulder region | localized primary osteoarthritis of both shoulders | Localized osteoporosis [Lequesne], shoulder region | localized primary osteoarthritis of left shoulder | localized primary osteoarthritis of right shoulder | localized secondary osteoarthritis of left shoulder | difficult to localize shoulder joint pain | localized secondary osteoarthritis of right shoulder | arthrodesis of shoulder with local bone graft | localized soft tissue swelling in both shoulders | difficult to localize soft tissue in shoulder | Osteoarthrosis, unspecified whether generalized or localized, shoulder region | Arthrodesis of shoulder joint with local bone graft | Arthrodesis of shoulder joint without local bone graft | Osteoarthrosis, localised, secondary, involving shoulder region | localized primary osteoarthritis of left shoulder acromioclavicular joint | localized primary osteoarthritis of right shoulder glenohumeral joint | localized primary osteoarthritis of right shoulder acromioclavicular joint | localized primary osteoarthritis of left shoulder glenohumeral joint

HP_6000164.label: pregnancy conceived despite intrauterine device
HP_6000164.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUDs) are used for contraception. Rarely pregnancy occurs despite the presence of an IUD. Such pregnancies are associated with an increased risk of spontaneous abortion and preterm delivery due to infection, and a higher risk of maternal septic complications.

HP_6000165.label: maternal folate deficiency
HP_6000165.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of folate deficiency during the corresponding pregnancy.

HP_6000166.label: maternal zinc deficiency
HP_6000166.definition: The mother of a fetus or index patient has a history of abnormally low zinc levels during the corresponding pregnancy.

HP_6000167.label: use of intrauterine device
HP_6000167.definition: Intrauterine devices (IUD) are commonly used for contraception. IUD complications are rare, but include perforation, pelvic infection, expulsion, missing strings, and difficult IUD removal.
HP_6000167.UMLS synonyms: History of use of hormone releasing intrauterine device contraception | Advise patient to avoid use of intrauterine devices

HP_6000168.label: history of recent central venous catheter
HP_6000168.definition: A past medical history of a recent central venous catheter (CVC). A CVC is an indwelling device inserted into a large, central vein (most commonly the internal jugular, subclavian, or femoral) and advanced until the terminal lumen resides within the inferior vena cava, superior vena cava, or right atrium. CVCs can be a necessary producre for critically ill patients with indications such as total parenteral nutrition administration, dialysis, plasmapheresis, medication administration, and hemodynamic monitoring, and to facilitate further complex interventions such as transvenous pacemaker placement. Complications include arrhythmia, central vein stenosis, and sepsis.

HP_6000169.label: history of total parenteral nutrition dependence
HP_6000169.definition: A past medical history of a recent depence on total parenteral nutrition (TPN), which refers to intravenously administered nutrition being the only source of nutrition the patient is receiving.

HP_6000170.label: pain alleviated by testicle elevation
HP_6000170.definition: This refers to testicular pain that is lessened or made more bearable by elevation of the testicle.
HP_6000170.synonyms: prehn 's sign | testicle elevation relieves pain

HP_6000171.label: abdominal wall mass
HP_6000171.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the abdominal wall (the skin, fascia, and muscle encases the abdominal cavity and viscera). The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP_6000171.UMLS synonyms: Anterior abdominal wall mass | computed tomography of abdomen: mass of anterior abdominal wall | computed tomography of abdomen: calcified anterior abdominal wall mass | computed tomography of abdomen: solitary mass of anterior abdominal wall | Fine needle biopsy of abdominal wall mass | Core needle biopsy of abdominal wall mass | Mass of subcutaneous tissue of abdominal wall | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: solitary mass in anterior abdominal wall | Mass of left lower quadrant of abdominal wall | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: peritoneal mass | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: mass in anterior wall of abdomen | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: solitary peritoneal mass | transverse colon laparoscopic procedure mass seen in transverse colon attached to abdominal wall | sigmoid colon procedure size of mass palpable in sigmoid colon attached to abdominal wall | laparoscopic surgery of ascending colon mass in right colon attached to abdomen wall | computed tomography of abdomen: multiple anterior abdominal wall masses | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: multiple masses in anterior abdominal wall | MRI of abdominal wall and peritoneal cavity: multiple peritoneal masses

HP_6000172.label: tympanic membrane bulging
HP_6000172.definition: The tympanic membrane protrudes (swells outwards). This feature may be observed with otoscopy.
HP_6000172.UMLS synonyms: Bulging tympanic membrane | bulging left tympanic membrane | bulging right tympanic membrane | bulging tympanic membranes of both ears

HP_6000173.label: ear pain exacerbated by manipulating tragus or pinna
HP_6000173.definition: Applies to pain of the ear that is worsened, aggravated, or exacerbated by touching or moving the tragus or pinna.

HP_6000174.label: lateral neck mass
HP_6000174.definition: An abnormal enlargement or swelling localized to the side of the neck. The word mass is usually used at an early stage of the diagnostic workup before the precise nature of the swelling has been determined.
HP_6000174.UMLS synonyms: translucent lateral neck mass | size of lateral neck mass refilling slowly after compression | size of lateral neck mass mobile laterally and restricted vertically | size of lateral neck mass pressure leading to food regurgitation | fistula of lateral neck

HP_6000175.label: occipital location
HP_6000175.definition: Applies to an abnormality that is situated in the occiput (back part of the head).

HP_6000176.label: anterior neck swelling
HP_6000176.definition: Abormal enlargement of the front part of the neck owing to accumulation of fluid.
HP_6000176.UMLS synonyms: swelling of anterior aspect of neck | puncture of anterior neck with swelling | lump or swelling on anterior neck | swollen tissue surrounding incision of anterior neck | swollen tissue surrounding wound of anterior neck

HP_6000177.label: uvular swelling
HP_6000177.definition: Abnormal enlargement of the uvula related to an abnormal accumulation of fluid.

HP_6000178.label: purulent drainage from stensen duct
HP_6000178.definition: Flow of pus (purulence) from the Stensen duct. The Stensen duct is also known as the parotid duct and is the route that saliva takes from the major salivary gland (parotid gland) to the mouth.

HP_6000179.label: history of gastric bypass surgery
HP_6000179.definition: History of having received gastric bypass surgery. This is a procedure that reduces the functional volume of the stomach and is used to treat morbid obesity.

HP_6000180.label: triggered by volatile organic compounds
HP_6000180.definition: Applies to a sign or symptom that is provoked or brought about by exposure to volatile organic compounds (VOCs), which comprise various organic chemicals which are released as gases from different liquids or solids.

HP_6000181.label: history of radiation therapy
HP_6000181.definition: A medical history of having undergone radiation therapy, which is a treatment that uses ionizing radiation for purposes such as the control the growth of malignant cells in cancer treatment.
HP_6000181.UMLS synonyms: History of radiation therapy | Family history of radiation therapy | History of radiation therapy to chest | History of external beam radiation therapy | History of radiation therapy to breast area | History of external beam radiation therapy to thyroid

HP_6000182.label: absent otoacoustic emissions
HP_6000182.definition: Failure to record otoacoustic emissions (OAE), i.e., sounds generated from the cochlea in response to an acoustic stimulus and transmitted across the middle ear to the external ear canal.
HP_6000182.UMLS synonyms: Absent or abnormal otoacoustic emissions | Absent distortion product otoacoustic emissions (OAEs) | Transient otoacoustic emission spectra absent indicating a deficiency of outer hair cell function

HP_6000183.label: thickened tympanic membrane
HP_6000183.definition: The tympanic membrane (eardrum, myringa) is a thin, semitransparent, oval membrane, approximately 1 cm in diameter, that separates the external acoustic meatus from the tympanic cavity. Thickening refers to an increase of the dimension across the membrane.

HP_6000184.label: filum terminale lipoma
HP_6000184.definition: Filum terminale lipomas (FTLs) are a type of lumbosacral lipoma in which the fat is entirely within the filum terminale and separate from the conus medullaris.
HP_6000184.UMLS synonyms: Isolated lipoma of filum terminale | Isolated transitional lipoma of filum terminale

HP_6000185.label: low tetrahydrocortisol ( thf ) plus 5 - alpha - thf / tetrahydrocortisone ( the ) ratio
HP_6000185.definition: The relative concentration of tetrahydrocortisol plus 5-alpha-tetrahydrocortisol relative to that of tetrahydrocortisone is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000186.label: anti - soluble liver antigen / liver pancreas antibody positivity
HP_6000186.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against soluble liver antigen.

HP_6000187.label: anti - thrombospondin type i domain - containing 7a antibody positivity
HP_6000187.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against thrombospondin type I domain-containing 7A.
HP_6000187.synonyms: anti - thsd7a antibody | anti - thsd7a antibody present in blood

HP_6000188.label: antisperm antibody positivity
HP_6000188.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the serum that react against sperm antigens.

HP_6000189.label: decreased circulating ficolin 3 concentration
HP_6000189.definition: Concentration of ficolin 3 in the blood circulation below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000190.label: abnormal seminal vesicle morphology
HP_6000190.definition: A structural abnormality of the seminal vesicle. The seminal vesicles are a pair of glands that also include the prostate gland and the bulbourethral glands and are located in the pelvis superior to the rectum, inferior to the fundus of the bladder and posterior to the prostate. The seminal vesicles contribute around 70% of the fluid that will eventually become semen.

HP_6000191.label: seminal vesicle cyst
HP_6000191.definition: A cyst (sac-like mass that may contain serous liquid or semisolid material) caused by distention of the seminal vesicle due to atresia of the ejaculatory duct.
HP_6000191.UMLS synonyms: Cyst of seminal vesicle | Excision of cyst of Müllerian duct in male | excision of cysts of both Mullerian ducts in male

HP_6000192.label: silica dust exposure
HP_6000192.definition: History of exposure to respirable crystalline silica (SiO2).
HP_6000192.UMLS synonyms: work restrictions no exposure to silica dust

HP_6000193.label: anti - osteoprotegerin antibody positivity
HP_6000193.definition: The presence of autoantibodies (immunoglobulins) in the blood circulation that react against osteoprotegerin.

HP_6000194.label: history of adrenalectomy
HP_6000194.definition: A past medical history of having had a surgical procedure to remove the adrenal glands.

HP_6000195.label: elevated mitochondrial citrate synthase synthase activity
HP_6000195.definition: Activity of the enzyme mitochondrial citrate synthase (EC:2.3.3.1) in muscle tissue is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000196.label: reduced muscle lactate dehydrogenase activity
HP_6000196.definition: Activity of the enzyme lactate dehdrogenase (LHD; 1.1.1.27) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. LDH catalyzes the conversion of pyruvate to lactate and back, as it converts NAD+ to NADH and back.

HP_6000197.label: reduced muscle phosphoglycerate mutase activity
HP_6000197.definition: Activity of the enzyme Phosphoglycerate mutase (PGM) in muscle tissue is below the lower limit of normal. PGM is an enzyme that catalyzes step 8 of glycolysis (EC 5.4.2.11).

HP_6000198.label: reduced muscle phosphorylase kinase activity
HP_6000198.definition: Activity of the enzyme muscle phosphorylase kinase (PhK) in muscle tissue below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000199.label: reduced 3 - beta - hydroxysteroid - delta - 5 - desaturase activity in cultured fibroblasts
HP_6000199.definition: Acitivity of 3-beta-hydroxysteroid-delta-5-desaturase, also known as Sterol C5-desaturase (EC 1.3.3.2), or SC5D below the lower limit of normal in cultured fibroblasts.

HP_6000200.label: reduced hepatic glucose - 6 - phosphatase activity
HP_6000200.definition: Activity of glucose-6-phosphatase (EC 3.1.3.9) in the liver below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000201.label: reduced hepatic glucose - 6 - phosphate translocase activity
HP_6000201.definition: Activity of glucose-6-phosphate translocase in liver below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000202.label: cerebrospinal fluid erythrocytes
HP_6000202.definition: The presence of red blood cells (RBCs) in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF). The CSF normally does not contain RBCs (erythrocytes).
HP_6000202.UMLS synonyms: Cerebrospinal fluid erythrocytes (finding) | cerebrospinal fluid erythrocytes (lab test) | burr cells / 100 erythrocytes in cerebrospinal fluid by manual count | CSF leukocyte/erythrocyte ratio | CSF leukocyte/erythrocyte ratio increased

HP_6000203.label: elevated csf cholestanol concentration
HP_6000203.definition: The concentration of cholestanol in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal. Cholestanol is the 5-alpha-dihydro derivative of cholesterol.

HP_6000204.label: elevated csf apolipoprotein b concentration
HP_6000204.definition: The concentration of apolipoprotein B in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000205.label: elevated csf myelin basic protein concentration
HP_6000205.definition: The concentration of myelin basic protein in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is above the upper limit of normal.
HP_6000205.synonyms: myelin basic protein high in csf

HP_6000206.label: reduced csf pyridoxal - 5 ' - phosphate concentration
HP_6000206.definition: The concentration of pyridoxal-5'-phosphate in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

HP_6000224.label: delayed passage of meconium
HP_6000224.definition: Failure to pass meconium (the first stool following birth) in the first 48 hours of life.

HP_6000225.label: single second heart sound
HP_6000225.definition: The second sound can remain single throughout the respiratory cycle due to either absence of one component or to synchronous occurrence of the two components. Since the pulmonary vascular impedance increases with age, many normal patients over age 50 have a single S2 or at most a narrow physiologic split on inspiration because P2 occurs early. A single second sound, however, is usually due to inability to auscultate a relatively soft pulmonic component. Such inability is rare in healthy infants, children, and young adults and is uncommon even in older persons under good auscultatory conditions using a rigid stethoscopic diaphragm.

HP_6000226.definition: The gradient (in this case, drop) in pressure across the aortic valve is above the upper limit of normal.

HP_6000228.label: failure to increase oxygen saturation on hyperoxia test
HP_6000228.definition: Hyperoxia test is the initial method to distinguish critical congenital heart disease (CCHD) from pulmonary disease. The test consists in measuring an arterial blood gas at room air and 100% inspired oxygen after 10 minutes. Neonates with congenital heart disease are usually not able to increase PaO2 above 100 mm Hg during 100% oxygen administration. In patients with pulmonary disease, PaO2 generally increased greater than or equal to 100 mm Hg with 100% oxygen as ventilation-perfusion discrepancies are overcome. A positive result indicates the cardiac origin and further cardiac workup is indicated to rule out CCHD.

HP_6000232.label: splenic necrosis
